# CargoVerse — 3D logistics operations on Oracle

A warehouse and logistics operations system:
- an isometric 3D map of a whole logistics park: three CargoVerse sites, ten neighbouring companies
  (plants, warehouses, a cold store, offices, a fuel station, the port container terminal), the
  highway and park roads with moving traffic;
- **imports and exports you can watch**: trucks bring goods in from the port through the West Gate,
  unload at the docks, and loaded trucks leave through the East Gate. Every gate pass is logged in Oracle;
- **a working container port**: ships arrive, wait at anchor, berth, and four quay cranes lift import
  containers off into the import stack and load export containers on. CargoVerse trucks collect import
  containers at the terminal and bring export containers to it. Every container move is in Oracle;
- **a town with vendor stores and supermarkets**: shoppers empty the shelves, stores reorder from the
  warehouses, and CargoVerse delivery vans load at the sites, drive to the stores and unload;
- sign-in with three access roles (Administrator, Operations Manager, Operator);
- work assigned to staff according to their job;
- a permanent audit trail. Everything is stored in **Oracle Database**.

```
Browser (React + Three.js)  ──HTTP / live stream──▶  Node API server  ──node-oracledb──▶  Oracle Database
   login · 3D yard · tasks                          auth · roles · live ops              tables · PL/SQL · triggers · views
```

## Quick start on a Mac (Apple Silicon or Intel)

You need Node.js 18+ and Docker Desktop (or Colima) for the Oracle container.

```bash
cd ~/Projects/waretrack
npm install                 # installs React, Three.js, Vite and the Oracle driver
cp .env.example .env        # then set SESSION_SECRET to any long random text
npm run db:up               # starts Oracle Database Free in Docker (first start: ~1–2 min)
npm run db:setup            # creates tables, PL/SQL, views and loads the seed data
                            # (already set up an older version? run npm run db:reset — it recreates everything)
npm run dev                 # API on :4000 + website on http://localhost:5173
```

Sign in with one of the demo accounts (shown on the login page):

| Role | Username | Password | Can do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Administrator | `admin` | `Admin@123` | Everything; manage users, roles and site access; full audit history |
| Operations Manager | `alex.chen` (Riverside + Southfield), `meera.iyer` (Northgate) | `Manager@123` | Assign and track work at their sites; see their sites' activity; reports; pause/speed operations |
| Operator | `zoe.reyes`, `dana.brooks`, `carla.mendes`, `sam.patel` | `Operator@123` | See their site; start, block and complete their own tasks |

Change these passwords (Users tab, signed in as admin) before showing the system to anyone else.

## Finding your way around

- The first view is the **whole park**. The map button (under the zoom controls) returns to it, the
  house button goes back to the current site, and the panels button hides the panels for a map-only view.
- Click anything: a site, a truck, a forklift, a neighbouring company's building, a car, a park gate.
  Each one opens a panel built from its database record. Trucks on the roads carry a tag: green for
  imports (goods in), orange for exports (goods out), grey when empty.
- **Work → Imports/Exports**: today's imports and exports per site (`v_trade_today`) and the gate log.
- **The port** (click the terminal, a ship or a crane): ships and their cargo, berths, cranes and the
  stacks. Managers and administrators can hold a ship at anchor or alongside, and close a berth.
- **The stores** (click a supermarket or shop in town): shelf stock per product with the reorder line,
  orders on the way and the van bringing them. Managers and administrators can place a restock order.
- **Work → Port & stores**: ships and port calls, the container log (search a container number to see
  its whole journey), stock across every store, and all store orders.
- **Work → Park**: the tenant directory. Administrators can edit a building's status, staff and lease.
  The change runs `WT_PARK.UPDATE_BUILDING` in Oracle and is audited.
- **Work → Database** (administrators and managers): browse every table, its columns, keys,
  constraints and rows, and the views, triggers and packages. Administrators also get a read-only
  **SQL console** with the example queries from `05_reports.sql`, and a log of the SQL the server runs.

## AI agents

Two agents sit in the **Work** panel (and the ✦ button in the header):

- **Exception watcher (Alerts tab — managers and admins).** It re-checks live operations every few seconds for:
  - shipments that will miss their promised time;
  - forklifts under 30 % battery in the middle of a job;
  - trucks held at the gate;
  - products below their reorder level;
  - blocked tasks.

  Each warning has a suggested task. **Create task** assigns it to the least-busy person with the right job at that site, e.g. the inventory clerk for low stock. No API key needed.
- **Operations assistant (Assistant tab — every role).** It can also answer questions about imports, exports and park tenants. Ask in plain language ("Which shipments are at risk?", "What should I do next?"). It uses Claude with tools that read the live data, can move the 3D view to what it is talking about, and — for managers, only when asked — creates tasks. Every tool is limited to the user's role and sites, and anything it creates is recorded in the audit trail like any other change.

  To turn it on, put `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=…` in `.env` and restart. The key stays on the server.

## Other commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev:memory` | Run without Oracle (in-memory store saved to `.data/`), handy for UI work |
| `npm run build` then `npm start` | Production build; the API also serves the website on http://localhost:4000 |
| `npm run typecheck` | TypeScript checks for the website and the server |
| `npm run db:reset` | Drop and recreate the schema with fresh seed data (**deletes all data**) |
| `npm run db:gen-seed` | Regenerate `db/oracle/04_seed.sql` from the app's seed data |
| `npm run db:down` | Stop the Oracle container (data is kept in a Docker volume) |

Using an existing Oracle install instead of Docker? Run `db/oracle/00_create_user.sql` as `SYSTEM`,
set `ORACLE_CONNECT_STRING` (e.g. `localhost:1521/XEPDB1`) in `.env`, then `npm run db:setup`.
The scripts also run by hand in SQL Developer in order 01 → 04.

## Project layout

```
db/oracle/        SQL scripts: schema, PL/SQL packages & triggers, views, seed, sample reports
docs/DATABASE.md  ER diagram, normalization, constraints, PL/SQL API, roles & rights
server/           Node API: auth (scrypt + sessions), role checks, Oracle repository, live operations host
  db/oracle.ts    Oracle implementation (node-oracledb Thin mode — no Oracle client install needed)
  db/memory.ts    Same rules in memory, for development/tests without a database
src/              Website: login, 3D scene, dashboard panels, Work panel (tasks, activity, team, reports, users)
```

All operational figures are demonstration data that the system generates and stores; there is no
connection to real carriers or customers.

# CargoVerse database (Oracle)

CargoVerse stores everything in an Oracle database: people and their access rights,
the fleet, shipments, inventory, the work assigned to staff, and a permanent history
of every change. The scripts live in `db/oracle/` and work on Oracle Database 19c, 21c
and 23ai (including the free editions).

| Script | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `00_create_user.sql` | Optional: creates the `WARETRACK` schema owner (run as `SYSTEM`) |
| `01_schema.sql` | 44 tables with primary/foreign keys, check constraints, identity columns, virtual columns, function-based unique indexes and comments |
| `02_plsql.sql` | Packages `WT_CORE`, `WT_AUTH`, `WT_WORK`, `WT_PARK`, `WT_PORT`, `WT_RETAIL` and 14 triggers |
| `03_views.sql` | 17 views used by the KPIs, reports, the park directory, the import/export log, the port and the stores |
| `04_seed.sql` | Seed data (generated from the app's data by `npm run db:gen-seed`) |
| `05_reports.sql` | 25 sample queries: joins, ROLLUP, HAVING, window functions, PIVOT, anti-joins, MINUS, date arithmetic and the PL/SQL API. They also appear in the app's SQL console |
| `99_drop_all.sql` | Removes every CargoVerse object |

## The logistics park, imports and exports

The three CargoVerse sites sit in the **Harborside Logistics Park** with ten other companies:
a car-parts plant, a bottling plant, a solar-panel factory, a cold store, a medical-supplies
warehouse, a grocery warehouse, an office tower, a fuel station, the park authority and the
Port Newark container terminal. All of these are rows in the database:

| Table | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `PARK_COMPANIES` | Tenants, their industry, contact and brand colour. At most one company is the logistics operator (function-based unique index `UX_COMPANY_OPERATOR`) |
| `PARK_BUILDINGS` | Every building on the map: position, size, floors, staff, status and lease. `FLOOR_AREA_M2` is a virtual column. Rows with `FACILITY_ID` are CargoVerse's own sites |
| `PARK_ROUTES`, `PARK_VEHICLES` | The roads' traffic: cars, vans, a shuttle bus, tenants' trucks and public traffic, each on a route at a speed |
| `PARK_GATES` | The West Gate (imports in) and East Gate (exports out) |
| `PARK_GATE_LOG` | **Every CargoVerse truck through a gate**: direction, `IMPORT` / `EXPORT` / `EMPTY`, product and pallets |

Rules in the database:
- `CK_GL_GATE_DIR`: trucks only enter at the West Gate and leave at the East Gate.
- `CK_GL_CARGO`: an import must come in loaded, an export must leave loaded, and an empty
  move carries 0 pallets.
- `TRG_GATE_LOG_AI` keeps `FACILITIES.IMPORTS_TODAY / EXPORTS_TODAY` (and the pallet counts) in
  step with the log, the same way the stock ledger keeps stock totals.
- `WT_PARK.UPDATE_BUILDING` needs `MANAGE_PARK` and refuses to mark a running CargoVerse
  site as vacant or under construction. Leases cannot end before they start.
  `TRG_PARK_BUILDINGS_AUDIT` writes every change to the audit log.
- `V_TRADE_TODAY` (imports vs exports per site), `V_GATE_LOG` and `V_PARK_DIRECTORY` feed the
  dashboards.

## The container port

Ships call at the Port Newark terminal on the bay; four quay cranes work the two berths.

| Table | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `SHIPPING_LINES` | Lines whose boxes pass through, with the ISO 6346 owner code (`CK_LINE_OWNER`: line code + `U`) |
| `PORT_BERTHS` | The two berths, open or closed, and the ship alongside |
| `VESSELS` | Each ship: line, IMO number, status (`AT_SEA` → `ARRIVING` → `ANCHORED` → `BERTHING` → `BERTHED` → `DEPARTING`), boxes to discharge and loaded, hold flag, position |
| `QUAY_CRANES` | Crane per berth, what it is doing and its moves today |
| `VESSEL_CALLS` | One row per port call: berthed, sailed, boxes off and on. `CALL_STATUS` is a virtual column |
| `CONTAINER_MOVES` | **The container ledger**: every lift off a ship (`DISCHARGE`), onto a ship (`LOAD`), and every box through the terminal gate (`GATE_OUT` by truck to a warehouse, `GATE_IN` for export). `LINE_CODE` is a virtual column with a foreign key to `SHIPPING_LINES` |
| `YARD_BLOCKS`, `YARD_CONTAINERS` | The import and export stacks and the boxes in them now |

Rules in the database:
- `TRG_CONTAINER_MOVES_BI` rejects any container number whose ISO 6346 check digit is wrong
  (`WT_PORT.CHECK_DIGIT` computes it in PL/SQL).
- `TRG_CONTAINER_MOVES_AI` keeps `YARD_CONTAINERS` in step with the ledger: discharged and gated-in
  boxes are stacked, loaded and gated-out boxes leave the stack.
- `CK_MOVE_SHIP`: ship moves need a ship and a crane; gate moves have neither.
- `WT_PORT.LOG_CALL` opens and closes `VESSEL_CALLS`; `WT_PORT.SET_VESSEL_HOLD` and
  `WT_PORT.SET_BERTH_OPEN` need `MANAGE_PORT`, keep at least one berth open and write the audit log.
- `SHIPMENTS.TRADE_LANE` / `CONTAINER_NO` (and `TRUCKS.TRADE_LANE`) mark sea freight: an import
  collected at the terminal or an export taken there, with `CK_SHIP_CONTAINER` requiring a valid
  container number for `SEA` and none for `ROAD`.
- Views: `V_VESSEL_SCHEDULE`, `V_PORT_BERTHS`, `V_YARD_SUMMARY`, `V_CONTAINER_MOVES`.

## Vendor stores and deliveries

| Table | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `STORES` | Supermarkets and shops in Port Harbor, the building they occupy and their usual supplying warehouse |
| `STORE_STOCK` | Shelf stock per store and product, reorder point, maximum, sales rate. `STOCK_STATUS` is a virtual column (`OK` / `REORDER` / `EMPTY`) |
| `STORE_ORDERS` | Restock orders on the warehouses: `PLACED` → `LOADING` → `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` → `DELIVERED` (or `CANCELLED`), automatic or placed by a manager |
| `STORE_ORDER_HISTORY` | Every status change of every order (written by `TRG_STORE_ORDERS_AIU`) |
| `DELIVERY_VANS` | CargoVerse vans and box trucks, their depot, status and current order |

Rules in the database:
- `FK_SO_LINE` is a composite foreign key `(STORE_ID, SKU_ID)` onto `STORE_STOCK`: a store can only
  order products it sells.
- `CK_SO_VAN`: an order being loaded or delivered must have a van; `CK_VAN_ORDER`: a van is idle
  exactly when it has no order.
- Loading a van takes the units off the warehouse through the stock ledger
  (`STOCK_MOVEMENTS.REASON = 'STORE_SHIP'`), so `TRG_STOCK_MOVEMENTS_AI` updates `INVENTORY`.
- `TRG_STORE_ORDERS_BIU` stamps dispatch and delivery times.
- `WT_RETAIL.PLACE_ORDER` / `CANCEL_ORDER` need `MANAGE_RETAIL`, refuse a second open order for
  the same shelf line, check the warehouse has the units, and write the audit log.
  `WT_RETAIL.BEST_SUPPLIER` and `WT_RETAIL.COVER_HOURS` are helper functions.
- Views: `V_STORE_STOCK`, `V_STORE_ORDERS`, `V_DELIVERY_FLEET`. Reports 19–26 in `05_reports.sql`
  cover port throughput, turnaround, container tracing, yard occupancy, store stock and deliveries.

## Database workspace in the app

Administrators and managers have a **Database** tab in the Work panel:
- **Tables**: every table with its row count, columns, keys, constraints, indexes and first rows,
  read live from Oracle's data dictionary (`USER_TABLES`, `USER_TAB_COLS`,
  `USER_CONSTRAINTS`…). It also shows the compile status of every view, trigger and package.
- **SQL console** (administrators only): runs one `SELECT` / `WITH` statement inside
  `SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY`, so Oracle itself rejects any change. The console caps results at 500
  rows and cancels a query after 15 s. Every query is recorded in the audit log, and
  the examples from `05_reports.sql` are one click away.
- **SQL activity**: the statements the server has sent to Oracle, with timings, including
  the live-operations writes every 2 seconds.

## Design notes

**Normalization.** The schema is in third normal form. Lookups are separate tables:
roles, permissions, job titles, carriers, drivers and SKUs. Many-to-many relationships
use junction tables (`ROLE_PERMISSIONS`, `USER_FACILITY_ACCESS`). Facts depend only on
their key: a truck row holds the truck's own data, and the carrier name lives in
`CARRIERS`.

**Controlled denormalization.** `FACILITIES.STOCK_PALLETS` and `INVENTORY.UNITS` are
running totals. They are never written directly. Every change is a row in
`STOCK_MOVEMENTS`, and the trigger `TRG_STOCK_MOVEMENTS_AI` keeps the totals in step,
so stock is always traceable to its movements. Report 5 rebuilds the running total from
the ledger with a window function.

**People vs. accounts.** `EMPLOYEES` holds who someone is and their job (Forklift
Operator, Dock Supervisor…). `APP_USERS` holds how they sign in and their access role
(Administrator, Manager, Operator). An employee can exist without a login, for example
a driver. Access rights come from the role (`ROLE_PERMISSIONS`) plus the sites granted
in `USER_FACILITY_ACCESS`.

**Integrity rules enforced by the database:**
- Check constraints: valid statuses and priorities; cargo between 0 and capacity;
  battery 0–100 %; stock ≥ 0; lower-case usernames; scrypt-format password hashes;
  JSON columns validated with `IS JSON`.
- `CK_TASK_ASSIGNED`: a task that is assigned, in progress, blocked or done must have
  an assignee.
- `UX_PALLET_SLOT`: a function-based unique index, so a yard slot holds one pallet at a time.
- `CK_PAL_PLACE`: a pallet is either in a yard slot or on a forklift, never both. The
  virtual column `PALLET_STATUS` derives STAGED / IN_TRANSIT from that.
- Circular references (truck ↔ dock, forklift ↔ pallet, truck ↔ current shipment) use
  `DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED` foreign keys, so a whole state change commits atomically.

**Business rules in PL/SQL.** The API calls these procedures instead of updating
tables directly, so the same rules apply no matter which client changes the data:

| Procedure | Rule it enforces |
| --- | --- |
| `WT_WORK.CREATE_TASK` | Caller needs `MANAGE_TASKS` and access to the site; the assignee must be an active employee of that site |
| `WT_WORK.CHANGE_STATUS` | Allowed transitions only (e.g. ASSIGNED → IN_PROGRESS → DONE). Operators may only move their own tasks, and only Start / Block / Resume / Complete |
| `WT_WORK.ASSIGN` | Managers re-assign within their sites; closed tasks cannot be re-assigned |
| `WT_AUTH.CREATE_USER` / `UPDATE_USER` | Needs `MANAGE_USERS`; admins cannot deactivate or demote themselves; deactivating revokes the user's sessions |
| `WT_AUTH.RECORD_LOGIN` / `CREATE_SESSION` / `REVOKE_SESSION` | Sign-in history, failed attempts and sessions |

Errors come back as `ORA-20001…20006`, and the API turns them into clear messages.

**Audit trail.** At the start of each transaction the API runs
`DBMS_SESSION.SET_IDENTIFIER(user_id)`. The audit triggers on `TASKS`, `APP_USERS`,
`USER_FACILITY_ACCESS`, `EMPLOYEES` and `SIM_STATE` read it through
`SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CLIENT_IDENTIFIER')`. Every human change is therefore written
to `AUDIT_LOG` together with who made it, inside the same transaction. Password hashes
are never written to the log. Administrators see the full log. Managers see entries for
their own sites (`V_AUDIT_FEED`).

**Operations data.** The server runs the live yard: trucks, docks, forklifts and pallets.
Every 2 seconds it writes changes in one transaction:
- `MERGE` for shipments and pallets;
- `UPDATE` for trucks, forklifts, docks and chargers;
- `INSERT` into the `STOCK_MOVEMENTS` and `OPERATION_EVENTS` ledgers.

Trucks passing a park gate add a row to `PARK_GATE_LOG` in the same transaction.
On restart it rebuilds the yard from these tables. When a forklift starts on a truck,
the server calls `WT_WORK.CREATE_TASK` to give that forklift's operator an
Unload or Load task. When the truck is finished, the task is completed.

## Roles and rights

| Permission | Administrator | Manager | Operator |
| --- | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| View live dashboard | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Access every site | ✓ | assigned sites | home site |
| Create / assign / cancel tasks | ✓ | ✓ | – |
| Start / block / complete own tasks | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| See audit history | all sites | own sites | – |
| Team & workload, SQL reports | ✓ | ✓ | – |
| Pause / resume / speed up operations | ✓ | ✓ | – |
| Create users, change roles and site access, reset passwords | ✓ | – | – |
| Imports / exports and the park directory | all sites | own sites | own site |
| Edit park tenants (status, staff, lease) | ✓ | – | – |
| Browse the database schema (Database tab) | ✓ | ✓ | – |
| Run SQL in the read-only console, see SQL activity | ✓ | – | – |

**Sign-in.** Passwords are stored as scrypt hashes. "Keep me signed in" sessions last
30 days and are renewed each time they're used, so an active user stays signed in
indefinitely. Signing out, or an admin deactivating the account, ends the session
straight away.

## Connecting with SQL Developer

* Host `localhost`, port `1521`, service name `FREEPDB1`
* User `waretrack`, password `WareTrack_2026` (or what you set in `docker-compose.yml` / `.env`)

The project was once called WareTrack. The database user, its password, the Docker container
(`waretrack-oracle`) and volume keep that original name so existing databases and connections
keep working; so do internal keys such as the company id `WARETRACK` and carrier `WareTrack`.

Then open `db/oracle/05_reports.sql` and run the queries.

====================================================================================================
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Optional: create the WARETRACK schema owner. Run as SYSTEM connected to the
-- pluggable database (e.g. FREEPDB1 / XEPDB1). Not needed with the Docker setup,
-- which creates the user automatically (APP_USER / APP_USER_PASSWORD).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE USER waretrack IDENTIFIED BY "WareTrack_2026" DEFAULT TABLESPACE users QUOTA UNLIMITED ON users;
GRANT CREATE SESSION, CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, CREATE SEQUENCE, CREATE PROCEDURE, CREATE TRIGGER TO waretrack;

====================================================================================================
FILE: waretrack/db/oracle/01_schema.sql
====================================================================================================
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CargoVerse logistics database — schema (Oracle Database 19c / 21c / 23ai)
-- Run as the application schema owner (e.g. WARETRACK). Order of scripts:
--   00_create_user.sql (as SYSTEM, optional)  01_schema.sql  02_plsql.sql
--   03_views.sql  04_seed.sql  05_reports.sql (sample queries)
-- 99_drop_all.sql removes everything.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET DEFINE OFF

-- ============================================================================
-- 1. Security: roles, permissions, job titles
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE roles (
  role_code     VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_roles PRIMARY KEY,
  role_name     VARCHAR2(60)  NOT NULL,
  description   VARCHAR2(400),
  CONSTRAINT ck_roles_code CHECK (role_code IN ('ADMIN', 'MANAGER', 'OPERATOR'))
);

CREATE TABLE permissions (
  perm_code     VARCHAR2(40)  CONSTRAINT pk_permissions PRIMARY KEY,
  description   VARCHAR2(400) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE role_permissions (
  role_code     VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_rp_role REFERENCES roles (role_code),
  perm_code     VARCHAR2(40)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_rp_perm REFERENCES permissions (perm_code),
  CONSTRAINT pk_role_permissions PRIMARY KEY (role_code, perm_code)
);

CREATE TABLE job_titles (
  job_code          VARCHAR2(30)   CONSTRAINT pk_job_titles PRIMARY KEY,
  title             VARCHAR2(80)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_job_title UNIQUE,
  responsibilities  VARCHAR2(1000)
);

-- ============================================================================
-- 2. Facilities and people
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE facilities (
  facility_id           VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT pk_facilities PRIMARY KEY,
  name                  VARCHAR2(80)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_facility_name UNIQUE,
  short_name            VARCHAR2(40)  NOT NULL,
  facility_kind         VARCHAR2(30)  NOT NULL,
  address               VARCHAR2(200) NOT NULL,
  capacity_pallets      NUMBER(8)     NOT NULL,
  stock_pallets         NUMBER(8)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,   -- maintained by trg_stock_movements_ai
  stock_start_pallets   NUMBER(8)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,   -- stock at shift start (for the delta KPI)
  outbound_today        NUMBER(6)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  putaways_today        NUMBER(6)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  otd_prev_pct          NUMBER(5,2)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,   -- on-time % of the previous period
  trucks_on_site_start  NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  imports_today         NUMBER(6)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,   -- trucks that brought goods in (trg_gate_log_ai)
  import_pallets_today  NUMBER(8)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  exports_today         NUMBER(6)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,   -- trucks that took goods out (trg_gate_log_ai)
  export_pallets_today  NUMBER(8)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_fac_kind     CHECK (facility_kind IN ('Depot', 'Cross-dock', 'Distribution center')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_fac_capacity CHECK (capacity_pallets > 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_fac_stock    CHECK (stock_pallets >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_fac_otd      CHECK (otd_prev_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
);

CREATE TABLE employees (
  employee_id   NUMBER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_employees PRIMARY KEY,
  full_name     VARCHAR2(80)  NOT NULL,
  email         VARCHAR2(120) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_emp_email UNIQUE,
  phone         VARCHAR2(30),
  job_code      VARCHAR2(30)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_emp_job REFERENCES job_titles (job_code),
  facility_id   VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT fk_emp_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  hired_on      DATE          DEFAULT TRUNC(SYSDATE) NOT NULL,
  emp_status    VARCHAR2(12)  DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_emp_status CHECK (emp_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ON_LEAVE', 'INACTIVE')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_emp_email  CHECK (email LIKE '%_@_%._%')
);
CREATE INDEX ix_emp_facility ON employees (facility_id);

CREATE TABLE app_users (
  user_id         NUMBER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_app_users PRIMARY KEY,
  username        VARCHAR2(40)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_username UNIQUE,
  password_hash   VARCHAR2(200) NOT NULL,
  role_code       VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_user_role REFERENCES roles (role_code),
  employee_id     NUMBER        NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_user_employee UNIQUE
                                CONSTRAINT fk_user_employee REFERENCES employees (employee_id),
  is_active       CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'Y' NOT NULL,
  created_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_by      NUMBER        CONSTRAINT fk_user_creator REFERENCES app_users (user_id),
  last_login_at   TIMESTAMP,
  failed_logins   NUMBER(3)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_user_active   CHECK (is_active IN ('Y', 'N')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_user_lower    CHECK (username = LOWER(username)),
  CONSTRAINT ck_user_hash     CHECK (password_hash LIKE 'scrypt$%')
);

-- Which facilities a user may work with (admins are granted all by permission).
CREATE TABLE user_facility_access (
  user_id       NUMBER       NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_ufa_user REFERENCES app_users (user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  facility_id   VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_ufa_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  granted_at    TIMESTAMP    DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT pk_user_facility_access PRIMARY KEY (user_id, facility_id)
);

-- Login sessions ("remember me" sessions last 30 days and are renewed on use).
CREATE TABLE user_sessions (
  session_id    VARCHAR2(64)  CONSTRAINT pk_user_sessions PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id       NUMBER        NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_sess_user REFERENCES app_users (user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at    TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at  TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  expires_at    TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
  revoked       CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL,
  remember_me   CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL,
  user_agent    VARCHAR2(200),
  CONSTRAINT ck_sess_revoked  CHECK (revoked IN ('Y', 'N')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_sess_remember CHECK (remember_me IN ('Y', 'N'))
);
CREATE INDEX ix_sess_user ON user_sessions (user_id);

-- ============================================================================
-- 3. Logistics master data
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE carriers (
  carrier_id    VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_carriers PRIMARY KEY,
  name          VARCHAR2(60)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_carrier_name UNIQUE,
  display_name  VARCHAR2(80)  NOT NULL,
  phone         VARCHAR2(30)
);

CREATE TABLE drivers (
  driver_id     NUMBER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_drivers PRIMARY KEY,
  carrier_id    VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_driver_carrier REFERENCES carriers (carrier_id),
  full_name     VARCHAR2(80)  NOT NULL,
  license_no    VARCHAR2(30)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_driver_license UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE skus (
  sku_id            VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_skus PRIMARY KEY,
  name              VARCHAR2(80)  NOT NULL,
  category          VARCHAR2(40)  NOT NULL,
  units_per_pallet  NUMBER(6)     NOT NULL,
  kg_per_pallet     NUMBER(8,2)   NOT NULL,
  pallet_look       VARCHAR2(12)  DEFAULT 'cardboard' NOT NULL,
  icon              VARCHAR2(12)  DEFAULT 'box' NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_sku_units CHECK (units_per_pallet > 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_sku_kg    CHECK (kg_per_pallet > 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_sku_look  CHECK (pallet_look IN ('cardboard', 'blue', 'white'))
);

CREATE TABLE inventory (
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_inv_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  sku_id          VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_inv_sku REFERENCES skus (sku_id),
  units           NUMBER(10)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,      -- maintained by trg_stock_movements_ai
  reorder_level   NUMBER(10)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  display_order   NUMBER(3)    DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT pk_inventory PRIMARY KEY (facility_id, sku_id),
  CONSTRAINT ck_inv_units CHECK (units >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_inv_reorder CHECK (reorder_level >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE docks (
  dock_id       VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_docks PRIMARY KEY,
  facility_id   VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_dock_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  dock_name     VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL,
  dock_kind     VARCHAR2(4)   NOT NULL,
  description   VARCHAR2(120),
  truck_id      VARCHAR2(20),                       -- booked/occupying truck (FK added below)
  trucks_today  NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT uq_dock_name UNIQUE (facility_id, dock_name),
  CONSTRAINT ck_dock_kind CHECK (dock_kind IN ('IN', 'OUT', 'ANY'))
);

CREATE TABLE chargers (
  charger_id      VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_chargers PRIMARY KEY,
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_chg_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  description     VARCHAR2(120) NOT NULL,
  sessions_today  NUMBER(5)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  energy_kwh      NUMBER(9,2)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  rate_pct_min    NUMBER(5,2)   NOT NULL
);

-- ============================================================================
-- 4. Fleet: trucks, shipments, forklifts, pallets
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE trucks (
  truck_id             VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_trucks PRIMARY KEY,
  carrier_id           VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_truck_carrier REFERENCES carriers (carrier_id),
  driver_id            NUMBER        NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_truck_driver REFERENCES drivers (driver_id),
  plate                VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_truck_plate UNIQUE,
  facility_id          VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_truck_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  direction            VARCHAR2(8)   NOT NULL,
  capacity_pallets     NUMBER(3)     NOT NULL,
  cargo_pallets        NUMBER(3)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  status               VARCHAR2(12)  NOT NULL,
  dock_id              VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT fk_truck_dock REFERENCES docks (dock_id),
  current_shipment_id  VARCHAR2(20),                -- FK added below
  sku_id               VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_truck_sku REFERENCES skus (sku_id),
  forklift_id          VARCHAR2(10),                -- assigned forklift, FK added below
  -- live telemetry written by the operations engine
  leg_idx              NUMBER(2)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  leg_dist             NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  pos_x                NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  pos_z                NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  heading              NUMBER(10,5)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  speed                NUMBER(8,3)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  away_remaining_s     NUMBER(10,2)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  trade_lane           VARCHAR2(4)   DEFAULT 'ROAD' NOT NULL, -- SEA = this trip is a container to / from the port
  updated_at           TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_truck_lane      CHECK (trade_lane IN ('ROAD', 'SEA')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_truck_direction CHECK (direction IN ('INBOUND', 'OUTBOUND')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_truck_capacity  CHECK (capacity_pallets > 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_truck_cargo     CHECK (cargo_pallets BETWEEN 0 AND capacity_pallets),
  CONSTRAINT ck_truck_status    CHECK (status IN ('EN_ROUTE', 'AT_GATE', 'DOCKING', 'WORKING', 'READY', 'DEPARTING', 'LEAVING', 'AWAY'))
);
CREATE INDEX ix_truck_facility ON trucks (facility_id, status);

CREATE TABLE shipments (
  shipment_id      VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_shipments PRIMARY KEY,
  truck_id         VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_ship_truck REFERENCES trucks (truck_id),
  facility_id      VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_ship_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  direction        VARCHAR2(8)   NOT NULL,
  customer         VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
  destination      VARCHAR2(120) NOT NULL,
  sku_id           VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_ship_sku REFERENCES skus (sku_id),
  pallets          NUMBER(3)     NOT NULL,
  -- operational clock (seconds since midnight of the operations day)
  confirmed_s      NUMBER(7)     NOT NULL,
  picked_s         NUMBER(7)     NOT NULL,
  loaded_s         NUMBER(7),
  transit_s        NUMBER(7),
  delivered_s      NUMBER(7),
  promised_s       NUMBER(7)     NOT NULL,
  transit_minutes  NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  on_time          CHAR(1),                         -- derived by trg_shipments_biu
  ship_status      VARCHAR2(12)  DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL, -- derived by trg_shipments_biu
  trade_lane       VARCHAR2(4)   DEFAULT 'ROAD' NOT NULL,  -- SEA = travels in a container through the port
  container_no     VARCHAR2(11),                          -- ISO 6346 container number (sea freight)
  created_at       TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  delivered_ts     TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT ck_ship_lane      CHECK (trade_lane IN ('ROAD', 'SEA')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_ship_container CHECK ((trade_lane = 'ROAD' AND container_no IS NULL)
                                   OR (trade_lane = 'SEA' AND REGEXP_LIKE(container_no, '^[A-Z]{3}U[0-9]{7}$'))),
  CONSTRAINT ck_ship_direction CHECK (direction IN ('INBOUND', 'OUTBOUND')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_ship_pallets   CHECK (pallets > 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_ship_on_time   CHECK (on_time IN ('Y', 'N')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_ship_status    CHECK (ship_status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'DELIVERED')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_ship_order     CHECK (picked_s >= 0 AND confirmed_s >= 0)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_ship_facility ON shipments (facility_id, delivered_ts);
CREATE INDEX ix_ship_truck ON shipments (truck_id);

ALTER TABLE trucks ADD CONSTRAINT fk_truck_shipment
  FOREIGN KEY (current_shipment_id) REFERENCES shipments (shipment_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;
ALTER TABLE docks ADD CONSTRAINT fk_dock_truck
  FOREIGN KEY (truck_id) REFERENCES trucks (truck_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;

CREATE TABLE forklifts (
  forklift_id    VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT pk_forklifts PRIMARY KEY,
  facility_id    VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_fl_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  model          VARCHAR2(60)  NOT NULL,
  operator_id    NUMBER        CONSTRAINT fk_fl_operator REFERENCES employees (employee_id),
  charger_id     VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_fl_charger UNIQUE
                               CONSTRAINT fk_fl_charger REFERENCES chargers (charger_id),
  battery_pct    NUMBER(5,2)   NOT NULL,
  task_state     VARCHAR2(12)  NOT NULL,
  truck_id       VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT fk_fl_truck REFERENCES trucks (truck_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  pallet_id      VARCHAR2(20),                       -- FK added below
  moves_today    NUMBER(5)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  pos_x          NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  pos_z          NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  heading        NUMBER(10,5)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  timer_s        NUMBER(8,3)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  pick_json      VARCHAR2(200),
  drop_json      VARCHAR2(200),
  updated_at     TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_fl_battery CHECK (battery_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  CONSTRAINT ck_fl_state   CHECK (task_state IN ('IDLE', 'CHARGING', 'TO_PICK', 'LIFTING', 'TO_DROP', 'DROPPING', 'TO_HOME')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_fl_pick    CHECK (pick_json IS JSON),
  CONSTRAINT ck_fl_drop    CHECK (drop_json IS JSON)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_fl_facility ON forklifts (facility_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_fl_operator ON forklifts (operator_id);

ALTER TABLE trucks ADD CONSTRAINT fk_truck_forklift
  FOREIGN KEY (forklift_id) REFERENCES forklifts (forklift_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;

CREATE TABLE pallets (
  pallet_id       VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_pallets PRIMARY KEY,
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_pal_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  sku_id          VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_pal_sku REFERENCES skus (sku_id),
  qty             NUMBER(6)     NOT NULL,
  weight_kg       NUMBER(8,2)   NOT NULL,
  lot_no          VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL,
  received_label  VARCHAR2(40)  NOT NULL,
  yard_slot       NUMBER(3),
  forklift_id     VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT fk_pal_forklift REFERENCES forklifts (forklift_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  is_featured     CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL,
  is_reserved     CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL,
  pallet_status   VARCHAR2(12)  GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
                    CASE WHEN yard_slot IS NOT NULL THEN 'STAGED'
                         WHEN forklift_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'IN_TRANSIT'
                         ELSE 'UNPLACED' END) VIRTUAL,
  created_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_pal_qty      CHECK (qty > 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pal_place    CHECK (yard_slot IS NULL OR forklift_id IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pal_featured CHECK (is_featured IN ('Y', 'N')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pal_reserved CHECK (is_reserved IN ('Y', 'N'))
);
-- One pallet per yard slot per facility (rows without a slot are not indexed).
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_pallet_slot ON pallets (
  CASE WHEN yard_slot IS NOT NULL THEN facility_id END,
  CASE WHEN yard_slot IS NOT NULL THEN yard_slot END);

ALTER TABLE forklifts ADD CONSTRAINT fk_fl_pallet
  FOREIGN KEY (pallet_id) REFERENCES pallets (pallet_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;

-- Stock ledger: every change to stock is a row here; triggers keep totals in sync.
CREATE TABLE stock_movements (
  movement_id     NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_stock_movements PRIMARY KEY,
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_sm_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  sku_id          VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT fk_sm_sku REFERENCES skus (sku_id),
  pallets_delta   NUMBER(8)     NOT NULL,
  units_delta     NUMBER(10)    DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  reason          VARCHAR2(12)  NOT NULL,
  pallet_id       VARCHAR2(20),
  shipment_id     VARCHAR2(20),
  forklift_id     VARCHAR2(10),
  sim_time_s      NUMBER(7),
  created_by      NUMBER        CONSTRAINT fk_sm_user REFERENCES app_users (user_id),
  created_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_sm_reason CHECK (reason IN ('OPENING', 'RECEIPT', 'PUTAWAY', 'PICK', 'RETURN', 'ADJUSTMENT', 'STORE_SHIP'))
);
CREATE INDEX ix_sm_facility ON stock_movements (facility_id, created_at);

-- ============================================================================
-- 5. Work management: tasks assigned to staff, and their status history
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE tasks (
  task_id         NUMBER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_tasks PRIMARY KEY,
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_task_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  title           VARCHAR2(160)  NOT NULL,
  description     VARCHAR2(1000),
  task_type       VARCHAR2(16)   NOT NULL,
  priority        VARCHAR2(8)    DEFAULT 'NORMAL' NOT NULL,
  task_status     VARCHAR2(12)   DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  source          VARCHAR2(8)    DEFAULT 'MANUAL' NOT NULL,
  assigned_to     NUMBER         CONSTRAINT fk_task_assignee REFERENCES employees (employee_id),
  created_by      NUMBER         CONSTRAINT fk_task_creator REFERENCES app_users (user_id),
  truck_id        VARCHAR2(20)   CONSTRAINT fk_task_truck REFERENCES trucks (truck_id),
  dock_id         VARCHAR2(20)   CONSTRAINT fk_task_dock REFERENCES docks (dock_id),
  forklift_id     VARCHAR2(10)   CONSTRAINT fk_task_forklift REFERENCES forklifts (forklift_id),
  shipment_id     VARCHAR2(20)   CONSTRAINT fk_task_shipment REFERENCES shipments (shipment_id),
  due_at          TIMESTAMP,
  created_at      TIMESTAMP      DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  started_at      TIMESTAMP,
  completed_at    TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT ck_task_type     CHECK (task_type IN ('UNLOAD', 'LOAD', 'PUTAWAY', 'CYCLE_COUNT', 'MAINTENANCE', 'DOCK_CHECK', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_task_priority CHECK (priority IN ('LOW', 'NORMAL', 'HIGH', 'URGENT')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_task_status   CHECK (task_status IN ('OPEN', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED', 'DONE', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_task_source   CHECK (source IN ('MANUAL', 'SYSTEM')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_task_assigned CHECK (task_status IN ('OPEN', 'CANCELLED') OR assigned_to IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_task_facility ON tasks (facility_id, task_status);
CREATE INDEX ix_task_assignee ON tasks (assigned_to, task_status);

CREATE TABLE task_updates (
  update_id       NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_task_updates PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id         NUMBER        NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_tu_task REFERENCES tasks (task_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id         NUMBER        CONSTRAINT fk_tu_user REFERENCES app_users (user_id),
  old_status      VARCHAR2(12),
  new_status      VARCHAR2(12)  NOT NULL,
  note            VARCHAR2(1000),
  created_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX ix_tu_task ON task_updates (task_id, created_at);

-- ============================================================================
-- 6. History: operational events (from the floor) and the audit trail (who changed what)
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE operation_events (
  event_id        NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_operation_events PRIMARY KEY,
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_oe_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  sim_time_s      NUMBER(7)     NOT NULL,
  message         VARCHAR2(300) NOT NULL,
  entity_kind     VARCHAR2(12),
  entity_id       VARCHAR2(20),
  created_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX ix_oe_facility ON operation_events (facility_id, event_id);

CREATE TABLE audit_log (
  audit_id        NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_audit_log PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id         NUMBER,                              -- NULL = system
  action          VARCHAR2(40)   NOT NULL,
  entity          VARCHAR2(40)   NOT NULL,
  entity_id       VARCHAR2(40),
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10),
  details         VARCHAR2(2000),
  client_info     VARCHAR2(200),
  created_at      TIMESTAMP      DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_facility ON audit_log (facility_id, audit_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_user ON audit_log (user_id, audit_id);

-- Single-row table holding the operations clock and controls.
CREATE TABLE sim_state (
  state_id        NUMBER(1)     DEFAULT 1 CONSTRAINT pk_sim_state PRIMARY KEY,
  sim_time_s      NUMBER(12,3)  NOT NULL,
  real_time_s     NUMBER(14,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  speed           NUMBER(3,1)   DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  paused          CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL,
  next_shipment   NUMBER(10)    NOT NULL,
  next_pallet     NUMBER(10)    NOT NULL,
  -- container terminal and store-delivery counters
  next_box             NUMBER(10)  DEFAULT 400000 NOT NULL,   -- next container serial number
  next_order           NUMBER(10)  DEFAULT 5000 NOT NULL,     -- next store order number
  port_moves_today     NUMBER(7)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  port_calls_today     NUMBER(5)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  port_gate_in_today   NUMBER(7)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  port_gate_out_today  NUMBER(7)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  port_ext_timer_s     NUMBER(8,2) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  updated_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_by      NUMBER,
  CONSTRAINT ck_sim_single CHECK (state_id = 1),
  CONSTRAINT ck_sim_paused CHECK (paused IN ('Y', 'N')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_sim_speed  CHECK (speed IN (1, 2, 4))
);

-- ============================================================================
-- 7. The logistics park: tenant companies, their buildings, public traffic,
--    the two park gates and the import / export log of every truck through them
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE park_companies (
  company_id      VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_park_companies PRIMARY KEY,
  name            VARCHAR2(80)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_company_name UNIQUE,
  industry        VARCHAR2(60)  NOT NULL,
  contact_name    VARCHAR2(80),
  contact_email   VARCHAR2(120),
  phone           VARCHAR2(30),
  brand_color     VARCHAR2(7)   NOT NULL,
  is_operator     CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL,     -- 'Y' = CargoVerse, which runs the logistics sites
  CONSTRAINT ck_company_color    CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(brand_color, '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_company_operator CHECK (is_operator IN ('Y', 'N')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_company_email    CHECK (contact_email IS NULL OR contact_email LIKE '%_@_%._%')
);
-- At most one company can be the park's logistics operator (function-based unique index).
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_company_operator ON park_companies (CASE WHEN is_operator = 'Y' THEN 'Y' END);

CREATE TABLE park_buildings (
  building_id     VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_park_buildings PRIMARY KEY,
  company_id      VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_pb_company REFERENCES park_companies (company_id),
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT uq_pb_facility UNIQUE
                                CONSTRAINT fk_pb_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  name            VARCHAR2(80)  NOT NULL,
  building_kind   VARCHAR2(14)  NOT NULL,
  street          VARCHAR2(60)  NOT NULL,
  pos_x           NUMBER(8,2)   NOT NULL,                 -- centre on the park map (metres)
  pos_z           NUMBER(8,2)   NOT NULL,
  width_m         NUMBER(6,1)   NOT NULL,
  depth_m         NUMBER(6,1)   NOT NULL,
  height_m        NUMBER(5,1)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  rotation_deg    NUMBER(3)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  floors          NUMBER(2)     DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  staff_count     NUMBER(5)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  bldg_status     VARCHAR2(12)  DEFAULT 'OPERATING' NOT NULL,
  lease_start     DATE          NOT NULL,
  lease_end       DATE          NOT NULL,
  description     VARCHAR2(400),
  floor_area_m2   NUMBER        GENERATED ALWAYS AS (ROUND(width_m * depth_m * floors)) VIRTUAL,
  updated_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_pb_kind     CHECK (building_kind IN ('WAREHOUSE', 'PLANT', 'OFFICE', 'COLD_STORE', 'FUEL_STATION', 'PARKING', 'GATEHOUSE',
                                                    'SERVICES', 'TERMINAL', 'SUPERMARKET', 'STORE', 'RESIDENTIAL')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pb_rotation CHECK (rotation_deg IN (0, 90, 180, 270)),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pb_size     CHECK (width_m > 0 AND depth_m > 0 AND height_m >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pb_floors   CHECK (floors BETWEEN 1 AND 60),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pb_staff    CHECK (staff_count >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pb_status   CHECK (bldg_status IN ('OPERATING', 'MAINTENANCE', 'VACANT', 'CONSTRUCTION')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pb_lease    CHECK (lease_end > lease_start),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pb_site     CHECK (facility_id IS NULL OR building_kind = 'WAREHOUSE')
);
CREATE INDEX ix_pb_company ON park_buildings (company_id);

CREATE TABLE park_routes (
  route_code      VARCHAR2(12)  CONSTRAINT pk_park_routes PRIMARY KEY,
  route_name      VARCHAR2(120) NOT NULL,
  is_loop         CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL,
  length_m        NUMBER(8,1)   NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_route_loop CHECK (is_loop IN ('Y', 'N')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_route_len  CHECK (length_m > 0)
);

-- Vehicles of tenants and public traffic using the park roads (company_id NULL = public).
CREATE TABLE park_vehicles (
  vehicle_id      VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT pk_park_vehicles PRIMARY KEY,
  company_id      VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT fk_pv_company REFERENCES park_companies (company_id),
  vehicle_kind    VARCHAR2(8)   NOT NULL,
  plate           VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_pv_plate UNIQUE,
  color_hex       VARCHAR2(7)   NOT NULL,
  route_code      VARCHAR2(12)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_pv_route REFERENCES park_routes (route_code),
  speed_kmh       NUMBER(4)     NOT NULL,
  route_offset    NUMBER(5,4)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,       -- start position along the route (0..1)
  is_active       CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'Y' NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_pv_kind   CHECK (vehicle_kind IN ('CAR', 'VAN', 'BUS', 'TRUCK', 'TANKER', 'TAXI', 'TRACTOR')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pv_color  CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(color_hex, '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pv_speed  CHECK (speed_kmh BETWEEN 5 AND 130),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pv_offset CHECK (route_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
  CONSTRAINT ck_pv_active CHECK (is_active IN ('Y', 'N'))
);
CREATE INDEX ix_pv_company ON park_vehicles (company_id);

CREATE TABLE park_gates (
  gate_code       VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT pk_park_gates PRIMARY KEY,
  name            VARCHAR2(60)  NOT NULL,
  building_id     VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_gate_building REFERENCES park_buildings (building_id),
  purpose         VARCHAR2(400),
  CONSTRAINT ck_gate_code CHECK (gate_code IN ('WEST', 'EAST'))
);

-- Every CargoVerse truck that passes a park gate: goods IN through the West Gate (imports),
-- goods OUT through the East Gate (exports). trg_gate_log_ai keeps the facility counters.
CREATE TABLE park_gate_log (
  gate_event_id   NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_park_gate_log PRIMARY KEY,
  gate_code       VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_gl_gate REFERENCES park_gates (gate_code),
  direction       VARCHAR2(3)   NOT NULL,
  trade_type      VARCHAR2(6)   NOT NULL,
  truck_id        VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_gl_truck REFERENCES trucks (truck_id),
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_gl_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  shipment_id     VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT fk_gl_shipment REFERENCES shipments (shipment_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  sku_id          VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT fk_gl_sku REFERENCES skus (sku_id),
  pallets         NUMBER(3)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  sim_time_s      NUMBER(7)     NOT NULL,
  created_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_gl_direction CHECK (direction IN ('IN', 'OUT')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_gl_trade     CHECK (trade_type IN ('IMPORT', 'EXPORT', 'EMPTY')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_gl_gate_dir  CHECK ((gate_code = 'WEST' AND direction = 'IN') OR (gate_code = 'EAST' AND direction = 'OUT')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_gl_cargo     CHECK ((trade_type = 'IMPORT' AND direction = 'IN'  AND pallets > 0)
                                 OR (trade_type = 'EXPORT' AND direction = 'OUT' AND pallets > 0)
                                 OR (trade_type = 'EMPTY' AND pallets = 0))
);
CREATE INDEX ix_gl_facility ON park_gate_log (facility_id, created_at);
CREATE INDEX ix_gl_truck ON park_gate_log (truck_id);

COMMENT ON TABLE park_companies IS 'Tenant companies of the Harborside Logistics Park';
COMMENT ON TABLE park_buildings IS 'Buildings on the park map, owned or leased by tenant companies';
COMMENT ON TABLE park_vehicles IS 'Cars, vans, buses and trucks that use the park roads';
COMMENT ON TABLE park_gate_log IS 'Import / export log: every CargoVerse truck through the park gates';

-- ============================================================================
-- 8. The container port: shipping lines, berths, quay cranes, the ships that
--    call, every container move (ledger) and the boxes currently in the yard
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE shipping_lines (
  line_code       VARCHAR2(3)   CONSTRAINT pk_shipping_lines PRIMARY KEY,
  name            VARCHAR2(60)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_line_name UNIQUE,
  owner_code      VARCHAR2(4)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_line_owner UNIQUE,   -- ISO 6346 owner code (line code + 'U')
  CONSTRAINT ck_line_code  CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(line_code, '^[A-Z]{3}$')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_line_owner CHECK (owner_code = line_code || 'U')
);

CREATE TABLE port_berths (
  berth_code      VARCHAR2(4)   CONSTRAINT pk_port_berths PRIMARY KEY,
  name            VARCHAR2(40)  NOT NULL,
  building_id     VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_berth_building REFERENCES park_buildings (building_id),
  pos_x           NUMBER(8,2)   NOT NULL,                 -- centre of the berth along the quay
  length_m        NUMBER(5)     DEFAULT 90 NOT NULL,
  is_open         CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'Y' NOT NULL,
  vessel_id       VARCHAR2(10),                           -- ship alongside or cleared in (FK added below)
  updated_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_berth_open CHECK (is_open IN ('Y', 'N')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_berth_len  CHECK (length_m > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE vessels (
  vessel_id       VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT pk_vessels PRIMARY KEY,
  name            VARCHAR2(40)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_vessel_name UNIQUE,
  line_code       VARCHAR2(3)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_vessel_line REFERENCES shipping_lines (line_code),
  imo_no          VARCHAR2(11)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_vessel_imo UNIQUE,
  flag            VARCHAR2(30)  NOT NULL,
  hull_color      VARCHAR2(7)   NOT NULL,
  capacity_boxes  NUMBER(4)     NOT NULL,
  through_boxes   NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,       -- aboard for other ports
  anchor_slot     NUMBER(2)     NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_vessel_slot UNIQUE,
  origin_port     VARCHAR2(40)  NOT NULL,
  next_port       VARCHAR2(40)  NOT NULL,
  vessel_status   VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL,
  berth_code      VARCHAR2(4)   CONSTRAINT fk_vessel_berth REFERENCES port_berths (berth_code),
  voyage_no       VARCHAR2(6)   NOT NULL,
  calls_total     NUMBER(6)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  import_boxes    NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,       -- still to discharge here
  export_boxes    NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,       -- loaded here this call
  export_target   NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  discharged      NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  loaded          NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  on_hold         CHAR(1)       DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL,     -- held by the port manager
  waited_s        NUMBER(10,2)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  timer_s         NUMBER(10,2)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  leg_dist        NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  pos_x           NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  pos_z           NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  heading         NUMBER(10,5)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  arrived_s       NUMBER(7),
  updated_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_vsl_imo    CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(imo_no, '^IMO [0-9]{7}$')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_vsl_color  CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(hull_color, '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_vsl_status CHECK (vessel_status IN ('AT_SEA', 'ARRIVING', 'ANCHORED', 'BERTHING', 'BERTHED', 'DEPARTING')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_vsl_berth  CHECK (vessel_status IN ('AT_SEA', 'ARRIVING', 'ANCHORED') OR berth_code IS NOT NULL),
  CONSTRAINT ck_vsl_hold   CHECK (on_hold IN ('Y', 'N')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_vsl_boxes  CHECK (import_boxes >= 0 AND export_boxes >= 0 AND through_boxes + export_boxes <= capacity_boxes)
);
ALTER TABLE port_berths ADD CONSTRAINT fk_berth_vessel
  FOREIGN KEY (vessel_id) REFERENCES vessels (vessel_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;

CREATE TABLE quay_cranes (
  crane_id        VARCHAR2(6)   CONSTRAINT pk_quay_cranes PRIMARY KEY,
  berth_code      VARCHAR2(4)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_crane_berth REFERENCES port_berths (berth_code),
  offset_m        NUMBER(5,1)   NOT NULL,
  crane_phase     VARCHAR2(10)  DEFAULT 'IDLE' NOT NULL,
  cycle_pct       NUMBER(6,4)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  moves_today     NUMBER(6)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  updated_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_crane_phase CHECK (crane_phase IN ('IDLE', 'DISCHARGE', 'LOAD')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_crane_cycle CHECK (cycle_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
);

-- One row per port call (written by wt_port.log_call when a ship berths and when it sails).
CREATE TABLE vessel_calls (
  call_id          NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_vessel_calls PRIMARY KEY,
  vessel_id        VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_call_vessel REFERENCES vessels (vessel_id),
  voyage_no        VARCHAR2(6)   NOT NULL,
  berth_code       VARCHAR2(4)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_call_berth REFERENCES port_berths (berth_code),
  arrived_s        NUMBER(7)     NOT NULL,
  departed_s       NUMBER(7),
  boxes_discharged NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  boxes_loaded     NUMBER(4)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  arrived_at       TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  departed_at      TIMESTAMP,
  call_status      VARCHAR2(10)  GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(CASE WHEN departed_at IS NULL THEN 'ALONGSIDE' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END AS VARCHAR2(10))) VIRTUAL,
  CONSTRAINT uq_call_voyage UNIQUE (vessel_id, voyage_no),
  CONSTRAINT ck_call_times  CHECK (departed_at IS NULL OR departed_at >= arrived_at)
);

CREATE TABLE yard_blocks (
  block_code      VARCHAR2(6)   CONSTRAINT pk_yard_blocks PRIMARY KEY,
  description     VARCHAR2(80)  NOT NULL,
  capacity_boxes  NUMBER(4)     NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_block_code CHECK (block_code IN ('IMPORT', 'EXPORT')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_block_cap  CHECK (capacity_boxes > 0)
);

-- Container ledger: every lift on or off a ship and every box through the terminal gate.
-- trg_container_moves_ai keeps YARD_CONTAINERS in step with it.
CREATE TABLE container_moves (
  move_id         NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_container_moves PRIMARY KEY,
  container_no    VARCHAR2(11)  NOT NULL,
  line_code       VARCHAR2(3)   GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(SUBSTR(container_no, 1, 3) AS VARCHAR2(3))) VIRTUAL
                                CONSTRAINT fk_move_line REFERENCES shipping_lines (line_code),
  move_type       VARCHAR2(9)   NOT NULL,
  vessel_id       VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT fk_move_vessel REFERENCES vessels (vessel_id),
  berth_code      VARCHAR2(4)   CONSTRAINT fk_move_berth REFERENCES port_berths (berth_code),
  crane_id        VARCHAR2(6)   CONSTRAINT fk_move_crane REFERENCES quay_cranes (crane_id),
  truck_id        VARCHAR2(20)  CONSTRAINT fk_move_truck REFERENCES trucks (truck_id),
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT fk_move_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  sim_time_s      NUMBER(7)     NOT NULL,
  created_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_move_no   CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(container_no, '^[A-Z]{3}U[0-9]{7}$')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_move_type CHECK (move_type IN ('DISCHARGE', 'LOAD', 'GATE_OUT', 'GATE_IN')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_move_ship CHECK ((move_type IN ('DISCHARGE', 'LOAD') AND vessel_id IS NOT NULL AND crane_id IS NOT NULL)
                              OR (move_type IN ('GATE_OUT', 'GATE_IN') AND vessel_id IS NULL AND crane_id IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT ck_move_truck CHECK (truck_id IS NULL OR facility_id IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_move_container ON container_moves (container_no, move_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_move_vessel ON container_moves (vessel_id, move_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_move_truck ON container_moves (truck_id);

-- Boxes in the stacks right now (maintained only by trg_container_moves_ai).
CREATE TABLE yard_containers (
  container_no    VARCHAR2(11)  CONSTRAINT pk_yard_containers PRIMARY KEY,
  block_code      VARCHAR2(6)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_yc_block REFERENCES yard_blocks (block_code),
  line_code       VARCHAR2(3)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_yc_line REFERENCES shipping_lines (line_code),
  vessel_id       VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT fk_yc_vessel REFERENCES vessels (vessel_id),     -- discharged from
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT fk_yc_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id), -- delivered by
  arrived_move_id NUMBER        NOT NULL,   -- the CONTAINER_MOVES row that stacked it (set by the trigger)
  arrived_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX ix_yc_block ON yard_containers (block_code, arrived_move_id);

-- ============================================================================
-- 9. Vendor stores in town, their shelf stock, the orders they place on the
--    CargoVerse warehouses and the delivery vans that restock them
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE stores (
  store_id         VARCHAR2(8)   CONSTRAINT pk_stores PRIMARY KEY,
  building_id      VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_store_building UNIQUE
                                 CONSTRAINT fk_store_building REFERENCES park_buildings (building_id),
  company_id       VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_store_company REFERENCES park_companies (company_id),
  name             VARCHAR2(60)  NOT NULL,
  store_kind       VARCHAR2(12)  NOT NULL,
  facility_id      VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_store_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id), -- usual supplier
  deliveries_today NUMBER(5)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  updated_at       TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_store_kind CHECK (store_kind IN ('SUPERMARKET', 'HARDWARE', 'OFFICE', 'PHARMACY', 'CONVENIENCE'))
);

CREATE TABLE store_stock (
  store_id        VARCHAR2(8)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_ss_store REFERENCES stores (store_id),
  sku_id          VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_ss_sku REFERENCES skus (sku_id),
  units           NUMBER(6)     NOT NULL,
  reorder_at      NUMBER(6)     NOT NULL,
  max_units       NUMBER(6)     NOT NULL,
  sales_per_hour  NUMBER(6,1)   NOT NULL,
  sold_today      NUMBER(8)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  stock_status    VARCHAR2(8)   GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(CASE WHEN units = 0 THEN 'EMPTY' WHEN units <= reorder_at THEN 'REORDER' ELSE 'OK' END AS VARCHAR2(8))) VIRTUAL,
  updated_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT pk_store_stock PRIMARY KEY (store_id, sku_id),
  CONSTRAINT ck_ss_units    CHECK (units >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_ss_levels   CHECK (reorder_at >= 0 AND reorder_at < max_units),
  CONSTRAINT ck_ss_rate     CHECK (sales_per_hour >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE delivery_vans (
  van_id          VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT pk_delivery_vans PRIMARY KEY,
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_van_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  van_kind        VARCHAR2(9)   NOT NULL,
  plate           VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_van_plate UNIQUE,
  driver_name     VARCHAR2(60)  NOT NULL,
  van_status      VARCHAR2(10)  DEFAULT 'IDLE' NOT NULL,
  order_id        VARCHAR2(12),                           -- current order (FK added below)
  store_id        VARCHAR2(8)   CONSTRAINT fk_van_store REFERENCES stores (store_id),
  leg_dist        NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  timer_s         NUMBER(8,2)   DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  pos_x           NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  pos_z           NUMBER(10,3)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  heading         NUMBER(10,5)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  trips_today     NUMBER(5)     DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  updated_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ck_van_kind   CHECK (van_kind IN ('VAN', 'BOX_TRUCK')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_van_status CHECK (van_status IN ('IDLE', 'LOADING', 'TO_STORE', 'UNLOADING', 'RETURNING')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_van_order  CHECK ((van_status = 'IDLE' AND order_id IS NULL) OR (van_status <> 'IDLE' AND order_id IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE store_orders (
  order_id        VARCHAR2(12)  CONSTRAINT pk_store_orders PRIMARY KEY,
  store_id        VARCHAR2(8)   NOT NULL,
  sku_id          VARCHAR2(20)  NOT NULL,
  facility_id     VARCHAR2(10)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_so_facility REFERENCES facilities (facility_id),
  units           NUMBER(6)     NOT NULL,
  order_status    VARCHAR2(16)  DEFAULT 'PLACED' NOT NULL,
  order_source    VARCHAR2(6)   DEFAULT 'AUTO' NOT NULL,
  placed_by       NUMBER        CONSTRAINT fk_so_user REFERENCES app_users (user_id),
  van_id          VARCHAR2(10)  CONSTRAINT fk_so_van REFERENCES delivery_vans (van_id),
  placed_s        NUMBER(7)     NOT NULL,
  dispatched_s    NUMBER(7),
  delivered_s     NUMBER(7),
  placed_at       TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  dispatched_at   TIMESTAMP,                              -- set by trg_store_orders_biu
  delivered_at    TIMESTAMP,
  -- a store can only order what it stocks (composite foreign key onto its shelf lines)
  CONSTRAINT fk_so_line    FOREIGN KEY (store_id, sku_id) REFERENCES store_stock (store_id, sku_id),
  CONSTRAINT ck_so_id      CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(order_id, '^SO-[0-9]+$')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_so_units   CHECK (units > 0),
  CONSTRAINT ck_so_status  CHECK (order_status IN ('PLACED', 'LOADING', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_so_source  CHECK (order_source IN ('AUTO', 'MANUAL')),
  CONSTRAINT ck_so_manual  CHECK (order_source = 'AUTO' OR placed_by IS NOT NULL),
  CONSTRAINT ck_so_van     CHECK (order_status IN ('PLACED', 'CANCELLED') OR van_id IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_so_store ON store_orders (store_id, placed_at);
CREATE INDEX ix_so_status ON store_orders (order_status);
ALTER TABLE delivery_vans ADD CONSTRAINT fk_van_order
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES store_orders (order_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;

-- Status history of every store order (written by trg_store_orders_aiu).
CREATE TABLE store_order_history (
  history_id      NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT pk_store_order_history PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id        VARCHAR2(12)  NOT NULL,  -- written only by trg_store_orders_aiu (no FK: the order row is mid-change when it fires)
  old_status      VARCHAR2(16),
  new_status      VARCHAR2(16)  NOT NULL,
  van_id          VARCHAR2(10),
  changed_by      NUMBER,
  changed_at      TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX ix_soh_order ON store_order_history (order_id, history_id);

COMMENT ON TABLE vessels IS 'Container ships calling at the Port Newark terminal';
COMMENT ON TABLE container_moves IS 'Container ledger: discharge / load by quay crane and gate in / out by truck';
COMMENT ON TABLE yard_containers IS 'Containers currently stacked in the terminal yard (kept by trg_container_moves_ai)';
COMMENT ON TABLE vessel_calls IS 'Port calls: when each ship berthed and sailed, boxes discharged and loaded';
COMMENT ON TABLE stores IS 'Vendor stores and supermarkets in Port Harbor supplied by the CargoVerse warehouses';
COMMENT ON TABLE store_stock IS 'Shelf stock per store and product; stores reorder at reorder_at';
COMMENT ON TABLE store_orders IS 'Restock orders from stores to CargoVerse warehouses, delivered by van';
COMMENT ON TABLE delivery_vans IS 'CargoVerse delivery vans and box trucks serving the stores';

====================================================================================================
FILE: waretrack/db/oracle/02_plsql.sql
====================================================================================================
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CargoVerse — PL/SQL packages and triggers
-- The application identifies the signed-in user to Oracle by setting the
-- session CLIENT_IDENTIFIER (DBMS_SESSION.SET_IDENTIFIER('<user_id>') at the start of each transaction),
-- so audit triggers record who made each change.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET DEFINE OFF

-- ============================================================================
-- Package WT_CORE: identity, permissions, audit helper, formatting
-- ============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE wt_core AS
  FUNCTION current_user_id RETURN NUMBER;
  FUNCTION has_permission (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_perm IN VARCHAR2) RETURN CHAR;
  FUNCTION can_access_facility (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_facility IN VARCHAR2) RETURN CHAR;
  FUNCTION otd_pct (p_facility IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER;
  FUNCTION fmt_clock (p_seconds IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2;
  PROCEDURE log_audit (
    p_action    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_entity    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_entity_id IN VARCHAR2,
    p_facility  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_details   IN VARCHAR2,
    p_user_id   IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL);
END wt_core;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY wt_core AS

  FUNCTION current_user_id RETURN NUMBER IS
    v_raw VARCHAR2(64) := SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'CLIENT_IDENTIFIER');
  BEGIN
    IF v_raw IS NULL THEN
      RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    RETURN TO_NUMBER(v_raw);
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN VALUE_ERROR OR INVALID_NUMBER THEN
      RETURN NULL;
  END current_user_id;

  FUNCTION has_permission (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_perm IN VARCHAR2) RETURN CHAR IS
    v_count NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO v_count
      FROM app_users u
      JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.role_code = u.role_code
     WHERE u.user_id = p_user_id
       AND u.is_active = 'Y'
       AND rp.perm_code = p_perm;
    RETURN CASE WHEN v_count > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
  END has_permission;

  FUNCTION can_access_facility (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_facility IN VARCHAR2) RETURN CHAR IS
    v_count NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    IF has_permission(p_user_id, 'VIEW_ALL_FACILITIES') = 'Y' THEN
      RETURN 'Y';
    END IF;
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO v_count
      FROM user_facility_access a
      JOIN app_users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
     WHERE a.user_id = p_user_id
       AND a.facility_id = p_facility
       AND u.is_active = 'Y';
    RETURN CASE WHEN v_count > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
  END can_access_facility;

  FUNCTION otd_pct (p_facility IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
    v_total   NUMBER;
    v_on_time NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    SELECT COUNT(*), NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN on_time = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
      INTO v_total, v_on_time
      FROM shipments
     WHERE facility_id = p_facility
       AND ship_status = 'DELIVERED'
       AND delivered_ts >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' DAY;
    IF v_total = 0 THEN
      RETURN 0;
    END IF;
    RETURN ROUND(100 * v_on_time / v_total, 2);
  END otd_pct;

  FUNCTION fmt_clock (p_seconds IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
    v_s NUMBER := MOD(FLOOR(NVL(p_seconds, 0)), 86400);
  BEGIN
    RETURN LPAD(FLOOR(v_s / 3600), 2, '0') || ':' || LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(v_s, 3600) / 60), 2, '0');
  END fmt_clock;

  PROCEDURE log_audit (
    p_action    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_entity    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_entity_id IN VARCHAR2,
    p_facility  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_details   IN VARCHAR2,
    p_user_id   IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
  IS
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, action, entity, entity_id, facility_id, details, client_info)
    VALUES (NVL(p_user_id, current_user_id), p_action, p_entity, p_entity_id, p_facility,
            SUBSTR(p_details, 1, 2000), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'MODULE'));
  END log_audit;

END wt_core;
/

-- ============================================================================
-- Package WT_AUTH: logins, sessions and user administration
-- Passwords are hashed by the application (scrypt); only hashes are stored.
-- ============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE wt_auth AS
  PROCEDURE record_login (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_success IN CHAR, p_username IN VARCHAR2);
  PROCEDURE create_session (p_session_id IN VARCHAR2, p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_days IN NUMBER, p_agent IN VARCHAR2);
  PROCEDURE revoke_session (p_session_id IN VARCHAR2);
  PROCEDURE create_user (
    p_admin_id    IN NUMBER,
    p_username    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_hash        IN VARCHAR2,
    p_role        IN VARCHAR2,
    p_full_name   IN VARCHAR2,
    p_email       IN VARCHAR2,
    p_phone       IN VARCHAR2,
    p_job_code    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_home_fac    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_facilities  IN VARCHAR2,   -- comma-separated facility ids
    o_user_id     OUT NUMBER);
  PROCEDURE update_user (
    p_admin_id    IN NUMBER,
    p_user_id     IN NUMBER,
    p_role        IN VARCHAR2,   -- NULL = unchanged
    p_active      IN CHAR,       -- NULL = unchanged
    p_facilities  IN VARCHAR2,   -- NULL = unchanged, '' handled as none
    p_hash        IN VARCHAR2);  -- NULL = unchanged
END wt_auth;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY wt_auth AS

  PROCEDURE require_admin (p_admin_id IN NUMBER) IS
  BEGIN
    IF p_admin_id IS NULL OR wt_core.has_permission(p_admin_id, 'MANAGE_USERS') = 'N' THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20003, 'Not permitted: managing users requires the MANAGE_USERS permission');
    END IF;
  END require_admin;

  -- p_facilities: comma-separated ids; '-' (or any non-matching value) removes all access.
  PROCEDURE set_facilities (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_facilities IN VARCHAR2) IS
    v_list VARCHAR2(400) := ',' || REPLACE(NVL(p_facilities, '-'), ' ', '') || ',';
  BEGIN
    DELETE FROM user_facility_access
     WHERE user_id = p_user_id
       AND INSTR(v_list, ',' || facility_id || ',') = 0;
    INSERT INTO user_facility_access (user_id, facility_id)
    SELECT p_user_id, f.facility_id
      FROM facilities f
     WHERE INSTR(v_list, ',' || f.facility_id || ',') > 0
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_facility_access a
                        WHERE a.user_id = p_user_id AND a.facility_id = f.facility_id);
  END set_facilities;

  PROCEDURE record_login (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_success IN CHAR, p_username IN VARCHAR2) IS
  BEGIN
    IF p_success = 'Y' THEN
      UPDATE app_users
         SET last_login_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, failed_logins = 0
       WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
      wt_core.log_audit('LOGIN', 'SESSION', p_username, NULL, 'Signed in', p_user_id);
    ELSE
      IF p_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE app_users SET failed_logins = failed_logins + 1 WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
      END IF;
      wt_core.log_audit('LOGIN_FAILED', 'SESSION', p_username, NULL, 'Wrong username or password', p_user_id);
    END IF;
  END record_login;

  PROCEDURE create_session (p_session_id IN VARCHAR2, p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_days IN NUMBER, p_agent IN VARCHAR2) IS
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO user_sessions (session_id, user_id, expires_at, remember_me, user_agent)
    VALUES (p_session_id, p_user_id, SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(p_days, 'DAY'),
            CASE WHEN p_days >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, SUBSTR(p_agent, 1, 200));
  END create_session;

  PROCEDURE revoke_session (p_session_id IN VARCHAR2) IS
    v_user NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    UPDATE user_sessions SET revoked = 'Y'
     WHERE session_id = p_session_id
     RETURNING user_id INTO v_user;
    IF v_user IS NOT NULL THEN
      wt_core.log_audit('LOGOUT', 'SESSION', NULL, NULL, 'Signed out', v_user);
    END IF;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
  END revoke_session;

  PROCEDURE create_user (
    p_admin_id    IN NUMBER,
    p_username    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_hash        IN VARCHAR2,
    p_role        IN VARCHAR2,
    p_full_name   IN VARCHAR2,
    p_email       IN VARCHAR2,
    p_phone       IN VARCHAR2,
    p_job_code    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_home_fac    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_facilities  IN VARCHAR2,
    o_user_id     OUT NUMBER)
  IS
    v_emp_id NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    require_admin(p_admin_id);
    INSERT INTO employees (full_name, email, phone, job_code, facility_id)
    VALUES (p_full_name, LOWER(p_email), p_phone, p_job_code, p_home_fac)
    RETURNING employee_id INTO v_emp_id;

    INSERT INTO app_users (username, password_hash, role_code, employee_id, created_by)
    VALUES (LOWER(p_username), p_hash, p_role, v_emp_id, p_admin_id)
    RETURNING user_id INTO o_user_id;

    set_facilities(o_user_id, NVL(p_facilities, p_home_fac));
  END create_user;

  PROCEDURE update_user (
    p_admin_id    IN NUMBER,
    p_user_id     IN NUMBER,
    p_role        IN VARCHAR2,
    p_active      IN CHAR,
    p_facilities  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_hash        IN VARCHAR2)
  IS
  BEGIN
    require_admin(p_admin_id);
    IF p_user_id = p_admin_id AND (p_active = 'N' OR (p_role IS NOT NULL AND p_role <> 'ADMIN')) THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20006, 'Administrators cannot deactivate or demote their own account');
    END IF;
    UPDATE app_users
       SET role_code     = NVL(p_role, role_code),
           is_active     = NVL(p_active, is_active),
           password_hash = NVL(p_hash, password_hash),
           failed_logins = CASE WHEN p_hash IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE failed_logins END
     WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
    IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'User ' || p_user_id || ' not found');
    END IF;
    IF p_facilities IS NOT NULL THEN
      set_facilities(p_user_id, p_facilities);
    END IF;
    IF p_active = 'N' THEN
      UPDATE user_sessions SET revoked = 'Y' WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND revoked = 'N';
    END IF;
  END update_user;

END wt_auth;
/

-- ============================================================================
-- Package WT_WORK: tasks assigned to staff, with role-based rules
-- Errors: -20001 not found, -20002 transition not allowed, -20003 not permitted,
--         -20004 invalid assignee, -20005 facility access denied
-- ============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE wt_work AS
  PROCEDURE create_task (
    p_user_id     IN NUMBER,     -- NULL = created by the system
    p_facility    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_title       IN VARCHAR2,
    p_description IN VARCHAR2,
    p_type        IN VARCHAR2,
    p_priority    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_assignee    IN NUMBER,
    p_truck       IN VARCHAR2,
    p_dock        IN VARCHAR2,
    p_forklift    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_shipment    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_due_minutes IN NUMBER,
    p_source      IN VARCHAR2,
    o_task_id     OUT NUMBER);
  PROCEDURE change_status (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_task_id IN NUMBER, p_new_status IN VARCHAR2, p_note IN VARCHAR2);
  PROCEDURE assign (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_task_id IN NUMBER, p_assignee IN NUMBER, p_note IN VARCHAR2);
  FUNCTION transition_allowed (p_old IN VARCHAR2, p_new IN VARCHAR2, p_operator IN CHAR) RETURN CHAR;
END wt_work;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY wt_work AS

  FUNCTION transition_allowed (p_old IN VARCHAR2, p_new IN VARCHAR2, p_operator IN CHAR) RETURN CHAR IS
  BEGIN
    IF p_operator = 'Y' THEN
      RETURN CASE
        WHEN p_old = 'ASSIGNED'    AND p_new = 'IN_PROGRESS'            THEN 'Y'
        WHEN p_old = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND p_new IN ('BLOCKED', 'DONE')     THEN 'Y'
        WHEN p_old = 'BLOCKED'     AND p_new = 'IN_PROGRESS'            THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N' END;
    END IF;
    RETURN CASE
      WHEN p_old = 'OPEN'        AND p_new IN ('ASSIGNED', 'CANCELLED')               THEN 'Y'
      WHEN p_old = 'ASSIGNED'    AND p_new IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'CANCELLED')            THEN 'Y'
      WHEN p_old = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND p_new IN ('BLOCKED', 'DONE', 'CANCELLED')        THEN 'Y'
      WHEN p_old = 'BLOCKED'     AND p_new IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'CANCELLED')            THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N' END;
  END transition_allowed;

  PROCEDURE check_assignee (p_assignee IN NUMBER, p_facility IN VARCHAR2) IS
    v_count NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    IF p_assignee IS NULL THEN
      RETURN;
    END IF;
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
      FROM employees
     WHERE employee_id = p_assignee
       AND emp_status = 'ACTIVE'
       AND (facility_id = p_facility OR facility_id IS NULL);
