    IF v_count = 0 THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20004, 'Employee ' || p_assignee || ' is not active at ' || p_facility);
    END IF;
  END check_assignee;

  PROCEDURE create_task (
    p_user_id     IN NUMBER,
    p_facility    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_title       IN VARCHAR2,
    p_description IN VARCHAR2,
    p_type        IN VARCHAR2,
    p_priority    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_assignee    IN NUMBER,
    p_truck       IN VARCHAR2,
    p_dock        IN VARCHAR2,
    p_forklift    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_shipment    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_due_minutes IN NUMBER,
    p_source      IN VARCHAR2,
    o_task_id     OUT NUMBER)
  IS
  BEGIN
    IF p_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      IF wt_core.has_permission(p_user_id, 'MANAGE_TASKS') = 'N' THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20003, 'Not permitted: creating tasks requires MANAGE_TASKS');
      END IF;
      IF wt_core.can_access_facility(p_user_id, p_facility) = 'N' THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20005, 'No access to facility ' || p_facility);
      END IF;
    END IF;
    check_assignee(p_assignee, p_facility);

    INSERT INTO tasks (facility_id, title, description, task_type, priority, task_status, source,
                       assigned_to, created_by, truck_id, dock_id, forklift_id, shipment_id, due_at)
    VALUES (p_facility, p_title, p_description, p_type, NVL(p_priority, 'NORMAL'),
            CASE WHEN p_assignee IS NULL THEN 'OPEN'
                 WHEN p_source = 'SYSTEM' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'
                 ELSE 'ASSIGNED' END,
            NVL(p_source, 'MANUAL'), p_assignee, p_user_id, p_truck, p_dock, p_forklift, p_shipment,
            CASE WHEN p_due_minutes IS NULL THEN NULL
                 ELSE SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(p_due_minutes, 'MINUTE') END)
    RETURNING task_id INTO o_task_id;

    INSERT INTO task_updates (task_id, user_id, old_status, new_status, note)
    SELECT o_task_id, p_user_id, NULL, task_status,
           CASE WHEN p_source = 'SYSTEM' THEN 'Created automatically by operations' ELSE 'Task created' END
      FROM tasks WHERE task_id = o_task_id;
  END create_task;

  PROCEDURE change_status (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_task_id IN NUMBER, p_new_status IN VARCHAR2, p_note IN VARCHAR2) IS
    v_task     tasks%ROWTYPE;
    v_emp_id   NUMBER;
    v_operator CHAR(1) := 'N';
  BEGIN
    BEGIN
      SELECT * INTO v_task FROM tasks WHERE task_id = p_task_id FOR UPDATE;
    EXCEPTION
      WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Task ' || p_task_id || ' not found');
    END;

    IF p_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      IF wt_core.can_access_facility(p_user_id, v_task.facility_id) = 'N' THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20005, 'No access to facility ' || v_task.facility_id);
      END IF;
      IF wt_core.has_permission(p_user_id, 'MANAGE_TASKS') = 'N' THEN
        SELECT employee_id INTO v_emp_id FROM app_users WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
        IF wt_core.has_permission(p_user_id, 'UPDATE_OWN_TASKS') = 'N'
           OR v_task.assigned_to IS NULL OR v_task.assigned_to <> v_emp_id THEN
          RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20003, 'Not permitted: you can only update tasks assigned to you');
        END IF;
        v_operator := 'Y';
      END IF;
    END IF;

    IF transition_allowed(v_task.task_status, p_new_status, v_operator) = 'N' THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, 'Cannot move task from ' || v_task.task_status || ' to ' || p_new_status);
    END IF;

    UPDATE tasks SET task_status = p_new_status WHERE task_id = p_task_id;
    INSERT INTO task_updates (task_id, user_id, old_status, new_status, note)
    VALUES (p_task_id, p_user_id, v_task.task_status, p_new_status, p_note);
  END change_status;

  PROCEDURE assign (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_task_id IN NUMBER, p_assignee IN NUMBER, p_note IN VARCHAR2) IS
    v_task tasks%ROWTYPE;
  BEGIN
    BEGIN
      SELECT * INTO v_task FROM tasks WHERE task_id = p_task_id FOR UPDATE;
    EXCEPTION
      WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Task ' || p_task_id || ' not found');
    END;
    IF p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND (wt_core.has_permission(p_user_id, 'MANAGE_TASKS') = 'N'
        OR wt_core.can_access_facility(p_user_id, v_task.facility_id) = 'N') THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20003, 'Not permitted: assigning tasks requires MANAGE_TASKS for ' || v_task.facility_id);
    END IF;
    IF v_task.task_status IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, 'Task ' || p_task_id || ' is already ' || v_task.task_status);
    END IF;
    check_assignee(p_assignee, v_task.facility_id);

    UPDATE tasks
       SET assigned_to = p_assignee,
           task_status = CASE WHEN task_status = 'OPEN' THEN 'ASSIGNED' ELSE task_status END
     WHERE task_id = p_task_id;
    INSERT INTO task_updates (task_id, user_id, old_status, new_status, note)
    SELECT p_task_id, p_user_id, v_task.task_status, task_status,
           NVL(p_note, 'Assigned to ' || (SELECT full_name FROM employees WHERE employee_id = p_assignee))
      FROM tasks WHERE task_id = p_task_id;
  END assign;

END wt_work;
/

-- ============================================================================
-- Triggers
-- ============================================================================

-- Stock ledger keeps facility totals and per-SKU inventory in step.
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_stock_movements_ai
AFTER INSERT ON stock_movements
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  UPDATE facilities
     SET stock_pallets = stock_pallets + :NEW.pallets_delta
   WHERE facility_id = :NEW.facility_id;

  IF :NEW.sku_id IS NOT NULL AND :NEW.units_delta <> 0 THEN
    UPDATE inventory
       SET units = units + :NEW.units_delta
     WHERE facility_id = :NEW.facility_id
       AND sku_id = :NEW.sku_id;
    IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 AND :NEW.units_delta > 0 THEN
      INSERT INTO inventory (facility_id, sku_id, units, reorder_level)
      VALUES (:NEW.facility_id, :NEW.sku_id, :NEW.units_delta, 0);
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
/

-- Shipment status and on-time flag are derived from the milestone times.
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_shipments_biu
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON shipments
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF :NEW.delivered_s IS NOT NULL THEN
    :NEW.ship_status := 'DELIVERED';
    IF :NEW.on_time IS NULL THEN
      :NEW.on_time := CASE WHEN :NEW.delivered_s <= :NEW.promised_s THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
    END IF;
    IF :NEW.delivered_ts IS NULL THEN
      :NEW.delivered_ts := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    END IF;
  ELSIF :NEW.direction = 'INBOUND' THEN
    :NEW.ship_status := 'IN_TRANSIT';
  ELSIF :NEW.transit_s IS NOT NULL THEN
    :NEW.ship_status := 'IN_TRANSIT';
  ELSIF :NEW.loaded_s IS NOT NULL THEN
    :NEW.ship_status := 'IN_PROGRESS';
  ELSE
    :NEW.ship_status := 'OPEN';
  END IF;
END;
/

-- Task timestamps follow the status.
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_tasks_biu
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON tasks
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF :NEW.task_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND :NEW.started_at IS NULL THEN
    :NEW.started_at := SYSTIMESTAMP;
  END IF;
  IF :NEW.task_status IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') AND :NEW.completed_at IS NULL THEN
    :NEW.completed_at := SYSTIMESTAMP;
  END IF;
END;
/

-- Audit trail: every human change to a task.
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_tasks_audit
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF task_status, assigned_to, priority, title ON tasks
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
  v_user NUMBER := wt_core.current_user_id;
  FUNCTION emp_name (p_id NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
    v_name employees.full_name%TYPE;
  BEGIN
    IF p_id IS NULL THEN RETURN 'nobody'; END IF;
    SELECT full_name INTO v_name FROM employees WHERE employee_id = p_id;
    RETURN v_name;
  EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN '#' || p_id;
  END;
BEGIN
  IF v_user IS NULL AND :NEW.source = 'SYSTEM' THEN
    RETURN; -- automatic operations tasks are recorded in operation_events instead
  END IF;
  IF INSERTING THEN
    wt_core.log_audit('TASK_CREATED', 'TASK', TO_CHAR(:NEW.task_id), :NEW.facility_id,
      :NEW.title || ' · ' || :NEW.priority || ' · assigned to ' || emp_name(:NEW.assigned_to), v_user);
  ELSE
    IF NVL(:OLD.task_status, '-') <> NVL(:NEW.task_status, '-') THEN
      wt_core.log_audit('TASK_STATUS', 'TASK', TO_CHAR(:NEW.task_id), :NEW.facility_id,
        :NEW.title || ': ' || :OLD.task_status || ' → ' || :NEW.task_status, v_user);
    END IF;
    IF NVL(:OLD.assigned_to, -1) <> NVL(:NEW.assigned_to, -1) THEN
      wt_core.log_audit('TASK_ASSIGNED', 'TASK', TO_CHAR(:NEW.task_id), :NEW.facility_id,
        :NEW.title || ': ' || emp_name(:OLD.assigned_to) || ' → ' || emp_name(:NEW.assigned_to), v_user);
    END IF;
    IF NVL(:OLD.priority, '-') <> NVL(:NEW.priority, '-') THEN
      wt_core.log_audit('TASK_PRIORITY', 'TASK', TO_CHAR(:NEW.task_id), :NEW.facility_id,
        :NEW.title || ': ' || :OLD.priority || ' → ' || :NEW.priority, v_user);
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
/

-- Audit trail: account administration (password hashes are never written to the log).
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_app_users_audit
AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF role_code, is_active, password_hash, username ON app_users
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
  v_changes VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
  IF INSERTING THEN
    wt_core.log_audit('USER_CREATED', 'USER', :NEW.username, NULL, 'Role ' || :NEW.role_code);
  ELSIF DELETING THEN
    wt_core.log_audit('USER_DELETED', 'USER', :OLD.username, NULL, 'Role ' || :OLD.role_code);
  ELSE
    IF :OLD.role_code <> :NEW.role_code THEN
      v_changes := v_changes || 'role ' || :OLD.role_code || ' → ' || :NEW.role_code || '; ';
    END IF;
    IF :OLD.is_active <> :NEW.is_active THEN
      v_changes := v_changes || CASE WHEN :NEW.is_active = 'Y' THEN 'activated' ELSE 'deactivated' END || '; ';
    END IF;
    IF :OLD.password_hash <> :NEW.password_hash THEN
      v_changes := v_changes || 'password reset; ';
    END IF;
    IF :OLD.username <> :NEW.username THEN
      v_changes := v_changes || 'renamed from ' || :OLD.username || '; ';
    END IF;
    IF v_changes IS NOT NULL THEN
      wt_core.log_audit('USER_UPDATED', 'USER', :NEW.username, NULL, RTRIM(v_changes, '; '));
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_user_access_audit
AFTER INSERT OR DELETE ON user_facility_access
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
  v_username app_users.username%TYPE;
BEGIN
  BEGIN
    SELECT MAX(username) INTO v_username FROM app_users WHERE user_id = NVL(:NEW.user_id, :OLD.user_id);
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN v_username := TO_CHAR(NVL(:NEW.user_id, :OLD.user_id)); -- e.g. app_users mutating during a cascade delete
  END;
  IF INSERTING THEN
    wt_core.log_audit('ACCESS_GRANTED', 'USER', v_username, :NEW.facility_id, 'Facility access granted');
  ELSE
    wt_core.log_audit('ACCESS_REVOKED', 'USER', v_username, :OLD.facility_id, 'Facility access revoked');
  END IF;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_employees_audit
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF job_code, facility_id, emp_status ON employees
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF INSERTING THEN
    wt_core.log_audit('EMPLOYEE_ADDED', 'EMPLOYEE', TO_CHAR(:NEW.employee_id), :NEW.facility_id,
      :NEW.full_name || ' · ' || :NEW.job_code);
  ELSE
    wt_core.log_audit('EMPLOYEE_UPDATED', 'EMPLOYEE', TO_CHAR(:NEW.employee_id), :NEW.facility_id,
      :NEW.full_name || ': ' || :OLD.job_code || '/' || :OLD.emp_status || ' → ' || :NEW.job_code || '/' || :NEW.emp_status);
  END IF;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_sim_state_audit
AFTER UPDATE OF paused, speed ON sim_state
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF :OLD.paused <> :NEW.paused THEN
    wt_core.log_audit(CASE WHEN :NEW.paused = 'Y' THEN 'OPS_PAUSED' ELSE 'OPS_RESUMED' END,
      'OPERATIONS', NULL, NULL, 'Operations clock ' || CASE WHEN :NEW.paused = 'Y' THEN 'paused' ELSE 'resumed' END,
      :NEW.updated_by);
  END IF;
  IF :OLD.speed <> :NEW.speed THEN
    wt_core.log_audit('OPS_SPEED', 'OPERATIONS', NULL, NULL, 'Speed ' || :OLD.speed || '× → ' || :NEW.speed || '×', :NEW.updated_by);
  END IF;
END;
/

-- ============================================================================
-- Package WT_PARK: tenant management (building status, staff, leases) and the
-- import / export summary used by the dashboards
-- ============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE wt_park AS
  PROCEDURE update_building (
    p_user_id     IN NUMBER,
    p_building_id IN VARCHAR2,
    p_status      IN VARCHAR2,
    p_staff       IN NUMBER,
    p_lease_end   IN DATE);
  FUNCTION trade_balance (p_facility IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER;
END wt_park;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY wt_park AS

  PROCEDURE update_building (
    p_user_id     IN NUMBER,
    p_building_id IN VARCHAR2,
    p_status      IN VARCHAR2,
    p_staff       IN NUMBER,
    p_lease_end   IN DATE)
  IS
    v_b park_buildings%ROWTYPE;
  BEGIN
    IF wt_core.has_permission(p_user_id, 'MANAGE_PARK') <> 'Y' THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20003, 'Not permitted: editing park buildings requires the MANAGE_PARK permission');
    END IF;
    BEGIN
      SELECT * INTO v_b FROM park_buildings WHERE building_id = p_building_id FOR UPDATE;
    EXCEPTION
      WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Building ' || p_building_id || ' not found');
    END;
    IF v_b.facility_id IS NOT NULL AND p_status IN ('VACANT', 'CONSTRUCTION') THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20004, 'A CargoVerse site that is running operations cannot be marked ' || p_status);
    END IF;
    IF p_lease_end IS NOT NULL AND p_lease_end <= v_b.lease_start THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20004, 'The lease cannot end before it starts (' || TO_CHAR(v_b.lease_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ')');
    END IF;
    UPDATE park_buildings
       SET bldg_status = NVL(p_status, bldg_status),
           staff_count = NVL(p_staff, staff_count),
           lease_end   = NVL(p_lease_end, lease_end),
           updated_at  = SYSTIMESTAMP
     WHERE building_id = p_building_id;
  END update_building;

  -- pallets imported minus pallets exported today (positive = stock building up)
  FUNCTION trade_balance (p_facility IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
    v_in  NUMBER;
    v_out NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    SELECT import_pallets_today, export_pallets_today INTO v_in, v_out
      FROM facilities WHERE facility_id = p_facility;
    RETURN v_in - v_out;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
      RETURN NULL;
  END trade_balance;

END wt_park;
/

-- Every truck through a park gate updates the facility's import / export counters.
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_gate_log_ai
AFTER INSERT ON park_gate_log
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF :NEW.trade_type = 'IMPORT' THEN
    UPDATE facilities
       SET imports_today = imports_today + 1,
           import_pallets_today = import_pallets_today + :NEW.pallets
     WHERE facility_id = :NEW.facility_id;
  ELSIF :NEW.trade_type = 'EXPORT' THEN
    UPDATE facilities
       SET exports_today = exports_today + 1,
           export_pallets_today = export_pallets_today + :NEW.pallets
     WHERE facility_id = :NEW.facility_id;
  END IF;
END;
/

-- Changes to tenant buildings are recorded in the audit trail.
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_park_buildings_audit
AFTER UPDATE OF bldg_status, staff_count, lease_end ON park_buildings
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
  v_changes VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
  IF :OLD.bldg_status <> :NEW.bldg_status THEN
    v_changes := v_changes || 'status ' || :OLD.bldg_status || ' → ' || :NEW.bldg_status || '; ';
  END IF;
  IF :OLD.staff_count <> :NEW.staff_count THEN
    v_changes := v_changes || 'staff ' || :OLD.staff_count || ' → ' || :NEW.staff_count || '; ';
  END IF;
  IF :OLD.lease_end <> :NEW.lease_end THEN
    v_changes := v_changes || 'lease end ' || TO_CHAR(:OLD.lease_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' → ' || TO_CHAR(:NEW.lease_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '; ';
  END IF;
  IF v_changes IS NOT NULL THEN
    wt_core.log_audit('BUILDING_UPDATED', 'BUILDING', :NEW.building_id, :NEW.facility_id,
      :NEW.name || ': ' || RTRIM(v_changes, '; '));
  END IF;
END;
/

-- ============================================================================
-- Package WT_PORT: container terminal rules (check digits, port calls,
-- holding ships, opening and closing berths)
-- ============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE wt_port AS
  FUNCTION check_digit (p_container_no IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER;
  FUNCTION is_valid_container (p_container_no IN VARCHAR2) RETURN CHAR;
  PROCEDURE log_call (
    p_vessel_id  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_voyage_no  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_berth_code IN VARCHAR2,
    p_phase      IN VARCHAR2,
    p_discharged IN NUMBER,
    p_loaded     IN NUMBER,
    p_sim_time   IN NUMBER);
  PROCEDURE set_vessel_hold (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_vessel_id IN VARCHAR2, p_hold IN CHAR);
  PROCEDURE set_berth_open (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_berth_code IN VARCHAR2, p_open IN CHAR);
  FUNCTION yard_free (p_block_code IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER;
END wt_port;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY wt_port AS

  -- ISO 6346: letters map to 10..38 skipping multiples of 11; weights are powers of two.
  FUNCTION check_digit (p_container_no IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
    v_sum   NUMBER := 0;
    v_ch    VARCHAR2(1);
    v_val   NUMBER;
    v_n     NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    IF p_container_no IS NULL OR LENGTH(p_container_no) < 10 THEN
      RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    FOR i IN 1 .. 10 LOOP
      v_ch := SUBSTR(p_container_no, i, 1);
      IF v_ch BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN
        v_val := TO_NUMBER(v_ch);
      ELSE
        v_n := ASCII(v_ch) - ASCII('A');            -- 0 for A
        v_val := 10 + v_n + CASE WHEN v_n = 0 THEN 0 WHEN v_n <= 10 THEN 1 WHEN v_n <= 20 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;
      END IF;
      v_sum := v_sum + v_val * POWER(2, i - 1);
    END LOOP;
    RETURN MOD(MOD(v_sum, 11), 10);
  END check_digit;

  FUNCTION is_valid_container (p_container_no IN VARCHAR2) RETURN CHAR IS
  BEGIN
    IF NOT REGEXP_LIKE(p_container_no, '^[A-Z]{3}U[0-9]{7}$') THEN
      RETURN 'N';
    END IF;
    RETURN CASE WHEN check_digit(p_container_no) = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(p_container_no, 11, 1)) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
  END is_valid_container;

  PROCEDURE log_call (
    p_vessel_id  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_voyage_no  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_berth_code IN VARCHAR2,
    p_phase      IN VARCHAR2,
    p_discharged IN NUMBER,
    p_loaded     IN NUMBER,
    p_sim_time   IN NUMBER)
  IS
  BEGIN
    IF p_phase = 'ARRIVE' THEN
      MERGE INTO vessel_calls c
      USING (SELECT p_vessel_id AS vessel_id, p_voyage_no AS voyage_no FROM dual) s
         ON (c.vessel_id = s.vessel_id AND c.voyage_no = s.voyage_no)
       WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT (vessel_id, voyage_no, berth_code, arrived_s)
         VALUES (p_vessel_id, p_voyage_no, p_berth_code, p_sim_time);
    ELSIF p_phase = 'DEPART' THEN
      UPDATE vessel_calls
         SET departed_s = p_sim_time,
             departed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP,
             boxes_discharged = p_discharged,
             boxes_loaded = p_loaded
       WHERE vessel_id = p_vessel_id
         AND voyage_no = p_voyage_no;
      IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN
        -- the ship was already alongside when the database was created
        INSERT INTO vessel_calls (vessel_id, voyage_no, berth_code, arrived_s, departed_s, boxes_discharged, boxes_loaded, departed_at)
        VALUES (p_vessel_id, p_voyage_no, p_berth_code, p_sim_time, p_sim_time, p_discharged, p_loaded, SYSTIMESTAMP);
      END IF;
    ELSE
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20004, 'Unknown port call phase ' || p_phase);
    END IF;
  END log_call;

  PROCEDURE require_port_manager (p_user_id IN NUMBER) IS
  BEGIN
    IF wt_core.has_permission(p_user_id, 'MANAGE_PORT') <> 'Y' THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20003, 'Not permitted: port operations require the MANAGE_PORT permission');
    END IF;
  END require_port_manager;

  PROCEDURE set_vessel_hold (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_vessel_id IN VARCHAR2, p_hold IN CHAR) IS
    v_v vessels%ROWTYPE;
  BEGIN
    require_port_manager(p_user_id);
    IF p_hold NOT IN ('Y', 'N') THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20004, 'Hold must be Y or N');
    END IF;
    BEGIN
      SELECT * INTO v_v FROM vessels WHERE vessel_id = p_vessel_id FOR UPDATE;
    EXCEPTION
      WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Vessel ' || p_vessel_id || ' not found');
    END;
    IF v_v.on_hold = p_hold THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, v_v.name || CASE WHEN p_hold = 'Y' THEN ' is already on hold' ELSE ' is not on hold' END);
    END IF;
    UPDATE vessels SET on_hold = p_hold, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE vessel_id = p_vessel_id;
    wt_core.log_audit(CASE WHEN p_hold = 'Y' THEN 'VESSEL_HELD' ELSE 'VESSEL_RELEASED' END, 'VESSEL', p_vessel_id, NULL,
      v_v.name || ' (' || v_v.voyage_no || ', ' || LOWER(REPLACE(v_v.vessel_status, '_', ' ')) || ')' ||
      CASE WHEN p_hold = 'Y' THEN ' held by the port manager' ELSE ' released' END, p_user_id);
  END set_vessel_hold;

  PROCEDURE set_berth_open (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_berth_code IN VARCHAR2, p_open IN CHAR) IS
    v_b port_berths%ROWTYPE;
    v_open NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    require_port_manager(p_user_id);
    BEGIN
      SELECT * INTO v_b FROM port_berths WHERE berth_code = p_berth_code FOR UPDATE;
    EXCEPTION
      WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Berth ' || p_berth_code || ' not found');
    END;
    IF v_b.is_open = p_open THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, v_b.name || CASE WHEN p_open = 'Y' THEN ' is already open' ELSE ' is already closed' END);
    END IF;
    IF p_open = 'N' THEN
      SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_open FROM port_berths WHERE is_open = 'Y' AND berth_code <> p_berth_code;
      IF v_open = 0 THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20004, 'At least one berth must stay open');
      END IF;
    END IF;
    UPDATE port_berths SET is_open = p_open, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE berth_code = p_berth_code;
    wt_core.log_audit(CASE WHEN p_open = 'Y' THEN 'BERTH_OPENED' ELSE 'BERTH_CLOSED' END, 'BERTH', p_berth_code, NULL,
      v_b.name || CASE WHEN p_open = 'Y' THEN ' reopened' ELSE ' closed to new arrivals' END, p_user_id);
  END set_berth_open;

  FUNCTION yard_free (p_block_code IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
    v_cap  NUMBER;
    v_used NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    SELECT capacity_boxes INTO v_cap FROM yard_blocks WHERE block_code = p_block_code;
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_used FROM yard_containers WHERE block_code = p_block_code;
    RETURN v_cap - v_used;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
      RETURN NULL;
  END yard_free;

END wt_port;
/

-- Every container move must carry a valid ISO 6346 number.
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_container_moves_bi
BEFORE INSERT ON container_moves
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF wt_port.is_valid_container(:NEW.container_no) <> 'Y' THEN
    RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20004, 'Invalid container number ' || :NEW.container_no || ' (ISO 6346 check digit)');
  END IF;
END;
/

-- The container ledger drives the yard: discharged and gated-in boxes are stacked,
-- loaded and gated-out boxes leave the stacks.
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_container_moves_ai
AFTER INSERT ON container_moves
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF :NEW.move_type IN ('DISCHARGE', 'GATE_IN') THEN
    MERGE INTO yard_containers y
    USING (SELECT :NEW.container_no AS container_no FROM dual) s
       ON (y.container_no = s.container_no)
     WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
       INSERT (container_no, block_code, line_code, vessel_id, facility_id, arrived_move_id)
       VALUES (:NEW.container_no, CASE WHEN :NEW.move_type = 'DISCHARGE' THEN 'IMPORT' ELSE 'EXPORT' END,
               SUBSTR(:NEW.container_no, 1, 3), :NEW.vessel_id, :NEW.facility_id, :NEW.move_id);
  ELSE
    DELETE FROM yard_containers WHERE container_no = :NEW.container_no;
  END IF;
END;
/

-- ============================================================================
-- Package WT_RETAIL: store restock orders placed on the CargoVerse warehouses
-- ============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE wt_retail AS
  PROCEDURE place_order (
    p_user_id   IN NUMBER,
    p_order_id  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_store_id  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_sku_id    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_units     IN NUMBER,
    p_facility  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_sim_time  IN NUMBER);
  PROCEDURE cancel_order (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_order_id IN VARCHAR2);
  FUNCTION cover_hours (p_store_id IN VARCHAR2, p_sku_id IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER;
  FUNCTION best_supplier (p_store_id IN VARCHAR2, p_sku_id IN VARCHAR2, p_units IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2;
END wt_retail;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY wt_retail AS

  PROCEDURE require_retail_manager (p_user_id IN NUMBER) IS
  BEGIN
    IF wt_core.has_permission(p_user_id, 'MANAGE_RETAIL') <> 'Y' THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20003, 'Not permitted: store orders require the MANAGE_RETAIL permission');
    END IF;
  END require_retail_manager;

  -- the store's usual warehouse if it has enough units, otherwise the warehouse with the most
  FUNCTION best_supplier (p_store_id IN VARCHAR2, p_sku_id IN VARCHAR2, p_units IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
    v_pref VARCHAR2(10);
    v_fac  VARCHAR2(10);
    v_n    NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    SELECT facility_id INTO v_pref FROM stores WHERE store_id = p_store_id;
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_n FROM inventory WHERE facility_id = v_pref AND sku_id = p_sku_id AND units >= p_units;
    IF v_n > 0 THEN
      RETURN v_pref;
    END IF;
    SELECT facility_id INTO v_fac
      FROM (SELECT facility_id FROM inventory
             WHERE sku_id = p_sku_id AND units >= p_units
             ORDER BY units DESC)
     WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
    RETURN v_fac;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
      RETURN NULL;
  END best_supplier;

  PROCEDURE place_order (
    p_user_id   IN NUMBER,
    p_order_id  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_store_id  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_sku_id    IN VARCHAR2,
    p_units     IN NUMBER,
    p_facility  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_sim_time  IN NUMBER)
  IS
    v_line  store_stock%ROWTYPE;
    v_open  NUMBER;
    v_have  NUMBER;
    v_name  stores.name%TYPE;
  BEGIN
    require_retail_manager(p_user_id);
    BEGIN
      SELECT * INTO v_line FROM store_stock WHERE store_id = p_store_id AND sku_id = p_sku_id;
      SELECT name INTO v_name FROM stores WHERE store_id = p_store_id;
    EXCEPTION
      WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Store ' || p_store_id || ' does not stock ' || p_sku_id);
    END;
    IF p_units IS NULL OR p_units <= 0 OR p_units > v_line.max_units * 2 THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20004, 'Order between 1 and ' || (v_line.max_units * 2) || ' units');
    END IF;
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_open FROM store_orders
     WHERE store_id = p_store_id AND sku_id = p_sku_id AND order_status IN ('PLACED', 'LOADING', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY');
    IF v_open > 0 THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, v_name || ' already has an open order for this product');
    END IF;
    SELECT NVL(MAX(units), 0) INTO v_have FROM inventory WHERE facility_id = p_facility AND sku_id = p_sku_id;
    IF v_have < p_units THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20006, p_facility || ' has only ' || v_have || ' units of ' || p_sku_id);
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO store_orders (order_id, store_id, sku_id, facility_id, units, order_status, order_source, placed_by, placed_s)
    VALUES (p_order_id, p_store_id, p_sku_id, p_facility, p_units, 'PLACED', 'MANUAL', p_user_id, p_sim_time);
    wt_core.log_audit('STORE_ORDER_PLACED', 'STORE_ORDER', p_order_id, p_facility,
      v_name || ': ' || p_units || ' × ' || p_sku_id || ' from ' || p_facility, p_user_id);
  END place_order;

  PROCEDURE cancel_order (p_user_id IN NUMBER, p_order_id IN VARCHAR2) IS
    v_o store_orders%ROWTYPE;
  BEGIN
    require_retail_manager(p_user_id);
    BEGIN
      SELECT * INTO v_o FROM store_orders WHERE order_id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;
    EXCEPTION
      WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Order ' || p_order_id || ' not found');
    END;
    IF v_o.order_status <> 'PLACED' THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, 'Only orders that are not yet loaded can be cancelled (this one is ' || v_o.order_status || ')');
    END IF;
    UPDATE store_orders SET order_status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE order_id = p_order_id;
    wt_core.log_audit('STORE_ORDER_CANCELLED', 'STORE_ORDER', p_order_id, v_o.facility_id,
      v_o.store_id || ': ' || v_o.units || ' × ' || v_o.sku_id || ' cancelled', p_user_id);
  END cancel_order;

  -- hours of trading the shelf stock will last at the store's sales rate
  FUNCTION cover_hours (p_store_id IN VARCHAR2, p_sku_id IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
    v_units NUMBER;
    v_rate  NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    SELECT units, sales_per_hour INTO v_units, v_rate FROM store_stock WHERE store_id = p_store_id AND sku_id = p_sku_id;
    IF v_rate = 0 THEN
      RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    RETURN ROUND(v_units / v_rate, 1);
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
      RETURN NULL;
  END cover_hours;

END wt_retail;
/

-- Order milestones are timestamped by the database.
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_store_orders_biu
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF order_status ON store_orders
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF :NEW.order_status = 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' AND :NEW.dispatched_at IS NULL THEN
    :NEW.dispatched_at := SYSTIMESTAMP;
  ELSIF :NEW.order_status = 'DELIVERED' AND :NEW.delivered_at IS NULL THEN
    :NEW.delivered_at := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    IF :NEW.dispatched_at IS NULL THEN
      :NEW.dispatched_at := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
/

-- Every status change of a store order is kept in STORE_ORDER_HISTORY.
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_store_orders_aiu
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF order_status ON store_orders
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
  v_old store_orders.order_status%TYPE;
BEGIN
  IF UPDATING THEN
    v_old := :OLD.order_status;
  END IF;
  IF INSERTING OR NVL(v_old, '-') <> :NEW.order_status THEN
    INSERT INTO store_order_history (order_id, old_status, new_status, van_id, changed_by)
    VALUES (:NEW.order_id, v_old, :NEW.order_status, :NEW.van_id, wt_core.current_user_id);
  END IF;
END;
/

====================================================================================================
FILE: waretrack/db/oracle/03_views.sql
====================================================================================================
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CargoVerse — reporting views (used by the API's reports and KPI endpoints)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET DEFINE OFF

-- KPI cards per facility: stock, trucks on site, on-time delivery (30 days), work and stock alerts.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_facility_kpi AS
SELECT f.facility_id,
       f.name,
       f.stock_pallets,
       f.capacity_pallets,
       ROUND(100 * f.stock_pallets / f.capacity_pallets, 1)                      AS fill_pct,
       f.stock_pallets - f.stock_start_pallets                                   AS stock_delta,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trucks t
         WHERE t.facility_id = f.facility_id
           AND t.status IN ('AT_GATE', 'DOCKING', 'WORKING', 'READY', 'DEPARTING')) AS trucks_on_site,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trucks t
         WHERE t.facility_id = f.facility_id
           AND t.direction = 'INBOUND'
           AND t.status NOT IN ('AWAY', 'LEAVING'))                                AS trucks_inbound,
       NVL(d.deliveries_30d, 0)                                                   AS deliveries_30d,
       NVL(d.on_time_30d, 0)                                                      AS on_time_30d,
       CASE WHEN NVL(d.deliveries_30d, 0) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE ROUND(100 * d.on_time_30d / d.deliveries_30d, 2) END             AS otd_pct,
       f.otd_prev_pct,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks k
         WHERE k.facility_id = f.facility_id
           AND k.task_status IN ('OPEN', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED'))    AS open_tasks,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory i
         WHERE i.facility_id = f.facility_id
           AND i.units < i.reorder_level)                                         AS low_stock_lines
  FROM facilities f
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT facility_id,
                    COUNT(*)                                          AS deliveries_30d,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN on_time = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS on_time_30d
               FROM shipments
              WHERE ship_status = 'DELIVERED'
                AND delivered_ts >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' DAY
              GROUP BY facility_id) d
    ON d.facility_id = f.facility_id;

-- Dock board: which truck is at or booked for each dock.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_dock_status AS
SELECT d.facility_id,
       d.dock_id,
       d.dock_name,
       d.dock_kind,
       t.truck_id,
       c.display_name   AS carrier,
       t.status         AS truck_status,
       t.direction,
       CASE WHEN t.truck_id IS NULL THEN 'AVAILABLE'
            WHEN t.status IN ('EN_ROUTE', 'AT_GATE') THEN 'BOOKED'
            WHEN t.status = 'DOCKING' THEN 'DOCKING'
            WHEN t.status = 'WORKING' THEN CASE WHEN t.direction = 'INBOUND' THEN 'UNLOADING' ELSE 'LOADING' END
            ELSE 'READY' END AS dock_state,
       CASE WHEN t.direction = 'INBOUND' THEN t.capacity_pallets - t.cargo_pallets ELSE t.cargo_pallets END AS pallets_done,
       t.capacity_pallets,
       d.trucks_today
  FROM docks d
  LEFT JOIN trucks t   ON t.truck_id = d.truck_id
  LEFT JOIN carriers c ON c.carrier_id = t.carrier_id;

-- Task board with people's names and the latest status note.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_task_board AS
SELECT k.task_id,
       k.facility_id,
       k.title,
       k.description,
       k.task_type,
       k.priority,
       k.task_status,
       k.source,
       k.assigned_to,
       e.full_name        AS assignee_name,
       j.title            AS assignee_job,
       k.created_by,
       NVL(ce.full_name, 'System') AS created_by_name,
       k.truck_id,
       k.dock_id,
       k.forklift_id,
       k.shipment_id,
       k.due_at,
       k.created_at,
       k.started_at,
       k.completed_at,
       (SELECT u.note FROM task_updates u
         WHERE u.task_id = k.task_id
           AND u.update_id = (SELECT MAX(u2.update_id) FROM task_updates u2 WHERE u2.task_id = k.task_id)) AS last_note,
       CASE WHEN k.due_at < SYSTIMESTAMP AND k.task_status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_overdue
  FROM tasks k
  LEFT JOIN employees e   ON e.employee_id = k.assigned_to
  LEFT JOIN job_titles j  ON j.job_code = e.job_code
  LEFT JOIN app_users cu  ON cu.user_id = k.created_by
  LEFT JOIN employees ce  ON ce.employee_id = cu.employee_id;

-- Inventory lines below their reorder level.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_low_stock AS
SELECT i.facility_id, f.name AS facility_name, i.sku_id, s.name AS sku_name, i.units, i.reorder_level,
       i.reorder_level - i.units AS shortfall
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN skus s       ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id
  JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = i.facility_id
 WHERE i.units < i.reorder_level;

-- Workload per employee.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_employee_workload AS
SELECT e.employee_id,
       e.full_name,
       j.title AS job_title,
       e.facility_id,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN k.task_status IN ('OPEN', 'ASSIGNED', 'BLOCKED') THEN 1 END) AS open_tasks,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN k.task_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 END)                     AS in_progress,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN k.task_status = 'DONE' AND k.completed_at >= TRUNC(SYSTIMESTAMP) THEN 1 END) AS done_today
  FROM employees e
  JOIN job_titles j ON j.job_code = e.job_code
  LEFT JOIN tasks k ON k.assigned_to = e.employee_id
 WHERE e.emp_status = 'ACTIVE'
 GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name, j.title, e.facility_id;

-- Directory of login accounts with their role, job and facility access.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_user_directory AS
SELECT u.user_id,
       u.username,
       u.role_code,
       r.role_name,
       u.is_active,
       u.employee_id,
       e.full_name,
       e.email,
       e.job_code,
       j.title AS job_title,
       e.facility_id AS home_facility,
       (SELECT LISTAGG(a.facility_id, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.facility_id)
          FROM user_facility_access a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id) AS facilities,
       (SELECT MIN(fl.forklift_id) FROM forklifts fl WHERE fl.operator_id = u.employee_id) AS forklift_id,
       u.last_login_at,
       u.created_at,
       u.failed_logins
  FROM app_users u
  JOIN roles r       ON r.role_code = u.role_code
  JOIN employees e   ON e.employee_id = u.employee_id
  JOIN job_titles j  ON j.job_code = e.job_code;

-- Audit trail with readable user names.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_audit_feed AS
SELECT a.audit_id,
       a.created_at,
       a.user_id,
       u.username,
       e.full_name,
       a.action,
       a.entity,
       a.entity_id,
       a.facility_id,
       a.details
  FROM audit_log a
  LEFT JOIN app_users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
  LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = u.employee_id;

-- Park directory: every building with its tenant, size and lease position.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_park_directory AS
SELECT b.building_id,
       b.name                                         AS building_name,
       b.building_kind,
       b.street,
       b.bldg_status,
       b.floors,
       b.floor_area_m2,
       b.staff_count,
       b.lease_start,
       b.lease_end,
       TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(b.lease_end, TRUNC(SYSDATE)))  AS lease_months_left,
       c.company_id,
       c.name                                         AS company_name,
       c.industry,
       c.brand_color,
       c.is_operator,
       b.facility_id,
       f.name                                         AS facility_name
  FROM park_buildings b
  JOIN park_companies c ON c.company_id = b.company_id
  LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = b.facility_id;

-- Gate log with carrier and product names (newest first in queries).
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_gate_log AS
SELECT g.gate_event_id,
       g.created_at,
       g.sim_time_s,
       g.gate_code,
       g.direction,
       g.trade_type,
       g.truck_id,
       c.name        AS carrier,
       g.facility_id,
       g.shipment_id,
       g.sku_id,
       s.name        AS sku_name,
       g.pallets
  FROM park_gate_log g
  JOIN trucks t   ON t.truck_id = g.truck_id
  JOIN carriers c ON c.carrier_id = t.carrier_id
  LEFT JOIN skus s ON s.sku_id = g.sku_id;

-- Imports and exports per site (today's counters kept by trg_gate_log_ai, plus empty moves logged today).
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_trade_today AS
SELECT f.facility_id,
       f.name,
       f.imports_today,
       f.import_pallets_today,
       f.exports_today,
       f.export_pallets_today,
       f.import_pallets_today - f.export_pallets_today          AS pallet_balance,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM park_gate_log g
         WHERE g.facility_id = f.facility_id
           AND g.trade_type = 'EMPTY'
           AND g.created_at >= TRUNC(SYSTIMESTAMP))              AS empty_moves_today
  FROM facilities f;

-- ============================================================================
-- Container port
-- ============================================================================
-- Ships with their line, berth and progress of the current call.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_vessel_schedule AS
SELECT v.vessel_id,
       v.name                                        AS vessel_name,
       l.name                                        AS shipping_line,
       v.imo_no,
       v.flag,
       v.voyage_no,
       v.vessel_status,
       v.on_hold,
       v.berth_code,
       b.name                                        AS berth_name,
       v.origin_port,
       v.next_port,
       v.import_boxes                                AS boxes_to_discharge,
       v.discharged,
       v.loaded,
       v.export_target,
       v.through_boxes + v.import_boxes + v.export_boxes AS boxes_aboard,
       v.capacity_boxes,
       ROUND(100 * (v.through_boxes + v.import_boxes + v.export_boxes) / v.capacity_boxes) AS pct_full,
       CASE v.vessel_status WHEN 'AT_SEA' THEN v.timer_s END AS seconds_to_approach,
       wt_core.fmt_clock(v.arrived_s)                AS alongside_since
  FROM vessels v
  JOIN shipping_lines l ON l.line_code = v.line_code
  LEFT JOIN port_berths b ON b.berth_code = v.berth_code;

-- Berths with the ship alongside and the quay cranes working it.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_port_berths AS
SELECT b.berth_code,
       b.name,
       b.is_open,
       b.vessel_id,
       v.name                                        AS vessel_name,
       v.vessel_status,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quay_cranes c WHERE c.berth_code = b.berth_code AND c.crane_phase <> 'IDLE') AS cranes_working,
       (SELECT SUM(c.moves_today) FROM quay_cranes c WHERE c.berth_code = b.berth_code)                AS moves_today
  FROM port_berths b
  LEFT JOIN vessels v ON v.vessel_id = b.vessel_id;

-- Boxes in each stacking block against its capacity.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_yard_summary AS
SELECT k.block_code,
       k.description,
       k.capacity_boxes,
       COUNT(y.container_no)                         AS boxes,
       k.capacity_boxes - COUNT(y.container_no)      AS free_slots,
       ROUND(100 * COUNT(y.container_no) / k.capacity_boxes) AS pct_full
  FROM yard_blocks k
  LEFT JOIN yard_containers y ON y.block_code = k.block_code
 GROUP BY k.block_code, k.description, k.capacity_boxes;

-- The container ledger with ship, truck and site names.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_container_moves AS
SELECT m.move_id,
       m.created_at,
       m.sim_time_s,
       m.container_no,
       l.name                                        AS shipping_line,
       m.move_type,
       m.vessel_id,
       v.name                                        AS vessel_name,
       m.berth_code,
       m.crane_id,
       m.truck_id,
       m.facility_id,
       f.name                                        AS facility_name
  FROM container_moves m
  JOIN shipping_lines l ON l.line_code = m.line_code
  LEFT JOIN vessels v    ON v.vessel_id = m.vessel_id
  LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = m.facility_id;

-- ============================================================================
-- Vendor stores and deliveries
-- ============================================================================
-- Shelf stock per store with cover (hours of sales left) and open orders.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_store_stock AS
SELECT s.store_id,
       s.name                                        AS store_name,
       s.store_kind,
       s.facility_id                                 AS usual_supplier,
       k.sku_id,
       k.name                                        AS sku_name,
       t.units,
       t.reorder_at,
       t.max_units,
       t.stock_status,
       t.sales_per_hour,
       t.sold_today,
       CASE WHEN t.sales_per_hour > 0 THEN ROUND(t.units / t.sales_per_hour, 1) END AS cover_hours,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_orders o
         WHERE o.store_id = t.store_id AND o.sku_id = t.sku_id
           AND o.order_status IN ('PLACED', 'LOADING', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY'))         AS open_orders
  FROM store_stock t
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = t.store_id
  JOIN skus k   ON k.sku_id = t.sku_id;

-- Store orders with store, product, supplying site and van.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_store_orders AS
SELECT o.order_id,
       o.order_status,
       o.order_source,
       o.store_id,
       s.name                                        AS store_name,
       o.sku_id,
       k.name                                        AS sku_name,
       o.units,
       o.facility_id,
       f.name                                        AS facility_name,
       o.van_id,
       v.driver_name,
       o.placed_by,
       o.placed_at,
       o.dispatched_at,
       o.delivered_at,
       ROUND((CAST(o.delivered_at AS DATE) - CAST(o.placed_at AS DATE)) * 24 * 60, 1) AS lead_minutes
  FROM store_orders o
  JOIN stores s     ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  JOIN skus k       ON k.sku_id = o.sku_id
  JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = o.facility_id
  LEFT JOIN delivery_vans v ON v.van_id = o.van_id;

-- The delivery fleet and what each van is doing now.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_delivery_fleet AS
SELECT v.van_id,
       v.facility_id,
       v.van_kind,
       v.plate,
       v.driver_name,
       v.van_status,
       v.order_id,
       s.name                                        AS store_name,
       o.sku_id,
       o.units,
       v.trips_today
  FROM delivery_vans v
  LEFT JOIN store_orders o ON o.order_id = v.order_id
  LEFT JOIN stores s       ON s.store_id = v.store_id;

-- 30 days of delivered shipments per facility (drives the on-time delivery KPI)
BEGIN
  FOR f IN (SELECT 'WH-01' AS fac, 1000 AS total, 966 AS ok, 'TRK-2051' AS truck, 'BOX-M' AS sku FROM dual
           UNION ALL SELECT 'WH-04' AS fac, 1000 AS total, 962 AS ok, 'TRK-2205' AS truck, 'LED-6060' AS sku FROM dual
           UNION ALL SELECT 'WH-02' AS fac, 1000 AS total, 982 AS ok, 'TRK-2127' AS truck, 'LED-6060' AS sku FROM dual) LOOP
    FOR i IN 1 .. f.total LOOP
      INSERT INTO shipments (shipment_id, truck_id, facility_id, direction, customer, destination, sku_id, pallets,
                             confirmed_s, picked_s, loaded_s, transit_s, delivered_s, promised_s, transit_minutes, on_time, created_at, delivered_ts)
      VALUES ('H' || SUBSTR(f.fac, 4) || '-' || LPAD(i, 5, '0'), f.truck, f.fac,
              CASE WHEN MOD(i, 2) = 0 THEN 'OUTBOUND' ELSE 'INBOUND' END,
              CASE MOD(i, 5) WHEN 0 THEN 'Liberty Supply Co.' WHEN 1 THEN 'Harbor & Co.' WHEN 2 THEN 'Metro Office Supply'
                             WHEN 3 THEN 'Hudson Clinics' ELSE 'Bayview Foods' END,
              'Historical delivery', f.sku, 6, 25200, 28800, 32400, 34200,
              CASE WHEN i <= f.ok THEN 36000 ELSE 39600 END, 37800, 30,
              CASE WHEN i <= f.ok THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
              SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(MOD(i * 7, 29) + 1, 'DAY'),
              SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(MOD(i * 7, 29) + 1, 'DAY') + INTERVAL '3' HOUR);
    END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
END;

FILE: waretrack/db/oracle/05_reports.sql

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CargoVerse — sample SQL reports (run in SQL Developer / SQL*Plus as WARETRACK)
-- Each query demonstrates a different SQL feature.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET DEFINE OFF

-- 1. KPI cards for every facility (view + scalar subqueries)
SELECT facility_id, name, stock_pallets, fill_pct, trucks_on_site, otd_pct, open_tasks
  FROM v_facility_kpi
 ORDER BY facility_id;

-- 2. Who is working on what right now (multi-table join)
SELECT e.full_name, j.title, k.title AS task, k.task_status, k.priority, f.name AS facility
  FROM tasks k
  JOIN employees e  ON e.employee_id = k.assigned_to
  JOIN job_titles j ON j.job_code = e.job_code
  JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = k.facility_id
 WHERE k.task_status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED')
 ORDER BY f.name, k.priority DESC;

-- 3. On-time delivery by facility and direction, with subtotals (GROUP BY ROLLUP)
SELECT NVL(facility_id, 'ALL')  AS facility,
       NVL(direction, 'ALL')    AS direction,
       COUNT(*)                 AS delivered,
       ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN on_time = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS on_time_pct
  FROM shipments
 WHERE ship_status = 'DELIVERED'
 GROUP BY ROLLUP (facility_id, direction)
 ORDER BY 1, 2;

-- 4. Facilities whose on-time rate is below the network average (HAVING + subquery)
SELECT facility_id, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN on_time = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS otd
  FROM shipments
 WHERE ship_status = 'DELIVERED'
 GROUP BY facility_id
HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN on_time = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <
       (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN on_time = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM shipments WHERE ship_status = 'DELIVERED');

-- 5. Running stock level per facility from the ledger (analytic window function)
SELECT facility_id, movement_id, reason, pallets_delta,
       SUM(pallets_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY facility_id ORDER BY movement_id) AS running_stock
  FROM stock_movements
 ORDER BY facility_id, movement_id
 FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;

-- 6. Busiest forklift operators today (join + aggregation + ranking)
SELECT e.full_name, fl.forklift_id, fl.moves_today, fl.battery_pct,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fl.moves_today DESC) AS rank_today
  FROM forklifts fl
  JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = fl.operator_id
 ORDER BY rank_today;

-- 7. Low stock lines and how short they are (view)
SELECT facility_name, sku_name, units, reorder_level, shortfall
  FROM v_low_stock
 ORDER BY shortfall DESC;

-- 8. Audit history: what did each manager change in the last 7 days (join + date filter)
SELECT a.created_at, a.username, a.action, a.facility_id, a.details
  FROM v_audit_feed a
  JOIN app_users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
 WHERE u.role_code = 'MANAGER'
   AND a.created_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY
 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC;

-- 9. Employees with no open work (NOT EXISTS anti-join)
SELECT e.full_name, j.title, e.facility_id
  FROM employees e
  JOIN job_titles j ON j.job_code = e.job_code
 WHERE e.emp_status = 'ACTIVE'
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks k
                    WHERE k.assigned_to = e.employee_id
                      AND k.task_status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED'));

-- 10. Permissions matrix (pivot of role_permissions)
SELECT *
  FROM (SELECT role_code, perm_code, 'Y' AS granted FROM role_permissions)
 PIVOT (MAX(granted) FOR role_code IN ('ADMIN' AS admin, 'MANAGER' AS manager, 'OPERATOR' AS operator))
 ORDER BY perm_code;

-- 11. Imports vs exports today per site (view with counters kept by a trigger)
SELECT facility_id, name, imports_today, import_pallets_today, exports_today, export_pallets_today, pallet_balance
  FROM v_trade_today
 ORDER BY facility_id;

-- 12. Gate traffic per hour and direction (TRUNC on timestamps + PIVOT)
SELECT *
  FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(created_at, 'HH24'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS hour_start, trade_type, pallets
          FROM park_gate_log)
 PIVOT (COUNT(*) AS trucks, SUM(pallets) AS pallets FOR trade_type IN ('IMPORT' AS imp, 'EXPORT' AS exp, 'EMPTY' AS empty))
 ORDER BY hour_start DESC;

-- 13. Which products are imported and exported the most (join + conditional aggregation)
SELECT s.name AS product,
       SUM(CASE WHEN g.trade_type = 'IMPORT' THEN g.pallets ELSE 0 END) AS imported_pallets,
       SUM(CASE WHEN g.trade_type = 'EXPORT' THEN g.pallets ELSE 0 END) AS exported_pallets
  FROM park_gate_log g
  JOIN skus s ON s.sku_id = g.sku_id
 GROUP BY s.name
 ORDER BY imported_pallets + exported_pallets DESC;

-- 14. Park tenants: staff and floor area per industry (GROUP BY + virtual column)
SELECT c.industry, COUNT(*) AS buildings, SUM(b.staff_count) AS staff, SUM(b.floor_area_m2) AS floor_area_m2
  FROM park_buildings b
  JOIN park_companies c ON c.company_id = b.company_id
 GROUP BY c.industry
 ORDER BY staff DESC;

-- 15. Leases ending within the next 5 years (date arithmetic on a view)
SELECT company_name, building_name, lease_end, lease_months_left
  FROM v_park_directory
 WHERE lease_end < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 60)
 ORDER BY lease_end;

-- 16. Vehicles on the park roads by owner, including public traffic (LEFT JOIN + NVL)
SELECT NVL(c.name, 'Public traffic') AS owner, v.vehicle_kind, COUNT(*) AS vehicles, ROUND(AVG(v.speed_kmh)) AS avg_kmh
  FROM park_vehicles v
  LEFT JOIN park_companies c ON c.company_id = v.company_id
 GROUP BY NVL(c.name, 'Public traffic'), v.vehicle_kind
 ORDER BY owner, vehicle_kind;

-- 17. Trucks that came in through the West Gate but have not left yet (MINUS set operation)
SELECT truck_id FROM park_gate_log WHERE direction = 'IN'
MINUS
SELECT g.truck_id FROM park_gate_log g
 WHERE g.direction = 'OUT'
   AND g.created_at > (SELECT MAX(i.created_at) FROM park_gate_log i WHERE i.truck_id = g.truck_id AND i.direction = 'IN');

-- 18. Use the PL/SQL API directly: create and progress a task as manager alex.chen (user 2)
--     (wrap in a transaction; the audit trigger records each step)
-- DECLARE v_id NUMBER;
-- BEGIN
--   DBMS_SESSION.SET_IDENTIFIER('2');
--   wt_work.create_task(2, 'WH-01', 'Sweep Bay 1 apron', 'Clear debris before next truck', 'DOCK_CHECK',
--                       'LOW', 16, NULL, 'WH-01-B1', NULL, NULL, 30, 'MANUAL', v_id);
--   wt_work.change_status(2, v_id, 'IN_PROGRESS', 'Started by manager');
--   COMMIT;
-- END;
-- /

-- 19. Port throughput by shipping line today (GROUP BY ROLLUP gives the terminal total)
SELECT NVL(l.name, 'All lines') AS shipping_line,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.move_type = 'DISCHARGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discharged,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.move_type = 'LOAD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)      AS loaded,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.move_type = 'GATE_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS gate_out,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.move_type = 'GATE_IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)   AS gate_in
  FROM container_moves m
  JOIN shipping_lines l ON l.line_code = m.line_code
 WHERE m.created_at >= TRUNC(SYSTIMESTAMP)
 GROUP BY ROLLUP (l.name)
 ORDER BY GROUPING(l.name), l.name;

-- 20. Ship turnaround: minutes alongside for every completed port call (interval arithmetic)
SELECT v.name AS vessel, c.voyage_no, c.berth_code, c.boxes_discharged, c.boxes_loaded,
       ROUND((CAST(c.departed_at AS DATE) - CAST(c.arrived_at AS DATE)) * 24 * 60, 1) AS minutes_alongside
  FROM vessel_calls c
  JOIN vessels v ON v.vessel_id = c.vessel_id
 WHERE c.call_status = 'COMPLETED'
 ORDER BY c.departed_at DESC;

-- 21. Trace import containers from ship to warehouse (self-join of the ledger: DISCHARGE → GATE_OUT)
SELECT d.container_no, v.name AS vessel, d.created_at AS discharged_at, g.truck_id, g.facility_id AS delivered_to,
       ROUND((CAST(g.created_at AS DATE) - CAST(d.created_at AS DATE)) * 24 * 60, 1) AS minutes_in_yard
  FROM container_moves d
  JOIN container_moves g ON g.container_no = d.container_no AND g.move_type = 'GATE_OUT' AND g.move_id > d.move_id
  JOIN vessels v ON v.vessel_id = d.vessel_id
 WHERE d.move_type = 'DISCHARGE'
   AND g.truck_id IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY g.move_id DESC;

-- 22. Yard occupancy and the oldest box in each block (analytic ROW_NUMBER)
SELECT block_code, boxes_in_block, oldest_container, arrived_at
  FROM (SELECT y.block_code, y.container_no AS oldest_container, y.arrived_at,
               COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY y.block_code) AS boxes_in_block,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY y.block_code ORDER BY y.arrived_move_id) AS rn
          FROM yard_containers y)
 WHERE rn = 1;

-- 23. Store shelves at or below their reorder point, with cover in hours (uses wt_retail.cover_hours)
SELECT s.name AS store, k.name AS product, t.units, t.reorder_at, t.max_units,
       wt_retail.cover_hours(t.store_id, t.sku_id) AS cover_hours, t.stock_status
  FROM store_stock t
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = t.store_id
  JOIN skus k ON k.sku_id = t.sku_id
 WHERE t.stock_status <> 'OK'
 ORDER BY cover_hours NULLS FIRST;

-- 24. Deliveries to stores per warehouse (PIVOT on the order status)
SELECT *
  FROM (SELECT facility_id, order_status FROM store_orders)
 PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR order_status IN ('PLACED' AS placed, 'LOADING' AS loading, 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' AS out_for_delivery,
                                      'DELIVERED' AS delivered, 'CANCELLED' AS cancelled))
 ORDER BY facility_id;

-- 25. Units shipped from each warehouse to stores (stock ledger, reason STORE_SHIP)
SELECT m.facility_id, k.name AS product, -SUM(m.units_delta) AS units_to_stores, COUNT(*) AS van_loads
  FROM stock_movements m
  JOIN skus k ON k.sku_id = m.sku_id
 WHERE m.reason = 'STORE_SHIP'
 GROUP BY m.facility_id, k.name
 ORDER BY m.facility_id, units_to_stores DESC;

-- 26. Average order lead time per store, placed → delivered (minutes)
SELECT store_name, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders, ROUND(AVG(lead_minutes), 1) AS avg_lead_minutes, MAX(lead_minutes) AS worst
  FROM v_store_orders
 WHERE order_status = 'DELIVERED'
 GROUP BY store_name
 ORDER BY avg_lead_minutes DESC;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CargoVerse — remove every object created by 01–04 (run as WARETRACK).
-- Safe to run on an empty schema: missing objects are skipped.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
  FOR v IN (SELECT view_name FROM user_views WHERE view_name LIKE 'V\_%' ESCAPE '\') LOOP
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'DROP VIEW ' || v.view_name;
  END LOOP;
  FOR p IN (SELECT object_name FROM user_objects WHERE object_type = 'PACKAGE' AND object_name LIKE 'WT\_%' ESCAPE '\') LOOP
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'DROP PACKAGE ' || p.object_name;
  END LOOP;
  FOR t IN (SELECT table_name FROM user_tables
             WHERE table_name IN ('STORE_ORDER_HISTORY', 'STORE_ORDERS', 'DELIVERY_VANS', 'STORE_STOCK', 'STORES',
                                  'YARD_CONTAINERS', 'CONTAINER_MOVES', 'YARD_BLOCKS', 'VESSEL_CALLS', 'QUAY_CRANES',
                                  'VESSELS', 'PORT_BERTHS', 'SHIPPING_LINES',
                                  'PARK_GATE_LOG', 'PARK_GATES', 'PARK_VEHICLES', 'PARK_ROUTES', 'PARK_BUILDINGS', 'PARK_COMPANIES',
                                  'AUDIT_LOG', 'OPERATION_EVENTS', 'TASK_UPDATES', 'TASKS', 'STOCK_MOVEMENTS',
                                  'PALLETS', 'FORKLIFTS', 'SHIPMENTS', 'TRUCKS', 'CHARGERS', 'DOCKS', 'INVENTORY',
                                  'SKUS', 'DRIVERS', 'CARRIERS', 'USER_SESSIONS', 'USER_FACILITY_ACCESS',
                                  'APP_USERS', 'EMPLOYEES', 'FACILITIES', 'JOB_TITLES', 'ROLE_PERMISSIONS',
                                  'PERMISSIONS', 'ROLES', 'SIM_STATE')) LOOP
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'DROP TABLE ' || t.table_name || ' CASCADE CONSTRAINTS PURGE';
  END LOOP;
END;

// npm run db:up — starts Oracle Database Free in Docker, with a clear message if Docker is missing.
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';

const has = spawnSync('docker', ['--version'], { stdio: 'ignore' });
if (has.error || has.status !== 0) {
  console.error(`
Docker is not installed (or not on the PATH), so Oracle cannot be started.

  1. Install Docker Desktop: https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/
     (on an Apple-silicon Mac choose "Download for Mac – Apple Silicon")
  2. Open Docker Desktop once and wait until it says "Engine running".
  3. Run again:  npm run db:up   then   npm run db:setup   then   npm run dev

Without Oracle you can still try the app with:  npm run dev:memory
`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const info = spawnSync('docker', ['info'], { stdio: 'ignore' });
if (info.status !== 0) {
  console.error('\nDocker is installed but not running. Open Docker Desktop, wait for "Engine running", then run npm run db:up again.\n');
  process.exit(1);
}
const r = spawnSync('docker', ['compose', 'up', '-d', 'oracle'], { stdio: 'inherit' });
if (r.status === 0) console.log('\nOracle is starting (first time: it downloads ~1 GB, then needs 1–2 minutes). Next: npm run db:setup\n');
process.exit(r.status ?? 1);

FILE: waretrack/scripts/dev.mjs
====================================================================================================
// Development: rebuilds and restarts the API on change, and runs the Vite dev server.
// Usage: npm run dev            (Oracle, settings from .env)
//        npm run dev:memory     (no database server needed)
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { serverBuild } from './build-server.mjs';

const memory = process.argv.includes('--memory');
const env = { ...process.env, ...(memory ? { DB_MODE: 'memory' } : {}) };
let api = null;
let retry = null;
let stopping = false;

const restart = () => {
  clearTimeout(retry);
  if (api) { api.removeAllListeners('exit'); api.kill('SIGINT'); }
  const child = spawn(process.execPath, ['--enable-source-maps', 'server-dist/index.mjs'], { stdio: 'inherit', env });
  api = child;
  child.on('exit', (code) => {
    if (stopping || api !== child || code === 0) return;
    // the API could not start (usually: Oracle is not running yet) — say so clearly and keep trying
    const oracle = !memory && (env.DB_MODE ?? 'oracle') !== 'memory';
    console.error([
      '',
      '  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐',
      '  │  The CargoVerse API server is NOT running — the website cannot sign in.  │',
      ...(oracle ? [
        '  │  It could not reach Oracle (see the message above). Check that:          │',
        '  │   1. Docker Desktop is installed and open ("Engine running")             │',
        '  │   2. you ran  npm run db:up   and then  npm run db:setup                 │',
        '  │  Retrying every 10 seconds… (or stop with Ctrl+C and run                 │',
        '  │  npm run dev:memory  to try the app without Oracle)                      │',
      ] : ['  │  See the error above. Retrying every 10 seconds…                         │']),
      '  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘',
      '',
    ].join('\n'));
    retry = setTimeout(restart, 10000);
  });
};

const ctx = await esbuild.context({
  ...serverBuild,
  plugins: [{ name: 'restart', setup(b) { b.onEnd((r) => { if (!r.errors.length) restart(); }); } }],
});
await ctx.watch();

const vite = spawn(process.execPath, ['node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', env });
const stop = () => { stopping = true; clearTimeout(retry); api?.kill('SIGINT'); vite.kill('SIGINT'); void ctx.dispose(); setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 1500); };
process.on('SIGINT', stop);
process.on('SIGTERM', stop);

// AI operations agents.
//  1. Exception watcher — scans live operations for problems (late shipments, forklifts low
//     on battery mid-job, trucks stuck at the gate, low stock, blocked tasks) and proposes a task.
//  2. Operations assistant — answers questions in plain language using Claude with tool use.
//     Tools read the same data the dashboard shows and respect the caller's role and sites.
// The Anthropic API key stays on the server (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); the browser never sees it.
import type { FacilityId, EntityRef, WorldState } from '../src/data/types';
import type { SessionUser, TaskType, Priority, Task } from '../src/api/types';
import { SKUS, carrierName } from '../src/data/seed';
import {
  kpis, facilityHeadline, deliveryWatch, truckView, forkliftView, forkliftActivity, truckBadge, search, dockStatus, fmtClock,
} from '../src/ui/derive';
import { AppError, type Repo } from './db/repo';
import type { SimHost } from './simhost';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- exception watcher

export interface Alert {
  id: string;
  facilityId: FacilityId;
  severity: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
  kind: 'late_shipment' | 'low_battery' | 'gate_wait' | 'low_stock' | 'blocked_task';
  title: string;
  detail: string;
  ref: EntityRef | null;
  suggestion: { title: string; description: string; type: TaskType; priority: Priority; truckId?: string; dockId?: string; jobCode: string } | null;
}

const SEV_ORDER = { high: 0, medium: 1, low: 2 };

export async function computeAlerts(w: WorldState, repo: Repo, facilities: FacilityId[]): Promise<Alert[]> {
  const out: Alert[] = [];
  for (const fac of facilities) {
    const f = w.facilities[fac];
    if (!f) continue;
    for (const d of deliveryWatch(w, fac)) {
      if (d.label !== 'At risk') continue;
      const t = w.trucks[d.truckId];
      out.push({
        id: `late_shipment:${d.id}`, facilityId: fac, severity: 'high', kind: 'late_shipment',
        title: `Shipment #${d.id} may miss its promised time`, detail: `${d.truckId} · ${d.text}`,
        ref: { kind: 'truck', id: d.truckId },
        suggestion: {
          title: `Expedite ${d.truckId} (#${d.id})`, type: 'DOCK_CHECK', priority: 'URGENT', truckId: d.truckId, dockId: t?.dockId ?? undefined,
          description: `Shipment #${d.id} is running late (${d.text}). Free up a forklift or dock and notify the customer if it will still miss the window.`,
          jobCode: 'DOCK_SUPERVISOR',
        },
      });
    }
    for (const fl of Object.values(w.forklifts)) {
      if (fl.facilityId !== fac || !fl.truckId || fl.battery >= 30) continue;
      out.push({
        id: `low_battery:${fl.id}`, facilityId: fac, severity: fl.battery < 20 ? 'high' : 'medium', kind: 'low_battery',
        title: `${fl.id} is at ${Math.round(fl.battery)}% battery mid-job`, detail: forkliftActivity(w, fl).text,
        ref: { kind: 'forklift', id: fl.id },
        suggestion: {
          title: `Swap in a charged forklift for ${fl.id}`, type: 'MAINTENANCE', priority: 'HIGH', truckId: fl.truckId,
          description: `${fl.id} is below 30% while working on ${fl.truckId}. Send it to charger ${fl.chargerId.split('-').pop()} after this pallet and hand the job to a charged forklift.`,
          jobCode: 'FORKLIFT_OPERATOR',
        },
      });
    }
    for (const t of Object.values(w.trucks)) {
      if (t.facilityId !== fac || t.phase !== 'at_gate') continue;
      out.push({
        id: `gate_wait:${t.id}`, facilityId: fac, severity: 'medium', kind: 'gate_wait',
        title: `${t.id} is waiting at the gate`, detail: t.dockId ? `Booked for ${w.docks[t.dockId]?.name} — yard lane busy` : 'No free dock for its direction',
        ref: { kind: 'truck', id: t.id },
        suggestion: {
          title: `Clear a dock for ${t.id}`, type: 'DOCK_CHECK', priority: 'HIGH', truckId: t.id, dockId: t.dockId ?? undefined,
          description: `${t.id} (${carrierName(t.carrier)}) is held at the gate. Check which dock can be freed first and guide the truck in.`,
          jobCode: 'DOCK_SUPERVISOR',
        },
      });
    }
    for (const l of f.inventory) {
      if (l.units >= l.lowBelow) continue;
      const name = SKUS[l.skuId]?.name ?? l.skuId;
      out.push({
        id: `low_stock:${fac}:${l.skuId}`, facilityId: fac, severity: l.units < l.lowBelow * 0.5 ? 'high' : 'low', kind: 'low_stock',
        title: `${name} is below its reorder level`, detail: `${l.units.toLocaleString()} units on hand, reorder at ${l.lowBelow.toLocaleString()}`,
        ref: null,
        suggestion: {
          title: `Reorder ${name}`, type: 'CYCLE_COUNT', priority: 'NORMAL',
          description: `Count ${name} on hand at ${f.name}, confirm the shortfall against the system (${l.units} units vs reorder level ${l.lowBelow}) and raise a replenishment order.`,
          jobCode: 'INVENTORY_CLERK',
        },
      });
    }
  }
  const blocked = (await repo.listTasks({ facilities, includeClosed: false, limit: 200 })).filter((t) => t.status === 'BLOCKED');
  for (const t of blocked) {
    out.push({
      id: `blocked_task:${t.id}`, facilityId: t.facilityId, severity: t.priority === 'URGENT' || t.priority === 'HIGH' ? 'high' : 'medium',
      kind: 'blocked_task', title: `Task blocked: ${t.title}`, detail: `${t.assigneeName ?? 'Unassigned'} — “${t.lastNote ?? 'no reason given'}”`,
      ref: t.truckId ? { kind: 'truck', id: t.truckId } : null, suggestion: null,
    });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => SEV_ORDER[a.severity] - SEV_ORDER[b.severity]);
}

/** Creates the suggested task for an alert, assigned to someone with the matching job at that site. */
export async function taskFromAlert(w: WorldState, repo: Repo, user: SessionUser, alertId: string, assigneeId: number | null): Promise<Task | null> {
  const alerts = await computeAlerts(w, repo, user.facilities);
  const a = alerts.find((x) => x.id === alertId);
  if (!a) throw new AppError(404, 'This alert has already cleared');
  if (!a.suggestion) throw new AppError(400, 'This alert has no suggested task');
  let assignee = assigneeId;
  if (assignee === null) {
    const staff = (await repo.listEmployees([a.facilityId])).filter((e) => e.status === 'ACTIVE' && e.jobCode === a.suggestion!.jobCode);
    staff.sort((x, y) => x.openTasks - y.openTasks);
    assignee = staff[0]?.id ?? null;
  }
  const id = await repo.createTask(user.userId, {
    facilityId: a.facilityId, title: a.suggestion.title, description: `${a.suggestion.description}\n\nRaised from alert: ${a.title}.`,
    type: a.suggestion.type, priority: a.suggestion.priority, assigneeId: assignee, truckId: a.suggestion.truckId ?? null,
    dockId: a.suggestion.dockId ?? null, dueMinutes: a.severity === 'high' ? 20 : 60, source: 'MANUAL',
  });
  return repo.getTask(id);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- operations assistant (Claude tool use)
