// Minimal HTTP router and helpers on node:http (no framework dependency).
import type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from 'node:http';
import { createReadStream, existsSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { extname, join, normalize } from 'node:path';
import type { SessionUser, Permission } from '../src/api/types';
import { AppError } from './db/repo';

export interface Ctx {
  req: IncomingMessage;
  res: ServerResponse;
  params: Record<string, string>;
  query: URLSearchParams;
  body: any; // eslint-disable-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  user: SessionUser | null;
  sessionId: string | null;
  ip: string;
}

type Handler = (ctx: Ctx) => Promise<unknown> | unknown;
interface Route { method: string; re: RegExp; keys: string[]; handler: Handler; auth: boolean; perm?: Permission }

export class Router {
  private routes: Route[] = [];
  constructor(private authenticate: (req: IncomingMessage, url: URL) => Promise<{ user: SessionUser; sessionId: string } | null>) {}

  add(method: string, path: string, handler: Handler, opts: { auth?: boolean; perm?: Permission } = {}): void {
    const keys: string[] = [];
    const re = new RegExp('^' + path.replace(/:([a-zA-Z]+)/g, (_, k) => { keys.push(k); return '([^/]+)'; }) + '$');
    this.routes.push({ method, re, keys, handler, auth: opts.auth ?? true, perm: opts.perm });
  }

  async handle(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, staticDir: string): Promise<void> {
    const url = new URL(req.url ?? '/', 'http://localhost');
    const ip = req.socket.remoteAddress ?? '';
    if (!url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return serveStatic(url.pathname, res, staticDir);
    const route = this.routes.find((r) => r.method === req.method && r.re.test(url.pathname));
    if (!route) return send(res, 404, { error: 'Not found' });
    const m = route.re.exec(url.pathname)!;
    const params: Record<string, string> = {};
    route.keys.forEach((k, i) => { params[k] = decodeURIComponent(m[i + 1]); });
    try {
      const ctx: Ctx = { req, res, params, query: url.searchParams, body: null, user: null, sessionId: null, ip };
      if (route.auth) {
        const a = await this.authenticate(req, url);
        if (!a) return send(res, 401, { error: 'Please sign in' });
        ctx.user = a.user;
        ctx.sessionId = a.sessionId;
        if (route.perm && !a.user.permissions.includes(route.perm)) {
          return send(res, 403, { error: `Your role (${a.user.roleName}) does not have the ${route.perm} permission` });
        }
      }
      if (req.method === 'POST' || req.method === 'PATCH' || req.method === 'PUT') ctx.body = await readJson(req);
      const out = await route.handler(ctx);
      if (!res.headersSent && !res.writableEnded) send(res, 200, out ?? { ok: true });
    } catch (e) {
      if (res.headersSent) { res.end(); return; }
      if (e instanceof AppError) return send(res, e.status, { error: e.message });
      console.error('[api]', req.method, url.pathname, e);
      send(res, 500, { error: 'Server error — see the server log' });
    }
  }
}

export function send(res: ServerResponse, status: number, body: unknown): void {
  const json = JSON.stringify(body);
  res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
  res.end(json);
}

async function readJson(req: IncomingMessage): Promise<unknown> {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
  let size = 0;
  for await (const c of req) {
    size += (c as Buffer).length;
    if (size > 1_000_000) throw new AppError(413, 'Request too large');
    chunks.push(c as Buffer);
  }
  if (!chunks.length) return {};
  try { return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')); } catch { throw new AppError(400, 'Invalid JSON body'); }
}

const MIME: Record<string, string> = {
  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
  '.json': 'application/json', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.png': 'image/png', '.ico': 'image/x-icon', '.map': 'application/json',
};

function serveStatic(pathname: string, res: ServerResponse, dir: string): void {
  const safe = normalize(decodeURIComponent(pathname)).replace(/^(\.\.[/\\])+/, '');
  let file = join(dir, safe);
  if (!file.startsWith(dir) || !existsSync(file) || statSync(file).isDirectory()) file = join(dir, 'index.html');
  if (!existsSync(file)) {
    res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
    res.end('Frontend not built. Run `npm run build`, or use `npm run dev` for development.');
    return;
  }
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': MIME[extname(file)] ?? 'application/octet-stream' });
  createReadStream(file).pipe(res);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- validation helpers
export function str(v: unknown, name: string, opts: { min?: number; max?: number; optional?: boolean } = {}): string {
  if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') {
    if (opts.optional) return '';
    throw new AppError(400, `${name} is required`);
  }
  if (typeof v !== 'string') throw new AppError(400, `${name} must be text`);
  const s = v.trim();
  if (opts.min && s.length < opts.min) throw new AppError(400, `${name} must be at least ${opts.min} characters`);
  if (opts.max && s.length > opts.max) throw new AppError(400, `${name} must be at most ${opts.max} characters`);
  return s;
}

export function oneOf<T extends string>(v: unknown, name: string, allowed: readonly T[]): T {
  if (typeof v !== 'string' || !allowed.includes(v as T)) throw new AppError(400, `${name} must be one of ${allowed.join(', ')}`);
  return v as T;
}

export function int(v: unknown, name: string, opts: { optional?: boolean; min?: number; max?: number } = {}): number | null {
  if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') {
    if (opts.optional) return null;
    throw new AppError(400, `${name} is required`);
  }
  const n = Number(v);
  if (!Number.isInteger(n)) throw new AppError(400, `${name} must be a whole number`);
  if (opts.min !== undefined && n < opts.min) throw new AppError(400, `${name} must be ≥ ${opts.min}`);
  if (opts.max !== undefined && n > opts.max) throw new AppError(400, `${name} must be ≤ ${opts.max}`);
  return n;
}

// CargoVerse API server: `npm run server` (Oracle) or `DB_MODE=memory npm run server`.
import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { config } from './config';
import type { Repo } from './db/repo';
import { MemoryRepo } from './db/memory';
import { OracleRepo } from './db/oracle';
import { SimHost } from './simhost';
import { buildRouter } from './routes';

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const repo: Repo = config.dbMode === 'memory' ? new MemoryRepo(config.memoryFile) : new OracleRepo(config.oracle);
  try {
    await repo.init();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(`\n[cargoverse] Could not start with DB_MODE=${config.dbMode}:\n  ${(e as Error).message}\n`);
    if (config.dbMode === 'oracle') {
      console.error('  Check that Oracle is running (npm run db:up), the schema is installed (npm run db:setup),');
      console.error(`  and ORACLE_CONNECT_STRING=${config.oracle.connectString} / ORACLE_USER=${config.oracle.user} in .env are correct.\n`);
    }
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const host = new SimHost(repo, config.persistEveryMs);
  await host.start();
  const router = buildRouter(repo, host, {
    secret: config.sessionSecret, rememberDays: config.rememberDays, shortHours: config.shortSessionHours, streamEveryMs: config.streamEveryMs,
  });

  const server = createServer((req, res) => { void router.handle(req, res, config.staticDir); });
  server.listen(config.port, () => {
    console.log(`[cargoverse] API on http://localhost:${config.port}  ·  database: ${repo.kind}${repo.kind === 'oracle' ? ` (${config.oracle.connectString})` : ` (${config.memoryFile})`}`);
  });

  const shutdown = async () => {
    console.log('\n[cargoverse] saving state and shutting down…');
    server.close();
    await host.stop();
    await repo.close();
    process.exit(0);
  };
  process.on('SIGINT', () => { void shutdown(); });
  process.on('SIGTERM', () => { void shutdown(); });
}

void main();

// API endpoints. Every route checks the caller's role permissions and facility access
// before calling the repository (which enforces the same rules again in Oracle).
import type { IncomingMessage } from 'node:http';
import type { FacilityId } from '../src/data/types';
import type { SessionUser, TaskStatus, TaskType, Priority, Role, SimControl } from '../src/api/types';
import { AppError, type Repo, LIVE_COUNT_TABLES, LIVE_ROW_TABLES } from './db/repo';
import { config } from './config';
import { Router, send, str, oneOf, int, type Ctx } from './http';
import { hashPassword, verifyPassword, validatePassword, newSessionId, signToken, readToken } from './auth';
import type { SimHost } from './simhost';
import { savedQueries } from './db/schema-meta';
import type { BuildingStatus } from '../src/data/park';
import { placeOrder, hasOpenOrder, chooseSupplier } from '../src/sim/retail';
import { portLog } from '../src/sim/port';
import { computeAlerts, taskFromAlert, runAssistant, assistantConfigured, type ChatTurn } from './agent';

const FACILITIES: FacilityId[] = ['WH-01', 'WH-02', 'WH-04'];
const TASK_TYPES: TaskType[] = ['UNLOAD', 'LOAD', 'PUTAWAY', 'CYCLE_COUNT', 'MAINTENANCE', 'DOCK_CHECK', 'OTHER'];
const PRIORITIES: Priority[] = ['LOW', 'NORMAL', 'HIGH', 'URGENT'];
const STATUSES: TaskStatus[] = ['OPEN', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED', 'DONE', 'CANCELLED'];
const ROLES: Role[] = ['ADMIN', 'MANAGER', 'OPERATOR'];

interface Opts { secret: string; rememberDays: number; shortHours: number; streamEveryMs: number }

export function buildRouter(repo: Repo, host: SimHost, opts: Opts): Router {
  // ------------------------------------------------------------ sessions (cached)
  const sessionCache = new Map<string, { userId: number; expires: number; remember: boolean; checked: number; extended: number }>();
  const userCache = new Map<number, { user: SessionUser; at: number }>();
  const invalidateUser = (id: number) => userCache.delete(id);

  async function authenticate(req: IncomingMessage, url: URL) {
    const header = req.headers.authorization;
    const token = header?.startsWith('Bearer ') ? header.slice(7) : url.searchParams.get('token');
    const sid = readToken(token, opts.secret);
    if (!sid) return null;
    const now = Date.now();
    let s = sessionCache.get(sid);
    if (!s || now - s.checked > 30000) {
      const row = await repo.getSession(sid);
      if (!row || row.revoked) { sessionCache.delete(sid); return null; }
      s = { userId: row.userId, expires: row.expiresAt.getTime(), remember: row.remember, checked: now, extended: s?.extended ?? 0 };
      sessionCache.set(sid, s);
    }
    if (s.expires < now) return null;
    // keep "remember me" sessions alive while they are used (renewed at most hourly)
    if (s.remember && now - s.extended > 3600000) {
      s.extended = now;
      s.expires = now + opts.rememberDays * 86400000;
      void repo.extendSession(sid, opts.rememberDays).catch(() => undefined);
    }
    let u = userCache.get(s.userId);
    if (!u || now - u.at > 15000) {
      const user = await repo.sessionUser(s.userId);
      if (!user) { sessionCache.delete(sid); return null; }
      u = { user, at: now };
      userCache.set(s.userId, u);
    }
    return { user: u.user, sessionId: sid };
  }

  const router = new Router(authenticate);
  const failures = new Map<string, { n: number; first: number }>();

  const facilityScope = (user: SessionUser, requested: string | null): FacilityId[] => {
    if (!requested) return user.facilities;
    const f = requested as FacilityId;
    if (!user.facilities.includes(f)) throw new AppError(403, `You do not have access to ${requested}`);
    return [f];
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ auth
  router.add('POST', '/api/auth/login', async (ctx) => {
    const username = str(ctx.body?.username, 'Username', { max: 40 }).toLowerCase();
    const password = str(ctx.body?.password, 'Password', { max: 200 });
    const remember = ctx.body?.remember !== false;
    const key = `${username}|${ctx.ip}`;
    const f = failures.get(key);
    if (f && f.n >= 5 && Date.now() - f.first < 300000) throw new AppError(429, 'Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.');
    const login = await repo.findLogin(username);
    const passwordOk = !!login && verifyPassword(password, login.passwordHash);
    const ok = passwordOk && !!login && login.active;
    await repo.recordLogin(login?.userId ?? null, username, ok);
    host.bump('audit');
    if (!ok || !login) {
      const cur = failures.get(key);
      failures.set(key, cur && Date.now() - cur.first < 300000 ? { n: cur.n + 1, first: cur.first } : { n: 1, first: Date.now() });
      // only reveal that an account is deactivated to someone who knows its password
      throw new AppError(401, passwordOk && login && !login.active ? 'This account has been deactivated. Contact your administrator.' : 'Wrong username or password');
    }
    failures.delete(key);
    const sid = newSessionId();
    const days = remember ? opts.rememberDays : opts.shortHours / 24;
    await repo.createSession(sid, login.userId, days, String(ctx.req.headers['user-agent'] ?? '').slice(0, 200));
    const user = await repo.sessionUser(login.userId);
    return { token: signToken(sid, opts.secret), user };
  }, { auth: false });

  router.add('POST', '/api/auth/logout', async (ctx) => {
    if (ctx.sessionId) { await repo.revokeSession(ctx.sessionId); sessionCache.delete(ctx.sessionId); host.bump('audit'); }
    return { ok: true };
  });

  router.add('GET', '/api/auth/me', (ctx) => ({ user: ctx.user }));

  router.add('GET', '/api/health', () => ({ ok: true, db: repo.kind }), { auth: false });

  router.add('GET', '/api/meta', async () => ({
    roles: await repo.listRoles(), jobTitles: await repo.listJobTitles(), db: repo.kind,
  }));

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ live stream (Server-Sent Events)
  router.add('GET', '/api/stream', (ctx) => {
    const user = ctx.user!;
    const res = ctx.res;
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-transform', Connection: 'keep-alive', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no' });
    const push = () => res.write(`event: snapshot\ndata: ${host.snapshot(user.facilities)}\n\n`);
    push();
    const timer = setInterval(push, opts.streamEveryMs);
    const ping = setInterval(() => res.write(': ping\n\n'), 15000);
    ctx.req.on('close', () => { clearInterval(timer); clearInterval(ping); });
    return new Promise<void>(() => undefined); // keep the response open
  });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ operations control
  router.add('POST', '/api/sim/control', async (ctx) => {
    const next: SimControl = { ...host.control };
    if (ctx.body?.paused !== undefined) next.paused = !!ctx.body.paused;
    if (ctx.body?.speed !== undefined) next.speed = Number(oneOf(String(ctx.body.speed), 'speed', ['1', '2', '4']));
    await repo.saveControl(next, ctx.user!.userId);
    host.setControl(next);
    host.bump('audit');
    return next;
  }, { perm: 'CONTROL_SIMULATION' });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ tasks
  router.add('GET', '/api/tasks', async (ctx) => {
    const u = ctx.user!;
    const facilities = facilityScope(u, ctx.query.get('facility'));
    const closed = ctx.query.get('closed') === '1';
    const mine = ctx.query.get('scope') === 'mine' || !u.permissions.includes('MANAGE_TASKS');
    if (mine && !u.permissions.includes('UPDATE_OWN_TASKS')) throw new AppError(403, 'Not permitted');
    return repo.listTasks({ facilities, assigneeId: mine ? u.employeeId : undefined, includeClosed: closed, limit: 300 });
  });

  router.add('POST', '/api/tasks', async (ctx) => {
    const b = ctx.body ?? {};
    const u = ctx.user!;
    const facilityId = oneOf(b.facilityId, 'facilityId', FACILITIES);
    facilityScope(u, facilityId);
    const id = await repo.createTask(u.userId, {
      facilityId,
      title: str(b.title, 'Title', { min: 3, max: 160 }),
      description: str(b.description, 'Description', { optional: true, max: 1000 }),
      type: oneOf(b.type, 'type', TASK_TYPES),
      priority: oneOf(b.priority ?? 'NORMAL', 'priority', PRIORITIES),
      assigneeId: int(b.assigneeId, 'assigneeId', { optional: true, min: 1 }),
      truckId: b.truckId ? str(b.truckId, 'truckId', { max: 20 }) : null,
      dockId: b.dockId ? str(b.dockId, 'dockId', { max: 20 }) : null,
      dueMinutes: int(b.dueMinutes, 'dueMinutes', { optional: true, min: 1, max: 60 * 24 * 14 }),
      source: 'MANUAL',
    });
    host.bump('tasks'); host.bump('audit');
    return repo.getTask(id);
  }, { perm: 'MANAGE_TASKS' });

  router.add('GET', '/api/tasks/:id/updates', async (ctx) => {
    const id = int(ctx.params.id, 'id')!;
    const task = await repo.getTask(id);
    if (!task) throw new AppError(404, 'Task not found');
    const u = ctx.user!;
    facilityScope(u, task.facilityId);
    if (!u.permissions.includes('MANAGE_TASKS') && task.assigneeId !== u.employeeId) throw new AppError(403, 'Not permitted');
    return repo.taskUpdates(id);
  });

  router.add('PATCH', '/api/tasks/:id/status', async (ctx) => {
    const id = int(ctx.params.id, 'id')!;
    const status = oneOf(ctx.body?.status, 'status', STATUSES);
    const note = ctx.body?.note ? str(ctx.body.note, 'Note', { max: 1000 }) : null;
    if (status === 'BLOCKED' && !note) throw new AppError(400, 'Please say what is blocking the task');
    await repo.changeTaskStatus(ctx.user!.userId, id, status, note);
    host.bump('tasks'); host.bump('audit');
    return repo.getTask(id);
  }, { perm: 'UPDATE_OWN_TASKS' });

  router.add('PATCH', '/api/tasks/:id/assign', async (ctx) => {
    const id = int(ctx.params.id, 'id')!;
    const assignee = int(ctx.body?.assigneeId, 'assigneeId', { min: 1 })!;
    const note = ctx.body?.note ? str(ctx.body.note, 'Note', { max: 1000 }) : null;
    await repo.assignTask(ctx.user!.userId, id, assignee, note);
    host.bump('tasks'); host.bump('audit');
    return repo.getTask(id);
  }, { perm: 'MANAGE_TASKS' });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ people
  router.add('GET', '/api/employees', async (ctx) => {
    const u = ctx.user!;
    const facilities = facilityScope(u, ctx.query.get('facility'));
    const all = u.permissions.includes('VIEW_ALL_FACILITIES') && !ctx.query.get('facility');
    return repo.listEmployees(all ? null : facilities);
  }, { perm: 'VIEW_TEAM' });

  router.add('GET', '/api/users', () => repo.listUsers(), { perm: 'MANAGE_USERS' });

  router.add('POST', '/api/users', async (ctx) => {
    const b = ctx.body ?? {};
    const password = str(b.password, 'Password', { max: 200 });
    const pwErr = validatePassword(password);
    if (pwErr) throw new AppError(400, pwErr);
    const username = str(b.username, 'Username', { min: 3, max: 40 }).toLowerCase();
    if (!/^[a-z0-9._-]+$/.test(username)) throw new AppError(400, 'Username may contain only letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore');
    const email = str(b.email, 'Email', { max: 120 });
    if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) throw new AppError(400, 'Email address is not valid');
    const facilities = Array.isArray(b.facilities) ? b.facilities.map((f: unknown) => oneOf(f, 'facility', FACILITIES)) : [];
    const id = await repo.createUser(ctx.user!.userId, {
      username, passwordHash: hashPassword(password), role: oneOf(b.role, 'role', ROLES),
      fullName: str(b.fullName, 'Full name', { min: 2, max: 80 }), email, phone: b.phone ? str(b.phone, 'Phone', { max: 30 }) : null,
      jobCode: str(b.jobCode, 'Job title', { max: 30 }), homeFacility: b.homeFacility ? oneOf(b.homeFacility, 'homeFacility', FACILITIES) : null,
      facilities,
    });
    host.bump('audit');
    return (await repo.listUsers()).find((x) => x.id === id);
  }, { perm: 'MANAGE_USERS' });

  router.add('PATCH', '/api/users/:id', async (ctx) => {
    const id = int(ctx.params.id, 'id')!;
    const b = ctx.body ?? {};
    let passwordHash: string | undefined;
    if (b.password) {
      const err = validatePassword(String(b.password));
      if (err) throw new AppError(400, err);
      passwordHash = hashPassword(String(b.password));
    }
    await repo.updateUser(ctx.user!.userId, id, {
      role: b.role === undefined ? undefined : oneOf(b.role, 'role', ROLES),
      active: b.active === undefined ? undefined : !!b.active,
      facilities: Array.isArray(b.facilities) ? b.facilities.map((f: unknown) => oneOf(f, 'facility', FACILITIES)) : undefined,
      passwordHash,
    });
    invalidateUser(id);
    if (b.active === false) for (const [sid, s] of sessionCache) if (s.userId === id) sessionCache.delete(sid);
    host.bump('audit');
    return (await repo.listUsers()).find((x) => x.id === id);
  }, { perm: 'MANAGE_USERS' });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ history & reports
  router.add('GET', '/api/audit', async (ctx) => {
    const u = ctx.user!;
    const requested = ctx.query.get('facility');
    const all = u.permissions.includes('VIEW_ALL_FACILITIES') && !requested;
    return repo.listAudit({
      facilities: all ? null : facilityScope(u, requested),
      limit: int(ctx.query.get('limit') ?? 100, 'limit', { min: 1, max: 500 })!,
      beforeId: int(ctx.query.get('before'), 'before', { optional: true }) ?? undefined,
    });
  }, { perm: 'VIEW_AUDIT' });

  router.add('GET', '/api/reports/kpis', async (ctx) => repo.kpis(facilityScope(ctx.user!, ctx.query.get('facility'))), { perm: 'VIEW_REPORTS' });
  router.add('GET', '/api/reports/workload', async (ctx) => repo.workload(facilityScope(ctx.user!, ctx.query.get('facility'))), { perm: 'VIEW_REPORTS' });
  router.add('GET', '/api/reports/low-stock', async (ctx) => repo.lowStock(facilityScope(ctx.user!, ctx.query.get('facility'))), { perm: 'VIEW_REPORTS' });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ logistics park (tenants, buildings, gates, imports / exports)
  // The park map and directory are visible to every signed-in user; changes need MANAGE_PARK.
  router.add('GET', '/api/park', () => repo.park());

  router.add('PATCH', '/api/park/buildings/:id', async (ctx) => {
    const b = ctx.body ?? {};
    const leaseEnd = b.leaseEnd === undefined || b.leaseEnd === null || b.leaseEnd === '' ? undefined : str(b.leaseEnd, 'Lease end', { max: 10 });
    if (leaseEnd && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(leaseEnd)) throw new AppError(400, 'Lease end must be a date (YYYY-MM-DD)');
    await repo.updateBuilding(ctx.user!.userId, str(ctx.params.id, 'id', { max: 20 }), {
      status: b.status === undefined ? undefined : oneOf<BuildingStatus>(b.status, 'status', ['OPERATING', 'MAINTENANCE', 'VACANT', 'CONSTRUCTION']),
      staff: int(b.staff, 'staff', { optional: true, min: 0, max: 99999 }) ?? undefined,
      leaseEnd,
    });
    host.bump('audit');
    return (await repo.park()).buildings.find((x) => x.id === ctx.params.id);
  }, { perm: 'MANAGE_PARK' });

  router.add('GET', '/api/park/gate-log', async (ctx) =>
    repo.gateLog(facilityScope(ctx.user!, ctx.query.get('facility')), int(ctx.query.get('limit') ?? 60, 'limit', { min: 1, max: 500 })!));
  router.add('GET', '/api/park/trade', async (ctx) => repo.trade(facilityScope(ctx.user!, ctx.query.get('facility'))));

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ container port
  router.add('GET', '/api/port/moves', async (ctx) => {
    const box = ctx.query.get('container');
    const vessel = ctx.query.get('vessel');
    return repo.containerMoves({
      limit: int(ctx.query.get('limit') ?? '60', 'limit', { min: 1, max: 500 })!,
      container: box ? str(box, 'container', { max: 11 }).toUpperCase() : undefined,
      vesselId: vessel ? str(vessel, 'vessel', { max: 10 }) : undefined,
    });
  });
  router.add('GET', '/api/port/calls', async (ctx) => repo.vesselCalls(int(ctx.query.get('limit') ?? '30', 'limit', { min: 1, max: 200 })!));
  router.add('POST', '/api/port/vessels/:id/hold', async (ctx) => {
    const v = host.world.port.vessels[ctx.params.id];
    if (!v) throw new AppError(404, 'Vessel not found');
    const hold = !!ctx.body?.hold;
    if (v.hold === hold) throw new AppError(409, `${v.name} is ${hold ? 'already on hold' : 'not on hold'}`);
    await repo.setVesselHold(ctx.user!.userId, v.id, hold);
    v.hold = hold;
    portLog(host.world, `${v.name} ${hold ? 'held by' : 'released by'} ${ctx.user!.fullName}`, { kind: 'vessel', id: v.id });
    host.bump('audit');
    return v;
  }, { perm: 'MANAGE_PORT' });
  router.add('POST', '/api/port/berths/:id/open', async (ctx) => {
    const P = host.world.port;
    const b = P.berths[ctx.params.id];
    if (!b) throw new AppError(404, 'Berth not found');
    const open = !!ctx.body?.open;
    if (b.open === open) throw new AppError(409, `${b.name} is already ${open ? 'open' : 'closed'}`);
    if (!open && !Object.values(P.berths).some((x) => x.id !== b.id && x.open)) throw new AppError(400, 'At least one berth must stay open');
    await repo.setBerthOpen(ctx.user!.userId, b.id, open);
    b.open = open;
    portLog(host.world, `${b.name} ${open ? 'reopened' : 'closed to new arrivals'} by ${ctx.user!.fullName}`, { kind: 'berth', id: b.id });
    host.bump('audit');
    return b;
  }, { perm: 'MANAGE_PORT' });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ vendor stores
  router.add('GET', '/api/retail/orders', async (ctx) => {
    const store = ctx.query.get('store');
    return repo.storeOrders({
      storeId: store ? str(store, 'store', { max: 8 }) : undefined,
      facilities: ctx.user!.facilities,
      limit: int(ctx.query.get('limit') ?? '40', 'limit', { min: 1, max: 300 })!,
    });
  });
  router.add('POST', '/api/retail/orders', async (ctx) => {
    const w = host.world;
    const st = w.retail.stores[str(ctx.body?.storeId, 'storeId', { max: 8 })];
    if (!st) throw new AppError(404, 'Store not found');
    const skuId = str(ctx.body?.skuId, 'skuId', { max: 20 });
    const line = st.lines.find((l) => l.skuId === skuId);
    if (!line) throw new AppError(400, `${st.name} does not stock ${skuId}`);
    const units = int(ctx.body?.units, 'units', { min: 1, max: line.maxUnits * 2 })!;
    if (hasOpenOrder(w, st.id, skuId)) throw new AppError(409, `${st.name} already has an open order for this product`);
    const wanted = ctx.body?.facilityId ? oneOf(ctx.body.facilityId, 'facilityId', FACILITIES) : null;
    const facilityId = wanted ?? chooseSupplier(w, st.facilityId, skuId, units);
    if (!facilityId) throw new AppError(400, 'No warehouse has enough stock for this order');
    facilityScope(ctx.user!, facilityId);
    const have = w.facilities[facilityId]?.inventory.find((l) => l.skuId === skuId)?.units ?? 0;
    if (have < units) throw new AppError(400, `${facilityId} has only ${have} units of ${skuId}`);
    const id = `SO-${w.retail.nextOrder++}`;
    await repo.placeStoreOrder(ctx.user!.userId, { id, storeId: st.id, skuId, units, facilityId, simTime: w.simTime });
    const order = placeOrder(w, { id, storeId: st.id, skuId, units, facilityId, source: 'MANUAL', placedBy: ctx.user!.userId });
    host.bump('audit');
    return order;
  }, { perm: 'MANAGE_RETAIL' });
  router.add('POST', '/api/retail/orders/:id/cancel', async (ctx) => {
    const o = host.world.retail.orders[ctx.params.id];
    if (!o) throw new AppError(404, 'Order not found (or already finished)');
    facilityScope(ctx.user!, o.facilityId);
    if (o.status !== 'PLACED') throw new AppError(409, `Only orders that are not yet loaded can be cancelled (this one is ${o.status})`);
    await repo.cancelStoreOrder(ctx.user!.userId, o.id);
    o.status = 'CANCELLED';
    host.bump('audit');
    return o;
  }, { perm: 'MANAGE_RETAIL' });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ database workspace
  router.add('GET', '/api/db/overview', () => repo.dbOverview(), { perm: 'VIEW_DATABASE' });
  router.add('GET', '/api/db/tables/:name', async (ctx) => {
    const name = str(ctx.params.name, 'table', { max: 60 });
    if (!/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_$#]*$/.test(name)) throw new AppError(400, 'Not a table name');
    return repo.dbTable(name);
  }, { perm: 'VIEW_DATABASE' });
  router.add('GET', '/api/db/queries', () => savedQueries(), { perm: 'VIEW_DATABASE' });
  router.add('POST', '/api/db/sql', async (ctx) => {
    const r = await repo.runSql(ctx.user!.userId, str(ctx.body?.sql, 'SQL', { max: 20000 }));
    host.bump('audit');
    return r;
  }, { perm: 'RUN_SQL' });
  router.add('GET', '/api/db/activity', (ctx) => {
    const all = repo.sqlActivity();
    return ctx.query.get('source') === 'all' ? all : all.filter((a) => a.source === 'api');
  }, { perm: 'RUN_SQL' });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ live database feed (every signed-in user)
  // Row counts are read from the database at most once a second, however many browsers are polling.
  let countsCache: { at: number; iso: string; counts: Record<string, number> } | null = null;
  let countsPending: Promise<void> | null = null;
  const liveCounts = async () => {
    if (!countsCache || Date.now() - countsCache.at > 1000) {
      countsPending ??= repo.liveCounts(LIVE_COUNT_TABLES)
        .then((counts) => { countsCache = { at: Date.now(), iso: new Date().toISOString(), counts }; })
        .finally(() => { countsPending = null; });
      await countsPending;
    }
    return countsCache!;
  };
  router.add('GET', '/api/db/live', async (ctx) => {
    const c = await liveCounts();
    const canSee = ctx.user!.permissions.includes('VIEW_DATABASE');
    return {
      status: host.db,
      target: repo.kind === 'oracle' ? `${config.oracle.user}@${config.oracle.connectString}` : 'in-memory development store',
      commits: host.commits.slice().reverse(),
      counts: c.counts, countsAt: c.iso,
      statements: canSee ? repo.sqlActivity().filter((a) => a.source !== 'live').slice(0, 40) : [],
    };
  });
  router.add('GET', '/api/db/row/:kind/:id', async (ctx) => {
    const map = LIVE_ROW_TABLES[String(ctx.params.kind)];
    if (!map) throw new AppError(404, 'This item is not stored as a single row');
    const id = str(ctx.params.id, 'id', { max: 40 });
    const row = await repo.liveRow(map.table, map.key, id);
    if (!row) throw new AppError(404, `No row in ${map.table} with ${map.key} = ${id}`);
    const fi = row.columns.indexOf('FACILITY_ID');
    const fac = fi >= 0 ? row.values[fi] : null;
    if (fac && !ctx.user!.facilities.includes(fac as FacilityId)) throw new AppError(403, `You do not have access to ${String(fac)}`);
    return row;
  });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ AI agents: exception watcher + assistant
  router.add('GET', '/api/alerts', async (ctx) => computeAlerts(host.world, repo, facilityScope(ctx.user!, ctx.query.get('facility'))), { perm: 'VIEW_TEAM' });

  router.add('POST', '/api/alerts/task', async (ctx) => {
    const id = str(ctx.body?.alertId, 'alertId', { max: 120 });
    const task = await taskFromAlert(host.world, repo, ctx.user!, id, int(ctx.body?.assigneeId, 'assigneeId', { optional: true, min: 1 }));
    host.bump('tasks'); host.bump('audit');
    return task;
  }, { perm: 'MANAGE_TASKS' });

  router.add('GET', '/api/assistant/status', () => ({ configured: assistantConfigured(), model: process.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL ?? 'claude-sonnet-5-5' }));

  const askTimes = new Map<number, number[]>();
  router.add('POST', '/api/assistant', async (ctx) => {
    const u = ctx.user!;
    const now = Date.now();
    const recent = (askTimes.get(u.userId) ?? []).filter((t) => now - t < 60000);
    if (recent.length >= 12) throw new AppError(429, 'Too many questions in a minute — please wait a moment.');
    askTimes.set(u.userId, [...recent, now]);
    const raw = Array.isArray(ctx.body?.messages) ? ctx.body.messages : [];
    const history: ChatTurn[] = raw
      .filter((m: { role?: string; content?: unknown }) => (m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'assistant') && typeof m.content === 'string' && m.content.trim())
      .map((m: { role: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string }) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }));
    const fac = (ctx.body?.facilityId as FacilityId) ?? u.facilities[0];
    return runAssistant(host, repo, u, history, fac);
  }, { perm: 'VIEW_DASHBOARD' });

  return router;
}

export { send };
export type { Ctx };

====================================================================================================
FILE: waretrack/server/simhost.ts

// Runs the shared operations simulation on the server, persists every change to
// the database, turns floor events into staff tasks, and serves live snapshots.
import type { WorldState, FacilityId } from '../src/data/types';
import type { SimControl, DbLiveStatus, DbCommit } from '../src/api/types';
import { stepWorld, syncPoses, setSimSink, type SimOp } from '../src/sim/engine';
import { SKUS } from '../src/data/seed';
import type { Repo, StockOp, EventOp, GateOp, BoxOp, CallOp, PersistBatch } from './db/repo';

const r1 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 10) / 10;

export class SimHost {
  world!: WorldState;
  control: SimControl = { paused: false, speed: 1 };
  operators: Record<string, number> = {};
  versions = { tasks: 1, audit: 1, world: 1, gate: 1 };

  private stock: StockOp[] = [];
  private events: EventOp[] = [];
  private gate: GateOp[] = [];
  private box: BoxOp[] = [];
  private calls: CallOp[] = [];
  private ops: SimOp[] = [];
  private saved = new Map<string, string>();
  private last = performance.now();
  private tickTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
  private flushTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
  private flushing = false;
  private snapCache = new Map<string, { v: string; json: string }>();

  /** Write-through status of the database (shown live in the header and the Database tab). */
  db: DbLiveStatus;
  readonly commits: DbCommit[] = [];

  constructor(private repo: Repo, private persistEveryMs: number) {
    this.db = {
      engine: repo.kind, commits: 0, failures: 0, rowsWritten: 0, lastCommitAt: null, lastCommitMs: 0, lastRows: 0,
      lastTables: {}, lastError: null, lastErrorAt: null,
    };
  }

  private recordCommit(b: PersistBatch, ms: number, error?: string): void {
    const tables: Record<string, number> = {};
    const add = (t: string, n: number) => { if (n > 0) tables[t] = (tables[t] ?? 0) + n; };
    add('STOCK_MOVEMENTS', b.stock.length);
    add('OPERATION_EVENTS', b.events.length);
    add('PARK_GATE_LOG', b.gate.length);
    add('SHIPMENTS', b.shipments.length);
    add('TRUCKS', b.trucks.length);
    add('DOCKS', b.docks.length);
    add('PALLETS', b.pallets.length + b.deletedPallets.length);
    add('FORKLIFTS', b.forklifts.length);
    add('CHARGERS', b.chargers.length);
    add('FACILITIES', b.facilities.length);
    add('SIM_STATE', 1);
    const rows = Object.values(tables).reduce((a, n) => a + n, 0);
    const at = new Date().toISOString();
    const d = this.db;
    if (error) {
      d.failures++; d.lastError = error; d.lastErrorAt = at;
    } else {
      d.commits++; d.rowsWritten += rows; d.lastCommitAt = at; d.lastCommitMs = ms; d.lastRows = rows; d.lastTables = tables;
    }
    this.commits.push({ seq: d.commits + d.failures, at, ms, rows: error ? 0 : rows, tables: error ? {} : tables, ok: !error, error });
    if (this.commits.length > 40) this.commits.splice(0, this.commits.length - 40);
  }

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    const loaded = await this.repo.loadWorld();
    this.world = loaded.world;
    this.control = loaded.control;
    this.operators = loaded.operators;
    syncPoses(this.world);
    if (this.repo.kind === 'oracle') this.markAllSaved();
    setSimSink((op) => this.onOp(op));
    this.last = performance.now();
    this.tickTimer = setInterval(() => this.tick(), 50);
    this.flushTimer = setInterval(() => { void this.flush(); }, this.persistEveryMs);
    // make sure work already in progress at start-up has a task for its operator
    for (const t of Object.values(this.world.trucks)) {
      if (t.phase === 'working' && t.forkliftId) this.ops.push({ k: 'assigned', forkliftId: t.forkliftId, truckId: t.id });
    }
  }

  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.tickTimer) clearInterval(this.tickTimer);
    if (this.flushTimer) clearInterval(this.flushTimer);
    setSimSink(null);
    await this.flush();
  }

  setControl(c: SimControl): void {
    this.control = { ...c };
    this.versions.world++;
  }

  bump(kind: 'tasks' | 'audit'): void {
    this.versions[kind]++;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- simulation
  private tick(): void {
    const now = performance.now();
    const dt = Math.min(1, (now - this.last) / 1000);
    this.last = now;
    if (this.control.paused) return;
    let remaining = dt * this.control.speed;
    while (remaining > 1e-6) {
      const step = Math.min(0.2, remaining);
      stepWorld(this.world, step);
      remaining -= step;
    }
    this.versions.world++;
  }

  private onOp(op: SimOp): void {
    if (op.k === 'stock') this.stock.push(op);
    else if (op.k === 'event') this.events.push(op);
    else if (op.k === 'gate') { this.gate.push(op); this.versions.gate++; }
    else if (op.k === 'box') this.box.push(op);
    else if (op.k === 'call') this.calls.push(op);
    else this.ops.push(op);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- persistence
  private fp(kind: string, e: unknown): string {
    switch (kind) {
      case 'truck': {
        const t = e as WorldState['trucks'][string];
        return [t.phase, t.dockId, t.cargo, t.shipmentId, t.skuId, t.forkliftId, t.legIdx, r1(t.legDist), r1(t.pos.x), r1(t.pos.z),
          Math.round(Math.max(0, t.awayUntil - this.world.realTime))].join('|');
      }
      case 'forklift': {
        const f = e as WorldState['forklifts'][string];
        return [Math.round(f.battery * 2) / 2, f.task, f.truckId, f.palletId, f.movesToday, r1(f.pos.x), r1(f.pos.z),
          JSON.stringify(f.pick), JSON.stringify(f.drop)].join('|');
      }
      case 'pallet': {
        const p = e as WorldState['pallets'][string];
        return [p.slot, p.forkliftId, p.reserved, p.received].join('|');
      }
      case 'dock': { const d = e as WorldState['docks'][string]; return [d.truckId, d.trucksToday].join('|'); }
      case 'charger': { const c = e as WorldState['chargers'][string]; return [c.sessionsToday, r1(c.energyKwh)].join('|'); }
      case 'facility': { const f = e as WorldState['facilities'][string]; return [f.outboundToday, f.putawaysToday].join('|'); }
      case 'shipment': {
        const s = e as WorldState['shipments'][string];
        return [s.loadedAt, s.transitAt, s.deliveredAt, s.onTime, s.promisedAt].join('|');
      }
      case 'vessel': {
        const v = e as WorldState['port']['vessels'][string];
        return [v.status, v.berthId, r1(v.dist), v.importBoxes, v.exportBoxes, v.discharged, v.loaded, v.hold, v.voyage, Math.round(v.timer), Math.round(v.waited / 5)].join('|');
      }
      case 'berth': { const b = e as WorldState['port']['berths'][string]; return [b.open, b.vesselId].join('|'); }
      case 'crane': { const c = e as WorldState['port']['cranes'][string]; return [c.phase, Math.round(c.cycle * 5), c.movesToday].join('|'); }
      case 'store': { const st = e as WorldState['retail']['stores'][string]; return String(st.deliveriesToday); }
      case 'storeLine': { const l = e as WorldState['retail']['stores'][string]['lines'][number]; return [l.units, l.soldToday].join('|'); }
      case 'order': {
        const o = e as WorldState['retail']['orders'][string];
        return [o.status, o.units, o.vanId, o.dispatchedAt, o.deliveredAt].join('|');
      }
      case 'van': { const v = e as WorldState['retail']['vans'][string]; return [v.status, v.orderId, r1(v.dist), Math.round(v.timer), v.tripsToday].join('|'); }
      default: return '';
    }
  }

  private collections(): [string, Record<string, unknown>][] {
    const w = this.world;
    const lines: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const st of Object.values(w.retail.stores)) for (const l of st.lines) lines[`${st.id}:${l.skuId}`] = l;
    return [['shipment', w.shipments], ['truck', w.trucks], ['dock', w.docks], ['pallet', w.pallets], ['forklift', w.forklifts],
      ['charger', w.chargers], ['facility', w.facilities], ['vessel', w.port.vessels], ['berth', w.port.berths], ['crane', w.port.cranes],
      ['store', w.retail.stores], ['storeLine', lines], ['order', w.retail.orders], ['van', w.retail.vans]];
  }

  private markAllSaved(): void {
    for (const [kind, coll] of this.collections()) {
      for (const [id, e] of Object.entries(coll)) this.saved.set(`${kind}:${id}`, this.fp(kind, e));
    }
  }

  async flush(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.flushing || !this.world) return;
    this.flushing = true;
    try {
      const w = this.world;
      const batch: PersistBatch = {
        world: w, stock: this.stock.splice(0), events: this.events.splice(0), gate: this.gate.splice(0),
        trucks: [], shipments: [], forklifts: [], pallets: [], deletedPallets: [], docks: [], chargers: [], facilities: [],
        box: this.box.splice(0), calls: this.calls.splice(0), vessels: [], berths: [], cranes: [], storeLines: [], stores: [], orders: [], vans: [],
      };
      const next = new Map<string, string>();
      const changed = <T>(kind: string, id: string, e: T, out: T[]) => {
        const f = this.fp(kind, e);
        next.set(`${kind}:${id}`, f);
        if (this.saved.get(`${kind}:${id}`) !== f) out.push(e);
      };
      for (const s of Object.values(w.shipments)) changed('shipment', s.id, s, batch.shipments);
      for (const t of Object.values(w.trucks)) changed('truck', t.id, t, batch.trucks);
      for (const d of Object.values(w.docks)) changed('dock', d.id, d, batch.docks);
      for (const p of Object.values(w.pallets)) changed('pallet', p.id, p, batch.pallets);
      for (const f of Object.values(w.forklifts)) changed('forklift', f.id, f, batch.forklifts);
      for (const c of Object.values(w.chargers)) changed('charger', c.id, c, batch.chargers);
      for (const f of Object.values(w.facilities)) changed('facility', f.id, f, batch.facilities);
      for (const v of Object.values(w.port.vessels)) changed('vessel', v.id, v, batch.vessels);
      for (const b of Object.values(w.port.berths)) changed('berth', b.id, b, batch.berths);
      for (const c of Object.values(w.port.cranes)) changed('crane', c.id, c, batch.cranes);
      for (const st of Object.values(w.retail.stores)) {
        changed('store', st.id, st, batch.stores);
        const touched: typeof st.lines = [];
        for (const l of st.lines) changed('storeLine', `${st.id}:${l.skuId}`, l, touched);
        for (const l of touched) batch.storeLines.push({ storeId: st.id, line: l });
      }
      for (const o of Object.values(w.retail.orders)) changed('order', o.id, o, batch.orders);
      for (const v of Object.values(w.retail.vans)) changed('van', v.id, v, batch.vans);
      for (const key of this.saved.keys()) {
        if (key.startsWith('pallet:') && !next.has(key)) batch.deletedPallets.push(key.slice(7));
      }
      // shipments and store orders pruned from memory stay in the database as history
      for (const [key, v] of this.saved) if ((key.startsWith('shipment:') || key.startsWith('order:')) && !next.has(key)) next.set(key, v);
      const t0 = performance.now();
      try {
        await this.repo.persist(batch);
        this.saved = next;
        this.recordCommit(batch, Math.round((performance.now() - t0) * 10) / 10);
      } catch (err) {
        this.recordCommit(batch, Math.round((performance.now() - t0) * 10) / 10, String((err as Error).message).split('\n')[0]);
        // keep ledger rows for the next attempt; entity rows are re-diffed anyway
        this.stock.unshift(...batch.stock);
        this.events.unshift(...batch.events);
        this.gate.unshift(...batch.gate);
        this.box.unshift(...batch.box);
        this.calls.unshift(...batch.calls);
        console.error('[persist] failed:', (err as Error).message);
        return;
      }
      await this.runAutomation();
    } finally {
      this.flushing = false;
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- task automation
  private async runAutomation(): Promise<void> {
    const ops = this.ops.splice(0);
    let touched = false;
    for (const op of ops) {
      try {
        if (op.k === 'assigned') touched = (await this.onAssigned(op.forkliftId, op.truckId)) || touched;
        else if (op.k === 'workDone') touched = (await this.onWorkDone(op.truckId)) || touched;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[automation]', op.k, (err as Error).message);
      }
    }
    if (touched) this.bump('tasks');
  }

  private async onAssigned(forkliftId: string, truckId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const w = this.world;
    const t = w.trucks[truckId];
    const f = w.forklifts[forkliftId];
    if (!t || !f || t.phase !== 'working') return false;
    const emp = this.operators[forkliftId] ?? null;
    const open = await this.repo.openSystemTasks(truckId);
    if (open.length) {
      const task = open[0];
      if (emp !== null && task.assigneeId !== emp) {
        await this.repo.assignTask(null, task.id, emp, `Reassigned to ${f.operator} on ${f.id}`);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    const s = w.shipments[t.shipmentId];
    const dock = t.dockId ? w.docks[t.dockId] : null;
    const verb = t.direction === 'inbound' ? 'Unload' : 'Load';
    const left = t.direction === 'inbound' ? t.cargo : t.capacity - t.cargo;
    await this.repo.createTask(null, {
      facilityId: t.facilityId,
      title: `${verb} ${t.id} at ${dock?.name ?? 'dock'}`,
      description: `${verb} ${t.capacity} pallets of ${SKUS[t.skuId]?.name ?? t.skuId} for ${s ? `${s.id} (${s.customer})` : 'the current shipment'} using ${f.id}.`,
      type: t.direction === 'inbound' ? 'UNLOAD' : 'LOAD',
      priority: 'NORMAL',
      assigneeId: emp,
      truckId: t.id,
      dockId: t.dockId,
      forkliftId: f.id,
      shipmentId: s?.id ?? null,
      dueMinutes: Math.max(5, Math.ceil((left * 100) / 60)),
      source: 'SYSTEM',
    });
    return true;
  }

  private async onWorkDone(truckId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const t = this.world.trucks[truckId];
    const open = await this.repo.openSystemTasks(truckId);
    for (const task of open) {
      const note = `Truck ${t?.direction === 'inbound' ? 'unloaded' : 'loaded'} · ${t?.capacity ?? ''} pallets`;
      if (task.status === 'OPEN') { await this.repo.changeTaskStatus(null, task.id, 'CANCELLED', 'Completed by another crew'); continue; }
      if (task.status === 'ASSIGNED' || task.status === 'BLOCKED') await this.repo.changeTaskStatus(null, task.id, 'IN_PROGRESS', null);
      await this.repo.changeTaskStatus(null, task.id, 'DONE', note);
    }
    return open.length > 0;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- live snapshots
  snapshot(facilities: FacilityId[]): string {
    const key = facilities.slice().sort().join(',');
    const v = `${this.versions.world}:${this.db.commits}:${this.db.failures}`;
    const hit = this.snapCache.get(key);
    if (hit && hit.v === v) return hit.json;
    const set = new Set<string>(facilities);
    const w = this.world;
    const pick = <T extends { facilityId: string }>(coll: Record<string, T>) =>
      Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(coll).filter(([, e]) => set.has(e.facilityId)));
    const trucks = pick(w.trucks);
    const shipIds = new Set(Object.values(trucks).map((t) => t.shipmentId));
    const forklifts = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(pick(w.forklifts)).map(([id, f]) => [id, { ...f, path: [] }]));
    const out = {
      world: {
        version: w.version, simTime: w.simTime, realTime: w.realTime, nextShipment: w.nextShipment, nextPallet: w.nextPallet,
        facilities: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(w.facilities).filter(([id]) => set.has(id))),
        docks: pick(w.docks), trucks, forklifts, pallets: pick(w.pallets), chargers: pick(w.chargers),
        shipments: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(w.shipments).filter(([id]) => shipIds.has(id))),
        laneLock: w.laneLock, events: w.events.filter((e) => set.has(e.facilityId)).slice(0, 30), eventSeq: w.eventSeq,
        // the port and the town are shared by every site
        port: w.port, retail: w.retail,
      },
      control: this.control,
      versions: { tasks: this.versions.tasks, audit: this.versions.audit, gate: this.versions.gate },
      db: this.db,
    };
    const json = JSON.stringify(out);
    this.snapCache.set(key, { v, json });
    return json;
  }
}

import { Component, useCallback, useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { startLive, startOffline, setStopper, preloadUi, useApp } from './store';
import { api, tokenStore, ApiError } from './api/client';
import { WarehouseScene, webglAvailable } from './scene/Scene';
import { Header } from './ui/Header';
import { KpiCards, SceneControls, InfoPanel, ShipmentTracking, FleetList, LabelsOverlay } from './ui/Panels';
import { LoginPage } from './ui/Login';
import { Workspace, Toast } from './ui/Workspace';
import { MapLegend } from './ui/ParkPanels';

class SceneBoundary extends Component<{ children: ReactNode }, { failed: boolean }> {
  state = { failed: false };
  static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { failed: true }; }
  componentDidCatch(err: unknown) { console.warn('3D scene failed to initialise', err); }
  render() { return this.state.failed ? <SceneFallback /> : this.props.children; }
}

function SceneFallback() {
  return (
    <div className="scene-fallback">
      <div>
        <b>3D view unavailable</b>
        <span>WebGL is disabled or not supported in this browser. Live data, panels and controls keep working.</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type Boot = 'checking' | 'login' | 'app';

export default function App() {
  const ready = useApp((s) => s.ready);
  const mode = useApp((s) => s.mode);
  const showPanels = useApp((s) => s.showPanels);
  const [boot, setBoot] = useState<Boot>('checking');
  const [serverDown, setServerDown] = useState(false);
  const [db, setDb] = useState<'oracle' | 'memory' | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [gl] = useState(() => webglAvailable());

  const enterLive = useCallback(async (user: Parameters<typeof startLive>[0], dbKind: 'oracle' | 'memory') => {
    await preloadUi();
    const stop = await startLive(user, dbKind);
    setStopper(stop);
    setBoot('app');
  }, []);

  // initial: find the server, then resume a remembered session if there is one
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      let dbKind: 'oracle' | 'memory' | null = null;
      try {
        dbKind = (await api.health()).db;
        if (cancelled) return;
        setDb(dbKind);
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) { setServerDown(true); setBoot('login'); }
        return;
      }
      if (!tokenStore.get()) { setBoot('login'); return; }
      try {
        const { user } = await api.me();
        if (!cancelled) await enterLive(user, dbKind);
      } catch (e) {
        tokenStore.clear();
        if (!cancelled) {
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) setNotice('Your session has expired. Please sign in again.');
          setBoot('login');
        }
      }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [enterLive]);

  // signing out returns to the login page
  useEffect(() => { if (boot === 'app' && mode === null) setBoot('login'); }, [boot, mode]);

  const login = async (username: string, password: string, remember: boolean) => {
    const { token, user } = await api.login(username, password, remember);
    tokenStore.set(token, remember);
    setNotice(null);
    await enterLive(user, db ?? 'oracle');
  };

  const offline = async () => {
    const stop = await startOffline();
    setStopper(stop);
    setBoot('app');
  };

  if (boot === 'checking') return <div className="boot"><div className="spinner" /> Connecting to CargoVerse…</div>;
  if (boot === 'login') {
    return (
      <>
        <LoginPage serverDown={serverDown} db={db} onLogin={login} onOffline={() => { void offline(); }} notice={notice} />
        <Toast />
      </>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="app">
      <div className="scene">
        {ready && (gl ? <SceneBoundary><WarehouseScene /></SceneBoundary> : <SceneFallback />)}
      </div>
      {ready && gl && <LabelsOverlay />}
      <Header />
      {ready && (
        <>
          <SceneControls />
          {showPanels ? (
            <>
              <KpiCards />
              <InfoPanel />
              <ShipmentTracking />
              <FleetList />
            </>
          ) : <MapLegend />}
          <Workspace />
        </>
      )}
      {mode === 'offline' && <div className="offline-banner">Offline demo — no server connection, nothing is saved to the database</div>}
      <Toast />
    </div>
  );
}

// Browser client for the CargoVerse API.
import type { FacilityId, EntityRef } from '../data/types';
import type {
  SessionUser, Task, TaskUpdate, TaskStatus, AuditEntry, Employee, UserRecord, SimControl, KpiRow, WorkloadRow,
  LowStockRow, JobTitle, RoleInfo, Role, TaskType, Priority, ParkData, BuildingPatch, GateEntry, TradeRow,
  DbOverview, DbTableDetail, SqlResult, SqlActivity, SavedQuery, DbLive, DbLiveRow,
  ContainerMoveRow, VesselCallRow, StoreOrderRow,
} from './types';
import type { Vessel, Berth, StoreOrder } from '../data/types';
import type { ParkBuilding } from '../data/park';

const TOKEN_KEY = 'waretrack.token';

export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(public status: number, message: string) { super(message); }
}

export const tokenStore = {
  get(): string | null { try { return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY) ?? sessionStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY); } catch { return null; } },
  set(token: string, remember: boolean) {
    try {
      (remember ? localStorage : sessionStorage).setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
      (remember ? sessionStorage : localStorage).removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
    } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
  },
  clear() { try { localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY); sessionStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY); } catch { /* ignore */ } },
};

let onUnauthorized: (() => void) | null = null;
export function setUnauthorizedHandler(fn: () => void) { onUnauthorized = fn; }

async function call<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const token = tokenStore.get();
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`/api${path}`, {
      method,
      headers: { ...(body !== undefined ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}), ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}) },
      body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
    });
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError(0, 'Cannot reach the CargoVerse server. Is it running?');
  }
  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!res.ok) {
    if (res.status === 401 && path !== '/auth/login') onUnauthorized?.();
    throw new ApiError(res.status, (data as { error?: string }).error ?? `Request failed (${res.status})`);
  }
  return data as T;
}

const qs = (o: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined | null>) => {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o)) if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') p.set(k, String(v));
  const s = p.toString();
  return s ? `?${s}` : '';
};

export const api = {
  health: () => call<{ ok: boolean; db: 'oracle' | 'memory' }>('GET', '/health'),
  login: (username: string, password: string, remember: boolean) =>
    call<{ token: string; user: SessionUser }>('POST', '/auth/login', { username, password, remember }),
  logout: () => call<{ ok: boolean }>('POST', '/auth/logout', {}),
  me: () => call<{ user: SessionUser }>('GET', '/auth/me'),
  meta: () => call<{ roles: RoleInfo[]; jobTitles: JobTitle[]; db: 'oracle' | 'memory' }>('GET', '/meta'),

  tasks: (o: { facility?: FacilityId; scope?: 'mine'; closed?: boolean }) =>
    call<Task[]>('GET', `/tasks${qs({ facility: o.facility, scope: o.scope, closed: o.closed ? 1 : undefined })}`),
  createTask: (t: { facilityId: FacilityId; title: string; description: string; type: TaskType; priority: Priority; assigneeId: number | null; truckId?: string | null; dockId?: string | null; dueMinutes?: number | null }) =>
    call<Task>('POST', '/tasks', t),
  taskStatus: (id: number, status: TaskStatus, note?: string) => call<Task>('PATCH', `/tasks/${id}/status`, { status, note }),
  assignTask: (id: number, assigneeId: number, note?: string) => call<Task>('PATCH', `/tasks/${id}/assign`, { assigneeId, note }),
  taskUpdates: (id: number) => call<TaskUpdate[]>('GET', `/tasks/${id}/updates`),

  employees: (facility?: FacilityId) => call<Employee[]>('GET', `/employees${qs({ facility })}`),
  users: () => call<UserRecord[]>('GET', '/users'),
  createUser: (u: { username: string; password: string; role: Role; fullName: string; email: string; phone?: string; jobCode: string; homeFacility: FacilityId | null; facilities: FacilityId[] }) =>
    call<UserRecord>('POST', '/users', u),
  updateUser: (id: number, patch: { role?: Role; active?: boolean; facilities?: FacilityId[]; password?: string }) =>
    call<UserRecord>('PATCH', `/users/${id}`, patch),

  audit: (o: { facility?: FacilityId; before?: number; limit?: number }) => call<AuditEntry[]>('GET', `/audit${qs(o)}`),
  kpis: (facility?: FacilityId) => call<KpiRow[]>('GET', `/reports/kpis${qs({ facility })}`),
  workload: (facility?: FacilityId) => call<WorkloadRow[]>('GET', `/reports/workload${qs({ facility })}`),
  lowStock: (facility?: FacilityId) => call<LowStockRow[]>('GET', `/reports/low-stock${qs({ facility })}`),
  simControl: (c: Partial<SimControl>) => call<SimControl>('POST', '/sim/control', c),

  park: () => call<ParkData>('GET', '/park'),
  updateBuilding: (id: string, patch: BuildingPatch) => call<ParkBuilding>('PATCH', `/park/buildings/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, patch),
  gateLog: (o: { facility?: FacilityId; limit?: number }) => call<GateEntry[]>('GET', `/park/gate-log${qs(o)}`),
  trade: (facility?: FacilityId) => call<TradeRow[]>('GET', `/park/trade${qs({ facility })}`),

  portMoves: (o: { limit?: number; container?: string; vessel?: string } = {}) => call<ContainerMoveRow[]>('GET', `/port/moves${qs(o)}`),
  portCalls: (limit = 30) => call<VesselCallRow[]>('GET', `/port/calls${qs({ limit })}`),
  holdVessel: (id: string, hold: boolean) => call<Vessel>('POST', `/port/vessels/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/hold`, { hold }),
  openBerth: (id: string, open: boolean) => call<Berth>('POST', `/port/berths/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/open`, { open }),
  storeOrders: (o: { store?: string; limit?: number } = {}) => call<StoreOrderRow[]>('GET', `/retail/orders${qs(o)}`),
  placeStoreOrder: (o: { storeId: string; skuId: string; units: number }) => call<StoreOrder>('POST', '/retail/orders', o),
  cancelStoreOrder: (id: string) => call<StoreOrder>('POST', `/retail/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/cancel`, {}),

  dbOverview: () => call<DbOverview>('GET', '/db/overview'),
  dbTable: (name: string) => call<DbTableDetail>('GET', `/db/tables/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`),
  dbQueries: () => call<SavedQuery[]>('GET', '/db/queries'),
  runSql: (sql: string) => call<SqlResult>('POST', '/db/sql', { sql }),
  dbLive: () => call<DbLive>('GET', '/db/live'),
  dbRow: (kind: string, id: string) => call<DbLiveRow>('GET', `/db/row/${encodeURIComponent(kind)}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`),
  dbActivity: (all: boolean) => call<(SqlActivity & { source: string })[]>('GET', `/db/activity${qs({ source: all ? 'all' : undefined })}`),

  alerts: (facility?: FacilityId) => call<Alert[]>('GET', `/alerts${qs({ facility })}`),
  alertTask: (alertId: string, assigneeId?: number) => call<Task>('POST', '/alerts/task', { alertId, assigneeId }),
  assistantStatus: () => call<{ configured: boolean; model: string }>('GET', '/assistant/status'),
  assistant: (messages: { role: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string }[], facilityId: FacilityId) =>
    call<{ reply: string; actions: { type: 'focus'; ref: EntityRef }[]; tools: string[] }>('POST', '/assistant', { messages, facilityId }),
};

export interface Alert {
  id: string;
  facilityId: FacilityId;
  severity: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
  kind: 'late_shipment' | 'low_battery' | 'gate_wait' | 'low_stock' | 'blocked_task';
  title: string;
  detail: string;
  ref: EntityRef | null;
  suggestion: { title: string; description: string; type: TaskType; priority: Priority; jobCode: string } | null;
}

export function streamUrl(): string {
  return `/api/stream?token=${encodeURIComponent(tokenStore.get() ?? '')}`;
}

// Types shared by the browser client and the Node API server.

  | 'VIEW_DASHBOARD'
  | 'VIEW_ALL_FACILITIES'
  | 'MANAGE_USERS'
  | 'VIEW_AUDIT'
  | 'MANAGE_TASKS'

  | 'CONTROL_SIMULATION'
  | 'VIEW_REPORTS'
  | 'VIEW_TEAM'

// Data-access boundary. The UI and simulation only talk to `WarehouseDataSource`.
// Today it is backed by local demonstration data persisted in localStorage.
// A future SQL-backed REST/GraphQL adapter implements the same interface,
// so neither the 3D scene nor the interface needs to change.
import type { WorldState, FacilityId, EntityRef } from './types';
import { createSeedWorld, WORLD_VERSION } from './seed';

export interface UiSnapshot {
  facilityId: FacilityId;
  selection: EntityRef | null;
  fleetTab: 'docks' | 'forklifts' | 'trucks';
  readEvents: number;
}

export interface WarehouseDataSource {
  loadWorld(): Promise<WorldState>;
  saveWorld(world: WorldState): Promise<void>;
  resetWorld(): Promise<WorldState>;
  loadUi(): Promise<Partial<UiSnapshot>>;
  saveUi(ui: UiSnapshot): Promise<void>;
}

const WORLD_KEY = 'waretrack.world';
const UI_KEY = 'waretrack.ui';

function safeGet(key: string): string | null {
  try { return localStorage.getItem(key); } catch { return null; }
}
function safeSet(key: string, value: string): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch { /* storage unavailable: keep running in memory */ }
}

export class LocalDemoDataSource implements WarehouseDataSource {
  async loadWorld(): Promise<WorldState> {
    const raw = safeGet(WORLD_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as WorldState;
        if (parsed && parsed.version === WORLD_VERSION && parsed.trucks) return parsed;
      } catch { /* fall through to seed */ }
    }
    return createSeedWorld();
  }
  async saveWorld(world: WorldState): Promise<void> {
    safeSet(WORLD_KEY, JSON.stringify(world));
  }
  async resetWorld(): Promise<WorldState> {
    try { localStorage.removeItem(WORLD_KEY); localStorage.removeItem(UI_KEY); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    return createSeedWorld();
  }
  async loadUi(): Promise<Partial<UiSnapshot>> {
    const raw = safeGet(UI_KEY);
    if (!raw) return {};
    try { return JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<UiSnapshot>; } catch { return {}; }
  }
  async saveUi(ui: UiSnapshot): Promise<void> {
    safeSet(UI_KEY, JSON.stringify(ui));
  }
}

export const dataSource: WarehouseDataSource = new LocalDemoDataSource();

// The container port (berths, quay cranes, yard blocks, the ships that call) and
// the town's vendor stores with the CargoVerse delivery fleet that restocks them.
// Static catalogue + geometry shared by the simulation, the 3D scene and the
// Oracle seed generator. The changing state lives in WorldState.port / .retail.
import type {
  FacilityId, Vec2, Vessel, Berth, QuayCrane, PortState, Store, StoreKind, DeliveryVan, RetailState,
} from './types';
import {
  ART_W, ART_E, MARKET_Z, BAY_Z, SHORE_Z, STREETS, FACILITY_STREET, FACILITY_OFFSET, PARK_BUILDINGS, type ParkBuilding,
} from './park';
import { LAYOUTS, FENCE_Z } from './layouts';
import { roundCorners, pathLength, sampleAt } from '../sim/geometry';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- terminal geometry (park coordinates)
export const TERMINAL = { x: -700, z: 301, w: 200, d: 78 } as const; // matches PB-PORT
export const QUAY_Z = TERMINAL.z + TERMINAL.d / 2; // 340: the quay wall
export const MOOR_Z = 349; // centre line of a ship alongside
export const SHIP_LENGTH = 80;
export const SHIP_BEAM = 13;
/** Import and export stacking blocks between the truck aisle and the quay apron. */
export const YARD_BLOCKS = {
  IMPORT: { x: -747, z: 309, w: 86, d: 24 },
  EXPORT: { x: -652, z: 309, w: 86, d: 24 },
} as const;
export const YARD_BAYS = 6; // along x
export const YARD_ROWS = 6; // along z
export const YARD_TIERS = 2;
export const YARD_CAPACITY = 60; // boxes per block
export const CRANE_CYCLE_S = 6; // real seconds per container move
export const SHIP_SPEED = { approach: 10, berthing: 5, departure: 7 }; // units per real second

/** Slot position of the i-th box in a yard block (fills bays, then rows, then tiers). */
export function yardSlot(block: keyof typeof YARD_BLOCKS, i: number): { x: number; y: number; z: number } {
  const b = YARD_BLOCKS[block];
  const bay = i % YARD_BAYS;
  const row = Math.floor(i / YARD_BAYS) % YARD_ROWS;
  const tier = Math.floor(i / (YARD_BAYS * YARD_ROWS));
  return {
    x: b.x - b.w / 2 + 7 + bay * ((b.w - 14) / (YARD_BAYS - 1)),
    y: 1.3 + tier * 2.6,
    z: b.z - b.d / 2 + 2 + row * ((b.d - 4) / (YARD_ROWS - 1)),
  };
}

export const BERTH_DEFS: { id: string; name: string; x: number }[] = [
  { id: 'B1', name: 'Berth 1 (west)', x: -745 },
  { id: 'B2', name: 'Berth 2 (east)', x: -655 },
];
export const CRANE_DEFS: { id: string; berthId: string; offset: number }[] = [
  { id: 'QC-01', berthId: 'B1', offset: -17 },
  { id: 'QC-02', berthId: 'B1', offset: 17 },
  { id: 'QC-03', berthId: 'B2', offset: -17 },
  { id: 'QC-04', berthId: 'B2', offset: 17 },
];
export const berthX = (id: string): number => BERTH_DEFS.find((b) => b.id === id)?.x ?? BERTH_DEFS[0].x;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- ship routes on the water
const anchorage = (slot: number): Vec2 => ({ x: -1010 - slot * 46, z: 468 + slot * 26 });

const pathCache = new Map<string, Vec2[]>();
const cached = (key: string, make: () => Vec2[]): Vec2[] => {
  let p = pathCache.get(key);
  if (!p) { p = make(); pathCache.set(key, p); }
  return p;
};

/** From the open sea to the ship's anchorage spot. */
export function approachPath(slot: number): Vec2[] {
  return cached(`a${slot}`, () => roundCorners([{ x: -1500, z: 660 + slot * 22 }, { x: -1180, z: 580 + slot * 10 }, anchorage(slot)], 40));
}
/** From the anchorage alongside the berth (the ship ends parallel to the quay, bow east). */
export function berthingPath(slot: number, berthId: string): Vec2[] {
  const bx = berthX(berthId);
  return cached(`b${slot}${berthId}`, () => roundCorners([anchorage(slot), { x: bx - 125, z: 402 }, { x: bx - 40, z: MOOR_Z + 9 }, { x: bx, z: MOOR_Z }], 30));
}
/** From the berth back out to sea, passing south of the other berth. */
export function departurePath(berthId: string): Vec2[] {
  const bx = berthX(berthId);
  return cached(`d${berthId}`, () => roundCorners([{ x: bx, z: MOOR_Z }, { x: bx + 55, z: MOOR_Z + 18 }, { x: -540, z: 420 }, { x: -730, z: 545 }, { x: -1120, z: 640 }, { x: -1520, z: 700 }], 40));
}
const lengths = new Map<Vec2[], number>();
export function legLength(pts: Vec2[]): number {
  let l = lengths.get(pts);
  if (l === undefined) { l = pathLength(pts); lengths.set(pts, l); }
  return l;
}

/** Position and heading of a ship from its status and the distance along its current leg. */
export function vesselPose(v: Pick<Vessel, 'status' | 'slot' | 'berthId' | 'dist'>): { pos: Vec2; heading: number } {
  switch (v.status) {
    case 'BERTHED':
      return { pos: { x: berthX(v.berthId ?? 'B1'), z: MOOR_Z }, heading: 0 };
    case 'BERTHING': {
      const pts = berthingPath(v.slot, v.berthId ?? 'B1');
      const len = legLength(pts);
      const s = sampleAt(pts, Math.min(v.dist, len));
      let heading = Math.atan2(s.dz, s.dx);
      // swing parallel to the quay over the last stretch
      const rem = len - v.dist;
      if (rem < 45) heading = heading * (rem / 45);
      return { pos: { x: s.x, z: s.z }, heading };
    }
    case 'DEPARTING': {
      const pts = departurePath(v.berthId ?? 'B1');
      const s = sampleAt(pts, Math.min(v.dist, legLength(pts)));
      return { pos: { x: s.x, z: s.z }, heading: Math.atan2(s.dz, s.dx) };
    }
    case 'ANCHORED': {
      const a = anchorage(v.slot);
      return { pos: a, heading: Math.atan2(-0.35, 1) };
    }
    case 'ARRIVING': {
      const pts = approachPath(v.slot);
      const s = sampleAt(pts, Math.min(v.dist, legLength(pts)));
      return { pos: { x: s.x, z: s.z }, heading: Math.atan2(s.dz, s.dx) };
    }
    default:
      return { pos: approachPath(v.slot)[0], heading: 0 };
  }
}

export const VESSEL_LINES: { code: string; name: string }[] = [

/** IMO number with its check digit (the last digit). */
export function imoNumber(six: string): string {
  const sum = six.split('').reduce((a, d, i) => a + Number(d) * (7 - i), 0);
  return `IMO ${six}${sum % 10}`;
}

const ISO_LETTERS: Record<string, number> = {};
{
  let v = 10;
  for (const ch of 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ') {
    if (v % 11 === 0) v++;
    ISO_LETTERS[ch] = v++;
  }
}
/** ISO 6346 container number, e.g. OSLU 412305 7 (owner code + U, serial, check digit). */
export function containerNo(prefix: string, serial: number): string {
  const owner = `${prefix}U`;
  const digits = String(serial % 1000000).padStart(6, '0');
  const chars = owner + digits;
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
    const c = chars[i];
    const val = c >= '0' && c <= '9' ? Number(c) : ISO_LETTERS[c];
    sum += val * 2 ** i;
  }
  const check = (sum % 11) % 10;
  return `${owner}${digits}${check}`;
}
export const vesselByPrefix = (prefix: string) => VESSEL_DEFS.find((d) => prefix.startsWith(d.prefix));
/** Owner prefix for CargoVerse's own export boxes. */
export const LOCAL_PREFIX = 'WTL';

export function voyageCode(callNo: number, eastbound: boolean): string {
  return `${String(callNo).padStart(3, '0')}${eastbound ? 'E' : 'W'}`;
}

export function seedPort(): PortState {
  const berths: Record<string, Berth> = {};
  for (const b of BERTH_DEFS) berths[b.id] = { id: b.id, name: b.name, x: b.x, open: true, vesselId: null };
  const cranes: Record<string, QuayCrane> = {};
  for (const c of CRANE_DEFS) cranes[c.id] = { id: c.id, berthId: c.berthId, offset: c.offset, phase: 'idle', cycle: 0, movesToday: 40 + c.offset * 0 + c.id.charCodeAt(4) * 3 };
  const vessels: Record<string, Vessel> = {};
  VESSEL_DEFS.forEach((d, i) => {
    const v: Vessel = {
      id: d.id, name: d.name, line: d.line, prefix: d.prefix, flag: d.flag, imo: imoNumber(d.imo6), color: d.color, slot: i,
      capacity: d.capacity, through: d.through, status: 'AT_SEA', berthId: null, dist: 0, pos: { x: 0, z: 0 }, heading: 0,
      timer: 20 + i * 35, importBoxes: 12 + (i % 3) * 2, exportBoxes: 0, exportTarget: 10 + (i % 2) * 2, discharged: 0, loaded: 0,
      hold: false, waited: 0, voyage: voyageCode(40 + i * 3, i % 2 === 0), calls: 40 + i * 3, arrivedAt: null, origin: d.origin, nextPort: d.nextPort,
    };
    vessels[v.id] = v;
  });
  // one ship alongside each berth when the shift starts, one on its way in
  const a = vessels['VSL-01'];
  Object.assign(a, { status: 'BERTHED', berthId: 'B1', importBoxes: 7, discharged: 7, timer: 0, arrivedAt: 27600 });
  berths.B1.vesselId = a.id;
  const b = vessels['VSL-04'];
  Object.assign(b, { status: 'BERTHED', berthId: 'B2', importBoxes: 0, discharged: 12, exportBoxes: 4, loaded: 4, timer: 0, arrivedAt: 26400 });
  berths.B2.vesselId = b.id;
  const c = vessels['VSL-02'];
  Object.assign(c, { status: 'ARRIVING', dist: legLength(approachPath(c.slot)) * 0.45, timer: 0 });
  for (const v of Object.values(vessels)) { const p = vesselPose(v); v.pos = p.pos; v.heading = p.heading; }
  cranes['QC-01'].phase = 'discharge';
  cranes['QC-02'].phase = 'discharge';
  cranes['QC-03'].phase = 'load';
  cranes['QC-04'].phase = 'load';
  // boxes already in the stacks at the start of the shift
  let serial = 411800;
  const importStack: string[] = [];
  const exportStack: string[] = [];
  const prefixes = VESSEL_DEFS.map((d) => d.prefix);
  for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) importStack.push(containerNo(prefixes[i % prefixes.length], serial++));
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) exportStack.push(containerNo(i % 3 === 0 ? LOCAL_PREFIX : prefixes[(i + 2) % prefixes.length], serial++));
  return {
    importStack, exportStack, yardCapacity: YARD_CAPACITY, movesToday: 312, callsToday: 3, gateOutToday: 64, gateInToday: 41,
    nextBox: 412300, extTimer: 0, vessels, berths, cranes, log: [],
  };
}

export const VAN_SPEED = 12; // units per real second on town and park roads
export const VAN_LOAD_S = 6;
export const VAN_UNLOAD_S = 7;

export function seedRetail(): RetailState {
  const stores: Record<string, Store> = {};
  STORE_DEFS.forEach((d, i) => {
    stores[d.id] = {
      id: d.id, buildingId: d.buildingId, name: d.name, chain: d.chain, kind: d.kind, facilityId: d.facilityId, deliveriesToday: 2 + (i % 3),
      lines: d.lines.map(([skuId, maxUnits, reorderAt, salesPerHour, units], j) => ({
        skuId, units, reorderAt, maxUnits, salesPerHour, acc: 0, soldToday: Math.round(salesPerHour * (2.5 + ((i + j) % 4) * 0.4)),
      })),
    };
  });
  const vans: Record<string, DeliveryVan> = {};
  for (const d of VAN_DEFS) {
    const depot = vanDepot(d.facilityId);
    vans[d.id] = {
      id: d.id, facilityId: d.facilityId, kind: d.kind, plate: d.plate, driver: d.driver, status: 'IDLE', orderId: null, storeId: null,
      dist: 0, timer: 0, pos: depot, heading: Math.PI / 2, tripsToday: 3 + (d.id.charCodeAt(6) % 3),
    };
  }
  return { stores, orders: {}, vans, nextOrder: 5120, log: [] };
}

export const storeDef = (id: string) => STORE_DEFS.find((s) => s.id === id);
export const storeBuilding = (storeId: string): ParkBuilding | undefined => {
  const d = storeDef(storeId);
  return d ? PARK_BUILDINGS.find((b) => b.id === d.buildingId) : undefined;
};
export const storeByBuilding = (buildingId: string) => STORE_DEFS.find((s) => s.buildingId === buildingId);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- delivery van routes (park coordinates)
/** Where vans leave a warehouse (its yard exit) and come back in (its gate). */
export function vanDepot(fac: FacilityId): Vec2 {
  const o = FACILITY_OFFSET[fac];
  return { x: LAYOUTS[fac].exitX + o.x, z: FENCE_Z - 3 + o.z };
}
function vanGate(fac: FacilityId): Vec2 {
  const o = FACILITY_OFFSET[fac];
  return { x: LAYOUTS[fac].gateX + o.x, z: FENCE_Z - 3 + o.z };
}
/** Loading bay in front of a store (on the Market Street side). */
export function storeDrop(storeId: string): Vec2 {
  const b = storeBuilding(storeId);
  if (!b) return { x: 0, z: MARKET_Z };
  const north = b.rotation === 0; // north side of Market Street, front faces south
  return { x: b.x + (north ? 1 : -1) * Math.min(18, b.w * 0.28), z: north ? b.z + b.d / 2 + 2.5 : b.z - b.d / 2 - 2.5 };
}

/** The town street a store's loading bay is on (Market Street, Bay Road or Shore Road). */
function storeStreetZ(d: Vec2): number {
  return [MARKET_Z, BAY_Z, SHORE_Z].reduce((best, z) => (Math.abs(z - d.z) < Math.abs(best - d.z) ? z : best), MARKET_Z);
}

/** Out to the store: street → avenue (southbound lane) → the store's street → loading bay. */
export function vanPathOut(fac: FacilityId, storeId: string): Vec2[] {
  return cached(`vo${fac}${storeId}`, () => {
    const e = vanDepot(fac);
    const d = storeDrop(storeId);
    const sz = STREETS[FACILITY_STREET[fac]];
    const av = (e.x + d.x) / 2 < 0 || d.x < ART_W + 40 ? ART_W : ART_E;
    const laneZ = sz + (av > e.x ? 3 : -3);
    const mz = storeStreetZ(d) + (d.x > av - 3 ? 3 : -3);
    return roundCorners([e, { x: e.x, z: laneZ }, { x: av - 3, z: laneZ }, { x: av - 3, z: mz }, { x: d.x, z: mz }, d], 6);
  });
}
/** Back to the warehouse: Market Street → avenue (northbound lane) → street → site gate. */
export function vanPathBack(fac: FacilityId, storeId: string): Vec2[] {
  return cached(`vb${fac}${storeId}`, () => {
    const g = vanGate(fac);
    const d = storeDrop(storeId);
    const sz = STREETS[FACILITY_STREET[fac]];
    const av = (g.x + d.x) / 2 < 0 || d.x < ART_W + 40 ? ART_W : ART_E;
    const mz = storeStreetZ(d) + (av + 3 > d.x ? 3 : -3);
    const laneZ = sz + (g.x > av + 3 ? 3 : -3);
    return roundCorners([d, { x: d.x, z: mz }, { x: av + 3, z: mz }, { x: av + 3, z: laneZ }, { x: g.x, z: laneZ }, g], 6);
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- truck routes between the highway and a site
/**
 * Inbound route (park coordinates): highway eastbound from the port, north on Harbor
 * Avenue through the West Gate, then east along the site's street to its gate.
 */
export function parkRouteIn(fac: FacilityId, gateLocalX: number, roadLaneLocalZ: number, gateStopLocalZ: number, lane: TradeLane = 'ROAD'): Vec2[] {
  const o = FACILITY_OFFSET[fac];
  const laneZ = roadLaneLocalZ + o.z;
  const gx = gateLocalX + o.x;
  // import containers are collected inside the terminal and leave through its out-gate
  const start: Vec2[] = lane === 'SEA'
    ? [{ x: PORT_PICKUP_X, z: PORT_AISLE_OUT_Z }, { x: PORT_OUT_X, z: PORT_AISLE_OUT_Z }, { x: PORT_OUT_X, z: HWY_EAST_LANES[1] }]
    : [{ x: HWY_X0, z: HWY_EAST_LANES[1] }];
  return [
    ...start,
    { x: ART_W + 3, z: HWY_EAST_LANES[1] },
    { x: ART_W + 3, z: laneZ },
    { x: gx, z: laneZ },
    { x: gx, z: gateStopLocalZ + o.z },
  ];
}

/** Outbound route: from the site's exit along its street, south on Industrial Avenue through the East Gate, then east. */
export function parkRouteOut(fac: FacilityId, exitLocalX: number, roadLaneLocalZ: number, exitStartLocalZ: number, lane: TradeLane = 'ROAD'): Vec2[] {
  const o = FACILITY_OFFSET[fac];
  const laneZ = roadLaneLocalZ + o.z;
  const ex = exitLocalX + o.x;
  const head: Vec2[] = [
    { x: ex, z: exitStartLocalZ + o.z },
    { x: ex, z: laneZ },
    { x: ART_E - 3, z: laneZ },
  ];
  if (lane === 'SEA') {
    // sea exports: right onto the westbound highway, then into the container terminal to drop the box
    return [
      ...head,
      { x: ART_E - 3, z: HWY_WEST_LANES[1] },
      { x: PORT_IN_X, z: HWY_WEST_LANES[1] },
      { x: PORT_IN_X, z: PORT_AISLE_IN_Z },
      { x: PORT_DROP_X, z: PORT_AISLE_IN_Z },
    ];
  }
  return [...head, { x: ART_E - 3, z: HWY_EAST_LANES[1] }, { x: HWY_X1, z: HWY_EAST_LANES[1] }];
}

/** Arc length along a polyline to the point closest to p. */
export function distanceAlong(pts: Vec2[], p: Vec2): number {
  let best = Infinity;
  let at = 0;
  let acc = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i - 1], b = pts[i];
    const dx = b.x - a.x, dz = b.z - a.z;
    const len2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
    const seg = Math.sqrt(len2);
    const t = len2 > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((p.x - a.x) * dx + (p.z - a.z) * dz) / len2)) : 0;
    const qx = a.x + dx * t, qz = a.z + dz * t;
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - qx, p.z - qz);
    if (d < best) { best = d; at = acc + seg * t; }
    acc += seg;
  }
  return at;
}
