// ---------------------------------------------------------------- public traffic
export type VehicleKind = 'CAR' | 'VAN' | 'BUS' | 'TRUCK' | 'TANKER' | 'TAXI' | 'TRACTOR';
export type RouteCode =
  | 'HWY_E1' | 'HWY_E2' | 'HWY_W1' | 'HWY_W2' | 'RING_CW' | 'RING_CCW' | 'THROUGH'
  | 'TOWN_W' | 'TOWN_E' | 'TOWN_RING' | 'TOWN_LINK' | 'PORT_YARD'
  | 'EAST_RING' | 'EAST_BLOCK' | 'OCEAN_LINK' | 'MARKET_RUN'
  | 'MAPLE_LOOP' | 'ELM_LOOP' | 'SUBURB_LINK'
  | 'WILLOW_LOOP' | 'BIRCH_LOOP' | 'WILLOW_LINK';

export interface ParkRoute { code: RouteCode; name: string; loop: boolean; pts: Vec2[]; length: number }

function route(code: RouteCode, name: string, loop: boolean, raw: Vec2[], r = 8): ParkRoute {
  let src = raw;
  if (loop) {
    // start mid-way along the first edge so that every corner of the ring gets rounded
    const m = { x: (raw[0].x + raw[1].x) / 2, z: (raw[0].z + raw[1].z) / 2 };
    src = [m, ...raw.slice(1), raw[0], m];
  }
  const pts = roundCorners(src, r);
  return { code, name, loop, pts, length: pathLength(pts) };
}

export interface ParkVehicle {
  id: string;
  companyId: string | null; // null = public traffic
  kind: VehicleKind;
  plate: string;
  color: string;
  route: RouteCode;
  speedKmh: number;
  offset: number; // 0..1 start position along the route
}

  ({ id, companyId, kind, plate, color, route: r, speedKmh, offset });

/** Scene units per real second for a vehicle's speed in km/h. */
export const kmhToUnits = (kmh: number) => kmh / 4.6;

/** Position and heading of a vehicle at a given simulation run time (seconds). */
export function vehiclePose(v: ParkVehicle, runTime: number): { x: number; z: number; heading: number; t: number } {
  const r = PARK_ROUTES[v.route];
  const speed = kmhToUnits(v.speedKmh);
  let d = (v.offset * r.length + runTime * speed) % r.length;
  if (d < 0) d += r.length;
  // walk the polyline
  let acc = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < r.pts.length; i++) {
    const a = r.pts[i - 1], b = r.pts[i];
    const seg = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
    if (seg <= 0) continue;
    if (acc + seg >= d) {
      const t = (d - acc) / seg;
      return { x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, z: a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t, heading: Math.atan2(b.z - a.z, b.x - a.x), t: d / r.length };
    }
    acc += seg;
  }
  const p = r.pts[r.pts.length - 1];
  return { x: p.x, z: p.z, heading: 0, t: 1 };
}

/** Which road a park position is on (for info panels). */
export function roadAt(p: Vec2): string {
  if (Math.abs(p.z - HWY_Z) <= HWY_HALF + 1) return ROAD_NAMES.hwy;
  if (p.x < -600 && p.z > 255) return 'Container terminal';
  if (p.z > HWY_SOUTH_EDGE) {
    if (Math.abs(p.z - MARKET_Z) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return TOWN_NAMES.market;
    if (Math.abs(p.z - BAY_Z) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return TOWN_NAMES.bay;
    if (Math.abs(p.z - SHORE_Z) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return TOWN_NAMES.shore;
    if (Math.abs(p.x - CENTRAL_X) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return TOWN_NAMES.central;
    if (Math.abs(p.x - OCEAN_X) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return TOWN_NAMES.ocean;
    if (Math.abs(p.x - CEDAR_X) <= ART_HALF + 1) return TOWN_NAMES.cedar;
    if (p.z > SHORE_Z + STREET_HALF) return 'Port Harbor Beach';
  }
  if (p.x > SUB_X0 + ART_HALF + 1 && p.z < HWY_Z - HWY_HALF) {
    if (Math.abs(p.z - SUB_STREETS.hill) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return SUB_NAMES.hill;
    if (Math.abs(p.z - SUB_STREETS.elm) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return SUB_NAMES.elm;
    if (Math.abs(p.z - SUB_STREETS.oak) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return SUB_NAMES.oak;
    if (Math.abs(p.x - MAPLE_X) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return SUB_NAMES.maple;
    if (Math.abs(p.x - SUB_X1) <= ART_HALF + 1) return TOWN_NAMES.cedar;
    if (Math.abs(p.z - STREETS.A) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return STREET_NAMES.A;
    if (Math.abs(p.z - STREETS.B) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return STREET_NAMES.B;
    return 'Maple Heights';
  }
  if (p.x < WIL_X1 - ART_HALF - 1 && p.x > WIL_X0 - ART_HALF - 2 && p.z < HWY_Z - HWY_HALF) {
    if (Math.abs(p.z - SUB_STREETS.hill) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return SUB_NAMES.hill;
    if (Math.abs(p.z - SUB_STREETS.elm) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return SUB_NAMES.elm;
    if (Math.abs(p.z - SUB_STREETS.oak) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return SUB_NAMES.oak;
    if (Math.abs(p.z - STREETS.A) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return STREET_NAMES.A;
    if (Math.abs(p.z - STREETS.B) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return STREET_NAMES.B;
    if (Math.abs(p.x - WIL_X0) <= ART_HALF + 1) return WIL_NAMES.willow;
    if (Math.abs(p.x - BIRCH_X) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return WIL_NAMES.birch;
    return WIL_NAMES.estate;
  }
  if (Math.abs(p.x - ART_W) <= ART_HALF + 1) return ROAD_NAMES.artW;
  if (Math.abs(p.x - ART_E) <= ART_HALF + 1) return ROAD_NAMES.artE;
  if (Math.abs(p.z - STREETS.A) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return STREET_NAMES.A;
  if (Math.abs(p.z - STREETS.B) <= STREET_HALF + 1) return STREET_NAMES.B;
  return 'Inside the park';
}

/** Overall extent of the park (used by the overview camera). */
export const PARK_BOUNDS = { x0: -900, x1: 920, z0: -320, z1: 620 };

// Client-side copy of the park records (loaded from Oracle through /api/park; the
// built-in seed is used offline) and the clock that drives public traffic.
import type { ParkData } from '../api/types';
import { PARK_COMPANIES, PARK_BUILDINGS, PARK_VEHICLES, vehiclePose, type ParkBuilding, type ParkVehicle, type ParkCompany } from './park';

let park: ParkData = { companies: PARK_COMPANIES, buildings: PARK_BUILDINGS, vehicles: PARK_VEHICLES };
let version = 0;
export const getPark = (): ParkData => park;
export const parkVersion = (): number => version;
export function setPark(p: ParkData): void { park = p; version++; }
export const findBuilding = (id: string): ParkBuilding | undefined => park.buildings.find((b) => b.id === id);
export const findVehicle = (id: string): ParkVehicle | undefined => park.vehicles.find((v) => v.id === id);
export const findCompany = (id: string | null): ParkCompany | undefined => (id ? park.companies.find((c) => c.id === id) : undefined);

// Traffic follows the operations clock (it stops when operations are paused).
let base = { t: 0, at: 0, rate: 1 };
let last = 0;
export function syncParkClock(runTime: number, paused: boolean, speed: number): void {
  base = { t: runTime, at: performance.now(), rate: paused ? 0 : speed };
}
export function parkTime(): number {
  const t = base.t + Math.min(0.6, (performance.now() - base.at) / 1000) * base.rate;
  // never run backwards because of snapshot jitter (but follow real jumps, e.g. a reset)
  if (t < last && last - t < 1) return last;
  last = t;
  return t;
}
export function vehicleNow(v: ParkVehicle) { return vehiclePose(v, parkTime()); }

====================================================================================================

// Street-level scenery for Port Harbor and the Maple Heights and Willow Grove housing estates: family houses,
// cars parked on driveways and kerbs, street lamps, benches, small parks, and the sidewalk
// loops that pedestrians walk. Everything here is generated deterministically on the client;
// it is decoration, not database records (the named buildings and vehicles are in park.ts).
import {
  HWY_Z, HWY_HALF, ART_W, ART_E, ART_HALF, STREET_HALF, STREETS,
  MARKET_Z, BAY_Z, SHORE_Z, CENTRAL_X, OCEAN_X, CEDAR_X, BEACH_Z0, SEA_Z0,
  SUB_X0, SUB_X1, MAPLE_X, SUB_STREETS, PARK_BUILDINGS, WIL_X0, WIL_X1, BIRCH_X,
} from './park';

export interface Rect { x0: number; x1: number; z0: number; z1: number }
export interface House { x: number; z: number; w: number; d: number; h: number; roof: number; rot: number; wall: string; roofColor: string; chimney: boolean }
export interface ParkedCar { x: number; z: number; rot: number; color: string }
export interface Lamp { x: number; z: number }
export interface Bench { x: number; z: number; rot: number }
export interface WalkLoop { pts: { x: number; z: number }[]; length: number }

// deterministic pseudo-random numbers
function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
    return s / 4294967296;
  };
}

const WALLS = ['#f8f1e5', '#f3e3c7', '#e9eef6', '#dbe7f3', '#f6dcd2', '#e3efe0', '#fff4d6', '#ece4f4', '#d9e2ec', '#f1e0c5'];
const ROOFS = ['#b5523b', '#8c4a3a', '#5c6474', '#3f4a5c', '#7a5c48', '#a0603f', '#4d5b6e'];
const CAR_COLORS = ['#f6f8fc', '#2b2d42', '#e4572e', '#3a86ff', '#8d99ae', '#ffb703', '#adb5bd', '#06d6a0', '#ef476f', '#1d3557', '#c92a2a', '#495057'];

const HWY_N = HWY_Z - HWY_HALF; // north edge of the highway
const HWY_S = HWY_Z + HWY_HALF;

/** Green spaces (lawn, trees, benches, no houses). */
export const GREENS: (Rect & { name: string })[] = [
  { name: 'Maple Park', x0: MAPLE_X + 12, x1: SUB_X1 - 12, z0: STREETS.B + 12, z1: SUB_STREETS.elm - 12 },
  { name: 'Hillcrest Green', x0: SUB_X0 + 14, x1: SUB_X0 + 84, z0: STREETS.A + 12, z1: SUB_STREETS.oak - 12 },
  { name: 'Willow Park', x0: BIRCH_X + STREET_HALF + 14, x1: WIL_X1 - ART_HALF - 14, z0: STREETS.B + 12, z1: SUB_STREETS.elm - 12 },
  { name: 'Birch Green', x0: WIL_X0 + ART_HALF + 14, x1: WIL_X0 + 80, z0: SUB_STREETS.elm + 12, z1: STREETS.A - 12 },
  { name: 'Ocean Gardens', x0: OCEAN_X + 12, x1: OCEAN_X + 60, z0: BAY_Z - 36, z1: BAY_Z - 12 },
];

const inRect = (x: number, z: number, r: Rect, m = 0) => x > r.x0 - m && x < r.x1 + m && z > r.z0 - m && z < r.z1 + m;

function blocked(x: number, z: number, hw: number, hd: number): boolean {
  for (const b of PARK_BUILDINGS) {
    const [w, d] = b.rotation === 90 || b.rotation === 270 ? [b.d, b.w] : [b.w, b.d];
    if (Math.abs(x - b.x) < w / 2 + hw + 3 && Math.abs(z - b.z) < d / 2 + hd + 3) return true;
  }
  for (const g of GREENS) if (inRect(x, z, g, Math.max(hw, hd) + 2)) return true;
  return false;
}

// avenues and streets that houses must keep clear of (centre, half width incl. sidewalk)
const NS_ROADS = [ART_W, ART_E, CENTRAL_X, OCEAN_X, CEDAR_X, WIL_X0, BIRCH_X].map((x) => ({ x, half: ART_HALF + 4 }));
const EW_ROADS = [MARKET_Z, BAY_Z, SHORE_Z, STREETS.A, STREETS.B, SUB_STREETS.hill, SUB_STREETS.elm, SUB_STREETS.oak].map((z) => ({ z, half: STREET_HALF + 4 }));
function onRoad(x: number, z: number, hw: number, hd: number): boolean {
  for (const r of NS_ROADS) if (Math.abs(x - r.x) < r.half + hw + 2) return true;
  for (const r of EW_ROADS) if (Math.abs(z - r.z) < r.half + hd) return true;
  return Math.abs(z - HWY_Z) < HWY_HALF + 14 + hd;
}

/**
 * A row of houses along an east–west street, between x0 and x1, on one side.
 * side = -1: north of the street (fronts face south), +1: south of the street (fronts face north).
 */
function row(out: House[], cars: ParkedCar[], sz: number, x0: number, x1: number, side: -1 | 1, seed: number, lot = 22, setback = 7) {
  const r = rng(seed);
  for (let x = x0 + lot / 2; x <= x1 - lot / 2; x += lot) {
    const w = 10 + Math.floor(r() * 5);
    const d = 9 + Math.floor(r() * 3);
    const twoStorey = r() < 0.55;
    const h = twoStorey ? 6.2 : 3.6;
    const cz = sz + side * (STREET_HALF + 3.4 + setback + d / 2);
    const cx = x + (r() - 0.5) * 3;
    if (blocked(cx, cz, w / 2, d / 2) || onRoad(cx, cz, w / 2, d / 2)) continue;
    out.push({
      x: cx, z: cz, w, d, h, roof: 2.4 + r() * 1.2,
      rot: side === -1 ? 0 : Math.PI,
      wall: WALLS[Math.floor(r() * WALLS.length)], roofColor: ROOFS[Math.floor(r() * ROOFS.length)],
      chimney: r() < 0.4,
    });
    // a car on the driveway next to the house
    if (r() < 0.55) {
      const dx = cx + (w / 2 + 3) * (r() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
      cars.push({ x: dx, z: sz + side * (STREET_HALF + 3.4 + 4), rot: Math.PI / 2, color: CAR_COLORS[Math.floor(r() * CAR_COLORS.length)] });
    }
  }
}

function build() {
  const houses: House[] = [];
  const cars: ParkedCar[] = [];
  const driveways: ParkedCar[] = [];
  let seed = 11;
  // Maple Heights: rows on both sides of each east–west street, in the two columns of blocks
  const cols: [number, number][] = [[SUB_X0 + ART_HALF + 16, MAPLE_X - STREET_HALF - 10], [MAPLE_X + STREET_HALF + 10, SUB_X1 - ART_HALF - 10],
    // Willow Grove, west of Harbor Avenue
    [WIL_X0 + ART_HALF + 12, BIRCH_X - STREET_HALF - 10], [BIRCH_X + STREET_HALF + 10, WIL_X1 - ART_HALF - 14]];
  const subStreets = [SUB_STREETS.hill, STREETS.B, SUB_STREETS.elm, STREETS.A, SUB_STREETS.oak];
  for (const [x0, x1] of cols) {
    for (const sz of subStreets) {
      row(houses, cars, sz, x0, x1, -1, seed++);
      row(houses, cars, sz, x0, x1, 1, seed++);
    }
  }
  // Port Harbor: town houses on the north side of Bay Road and along Shore Road
  for (const [x0, x1] of [[ART_W + 14, CENTRAL_X - 12], [CENTRAL_X + 12, ART_E - 14], [ART_E + 14, OCEAN_X - 12], [OCEAN_X + 12, CEDAR_X - 12]]) {
    row(houses, cars, BAY_Z, x0, x1, -1, seed++, 18, 4);
    row(houses, cars, SHORE_Z, x0, x1, -1, seed++, 18, 4);
  }
  for (const c of cars) driveways.push(c);

  // cars parked along the kerbs of the town streets (gaps at junctions)
  const r = rng(97);
  const kerb: ParkedCar[] = [];
  const junctions = [ART_W, CENTRAL_X, ART_E, OCEAN_X, CEDAR_X, WIL_X0, BIRCH_X];
  for (const sz of [MARKET_Z, BAY_Z, SHORE_Z]) {
    for (let x = ART_W + 14; x < CEDAR_X - 12; x += 7.5) {
      if (junctions.some((j) => Math.abs(x - j) < 16)) continue;
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        if (r() < 0.6) continue;
        kerb.push({ x, z: sz + s * (STREET_HALF - 1.4), rot: s < 0 ? Math.PI : 0, color: CAR_COLORS[Math.floor(r() * CAR_COLORS.length)] });
      }
    }
  }
  for (const sz of [SUB_STREETS.hill, SUB_STREETS.elm, SUB_STREETS.oak]) {
    for (let x = SUB_X0 + 20; x < SUB_X1 - 12; x += 9) {
      if (Math.abs(x - MAPLE_X) < 16 || r() < 0.7) continue;
      const s = r() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
      kerb.push({ x, z: sz + s * (STREET_HALF - 1.4), rot: s < 0 ? Math.PI : 0, color: CAR_COLORS[Math.floor(r() * CAR_COLORS.length)] });
    }
    for (let x = WIL_X0 + 18; x < WIL_X1 - 16; x += 9) {
      if (Math.abs(x - BIRCH_X) < 16 || r() < 0.7) continue;
      const s = r() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
      kerb.push({ x, z: sz + s * (STREET_HALF - 1.4), rot: s < 0 ? Math.PI : 0, color: CAR_COLORS[Math.floor(r() * CAR_COLORS.length)] });
    }
  }

  // street lamps along every street and avenue in town and in the estate
  const lamps: Lamp[] = [];
  const lampEW = (sz: number, x0: number, x1: number, step = 30) => {
    for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x += step) {
      if (junctions.some((j) => Math.abs(x - j) < 12)) continue;
      lamps.push({ x, z: sz - STREET_HALF - 2.6 }, { x: x + step / 2, z: sz + STREET_HALF + 2.6 });
    }
  };
  for (const sz of [MARKET_Z, BAY_Z, SHORE_Z]) lampEW(sz, ART_W + 16, CEDAR_X - 10);
  for (const sz of subStreets) lampEW(sz, SUB_X0 + 16, SUB_X1 - 10, 36);
  for (const sz of subStreets) lampEW(sz, WIL_X0 + 14, WIL_X1 - 14, 36);
  const lampNS = (ax: number, z0: number, z1: number, half: number, step = 30) => {
    for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z += step) {
      if ([MARKET_Z, BAY_Z, SHORE_Z, ...subStreets].some((s) => Math.abs(z - s) < 12)) continue;
      lamps.push({ x: ax - half - 2.6, z }, { x: ax + half + 2.6, z: z + step / 2 });
    }
  };
  for (const ax of [CENTRAL_X, OCEAN_X]) lampNS(ax, HWY_S + 12, SHORE_Z - 10, STREET_HALF);
  for (const ax of [ART_W, ART_E, CEDAR_X]) lampNS(ax, HWY_S + 12, SHORE_Z - 10, ART_HALF);
  for (const ax of [SUB_X0, SUB_X1]) lampNS(ax, SUB_STREETS.hill + 10, HWY_N - 14, ART_HALF, 34);
  lampNS(MAPLE_X, SUB_STREETS.hill + 10, HWY_N - 14, STREET_HALF, 34);
  lampNS(WIL_X0, SUB_STREETS.hill + 10, HWY_N - 14, ART_HALF, 34);
  lampNS(BIRCH_X, SUB_STREETS.hill + 10, HWY_N - 14, STREET_HALF, 34);
  // the beach promenade
  for (let x = ART_W; x <= CEDAR_X + 60; x += 26) lamps.push({ x, z: BEACH_Z0 - 2 });

  // benches in the parks and on the promenade
  const benches: Bench[] = [];
  for (const g of GREENS) {
    const cx = (g.x0 + g.x1) / 2, cz = (g.z0 + g.z1) / 2;
    benches.push({ x: cx - 8, z: cz, rot: Math.PI / 2 }, { x: cx + 8, z: cz, rot: -Math.PI / 2 }, { x: cx, z: cz - 8, rot: 0 }, { x: cx, z: cz + 8, rot: Math.PI });
  }
  for (let x = ART_W + 13; x <= CEDAR_X + 40; x += 52) benches.push({ x, z: BEACH_Z0 + 1.5, rot: Math.PI });

  // trees: back gardens, parks, the estate's streets, the beach promenade
  const trees: [number, number, number][] = [];
  const tr = rng(331);
  for (const h of houses) {
    if (tr() < 0.6) {
      const back = h.rot === 0 ? -1 : 1;
      const tx = h.x + (tr() - 0.5) * h.w, tz = h.z + back * (h.d / 2 + 4 + tr() * 3);
      if (!onRoad(tx, tz, 1, 1)) trees.push([tx, tz, 0.8 + tr() * 0.5]);
    }
  }
  for (const g of GREENS) {
    for (let x = g.x0 + 4; x <= g.x1 - 4; x += 10) {
      for (let z = g.z0 + 4; z <= g.z1 - 4; z += 10) {
        const cx = (g.x0 + g.x1) / 2, cz = (g.z0 + g.z1) / 2;
        if (Math.abs(x - cx) < 12 && Math.abs(z - cz) < 12) continue; // the plaza in the middle
        if (tr() < 0.55) trees.push([x + (tr() - 0.5) * 5, z + (tr() - 0.5) * 5, 0.9 + tr() * 0.6]);
      }
    }
  }
  for (const sz of subStreets) {
    for (let x = SUB_X0 + 22; x < SUB_X1 - 10; x += 16) {
      if (Math.abs(x - MAPLE_X) < 14) continue;
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        const tz = sz + s * (STREET_HALF + 4.6);
        if (!blocked(x, tz, 1, 1) && tr() < 0.75) trees.push([x, tz, 0.75 + tr() * 0.3]);
      }
    }
    for (let x = WIL_X0 + 18; x < WIL_X1 - 14; x += 16) {
      if (Math.abs(x - BIRCH_X) < 14) continue;
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        const tz = sz + s * (STREET_HALF + 4.6);
        if (!blocked(x, tz, 1, 1) && tr() < 0.75) trees.push([x, tz, 0.75 + tr() * 0.3]);
      }
    }
  }
  for (let x = ART_W - 20; x <= CEDAR_X + 120; x += 14) trees.push([x, BEACH_Z0 - 5.5, 0.9 + tr() * 0.4]); // promenade palms-ish row
  // the estate's northern edge: a wooded strip
  for (let x = WIL_X0 - 30; x <= WIL_X1 - 14; x += 9) {
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) trees.push([x + (tr() - 0.5) * 6, SUB_STREETS.hill - 46 - k * 9 + (tr() - 0.5) * 4, 1 + tr() * 0.6]);
  }
  for (let x = SUB_X0 + 12; x <= SUB_X1 + 40; x += 9) {
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) trees.push([x + (tr() - 0.5) * 6, SUB_STREETS.hill - 46 - k * 9 + (tr() - 0.5) * 4, 1 + tr() * 0.6]);
  }

  // sidewalk loops that pedestrians walk (inset from the street centre lines)
  const loops: WalkLoop[] = [];
  const inset = STREET_HALF + 1.7;
  const loop = (x0: number, x1: number, z0: number, z1: number) => {
    const pts = [{ x: x0 + inset, z: z0 + inset }, { x: x1 - inset, z: z0 + inset }, { x: x1 - inset, z: z1 - inset }, { x: x0 + inset, z: z1 - inset }];
    loops.push({ pts, length: 2 * (x1 - x0 - 2 * inset) + 2 * (z1 - z0 - 2 * inset) });
  };
  const townX = [ART_W, CENTRAL_X, ART_E, OCEAN_X, CEDAR_X];
  for (let i = 0; i < townX.length - 1; i++) {
    loop(townX[i], townX[i + 1], MARKET_Z, BAY_Z);
    loop(townX[i], townX[i + 1], BAY_Z, SHORE_Z);
  }
  const subX = [WIL_X0, BIRCH_X, WIL_X1, -1, SUB_X0, MAPLE_X, SUB_X1];
  for (let i = 0; i < subX.length - 1; i++) {
    if (subX[i] === -1 || subX[i + 1] === -1) continue;
    for (let k = 0; k < subStreets.length - 1; k++) loop(subX[i], subX[i + 1], subStreets[k], subStreets[k + 1]);
  }

  return { houses, driveways, kerb, lamps, benches, trees, loops };
}

export const SCENERY = build();

/** Stretches of the beach and promenade where people stroll back and forth (x0, x1, z). */
export const PROMENADE = { x0: ART_W - 30, x1: CEDAR_X + 140, z: BEACH_Z0 - 2, beachZ0: BEACH_Z0 + 4, beachZ1: SEA_Z0 - 4 };

/** Where shoppers stand around (shop fronts, bus stops): [x, z]. */
export function crowdSpots(): [number, number][] {
  const out: [number, number][] = [];
  for (const b of PARK_BUILDINGS) {
    if (!['SUPERMARKET', 'STORE'].includes(b.kind) || b.z < HWY_S) continue;
    const front = b.rotation === 180 ? b.z - b.d / 2 - 4 : b.z + b.d / 2 + 4;
    out.push([b.x - b.w / 4, front], [b.x + b.w / 5, front]);
  }
  return out;
}

export function loopPoint(l: WalkLoop, s: number): { x: number; z: number; dx: number; dz: number } {
  let d = ((s % l.length) + l.length) % l.length;
  const n = l.pts.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = l.pts[i], b = l.pts[(i + 1) % n];
    const seg = Math.abs(b.x - a.x) + Math.abs(b.z - a.z);
    if (d <= seg) {
      const t = seg ? d / seg : 0;
      return { x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, z: a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t, dx: Math.sign(b.x - a.x), dz: Math.sign(b.z - a.z) };
    }
    d -= seg;
  }
  return { x: l.pts[0].x, z: l.pts[0].z, dx: 1, dz: 0 };
}

export function createSeedWorld(): WorldState {
  const w: WorldState = {
    version: WORLD_VERSION,
    simTime: SIM_START,
    realTime: 0,
    nextShipment: 78470,
    nextPallet: 1100,
    facilities: {},
    docks: {},
    trucks: {},
    shipments: {},
    forklifts: {},
    pallets: {},
    chargers: {},
    laneLock: { 'WH-01': null, 'WH-02': null, 'WH-04': null },
    events: [],
    eventSeq: 0,
    port: seedPort(),
    retail: seedRetail(),
  };
  for (const f of FACILITIES) w.facilities[f.id] = structuredClone(f);
  for (const d of DOCKS) w.docks[d.id] = { ...d };

  for (const s of TRUCKS) {
    const t: Truck = {
      id: s.id, facilityId: s.fac, carrier: s.carrier, driver: s.driver, plate: s.plate, direction: s.dir,
      phase: s.phase, dockId: s.dock, shipmentId: s.ship.id, capacity: s.cap,
      cargo: s.dir === 'inbound' ? s.cap - s.done : s.done,
      skuId: s.sku, legs: [], legIdx: 0, legDist: 0, pos: { x: 0, z: 0 }, heading: 0, speed: 0, awayUntil: 0, forkliftId: null, lane: 'ROAD',
    };
    if (s.phase === 'en_route') {
      const leg = legRoadIn(s.fac);
      t.legs = [leg];
      t.legDist = Math.max(0, pathLength(leg.pts) - (s.remaining ?? 100));
      t.speed = ROAD_SPEED;
    } else if (s.phase === 'docking' && s.dock) {
      t.legs = [legYardIn(s.fac, s.dock), legReverseIn(s.fac, s.dock)];
      t.legIdx = s.dockLeg ?? 0;
      t.legDist = s.dockDist ?? 0;
      w.laneLock[s.fac] = s.id;
    }
    w.trucks[t.id] = t;
    w.shipments[s.ship.id] = { ...s.ship, truckId: s.id, facilityId: s.fac, direction: s.dir, skuId: s.sku, pallets: s.cap, onTime: null, lane: 'ROAD', containerNo: null };
  }

  for (const p of PALLETS) {
    const sku = SKUS[p.sku];
    w.pallets[p.id] = {
      id: p.id, facilityId: p.fac, skuId: p.sku, qty: p.qty ?? sku.unitsPerPallet, weightKg: p.kg ?? sku.kgPerPallet,
      lot: p.lot, received: p.received, slot: p.slot, forkliftId: null, featured: !!p.featured, reserved: false,
    };
  }

  for (const s of FORKS) {
    const pad = LAYOUTS[s.fac].chargers[s.charger];
    const f: Forklift = {
      id: s.id, facilityId: s.fac, operator: s.op, model: s.model, battery: s.battery, task: 'idle', truckId: null,
      palletId: null, movesToday: s.moves, chargerId: s.charger, pos: { ...pad }, heading: Math.PI, speed: 0,
      path: [], pathDist: 0, timer: 0, pick: null, drop: null,
    };
    if (s.battery < 95) f.task = 'charging';
    if (s.work) {
      f.task = s.work.task;
      f.truckId = s.work.truck;
      f.pos = { ...s.work.at };
      f.pick = s.work.pick ?? null;
      f.drop = s.work.drop ?? null;
      w.trucks[s.work.truck].forkliftId = s.id;
      if (s.work.pallet) {
        const sku = SKUS[s.work.pallet.sku];
        w.pallets[s.work.pallet.id] = {
          id: s.work.pallet.id, facilityId: s.fac, skuId: sku.id, qty: sku.unitsPerPallet, weightKg: sku.kgPerPallet,
          lot: 'L2502-' + s.work.pallet.id.slice(-3), received: 'Today, 09:3' + s.work.pallet.id.slice(-1),
          slot: null, forkliftId: s.id, featured: false, reserved: false,
        };
        f.palletId = s.work.pallet.id;
      }
    }
    w.forklifts[f.id] = f;
  }

  for (const [fac, L] of Object.entries(LAYOUTS)) {
    for (const id of Object.keys(L.chargers)) {
      const [sessions, energy] = CHARGER_STATS[id] ?? [3, 20];
      const c: Charger = { id, facilityId: fac as FacilityId, description: '48 V lithium-ion forklift charger', sessionsToday: sessions, energyKwh: energy, ratePctPerMin: 8 };
      w.chargers[id] = c;
    }
  }

  w.events.push(
    { t: hm('09:31'), facilityId: 'WH-04', text: 'TRK-2205 docked at In 1', ref: { kind: 'truck', id: 'TRK-2205' } },
    { t: hm('09:34'), facilityId: 'WH-02', text: 'TRK-2127 started loading at Bay 3', ref: { kind: 'truck', id: 'TRK-2127' } },
    { t: hm('09:36'), facilityId: 'WH-01', text: 'Safety Helmet below reorder level', ref: { kind: 'pallet', id: 'PAL-1026' } },
  );
  w.eventSeq = w.events.length;
  return w;
}

/** Today's earlier traffic through the park gates (matches the facilities' import/export counters). */
export interface GateHistoryRow {
  gate: 'WEST' | 'EAST'; direction: 'IN' | 'OUT'; trade: 'IMPORT' | 'EXPORT' | 'EMPTY';
  truckId: string; facilityId: FacilityId; skuId: string; pallets: number; simTime: number; minutesAgo: number;
}
export function seedGateHistory(w: WorldState): GateHistoryRow[] {
  const rows: GateHistoryRow[] = [];
  for (const f of Object.values(w.facilities)) {
    const trucks = Object.values(w.trucks).filter((t) => t.facilityId === f.id);
    const pick = (dir: 'inbound' | 'outbound', i: number) => {
      const list = trucks.filter((t) => t.direction === dir);
      return (list.length ? list : trucks)[i % (list.length || trucks.length)];
    };
    const spread = (n: number, total: number) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => Math.floor(total / n) + (i < total % n ? 1 : 0));
    const add = (trade: 'IMPORT' | 'EXPORT', n: number, total: number) => {
      spread(n, total).forEach((pallets, i) => {
        const t = pick(trade === 'IMPORT' ? 'inbound' : 'outbound', i);
        const minutesAgo = 20 + Math.round(((n - i) / n) * 300) + (trade === 'EXPORT' ? 7 : 0);
        rows.push({
          gate: trade === 'IMPORT' ? 'WEST' : 'EAST', direction: trade === 'IMPORT' ? 'IN' : 'OUT', trade,
          truckId: t.id, facilityId: f.id, skuId: f.inventory[i % f.inventory.length].skuId, pallets,
          simTime: Math.max(0, SIM_START - minutesAgo * 60), minutesAgo,
        });
        // the same truck passed the other gate empty
        rows.push({
          gate: trade === 'IMPORT' ? 'EAST' : 'WEST', direction: trade === 'IMPORT' ? 'OUT' : 'IN', trade: 'EMPTY',
          truckId: t.id, facilityId: f.id, skuId: f.inventory[i % f.inventory.length].skuId, pallets: 0,
          simTime: Math.max(0, SIM_START - (minutesAgo + (trade === 'IMPORT' ? -12 : 12)) * 60), minutesAgo: minutesAgo + (trade === 'IMPORT' ? -12 : 12),
        });
      });
    };
    add('IMPORT', f.importsToday, f.importPalletsToday);
    add('EXPORT', f.exportsToday, f.exportPalletsToday);
  }
  return rows.sort((a, b) => b.minutesAgo - a.minutesAgo);
}

// Domain types shared by the data adapter, the simulation and the UI.
// These mirror what a future SQL-backed API would return.

export type FacilityId = 'WH-01' | 'WH-02' | 'WH-04';
export type EntityKind =
  | 'facility' | 'truck' | 'forklift' | 'pallet' | 'dock' | 'charger' | 'asset' | 'building' | 'vehicle' | 'gate'
  | 'vessel' | 'crane' | 'berth' | 'store' | 'van';
export interface EntityRef {
  kind: EntityKind;
  id: string;
}

export interface Vec2 {
  x: number;
  z: number;
}

export type PalletLook = 'cardboard' | 'blue' | 'white';
export type SkuIcon = 'box' | 'container' | 'helmet' | 'tape' | 'panel' | 'chair' | 'gloves';

  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  unitsPerPallet: number;
  kgPerPallet: number;

}

  lowBelow: number;
}

  id: FacilityId;

  address: string;

// Moving and state-driven scene objects. Transforms are read from the world
// state every frame; structural changes (cargo, pallets) follow the UI tick.
import { useRef } from 'react';
import { useFrame, type ThreeEvent } from '@react-three/fiber';
import type * as THREE from 'three';
import type { EntityRef, FacilityId, PalletLook } from '../data/types';
import { LAYOUTS } from '../data/layouts';
import { SKUS } from '../data/seed';
import { getWorld, useApp } from '../store';
import { LIFT_TIME } from '../sim/engine';
import { assetsOf } from '../ui/derive';
import { TruckModel, ForkliftModel, PalletModel, Pin, ChargerUnit } from './models';

export function useSelectHandlers(ref: EntityRef) {
  const select = useApp((s) => s.select);
  const setHovered = useApp((s) => s.setHovered);
  const camera = useApp((s) => s.camera);
  return {
    onClick: (e: ThreeEvent<MouseEvent>) => {
      if (e.delta > 6) return;
      e.stopPropagation();
      select(ref);
    },
    onDoubleClick: (e: ThreeEvent<MouseEvent>) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      select(ref);
      camera({ kind: 'focus', ref });
    },
    onPointerOver: (e: ThreeEvent<PointerEvent>) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      document.body.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      setHovered(ref);
    },
    onPointerOut: () => {
      document.body.style.cursor = '';
      const h = useApp.getState().hovered;
      if (h && h.kind === ref.kind && h.id === ref.id) setHovered(null);
    },
  };
}

function AssetHit({ id, x, z, size, rotation }: { id: string; x: number; z: number; size: [number, number, number]; rotation: number }) {
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'asset', id });
  return (
    <mesh position={[x, size[1] / 2, z]} rotation={[0, rotation, 0]} {...handlers} name={`asset-${id}`}>
      <boxGeometry args={size} />
      <meshBasicMaterial transparent opacity={0} depthWrite={false} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function DoorHit({ id, x }: { id: string; x: number }) {
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'dock', id });
  return (
    <mesh position={[x, 2.5, 0.5]} {...handlers} name={`door-${id}`}>
      <boxGeometry args={[4.6, 5, 1]} />
      <meshBasicMaterial transparent opacity={0} depthWrite={false} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

/**
 * Moves a group towards its target pose. In live mode the server streams poses
 * ~5×/s, so the displayed pose eases toward the latest one; big jumps snap.
 */
export function follow(g: THREE.Group, x: number, z: number, heading: number, dt: number, init: { done: boolean }) {
  const live = useApp.getState().mode === 'live';
  const dx = x - g.position.x, dz = z - g.position.z;
  if (!live || !init.done || dx * dx + dz * dz > 400) {
    g.position.set(x, 0, z);
    g.rotation.y = -heading;
    init.done = true;
    return;
  }
  const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 9);
  g.position.x += dx * k;
  g.position.z += dz * k;
  let dh = -heading - g.rotation.y;
  while (dh > Math.PI) dh -= Math.PI * 2;
  while (dh < -Math.PI) dh += Math.PI * 2;
  g.rotation.y += dh * k;
}

const SEA_BOX_COLORS = ['#d9480f', '#1971c2', '#2b8a3e', '#e67700', '#5f3dc4', '#c92a2a', '#0b7285'];

function TruckObj({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const box = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const init = useRef({ done: false });
  const t0 = getWorld().trucks[id];
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'truck', id });
  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const w = getWorld();
    const t = w.trucks[id];
    if (!g.current || !t) return;
    g.current.visible = t.phase !== 'away';
    follow(g.current, t.pos.x, t.pos.z, t.heading, dt, init.current);
    // sea freight: the trailer carries a shipping container to / from the port
    if (box.current) {
      const s = w.shipments[t.shipmentId];
      const show = t.lane === 'SEA' && !!s?.containerNo && t.cargo > 0 && (t.phase === 'en_route' || t.phase === 'leaving' || t.phase === 'at_gate');
      box.current.visible = show;
      if (show && s?.containerNo && box.current.userData.no !== s.containerNo) {
        box.current.userData.no = s.containerNo;
        let h = 0;
        for (const ch of s.containerNo) h = (h * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0;
        (box.current.material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial).color.set(SEA_BOX_COLORS[h % SEA_BOX_COLORS.length]);
      }
    }
  });
  if (!t0) return null;
  return (
    <group ref={g} {...handlers} name={`truck-${id}`}>
      <TruckModel carrier={t0.carrier} />
      <mesh ref={box} position={[-1.55, 2.8, 0]} visible={false} castShadow>
        <boxGeometry args={[9.1, 3.25, 2.7]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#1971c2" roughness={0.7} />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

function ForkliftObj({ id, carrying }: { id: string; carrying: PalletLook | null }) {
  const g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const lift = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const init = useRef({ done: false });
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'forklift', id });
  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const f = getWorld().forklifts[id];
    if (!g.current || !f) return;
    follow(g.current, f.pos.x, f.pos.z, f.heading, dt, init.current);
    if (lift.current) {
      let h = f.palletId ? 0.5 : 0.12;
      const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - f.timer / LIFT_TIME));
      if (f.task === 'lifting') h = 0.12 + 0.38 * p;
      if (f.task === 'dropping') h = 0.5 - 0.38 * p;
      lift.current.position.y = h;
    }
  });
  return (
    <group ref={g} {...handlers} name={`forklift-${id}`}>
      <group scale={1.45}><ForkliftModel ref={lift} carrying={carrying} forkHeight={0.12} /></group>
    </group>
  );
}

function lookOf(palletId: string | null): PalletLook | null {
  if (!palletId) return null;
  const p = getWorld().pallets[palletId];
  return p ? SKUS[p.skuId].look : null;
}

function StagedPallet({ id, x, z, look, featured }: { id: string; x: number; z: number; look: PalletLook; featured: boolean }) {
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'pallet', id });
  return (
    <group position={[x, 0, z]} {...handlers} name={`pallet-${id}`}>
      <group scale={1.45}><PalletModel look={look} layers={2} /></group>
      {featured && <Pin y={2.2} />}
    </group>
  );
}

function DockPad({ id, x }: { id: string; x: number }) {
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'dock', id });
  return (
    <mesh position={[x, 0.06, 7.4]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} {...handlers} name={`dock-${id}`}>
      <planeGeometry args={[4.6, 13]} />
      <meshBasicMaterial transparent opacity={0} depthWrite={false} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function ChargerObj({ id, x, z, active }: { id: string; x: number; z: number; active: boolean }) {
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'charger', id });
  return (
    <group position={[x, 0, z]} {...handlers} name={`charger-${id}`}>
      <ChargerUnit active={active} />
    </group>
  );
}

export function Dynamic({ facilityId }: { facilityId: FacilityId }) {
  useApp((s) => s.tick); // re-render on throttled ticks for structural changes
  const w = getWorld();
  const L = LAYOUTS[facilityId];
  const trucks = Object.values(w.trucks).filter((t) => t.facilityId === facilityId);
  const forks = Object.values(w.forklifts).filter((f) => f.facilityId === facilityId);
  const staged = Object.values(w.pallets).filter((p) => p.facilityId === facilityId && p.slot !== null);
  const docks = Object.values(w.docks).filter((d) => d.facilityId === facilityId);
  return (
    <group>
      {trucks.map((t) => <TruckObj key={t.id} id={t.id} />)}
      {forks.map((f) => <ForkliftObj key={f.id} id={f.id} carrying={lookOf(f.palletId)} />)}
      {staged.map((p) => {
        const s = L.slots[p.slot as number];
        return <StagedPallet key={p.id} id={p.id} x={s.x} z={s.z} look={SKUS[p.skuId].look} featured={p.featured} />;
      })}
      {docks.map((d) => <DockPad key={d.id} id={d.id} x={L.doors[d.id]} />)}
      {docks.map((d) => <DoorHit key={`door-${d.id}`} id={d.id} x={L.doors[d.id]} />)}
      {assetsOf(facilityId).map((a) => <AssetHit key={a.id} id={a.id} x={a.pos.x} z={a.pos.z} size={a.size} rotation={a.rotation} />)}
      {Object.entries(L.chargers).map(([id, pos]) => {
        const f = forks.find((x) => x.chargerId === id);
        return <ChargerObj key={id} id={id} x={pos.x} z={pos.z} active={f?.task === 'charging'} />;
      })}
    </group>
  );
}

type V3 = [number, number, number];

function Flat({ x, z, w, d, color, y = 0.02, rot = 0 }: { x: number; z: number; w: number; d: number; color: string; y?: number; rot?: number }) {
  return (
    <mesh position={[x, y, z]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, rot]} receiveShadow material={mat(color, { rough: 1 })}>
      <planeGeometry args={[w, d]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function Decal({ tex, x, z, w, d, rot = 0, y = 0.07 }: { tex: THREE.Texture; x: number; z: number; w: number; d: number; rot?: number; y?: number }) {
  const m = useMemo(() => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }), [tex]);
  return (
    <mesh position={[x, y, z]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, rot]} material={m}>
      <planeGeometry args={[w, d]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

    const w = ART_E - ART_W;
    els.push(<Flat key={`st${k}`} x={0} z={sz} w={w} d={STREET_HALF * 2} color={ROAD} y={0.032} />);
    for (let x = ART_W + 12; x < ART_E - 10; x += 8) els.push(<Flat key={`sd${k}${x}`} x={x} z={sz} w={3.6} d={0.3} color={LINE} y={0.05} />);
    els.push(<Flat key={`sw0${k}`} x={0} z={sz - STREET_HALF - 0.4} w={w - ART_HALF * 2 - 6.4} d={0.8} color={C.curb} y={0.035} />);
    els.push(<Flat key={`sw1${k}`} x={0} z={sz + STREET_HALF + 1.7} w={w - ART_HALF * 2 - 6.4} d={3.4} color={C.curb} y={0.035} />);
    // zebra crossings next to each junction
    for (const jx of [ART_W + ART_HALF + 4, ART_E - ART_HALF - 4]) {
      for (let i = -5; i <= 5; i += 1.6) els.push(<Flat key={`zb${k}${jx}${i}`} x={jx} z={sz + i} w={3.2} d={0.7} color={LINE} y={0.055} />);
    }
  }
  return <group>{els}</group>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- landscaping
function useTreeSpots(): [number, number, number][] {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const out: [number, number, number][] = [];
    const ok = (x: number, z: number) => {
      for (const b of getPark().buildings) {
        const [w, d] = b.rotation === 90 || b.rotation === 270 ? [b.d, b.w] : [b.w, b.d];
        if (Math.abs(x - b.x) < w / 2 + 4 && Math.abs(z - b.z) < d / 2 + 4) return false;
      }
      return true;
    };
    let n = 0;
    const add = (x: number, z: number) => { if (ok(x, z)) out.push([x, z, 0.9 + ((n++ * 37) % 7) / 10]); };
    for (let x = -600; x <= 640; x += 21) {
      if ([ART_W, ART_E, WIL_X0, BIRCH_X].every((ax) => Math.abs(x - ax) > 18)) add(x, HWY_Z - HWY_HALF - 8);
      if (x > -610) add(x + 9, HWY_Z + HWY_HALF + 9);
    }
    for (let z = 200; z >= ART_Z0 + 10; z -= 23) {
      if ([SUB_STREETS.hill, STREETS.B, SUB_STREETS.elm, STREETS.A, SUB_STREETS.oak].every((s) => Math.abs(z - s) > 12)) add(ART_W - ART_HALF - 9, z);
      add(ART_E + ART_HALF + 9, z);
    }
    for (let x = ART_W + 20; x <= ART_E - 20; x += 26) add(x, ART_Z0 + 4);
    // street trees in town
    for (let x = ART_W + 16; x <= ART_E - 14; x += 22) {
      if (Math.abs(x - CENTRAL_X) < 14) continue;
      add(x, MARKET_Z + STREET_HALF + 5);
      add(x + 11, BAY_Z - STREET_HALF - 5);
      add(x, BAY_Z + STREET_HALF + 5);
      add(x + 11, SHORE_Z - STREET_HALF - 5);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) add(-185 + (i % 4) * 16, 438 + Math.floor(i / 4) * 8);
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) add(110 + (i % 5) * 22, 446 + Math.floor(i / 5) * 8);
    // small parks
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) add(-318 + (i % 3) * 9, -40 - Math.floor(i / 3) * 9);
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) add(312 + (i % 2) * 10, -10 - Math.floor(i / 2) * 11);
    return out;
  }, []);
}

function Trees() {
  const spots = useTreeSpots();
  const trunk = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const crown = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const crown2 = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const apply = () => {
    const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
    spots.forEach(([x, z, s], i) => {
      m.makeScale(s, s, s).setPosition(x, 0.9 * s, z);
      trunk.current?.setMatrixAt(i, m);
      m.makeScale(s, s, s).setPosition(x, 3.0 * s, z);
      crown.current?.setMatrixAt(i, m);
      m.makeScale(s, s, s).setPosition(x + 0.5 * s, 2.4 * s, z + 0.4 * s);
      crown2.current?.setMatrixAt(i, m);
    });
    for (const r of [trunk, crown, crown2]) if (r.current) r.current.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  };
  return (
    <group ref={() => apply()}>
      <instancedMesh ref={trunk} args={[undefined, undefined, spots.length]} castShadow material={mat(C.trunk)}>
        <cylinderGeometry args={[0.18, 0.24, 1.8, 6]} />
      </instancedMesh>
      <instancedMesh ref={crown} args={[undefined, undefined, spots.length]} castShadow material={mat(C.leaf, { rough: 0.9 })}>
        <sphereGeometry args={[1.55, 12, 9]} />
      </instancedMesh>
      <instancedMesh ref={crown2} args={[undefined, undefined, spots.length]} castShadow material={mat(C.leafDark, { rough: 0.9 })}>
        <sphereGeometry args={[0.9, 10, 8]} />
      </instancedMesh>
    </group>
  );
}

function SignPost({ p, rot, title, sub, arrow }: { p: V3; rot: number; title: string; sub: string; arrow: 'left' | 'right' | 'up' }) {

  const m = useMemo(() => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex }), [tex]);
  return (
    <group position={p} rotation={[0, rot, 0]}>
      <Box p={[-4.5, 3, 0]} s={[0.3, 6, 0.3]} c="#9aa4b8" />
      <Box p={[4.5, 3, 0]} s={[0.3, 6, 0.3]} c="#9aa4b8" />
      <mesh position={[0, 6.4, 0.18]} material={m}><planeGeometry args={[11, 3.8]} /></mesh>
      <Box p={[0, 6.4, 0]} s={[11.2, 3.9, 0.25]} c="#1b6b43" shadow={false} />
    </group>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- buildings
function Sign({ p, rot = 0, name, sub, color, w = 16 }: { p: V3; rot?: number; name: string; sub: string; color: string; w?: number }) {
  const tex = useMemo(() => companySign(name, sub, color), [name, sub, color]);
  const m = useMemo(() => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }), [tex]);
  return <mesh position={p} rotation={[0, rot, 0]} material={m}><planeGeometry args={[w, w / 4]} /></mesh>;
}

function Windows({ w, h, d }: { w: number; h: number; d: number }) {
  const m = useMemo(() => {
    const a = windowTexture().clone(); a.repeat.set(w / 5, h / 4); a.needsUpdate = true;
    const b = windowTexture().clone(); b.repeat.set(d / 5, h / 4); b.needsUpdate = true;
    const top = mat('#e9edf5');
    return [new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: b, roughness: 0.9 }), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: b, roughness: 0.9 }), top, top,
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: a, roughness: 0.9 }), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: a, roughness: 0.9 })];
  }, [w, h, d]);
  return <mesh position={[0, h / 2, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow material={m}><boxGeometry args={[w, h, d]} /></mesh>;
}

/** Smoke puffs rising from a stack; follows the operations clock (stops when paused). */
function Smoke({ p, h }: { p: V3; h: number }) {
  const g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const m = useMemo(() => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#f4f6fa', transparent: true, opacity: 0.7, depthWrite: false, roughness: 1 }), []);
  useFrame(() => {
    const t = parkTime();
    g.current?.children.forEach((c, i) => {
      const k = ((t * 0.25 + i / 4) % 1);
      c.position.set(k * 3, h + k * 10, -k * 1.5);
      const s = 0.8 + k * 2.4;
      c.scale.set(s, s, s);
      ((c as THREE.Mesh).material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial).opacity = 0.75 * (1 - k);
    });
  });
  const mats = useMemo(() => [0, 1, 2, 3].map(() => m.clone()), [m]);
  return (
    <group ref={g} position={p}>
      {mats.map((mm, i) => <mesh key={i} material={mm}><sphereGeometry args={[1, 10, 8]} /></mesh>)}
    </group>
  );
}

function Stack({ x, z, h, color }: { x: number; z: number; h: number; color: string }) {
  return (
    <group position={[x, 0, z]}>
      <mesh position={[0, h / 2, 0]} castShadow material={mat('#d5dbe6')}><cylinderGeometry args={[1.1, 1.4, h, 14]} /></mesh>
      <mesh position={[0, h - 2, 0]} material={mat(color)}><cylinderGeometry args={[1.13, 1.13, 1.4, 14]} /></mesh>
      <mesh position={[0, h - 5, 0]} material={mat('#ffffff')}><cylinderGeometry args={[1.18, 1.18, 1.2, 14]} /></mesh>
      <Smoke p={[0, 0, 0]} h={h + 1} />
    </group>
  );
}

function Tank({ x, z, r, h, color }: { x: number; z: number; r: number; h: number; color: string }) {
  return (

      <mesh position={[0, h * 0.7, 0]} material={mat(color)}><cylinderGeometry args={[r + 0.04, r + 0.04, 0.9, 20]} /></mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

function ParkedCars({ b }: { b: ParkBuilding }) {
  const cars: JSX.Element[] = [];
  const cols = Math.floor((b.w - 8) / 3.2);
  const rows = [-b.d / 2 + 6, -b.d / 2 + 13, b.d / 2 - 13, b.d / 2 - 6];
  rows.forEach((rz, ri) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++) {
      const x = -b.w / 2 + 4 + i * 3.2 + 1.6;
      const seed = (i * 7 + ri * 13 + b.id.length * 3) % 10;
      cars.push(<Flat key={`l${ri}-${i}`} x={x - 1.6} z={rz} w={0.14} d={5.6} color={LINE} y={0.06} />);
      if (seed < 6) {
        cars.push(
          <group key={`c${ri}-${i}`} position={[x, 0, rz]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2 + (ri % 2 ? Math.PI : 0), 0]} scale={0.85}>
            <CarModel color={CAR_COLORS[(i + ri * 3) % CAR_COLORS.length]} parked />
          </group>,
        );
      }
    }
  });
  return <group>{cars}</group>;
}

function BuildingBody({ b }: { b: ParkBuilding }) {
  const company = findCompany(b.companyId);
  const color = company?.color ?? '#5b6476';
  const name = company?.name ?? b.name;
  const front = b.d / 2;
  const parts: JSX.Element[] = [];
  const signSub = b.kind === 'PLANT' ? 'Plant' : b.kind === 'COLD_STORE' ? 'Cold store' : b.kind === 'OFFICE' ? `${b.floors} floors` : b.kind.charAt(0) + b.kind.slice(1).toLowerCase().replace('_', ' ');
  switch (b.kind) {
    case 'PLANT': {
      const hallW = b.w * 0.72, hallD = b.d * 0.62;
      parts.push(<Box key="hall" p={[-b.w * 0.1, b.h / 2, front - hallD / 2 - 6]} s={[hallW, b.h, hallD]} c={C.white} />);
      parts.push(<Box key="roof" p={[-b.w * 0.1, b.h + 0.15, front - hallD / 2 - 6]} s={[hallW + 0.4, 0.3, hallD + 0.4]} c={b.companyId === 'HELIOS' ? '#2b3a67' : color} />);
      if (b.companyId === 'HELIOS') {
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) parts.push(<Box key={`pv${i}`} p={[-b.w * 0.1 - hallW / 2 + 8 + i * (hallW - 16) / 5, b.h + 0.6, front - hallD / 2 - 6]} s={[(hallW - 16) / 6.5, 0.2, hallD - 8]} c="#3554a5" shadow={false} />);
      } else {
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) parts.push(<Box key={`mon${i}`} p={[-b.w * 0.1 - hallW / 2 + 12 + i * (hallW - 24) / 3, b.h + 1.2, front - hallD / 2 - 6]} s={[6, 2, hallD - 10]} c="#e3e8f2" />);
      }
      parts.push(<Box key="band" p={[-b.w * 0.1, 2.2, front - 6 + 0.06]} s={[hallW, 4.4, 0.2]} c={color} />);
      // loading doors on the front
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) parts.push(<Box key={`dr${i}`} p={[-b.w * 0.1 - hallW / 2 + 10 + i * 9, 2.4, front - 6 + 0.2]} s={[5, 4.4, 0.12]} c={C.rollDoor} shadow={false} />);
      // annexe with stacks and tanks
      const ax = b.w / 2 - b.w * 0.14;
      parts.push(<Box key="boiler" p={[ax, b.h * 0.45, front - 18]} s={[b.w * 0.2, b.h * 0.9, 18]} c="#e9edf5" />);
      parts.push(<Stack key="s1" x={ax - 3} z={front - 26} h={b.h * 2.4} color={color} />);
      parts.push(<Stack key="s2" x={ax + 5} z={front - 26} h={b.h * 2.0} color={color} />);

      if (b.companyId === 'GREENLEAF') parts.push(<Tank key="t3" x={ax - 12} z={-b.d / 2 + 9} r={4} h={12} color={color} />);

    case 'OFFICE':

      parts.push(<Box key="canopy" p={[0, 3.6, front + 1.5]} s={[10, 0.3, 3]} c={color} />);
      const parkSvc = b.kind === 'SERVICES' && b.companyId === 'PARKAUTH';
      const medical = /clinic|medical/i.test(b.name) || parkSvc;
      const svcSub = parkSvc ? 'Clinic · Security' : /school/i.test(b.name) ? 'School' : /police/i.test(b.name) ? 'Police' : /fire/i.test(b.name) ? 'Fire & rescue' : /library/i.test(b.name) ? 'Public library' : medical ? 'Hospital · Emergency' : 'Town services';
      parts.push(<Sign key="sign" p={[0, b.h - 2.2, front + 0.2]} name={parkSvc ? 'Park Services' : b.kind === 'SERVICES' ? b.name : name} sub={b.kind === 'SERVICES' ? svcSub : b.status === 'VACANT' ? 'Office space to let' : 'Offices'} color={color} w={Math.min(22, b.w - 4)} />);

    }
    case 'RESIDENTIAL': {
      parts.push(<group key="body"><Windows w={b.w} h={b.h} d={b.d} /></group>);
      parts.push(<Box key="crown" p={[0, b.h + 0.4, 0]} s={[b.w + 0.3, 0.8, b.d + 0.3]} c="#dfe3ec" />);
      parts.push(<Box key="roofbox" p={[b.w * 0.15, b.h + 1.8, 0]} s={[b.w * 0.3, 2, b.d * 0.3]} c="#cfd5e1" />);
      parts.push(<Box key="band" p={[0, b.h - 0.6, front + 0.06]} s={[b.w, 1.2, 0.12]} c={color} shadow={false} />);
      for (let f = 1; f < Math.min(b.floors, 12); f += 2) {

  if (b.rotation === 180) {
    const backZ = b.kind === 'PLANT' ? front - 6 - b.d * 0.62 : -b.d / 2;
    const x = b.kind === 'PLANT' ? -b.w * 0.1 : 0;
    const y = b.kind === 'OFFICE' || b.kind === 'SERVICES' ? b.h - 2.2 : b.h - 3.4;
    if (b.kind !== 'PARKING' && b.kind !== 'FUEL_STATION' && b.kind !== 'TERMINAL' && b.kind !== 'RESIDENTIAL') {
      parts.push(<Sign key="backsign" p={[x, y, backZ - 0.3]} rot={Math.PI} name={name} sub={signSub} color={color} w={Math.min(22, b.w - 4)} />);
    }

  }
  return <group>{parts}</group>;
}


export function buildingDims(b: ParkBuilding): [number, number, number] {
  const h = b.kind === 'PARKING' || b.kind === 'TERMINAL' ? 3 : b.kind === 'PLANT' ? b.h + 4 : b.h + 1;
  return b.rotation === 90 || b.rotation === 270 ? [b.d, h, b.w] : [b.w, h, b.d];
}

function NeighbourBuilding({ b }: { b: ParkBuilding }) {
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'building', id: b.id });
  const rot = (b.rotation * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dims = buildingDims(b);
  return (
    <group>
      <group position={[b.x, 0, b.z]} rotation={[0, rot, 0]}>
        <BuildingBody b={b} />
      </group>
      <mesh position={[b.x, dims[1] / 2, b.z]} {...handlers} name={`building-${b.id}`}>
        <boxGeometry args={dims} />
        <meshBasicMaterial transparent opacity={0} depthWrite={false} />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- gates with barriers
function Gate({ code }: { code: GateCode }) {
  const g = PARK_GATES[code];
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'gate', id: code });
  const arm = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const lift = useRef(0);
  const west = code === 'WEST';
  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    // the barrier opens while a truck or a car is passing through
    let near = false;
    const w = getWorld();
    for (const t of Object.values(w.trucks)) {
      if (t.phase === 'away') continue;
      const p = toPark(t.facilityId, t.pos);
      if (Math.abs(p.x - g.lane.x) < 6 && Math.abs(p.z - g.lane.z) < 20) { near = true; break; }
    }
    if (!near) {
      for (const v of Object.values(w.retail?.vans ?? {})) {
        if (v.status === 'IDLE') continue;
        if (Math.abs(v.pos.x - g.lane.x) < 8 && Math.abs(v.pos.z - g.lane.z) < 18) { near = true; break; }
      }
    }
    if (!near) {
      for (const v of getPark().vehicles) {
        const p = vehicleNow(v);
        if (Math.abs(p.x - g.lane.x) < 6 && Math.abs(p.z - g.lane.z) < 18) { near = true; break; }
      }
    }
    const target = near ? 1 : 0;
    lift.current += (target - lift.current) * Math.min(1, dt * 5);
    if (arm.current) arm.current.rotation.z = (west ? -1 : 1) * lift.current * 1.35;
  });
  const boothX = g.pos.x, z = g.pos.z;
  const pivotX = west ? ART_W + ART_HALF + 0.6 : ART_E - ART_HALF - 0.6;
  return (
    <group>
      <group position={[boothX, 0, z]} {...handlers} name={`gate-${code}`}>
        <Box p={[0, 1.6, 0]} s={[4, 3.2, 5]} c={C.white} />
        <Box p={[0, 2.3, 0]} s={[4.06, 1.1, 5.06]} c={C.glass} shadow={false} />
        <Box p={[0, 3.45, 0]} s={[5.2, 0.3, 6.2]} c="#4b5563" />
        <Box p={[0, 3.9, 0]} s={[5.2, 0.6, 0.2]} c={west ? '#2f9e44' : '#e8590c'} shadow={false} />
      </group>
      <Box p={[pivotX, 0.6, z]} s={[0.7, 1.2, 0.7]} c="#4b5563" />
      <group ref={arm} position={[pivotX, 1.15, z]}>
        <Box p={[west ? -3.3 : 3.3, 0, 0]} s={[6.6, 0.22, 0.22]} c="#e03131" shadow={false} />
        {[-1, -3, -5].map((o) => <Box key={o} p={[west ? o : -o, 0, 0]} s={[0.8, 0.24, 0.24]} c="#ffffff" shadow={false} />)}
      </group>
      {/* stop line */}
      <Flat x={west ? ART_W + 3.5 : ART_E - 3.5} z={z + (west ? 3 : -3)} w={6.4} d={0.5} color={LINE} y={0.06} />
    </group>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- traffic
function Vehicle({ v }: { v: ParkVehicle }) {
  const g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'vehicle', id: v.id });
  useFrame(() => {
    const p = vehicleNow(v);
    if (!g.current) return;
    g.current.position.set(p.x, 0, p.z);
    g.current.rotation.y = -p.heading;
  });
  const company = findCompany(v.companyId);
  const accent = company?.color ?? v.color;
  return (
    <group ref={g} {...handlers} name={`vehicle-${v.id}`}>
      {v.kind === 'CAR' && <CarModel color={v.color} />}
      {v.kind === 'VAN' && <VanModel color={v.color} />}
      {v.kind === 'BUS' && <BusModel color={v.color} />}
      {(v.kind === 'TRUCK' || v.kind === 'TANKER') && <RigModel color={accent} tanker={v.kind === 'TANKER'} />}
      {v.kind === 'TAXI' && <TaxiModel color={v.color} />}
      {v.kind === 'TRACTOR' && <TractorModel color={v.color} box={['#1971c2', '#d9480f', '#2b8a3e', '#5f3dc4'][Number(v.id.slice(-1)) % 4]} />}
    </group>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the park
export function ParkScene() {
  useApp((s) => s.parkVersion);
  const park = getPark();
  return (
    <group>
      <Flat x={-200} z={0} w={2600} d={1500} color={C.ground} y={0} />
      <Lawns />
      <Roads />
      <Signs />
      <Trees />
      <Scenery />
      <People />
      <BeachProps />
      {park.buildings.filter((b) => !b.facilityId && b.kind !== 'GATEHOUSE').map((b) => <NeighbourBuilding key={b.id} b={b} />)}
      <Gate code="WEST" />
      <Gate code="EAST" />
      {park.vehicles.map((v) => <Vehicle key={v.id} v={v} />)}
      <PortScene />
    </group>
  );
}

export { HWY_X0, HWY_X1 };

// Pedestrians: people walking the sidewalks round the town and estate blocks, strolling on the
// beach promenade, standing outside the shops, and relaxing on the beach. Instanced and animated
// on the client (decoration only).
import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { SCENERY, PROMENADE, crowdSpots, loopPoint } from '../data/scenery';
import { mat } from './materials';

const SHIRTS = ['#e03131', '#1971c2', '#2f9e44', '#f08c00', '#9c36b5', '#f8f9fa', '#212529', '#0c8599', '#e64980', '#fab005', '#5c7cfa', '#868e96'];
const TROUSERS = ['#343a40', '#1c3d6e', '#495057', '#5f3dc4', '#6b4a35', '#2b2d42'];
const SKIN = ['#f1c7a5', '#d9a47c', '#a86f4c', '#7a4b2e', '#ffdbc0', '#c68b62'];
const SCALE = 1.25; // a touch larger than life so people read from the default camera height

type Walker =
  | { kind: 'loop'; loop: number; s0: number; v: number; off: number }
  | { kind: 'prom'; x0: number; span: number; v: number; z: number }
  | { kind: 'stand'; x: number; z: number; face: number };

function rnd(seed: number) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => ((s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0) / 4294967296);
}

function usePeople() {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const r = rnd(2026);
    const people: { w: Walker; shirt: string; legs: string; skin: string; phase: number }[] = [];
    const add = (w: Walker) => people.push({
      w, shirt: SHIRTS[Math.floor(r() * SHIRTS.length)], legs: TROUSERS[Math.floor(r() * TROUSERS.length)],
      skin: SKIN[Math.floor(r() * SKIN.length)], phase: r() * 10,
    });
    SCENERY.loops.forEach((l, i) => {
      const n = Math.round(l.length / 45);
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) add({ kind: 'loop', loop: i, s0: r() * l.length, v: (1.1 + r() * 0.6) * (r() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1), off: (r() - 0.5) * 1.8 });
    });
    for (let k = 0; k < 60; k++) {
      const span = 60 + r() * 220;
      add({ kind: 'prom', x0: PROMENADE.x0 + r() * (PROMENADE.x1 - PROMENADE.x0 - span), span, v: 0.9 + r() * 0.6, z: PROMENADE.z + (r() - 0.5) * 2.4 });
    }
    for (const [x, z] of crowdSpots()) {
      const n = 1 + Math.floor(r() * 3);
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) add({ kind: 'stand', x: x + (r() - 0.5) * 6, z: z + (r() - 0.5) * 3, face: r() * Math.PI * 2 });
    }
    // on the sand
    for (let k = 0; k < 70; k++) {
      add({ kind: 'stand', x: PROMENADE.x0 + 20 + r() * (PROMENADE.x1 - PROMENADE.x0 - 40), z: PROMENADE.beachZ0 + r() * (PROMENADE.beachZ1 - PROMENADE.beachZ0), face: r() * Math.PI * 2 });
    }
    return people;
  }, []);
}

const _m = new THREE.Matrix4();
const _q = new THREE.Quaternion();
const _e = new THREE.Euler();
const _v = new THREE.Vector3();
const _s = new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1);
const _c = new THREE.Color();

export function People() {
  const people = usePeople();
  const torso = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const head = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const legL = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const legR = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const geos = useMemo(() => ({
    torso: new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.55, 0.72, 0.32).translate(0, 1.23, 0),
    head: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.2, 10, 8).translate(0, 1.82, 0),
    leg: new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.2, 0.86, 0.22).translate(0, -0.43, 0), // pivot at the hip
  }), []);
  const white = mat('#ffffff');
  const coloured = useRef(false);

  useFrame(({ clock }) => {
    const t = clock.elapsedTime;
    const parts = [torso.current, head.current, legL.current, legR.current];
    if (parts.some((p) => !p)) return;
    const [T, H, L, R] = parts as THREE.InstancedMesh[];
    people.forEach((p, i) => {
      let x: number, z: number, face: number, moving = true;
      const w = p.w;
      if (w.kind === 'loop') {
        const l = SCENERY.loops[w.loop];
        const pt = loopPoint(l, w.s0 + w.v * t);
        const dx = pt.dx * Math.sign(w.v), dz = pt.dz * Math.sign(w.v);
        x = pt.x + pt.dz * w.off;
        z = pt.z - pt.dx * w.off;
        face = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
      } else if (w.kind === 'prom') {
        const u = (w.v * t + p.phase * 20) % (2 * w.span);
        const back = u > w.span;
        x = w.x0 + (back ? 2 * w.span - u : u);
        z = w.z;
        face = back ? -Math.PI / 2 : Math.PI / 2;
      } else {
        x = w.x; z = w.z; face = w.face + Math.sin(t * 0.3 + p.phase) * 0.4; moving = false;
      }
      const swing = moving ? Math.sin(t * 7 + p.phase) * 0.45 : 0;
      const bob = moving ? Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 7 + p.phase)) * 0.05 : 0;
      _e.set(0, face, 0); _q.setFromEuler(_e);
      _m.compose(_v.set(x, bob, z), _q, _s.set(SCALE, SCALE, SCALE));
      T.setMatrixAt(i, _m); H.setMatrixAt(i, _m);
      // legs hang from the hip (0.87 m) and swing in opposite directions
      const hip = 0.87 * SCALE;
      const ox = Math.cos(face) * 0.13 * SCALE, oz = -Math.sin(face) * 0.13 * SCALE;
      _e.set(swing, face, 0, 'YXZ'); _q.setFromEuler(_e);
      _m.compose(_v.set(x - ox, hip + bob, z - oz), _q, _s);
      L.setMatrixAt(i, _m);
      _e.set(-swing, face, 0, 'YXZ'); _q.setFromEuler(_e);
      _m.compose(_v.set(x + ox, hip + bob, z + oz), _q, _s);
      R.setMatrixAt(i, _m);
      _e.order = 'XYZ';
    });
    for (const m of [T, H, L, R]) m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    if (!coloured.current) {
      people.forEach((p, i) => {
        T.setColorAt(i, _c.set(p.shirt)); H.setColorAt(i, _c.set(p.skin));
        L.setColorAt(i, _c.set(p.legs)); R.setColorAt(i, _c.set(p.legs));
      });
      for (const m of [T, H, L, R]) { if (m.instanceColor) m.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true; m.computeBoundingSphere(); }
      coloured.current = true;
    }
  });

  const n = people.length;
  return (
    <group>
      <instancedMesh ref={torso} args={[geos.torso, white, n]} castShadow frustumCulled={false} />
      <instancedMesh ref={head} args={[geos.head, white, n]} frustumCulled={false} />
      <instancedMesh ref={legL} args={[geos.leg, white, n]} frustumCulled={false} />
      <instancedMesh ref={legR} args={[geos.leg, white, n]} frustumCulled={false} />
    </group>
  );
}

/** Beach umbrellas and towels (static). */
export function BeachProps() {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const pole = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const towel = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const spots = useMemo(() => {
    const r = rnd(77);
    const out: [number, number, string][] = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < 90; k++) out.push([PROMENADE.x0 + 30 + r() * (PROMENADE.x1 - PROMENADE.x0 - 60), PROMENADE.beachZ0 + 2 + r() * (PROMENADE.beachZ1 - PROMENADE.beachZ0 - 4), SHIRTS[Math.floor(r() * SHIRTS.length)]]);
    return out;
  }, []);
  const geos = useMemo(() => ({
    canopy: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.8, 0.9, 10).translate(0, 2.7, 0),
    pole: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 2.7, 6).translate(0, 1.35, 0),
    towel: new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.0, 0.03, 2.0).translate(1.4, 0.03, 0.6),
  }), []);
  const white = mat('#ffffff');
  const set = () => {
    const [a, b, c] = [ref.current, pole.current, towel.current];
    if (!a || !b || !c) return;
    spots.forEach(([x, z, col], i) => {
      _m.makeTranslation(x, 0, z);
      a.setMatrixAt(i, _m); b.setMatrixAt(i, _m); c.setMatrixAt(i, _m);
      a.setColorAt(i, _c.set(col)); c.setColorAt(i, _c.set(SHIRTS[(i * 5) % SHIRTS.length]));
    });
    for (const m of [a, b, c]) { m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; if (m.instanceColor) m.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true; m.computeBoundingSphere(); }
  };
  return (
    <group ref={() => set()}>
      <instancedMesh ref={ref} args={[geos.canopy, white, spots.length]} castShadow />
      <instancedMesh ref={pole} args={[geos.pole, mat('#e9ecef'), spots.length]} />
      <instancedMesh ref={towel} args={[geos.towel, white, spots.length]} />
    </group>
  );
}

// The working container terminal (quay, cranes, stacks, ships) and the town's
// delivery vans. Everything moving here is read from WorldState.port / .retail,
// which the server simulates and stores in Oracle.
import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { getWorld, useApp } from '../store';
import {
  TERMINAL, QUAY_Z, MOOR_Z, SHIP_LENGTH, SHIP_BEAM, YARD_BLOCKS, YARD_CAPACITY, yardSlot, CRANE_DEFS, BERTH_DEFS, CRANE_CYCLE_S,
  storeBuilding,
} from '../data/city';
import { PORT_IN_X, PORT_OUT_X, PORT_GATE_Z, PORT_AISLE_IN_Z, PORT_AISLE_OUT_Z, HWY_Z, HWY_HALF } from '../data/park';
import { C, mat, containerTexture, companySign, groundText } from './materials';
import { Box } from './models';
import { useSelectHandlers, follow } from './Dynamic';

type V3 = [number, number, number];
const BOX_COLORS = ['#d9480f', '#1971c2', '#2b8a3e', '#e67700', '#5f3dc4', '#1d3557', '#c92a2a', '#0b7285', '#f08c00', '#495057'];
export const boxColor = (no: string): string => {
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < no.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + no.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return BOX_COLORS[h % BOX_COLORS.length];
};

function Flat({ x, z, w, d, color, y = 0.02 }: { x: number; z: number; w: number; d: number; color: string; y?: number }) {
  return (
    <mesh position={[x, y, z]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} receiveShadow material={mat(color, { rough: 1 })}>
      <planeGeometry args={[w, d]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function useBoxMaterial(): THREE.MeshStandardMaterial {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const t = containerTexture('#ffffff').clone();
    t.repeat.set(3, 1);
    t.needsUpdate = true;
    return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: t, roughness: 0.8 });
  }, []);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- stacks
function YardStacks() {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const material = useBoxMaterial();
  const sig = useRef('');
  useFrame(() => {
    const m = ref.current;
    const P = getWorld().port;
    if (!m || !P) return;
    const key = `${P.importStack.length}:${P.importStack[0] ?? ''}:${P.exportStack.length}:${P.exportStack[0] ?? ''}`;
    if (key === sig.current) return;
    sig.current = key;
    const mtx = new THREE.Matrix4();
    const col = new THREE.Color();
    let n = 0;
    const put = (block: 'IMPORT' | 'EXPORT', list: string[]) => {
      list.slice(0, YARD_CAPACITY).forEach((no, i) => {
        const p = yardSlot(block, i);
        mtx.makeTranslation(p.x, p.y, p.z);
        m.setMatrixAt(n, mtx);
        m.setColorAt(n, col.set(boxColor(no)));
        n++;
      });
    };
    put('IMPORT', P.importStack);
    put('EXPORT', P.exportStack);
    m.count = n;
    m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    if (m.instanceColor) m.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
  });
  return (
    <instancedMesh ref={ref} args={[undefined, undefined, YARD_CAPACITY * 2]} castShadow receiveShadow material={material} frustumCulled={false}>
      <boxGeometry args={[12, 2.6, 2.6]} />
    </instancedMesh>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- ships
function hullGeometry(): THREE.ExtrudeGeometry {
  const L = SHIP_LENGTH / 2, B = SHIP_BEAM / 2;
  const s = new THREE.Shape();
  s.moveTo(-L, -B);
  s.lineTo(L - 12, -B);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(L, -B * 0.6, L + 1, 0);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(L, B * 0.6, L - 12, B);
  s.lineTo(-L, B);
  s.lineTo(-L, -B);
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 5.2, bevelEnabled: false });
  g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  g.translate(0, -1.6, 0);
  return g;
}

const DECK_BAYS = 5;
const DECK_ROWS = 4;
const deckSlot = (i: number): V3 => {
  const bay = i % DECK_BAYS;
  const row = Math.floor(i / DECK_BAYS) % DECK_ROWS;
  const tier = Math.floor(i / (DECK_BAYS * DECK_ROWS));
  return [-20 + bay * 12.6, 4.9 + tier * 2.6, -4.5 + row * 3];
};

function Ship({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const boxes = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const init = useRef({ done: false });
  const shown = useRef(-1);
  const v0 = getWorld().port.vessels[id];
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'vessel', id });
  const hull = useMemo(() => hullGeometry(), []);
  const material = useBoxMaterial();
  const nameTex = useMemo(() => companySign(v0?.name ?? id, v0?.line ?? '', v0?.color ?? '#1d3557'), [v0?.name, v0?.line, v0?.color, id]);
  const nameMat = useMemo(() => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: nameTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }), [nameTex]);
  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const v = getWorld().port.vessels[id];
    if (!g.current || !v) return;
    g.current.visible = v.status !== 'AT_SEA';
    follow(g.current, v.pos.x, v.pos.z, v.heading, dt, init.current);
    const aboard = Math.min(v.capacity, v.through + v.importBoxes + v.exportBoxes);
    if (boxes.current && aboard !== shown.current) {
      shown.current = aboard;
      const m = boxes.current;
      const mtx = new THREE.Matrix4();
      const col = new THREE.Color();
      for (let i = 0; i < aboard; i++) {
        const p = deckSlot(i);
        mtx.makeTranslation(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
        m.setMatrixAt(i, mtx);
        m.setColorAt(i, col.set(BOX_COLORS[(i * 7 + id.charCodeAt(5)) % BOX_COLORS.length]));
      }
      m.count = aboard;
      m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      if (m.instanceColor) m.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  });
  if (!v0) return null;
  const L = SHIP_LENGTH / 2;
  return (
    <group ref={g} {...handlers} name={`vessel-${id}`}>
      <mesh geometry={hull} castShadow receiveShadow material={mat(v0.color, { rough: 0.6 })} />
      {/* waterline stripe and deck */}
      <Box p={[-1, -0.9, 0]} s={[SHIP_LENGTH - 4, 1.2, SHIP_BEAM + 0.08]} c="#a61e1e" shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[-2, 3.62, 0]} s={[SHIP_LENGTH - 12, 0.12, SHIP_BEAM - 1]} c="#c7ced9" shadow={false} />
      {/* accommodation block and bridge at the stern */}
      <Box p={[-L + 6, 8.2, 0]} s={[7, 9, SHIP_BEAM - 2]} c={C.white} />
      <Box p={[-L + 6, 12.9, 0]} s={[8, 1.4, SHIP_BEAM + 2]} c={C.white} />
      <Box p={[-L + 9.55, 11.4, 0]} s={[0.1, 1.2, SHIP_BEAM - 2.5]} c={C.glass} shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[-L + 2, 12, 0]} s={[3, 6, 3]} c={v0.color} />
      <Box p={[-L + 2, 15.2, 0]} s={[3.1, 0.6, 3.1]} c="#1b1f29" shadow={false} />
      {/* name on both sides of the bow */}
      <mesh position={[L - 16, 1.4, SHIP_BEAM / 2 + 0.06]} material={nameMat}><planeGeometry args={[14, 3.5]} /></mesh>
      <mesh position={[L - 16, 1.4, -SHIP_BEAM / 2 - 0.06]} rotation={[0, Math.PI, 0]} material={nameMat}><planeGeometry args={[14, 3.5]} /></mesh>
      <instancedMesh ref={boxes} args={[undefined, undefined, 60]} castShadow material={material} frustumCulled={false}>
        <boxGeometry args={[12, 2.6, 2.6]} />
      </instancedMesh>
    </group>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- quay cranes
/** Spreader path for one move: down to the pick side, up, across, down to the drop side, back. */
const KEYS: [number, 'P' | 'D', number][] = [[0, 'P', 1], [0.15, 'P', 0], [0.25, 'P', 0], [0.38, 'P', 1], [0.5, 'D', 1], [0.6, 'D', 0], [0.65, 'D', 0], [0.78, 'D', 1], [1, 'P', 1]];
function spreader(cycle: number): { side: number; low: number } {
  for (let i = 1; i < KEYS.length; i++) {
    const [t1, s1, h1] = KEYS[i];
    const [t0, s0, h0] = KEYS[i - 1];
    if (cycle <= t1) {
      const k = (cycle - t0) / (t1 - t0 || 1);
      const a = s0 === 'P' ? 0 : 1, b = s1 === 'P' ? 0 : 1;
      return { side: a + (b - a) * k, low: 1 - (h0 + (h1 - h0) * k) };
    }
  }
  return { side: 0, low: 0 };
}

function Crane({ id, berthX, offset }: { id: string; berthX: number; offset: number }) {
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'crane', id });
  const trolley = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const hoist = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const cargo = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const cable = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const local = useRef(0);
  const boxMat = useBoxMaterial();
  const H = 26; // boom height
  const zApron = QUAY_Z - 6.5;
  const zShip = MOOR_Z;
  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const c = getWorld().port?.cranes[id];
    if (!c) return;
    const { control } = useApp.getState();
    const rate = control.paused ? 0 : control.speed;
    let cyc = local.current;
    if (c.phase === 'idle') cyc = 0;
    else {
      cyc = (cyc + (dt * rate) / CRANE_CYCLE_S) % 1;
      let diff = c.cycle - cyc;
      if (diff > 0.5) diff -= 1;
      if (diff < -0.5) diff += 1;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 0.2) cyc = c.cycle; // resync with the server
    }
    local.current = cyc;
    const discharge = c.phase === 'discharge';
    const s = spreader(cyc);
    // P = pick side: the ship when discharging, the apron when loading
    const pickZ = discharge ? zShip : zApron, dropZ = discharge ? zApron : zShip;
    const z = pickZ + (dropZ - pickZ) * s.side;
    const lowY = (z > QUAY_Z ? 7 : 3.2);
    const y = H - 2 - (H - 2 - lowY) * s.low;
    if (trolley.current) trolley.current.position.z = z;
    if (hoist.current) hoist.current.position.y = y;
    if (cable.current) {
      const len = H - 1 - y;
      cable.current.scale.y = Math.max(0.1, len);
      cable.current.position.y = y + len / 2;
    }
    if (cargo.current) cargo.current.visible = c.phase !== 'idle' && cyc > 0.25 && cyc < 0.65;
  });
  const x = berthX + offset;
  const legs: V3[] = [[-6, 0, QUAY_Z - 12], [6, 0, QUAY_Z - 12], [-6, 0, QUAY_Z - 1.5], [6, 0, QUAY_Z - 1.5]];
  return (
    <group position={[x, 0, 0]} {...handlers} name={`crane-${id}`}>
      {legs.map((p, i) => <Box key={i} p={[p[0], 11, p[2]]} s={[0.9, 22, 0.9]} c="#e03131" />)}
      <Box p={[0, 1, QUAY_Z - 12]} s={[13, 1.2, 1.2]} c="#c92a2a" />
      <Box p={[0, 1, QUAY_Z - 1.5]} s={[13, 1.2, 1.2]} c="#c92a2a" />
      <Box p={[0, 21.5, QUAY_Z - 6.75]} s={[13, 1.2, 12]} c="#c92a2a" />
      {/* machinery house and the boom reaching over the ship */}
      <Box p={[0, 24.2, QUAY_Z - 16]} s={[6, 4, 8]} c="#f1f3f7" />
      <Box p={[-2.2, H, QUAY_Z + 4]} s={[0.8, 1.2, 46]} c="#e03131" />
      <Box p={[2.2, H, QUAY_Z + 4]} s={[0.8, 1.2, 46]} c="#e03131" />
      <Box p={[0, 30, QUAY_Z - 10]} s={[0.6, 8, 0.6]} c="#e03131" />
      <group ref={trolley} position={[0, 0, zApron]}>
        <Box p={[0, H - 0.6, 0]} s={[3, 1.2, 5.4]} c="#343a40" />
        <mesh ref={cable} position={[0, H - 4, 0]} material={mat('#343a40')}><boxGeometry args={[0.12, 1, 0.12]} /></mesh>
        <group ref={hoist} position={[0, H - 6, 0]}>
          <Box p={[0, 1.6, 0]} s={[12.2, 0.4, 2.8]} c="#f6b818" />
          <mesh ref={cargo} position={[0, 0, 0]} castShadow material={boxMat}>
            <boxGeometry args={[12, 2.6, 2.6]} />
          </mesh>
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- delivery vans
function VanBody({ box }: { box: boolean }) {
  return box ? (
    <group>
      <Box p={[-0.9, 2.1, 0]} s={[6.4, 3.4, 2.5]} c={C.white} />
      <Box p={[-0.9, 1.0, 0]} s={[6.42, 0.5, 2.52]} c={C.blue} shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[3.2, 1.6, 0]} s={[1.9, 2.4, 2.4]} c={C.blue} />
      <Box p={[4.16, 2.1, 0]} s={[0.05, 1.0, 2.1]} c={C.glass} shadow={false} />
      {[3.2, -2.4, -3.5].map((x) => (
        <group key={x}>
          <mesh position={[x, 0.45, 1.15]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} material={mat(C.tire)}><cylinderGeometry args={[0.45, 0.45, 0.3, 12]} /></mesh>
          <mesh position={[x, 0.45, -1.15]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} material={mat(C.tire)}><cylinderGeometry args={[0.45, 0.45, 0.3, 12]} /></mesh>
        </group>
      ))}
    </group>
  ) : (
    <group>
      <Box p={[-0.4, 1.45, 0]} s={[4.6, 2.3, 2.1]} c={C.white} />
      <Box p={[-0.4, 1.0, 0]} s={[4.62, 0.4, 2.12]} c={C.blue} shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[2.25, 1.0, 0]} s={[1.1, 1.4, 2.0]} c={C.blue} />
      <Box p={[2.0, 1.85, 0]} s={[0.05, 0.8, 1.8]} c={C.glass} shadow={false} />
      {[[1.8, 1.0], [1.8, -1.0], [-1.7, 1.0], [-1.7, -1.0]].map(([x, z]) => (
        <mesh key={`${x}${z}`} position={[x, 0.4, z]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} material={mat(C.tire)}><cylinderGeometry args={[0.4, 0.4, 0.28, 10]} /></mesh>
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}

function Van({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const init = useRef({ done: false });
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'van', id });
  const v0 = getWorld().retail?.vans[id];
  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const v = getWorld().retail?.vans[id];
    if (!g.current || !v) return;
    g.current.visible = v.status !== 'IDLE';
    follow(g.current, v.pos.x, v.pos.z, v.heading, dt, init.current);
  });
  if (!v0) return null;
  return <group ref={g} {...handlers} name={`van-${id}`}><VanBody box={v0.kind === 'BOX_TRUCK'} /></group>;
}

/** Pallet stack on the pavement while a van unloads at a store. */
function UnloadingPallets() {
  const g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  useFrame(() => {
    const R = getWorld().retail;
    if (!g.current || !R) return;
    let i = 0;
    for (const v of Object.values(R.vans)) {
      const child = g.current.children[i++];
      if (!child) break;
      const b = v.storeId ? storeBuilding(v.storeId) : undefined;
      child.visible = v.status === 'UNLOADING' && !!b;
      if (child.visible && b) child.position.set(v.pos.x - Math.cos(v.heading) * 4, 0, v.pos.z - Math.sin(v.heading) * 4 + (b.rotation === 0 ? -2.5 : 2.5));
    }
  });
  const n = Object.keys(getWorld().retail?.vans ?? {}).length;
  return (
    <group ref={g}>
      {Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => (
        <group key={i} visible={false}>
          <Box p={[0, 0.15, 0]} s={[1.6, 0.3, 1.6]} c={C.wood} shadow={false} />
          <Box p={[0, 0.85, 0]} s={[1.4, 1.1, 1.4]} c={C.cardboard} />
        </group>
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the whole port + delivery traffic
export function PortScene() {
  useApp((s) => s.ready);
  const w = getWorld();
  const vessels = Object.keys(w.port?.vessels ?? {});
  const vans = Object.keys(w.retail?.vans ?? {});
  return (
    <group>
      <TerminalGround />
      <YardStacks />
      {CRANE_DEFS.map((c) => <Crane key={c.id} id={c.id} berthX={BERTH_DEFS.find((b) => b.id === c.berthId)!.x} offset={c.offset} />)}
      {vessels.map((id) => <Ship key={id} id={id} />)}
      {vans.map((id) => <Van key={id} id={id} />)}
      <UnloadingPallets />
    </group>
  );
}

export const SHIP_DIMS: [number, number, number] = [SHIP_LENGTH + 2, 16, SHIP_BEAM + 1];
export const CRANE_DIMS: [number, number, number] = [14, 30, 14];
export const VAN_DIMS = { VAN: [5.8, 2.7, 2.2] as [number, number, number], BOX_TRUCK: [8.6, 4, 2.6] as [number, number, number] };
