// Isometric 3D warehouse scene (React Three Fiber).
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Canvas, useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { MapControls } from 'three/examples/jsm/controls/MapControls.js';
import type { FacilityId, Vec2 } from '../data/types';
import { LAYOUTS } from '../data/layouts';
import { getWorld, useApp } from '../store';
import { entityWorldPos, entityLocalPos, findAsset, palletsOfSku } from '../ui/derive';
import { FACILITY_OFFSET, PARK_BOUNDS, toPark } from '../data/park';
import { findBuilding, findVehicle, vehicleNow } from '../data/parkClient';
import { ParkScene, VEHICLE_DIMS, buildingDims, OVERVIEW_TARGET } from './Park';
import { SHIP_DIMS, CRANE_DIMS, VAN_DIMS } from './Port';
import { storeBuilding } from '../data/city';
import { remainingPts, legYardIn, legReverseIn } from '../sim/paths';
import { cachedLength } from '../sim/engine';
import { Site } from './Site';
import { Dynamic, useSelectHandlers } from './Dynamic';
import { Pin } from './models';
import { glowTexture } from './materials';
import { anchors, labelSpecs } from './labels';

const POLAR = (54 * Math.PI) / 180; // angle from vertical (isometric-style)
const RADIUS = 900;

function CameraRig({ facilityId }: { facilityId: FacilityId }) {
  const { camera, gl, size } = useThree();
  const cam = camera as THREE.OrthographicCamera;
  const controls = useMemo(() => {
    const c = new MapControls(cam, gl.domElement);
    c.enableDamping = true;
    c.dampingFactor = 0.14;
    c.screenSpacePanning = false;
    c.minPolarAngle = POLAR;
    c.maxPolarAngle = POLAR;
    c.zoomToCursor = true;
    c.rotateSpeed = 0.6;
    return c;
  }, [cam, gl]);
  useEffect(() => () => controls.dispose(), [controls]);

  const anim = useRef<null | { t: number; dur: number; from: { tx: number; tz: number; az: number; zoom: number }; to: { tx: number; tz: number; az: number; zoom: number } }>(null);
  const followPrev = useRef<Vec2 | null>(null);

  const homeZoom = (fac: FacilityId = facilityId) => size.width / LAYOUTS[fac].camera.span;
  /** Zoom at which the whole park fits on screen. */
  const overviewZoom = () => {
    const dx = PARK_BOUNDS.x1 - PARK_BOUNDS.x0, dz = PARK_BOUNDS.z1 - PARK_BOUNDS.z0;
    const across = (dx + dz) / Math.SQRT2;
    return Math.min(size.width / (across * 1.02), size.height / (across * Math.cos(POLAR) * 1.12));
  };
  const homeOf = (fac: FacilityId) => {
    const L = LAYOUTS[fac];
    const p = toPark(fac, { x: L.camera.x, z: L.camera.z });
    return { tx: p.x, tz: p.z, az: Math.PI / 4, zoom: homeZoom(fac) };
  };
  const overview = () => ({ tx: OVERVIEW_TARGET.x, tz: OVERVIEW_TARGET.z, az: Math.PI / 4, zoom: overviewZoom() });
  controls.minZoom = overviewZoom() * 0.8;
  controls.maxZoom = homeZoom() * 5;

  const azimuth = () => Math.atan2(cam.position.x - controls.target.x, cam.position.z - controls.target.z);
  const setPose = (tx: number, tz: number, az: number, zoom: number) => {
    const r = RADIUS;
    controls.target.set(tx, 0, tz);
    cam.position.set(tx + Math.sin(az) * Math.sin(POLAR) * r, Math.cos(POLAR) * r, tz + Math.cos(az) * Math.sin(POLAR) * r);
    cam.zoom = zoom;
    cam.lookAt(controls.target);
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  };
  const animateTo = (to: { tx?: number; tz?: number; az?: number; zoom?: number }, dur = 0.6) => {
    const from = { tx: controls.target.x, tz: controls.target.z, az: azimuth(), zoom: cam.zoom };
    anim.current = {
      t: 0,
      dur,
      from,
      to: { tx: to.tx ?? from.tx, tz: to.tz ?? from.tz, az: to.az ?? from.az, zoom: Math.min(controls.maxZoom, Math.max(controls.minZoom, to.zoom ?? from.zoom)) },
    };
  };

  // first view: the whole park; later facility changes fly to the site
  const first = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    anim.current = null;
    if (first.current) {
      first.current = false;
      const start = useApp.getState().startView === 'site' ? homeOf(facilityId) : overview();
      setPose(start.tx, start.tz, start.az, start.zoom);
    } else {
      animateTo(homeOf(facilityId), 0.9);
    }
    controls.update();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [facilityId]);

  // stop follow / animation when the user drags
  useEffect(() => {
    const onStart = () => {
      anim.current = null;
      if (useApp.getState().follow) useApp.getState().toggleFollow();
    };
    controls.addEventListener('start', onStart);
    return () => controls.removeEventListener('start', onStart);
  }, [controls]);

  // camera commands from the UI
  const cmd = useApp((s) => s.cameraCmd);
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = cmd.cmd;
    if (!c) return;
    switch (c.kind) {
      case 'zoomIn': animateTo({ zoom: cam.zoom * 1.35 }); break;
      case 'zoomOut': animateTo({ zoom: cam.zoom / 1.35 }); break;
      case 'rotateLeft': animateTo({ az: azimuth() - Math.PI / 4 }); break;
      case 'rotateRight': animateTo({ az: azimuth() + Math.PI / 4 }); break;
      case 'home': animateTo(homeOf(facilityId)); break;
      case 'overview': animateTo(overview(), 0.9); break;
      case 'focus': {
        const p = entityWorldPos(getWorld(), c.ref);
        if (!p) break;
        if (c.ref.kind === 'building' || c.ref.kind === 'store' || c.ref.kind === 'vessel' || c.ref.kind === 'berth') {
          // frame the whole building / ship rather than zooming into one wall
          const b = c.ref.kind === 'store' ? storeBuilding(c.ref.id) : c.ref.kind === 'building' ? findBuilding(c.ref.id) : undefined;
          const span = b ? Math.max(b.w, b.d, 30) * 3.2 : c.ref.kind === 'vessel' || c.ref.kind === 'berth' ? 260 : 200;
          animateTo({ tx: p.x, tz: p.z, zoom: size.width / span }, 0.8);
        } else {
          const park = c.ref.kind === 'vehicle' || c.ref.kind === 'gate' || c.ref.kind === 'van' || c.ref.kind === 'crane';
          animateTo({ tx: p.x, tz: p.z, zoom: Math.max(cam.zoom, homeZoom() * (park ? 1.1 : 1.6)) }, 0.8);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [cmd.seq]);

  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const a = anim.current;
    if (a) {
      a.t = Math.min(1, a.t + dt / a.dur);
      const e = a.t < 0.5 ? 2 * a.t * a.t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * a.t + 2, 2) / 2;
      let daz = a.to.az - a.from.az;
      while (daz > Math.PI) daz -= Math.PI * 2;
      while (daz < -Math.PI) daz += Math.PI * 2;
      setPose(
        a.from.tx + (a.to.tx - a.from.tx) * e,
        a.from.tz + (a.to.tz - a.from.tz) * e,
        a.from.az + daz * e,
        a.from.zoom + (a.to.zoom - a.from.zoom) * e,
      );
      if (a.t >= 1) anim.current = null;
    } else {
      const s = useApp.getState();
      if (s.follow && s.selection) {
        const p = entityWorldPos(getWorld(), s.selection);
        if (p) {
          const prev = followPrev.current;
          if (prev) {
            const dx = p.x - prev.x, dz = p.z - prev.z;
            controls.target.x += dx; controls.target.z += dz;
            cam.position.x += dx; cam.position.z += dz;
          }
          followPrev.current = { x: p.x, z: p.z };
        }
      } else followPrev.current = null;
    }
    controls.update();
  });
  return <ShadowLight target={controls.target} />;
}

function ShadowLight({ target }: { target: THREE.Vector3 }) {
  const light = useRef<THREE.DirectionalLight>(null);
  const { scene, camera, size } = useThree();
  const half = useRef(120);
  useEffect(() => {
    const l = light.current;
    if (!l) return;
    scene.add(l.target);
    return () => { scene.remove(l.target); };
  }, [scene]);
  useFrame(() => {
    const l = light.current;
    if (!l) return;
    l.position.set(target.x + 120, 220, target.z + 90);
    l.target.position.set(target.x, 0, target.z);
    l.target.updateMatrixWorld();
    // keep the shadowed area matched to what is on screen (whole park when zoomed out)
    const visible = size.width / (camera as THREE.OrthographicCamera).zoom;
    const want = Math.max(120, Math.min(900, visible * 0.75));
    if (Math.abs(want - half.current) / half.current > 0.15) {
      half.current = want;
      const sc = l.shadow.camera;
      sc.left = -want; sc.right = want; sc.top = want; sc.bottom = -want; sc.far = 900;
      sc.updateProjectionMatrix();
    }
  });
  return (
    <directionalLight
      ref={light}
      intensity={1.85}
      castShadow
      shadow-mapSize={[2048, 2048]}
      shadow-bias={-0.0004}
      shadow-normalBias={0.04}
      shadow-camera-left={-120}
      shadow-camera-right={120}
      shadow-camera-top={120}
      shadow-camera-bottom={-120}
      shadow-camera-near={1}
      shadow-camera-far={900}
    />
  );
}

const DIMS: Record<string, [number, number, number]> = {
  truck: [12.8, 5.0, 3.3],
  forklift: [5.4, 4.2, 2.6],
  pallet: [2.4, 2.6, 2.4],
  dock: [4.9, 0.4, 13.4],
  charger: [3.6, 1.9, 4.0],
};

function RouteRibbon({ truckId }: { truckId: string }) {
  const tick = useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const data = useMemo(() => {
    const t = getWorld().trucks[truckId];
    if (!t || t.phase === 'away' || t.phase === 'working' || t.phase === 'ready') return null;
    let pts: Vec2[] = [];
    t.legs.forEach((leg, i) => {
      if (i < t.legIdx) return;
      const part = i === t.legIdx ? remainingPts(leg.pts, t.legDist) : leg.pts;
      pts = pts.concat(part);
    });
    if ((t.phase === 'en_route' || t.phase === 'at_gate') && t.dockId) {
      pts = pts.concat(legYardIn(t.facilityId, t.dockId).pts, legReverseIn(t.facilityId, t.dockId).pts);
    }
    if (pts.length < 2 || cachedLength(pts) < 1) return null;
    const pos: number[] = [];
    const idx: number[] = [];
    const half = 0.7;
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
      const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)];
      const dx = b.x - a.x, dz = b.z - a.z;
      const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      const nx = -dz / l, nz = dx / l;
      pos.push(pts[i].x + nx * half, 0.09, pts[i].z + nz * half, pts[i].x - nx * half, 0.09, pts[i].z - nz * half);
      if (i > 0) { const k = i * 2; idx.push(k - 2, k - 1, k, k - 1, k + 1, k); }
    }
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    g.setIndex(idx);
    return { g, end: pts[pts.length - 1] };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [truckId, tick]);
  useEffect(() => () => data?.g.dispose(), [data]);
  if (!data) return null;
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={data.g} renderOrder={2}>
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#2f62e0" transparent opacity={0.85} depthWrite={false} side={THREE.DoubleSide} />
      </mesh>
      <group position={[data.end.x, 0, data.end.z]}><Pin y={0.2} /></group>
    </group>
  );
}

function SiteFrame({ truckId }: { truckId: string }) {
  const fac = getWorld().trucks[truckId]?.facilityId;
  if (!fac) return null;
  const o = FACILITY_OFFSET[fac];
  return <group position={[o.x, 0, o.z]}><RouteRibbon truckId={truckId} /></group>;
}

function dimsFor(ref: { kind: string; id: string } | null): [number, number, number] | null {
  if (!ref || ref.kind === 'facility') return null;
  if (ref.kind === 'asset') return findAsset(ref.id)?.size ?? null;
  if (ref.kind === 'building') { const b = findBuilding(ref.id); return b ? buildingDims(b) : null; }
  if (ref.kind === 'vehicle') { const v = findVehicle(ref.id); return v ? VEHICLE_DIMS[v.kind] : null; }
  if (ref.kind === 'gate') return [5, 4.5, 6];
  if (ref.kind === 'vessel') return SHIP_DIMS;
  if (ref.kind === 'crane') return CRANE_DIMS;
  if (ref.kind === 'berth') return [90, 2, 16];
  if (ref.kind === 'store') { const b = storeBuilding(ref.id); return b ? buildingDims(b) : null; }
  if (ref.kind === 'van') { const v = getWorld().retail?.vans[ref.id]; return v ? VAN_DIMS[v.kind] : null; }
  return DIMS[ref.kind] ?? null;
}

/** Where to draw selection / hover boxes (park coordinates; docks sit on their pad). */
function fxPos(ref: { kind: string; id: string }): { x: number; z: number } | null {
  if (ref.kind === 'dock') {
    const l = entityLocalPos(getWorld(), ref as never);
    return l && l.fac ? toPark(l.fac, { x: l.p.x, z: 7.4 }) : null;
  }
  return entityWorldPos(getWorld(), ref as never);
}

function headingOf(ref: { kind: string; id: string }): number {
  const w = getWorld();
  if (ref.kind === 'truck') return w.trucks[ref.id]?.heading ?? 0;
  if (ref.kind === 'forklift') return w.forklifts[ref.id]?.heading ?? 0;
  if (ref.kind === 'asset') return -(findAsset(ref.id)?.rotation ?? 0);
  if (ref.kind === 'vehicle') { const v = findVehicle(ref.id); return v ? vehicleNow(v).heading : 0; }
  if (ref.kind === 'vessel') return w.port?.vessels[ref.id]?.heading ?? 0;
  if (ref.kind === 'van') return w.retail?.vans[ref.id]?.heading ?? 0;
  return 0;
}

/** Light outline on whatever the pointer is over (when it isn't already selected). */
function HoverFx() {
  const hovered = useApp((s) => s.hovered);
  const sel = useApp((s) => s.selection);
  const g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const same = hovered && sel && hovered.kind === sel.kind && hovered.id === sel.id;
  const dims = same ? null : dimsFor(hovered);
  const edges = useMemo(() => (dims ? new THREE.EdgesGeometry(new THREE.BoxGeometry(...dims)) : null), [dims]);
  useFrame(() => {
    const grp = g.current;
    if (!grp || !hovered) return;
    const p = fxPos(hovered);
    grp.visible = !!p;
    if (!p) return;
    grp.position.set(p.x, 0, p.z);
    grp.rotation.y = -headingOf(hovered);
  });
  if (!hovered || !dims || !edges) return null;
  return (
    <group ref={g}>
      <lineSegments geometry={edges} position={[0, dims[1] / 2, 0]}>
        <lineBasicMaterial color="#7d9cf0" transparent opacity={0.9} />
      </lineSegments>
    </group>
  );
}

/** Pulsing rings under every pallet of the product chosen in the inventory list. */
function SkuHighlight() {
  const sku = useApp((s) => s.highlightSku);
  const fac = useApp((s) => s.facilityId);
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const ring = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  useFrame(({ clock }) => {
    if (!ring.current) return;
    const k = 1 + 0.18 * Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 4);
    ring.current.children.forEach((c) => c.scale.set(k, k, k));
  });
  if (!sku) return null;
  const pallets = palletsOfSku(getWorld(), fac, sku);
  return (
    <group ref={ring}>
      {pallets.map((p) => {
        const pos = entityWorldPos(getWorld(), { kind: 'pallet', id: p.id });
        if (!pos) return null;
        return (
          <mesh key={p.id} position={[pos.x, 0.08, pos.z]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} renderOrder={4}>
            <ringGeometry args={[1.6, 2.1, 40]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial color="#f0a030" transparent opacity={0.9} depthWrite={false} />
          </mesh>
        );
      })}
    </group>
  );
}

function SelectionFx() {
  const sel = useApp((s) => s.selection);
  const g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const glow = useMemo(() => glowTexture(), []);
  const dims = dimsFor(sel);
  const edges = useMemo(() => (dims ? new THREE.EdgesGeometry(new THREE.BoxGeometry(...dims)) : null), [dims]);
  useFrame(() => {
    const grp = g.current;
    if (!grp || !sel) return;
    const p = fxPos(sel);
    grp.visible = !!p;
    if (!p) return;
    const heading = headingOf(sel);
    grp.position.set(p.x, 0, p.z);
    grp.rotation.y = -heading;
  });
  if (!sel || !dims || !edges) return null;
  return (
    <group>
      <group ref={g}>
        <mesh position={[0, dims[1] / 2, 0]} renderOrder={3}>
          <boxGeometry args={dims} />
          <meshBasicMaterial color="#2f62e0" transparent opacity={0.07} depthWrite={false} />
        </mesh>
        <lineSegments geometry={edges} position={[0, dims[1] / 2, 0]}>
          <lineBasicMaterial color="#2f62e0" />
        </lineSegments>
        <mesh position={[0, 0.07, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <planeGeometry args={[Math.max(dims[0], dims[2]) * 1.6, Math.max(dims[0], dims[2]) * 1.6]} />
          <meshBasicMaterial map={glow} transparent depthWrite={false} />
        </mesh>
      </group>
      {sel.kind === 'truck' && <SiteFrame truckId={sel.id} />}
    </group>
  );
}

function BuildingHitbox({ facilityId }: { facilityId: FacilityId }) {
  const L = LAYOUTS[facilityId];
  const handlers = useSelectHandlers({ kind: 'facility', id: facilityId });
  const b = L.building;
  return (
    <mesh position={[(b.x0 + b.x1) / 2, b.height / 2 + 1, -b.depth / 2]} {...handlers}>
      <boxGeometry args={[b.x1 - b.x0, b.height + 3, b.depth]} />
      <meshBasicMaterial transparent opacity={0} depthWrite={false} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

/** Read-only camera state for the ?debug test hook. */
export const cameraProbe = {
  across: 0,
  target: { x: 0, z: 0 },
  project: (x: number, y: number, z: number): { x: number; y: number } | null => { void x; void y; void z; return null; },
};

function Projector() {
  const { camera, size } = useThree();
  const v = useMemo(() => new THREE.Vector3(), []);
  cameraProbe.project = (x, y, z) => {
    const p = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z).project(camera);
    return { x: (p.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * size.width, y: (-p.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * size.height };
  };
  useFrame(() => {
    cameraProbe.across = size.width / (camera as THREE.OrthographicCamera).zoom;
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
    camera.getWorldDirection(dir);
    // where the view ray through the screen centre meets the ground
    const t = -camera.position.y / dir.y;
    cameraProbe.target = { x: camera.position.x + dir.x * t, z: camera.position.z + dir.z * t };
    const s = useApp.getState();
    const specs = labelSpecs(getWorld(), s.facilityId, s.selection, s.hovered);
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    // units visible across the screen: "far" labels only appear when zoomed out, "near" ones only when zoomed in
    const across = size.width / (camera as THREE.OrthographicCamera).zoom;
    for (const sp of specs) {
      seen.add(sp.key);
      if (!sp.world) { anchors.set(sp.key, { x: 0, y: 0, on: false }); continue; }
      v.set(sp.world.x, sp.world.y, sp.world.z).project(camera);
      const zoomOk = sp.range === 'far' ? across > 420 : sp.range === 'near' ? across < 520 : true;
      const x = (v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * size.width, y = (-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * size.height;
      anchors.set(sp.key, { x, y, on: zoomOk && v.z < 1 && v.z > -1 && x > -40 && x < size.width + 40 && y > -20 && y < size.height + 60 });
    }
    for (const k of [...anchors.keys()]) if (!seen.has(k)) anchors.delete(k);
  });
  return null;
}

export function WarehouseScene() {
  const downAt = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  const facilityId = useApp((s) => s.facilityId);
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const sites: FacilityId[] = ['WH-01', 'WH-02', 'WH-04'];
  return (
    <Canvas
      orthographic
      shadows
      flat
      dpr={[1, 2]}
      camera={{ position: [300, 540, 300], zoom: 2, near: 1, far: 3000 }}
      gl={{ antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' }}
      onPointerDown={(e) => { downAt.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }; }}
      onPointerMissed={(e) => {
        document.body.style.cursor = '';
        // a click on empty ground (not the end of a drag) clears the selection
        const d = downAt.current;
        if (e.type === 'click' && d && Math.hypot(e.clientX - d.x, e.clientY - d.y) < 6) {
          const s = useApp.getState();
          s.setHovered(null);
          if (s.selection) s.select(null);
        }
      }}
    >
      <color attach="background" args={['#e6ebf5']} />
      <hemisphereLight args={['#ffffff', '#c9d2e8', 1.3]} />
      <ambientLight intensity={0.35} />
      <CameraRig facilityId={facilityId} />
      <ParkScene />
      {sites.map((fac) => {
        const o = FACILITY_OFFSET[fac];
        const visible = !!getWorld().facilities[fac]; // sites outside the user's access show buildings only
        return (
          <group key={fac} position={[o.x, 0, o.z]}>
            <Site L={LAYOUTS[fac]} label={fac} />
            <BuildingHitbox facilityId={fac} />
            {visible && <Dynamic facilityId={fac} />}
          </group>
        );
      })}
      <SelectionFx />
      <HoverFx />
      <SkuHighlight />
      <Projector />
    </Canvas>
  );
}

export function webglAvailable(): boolean {
  try {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    return !!(c.getContext('webgl2') || c.getContext('webgl'));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// Street-level detail for the town and the Maple Heights estate, all instanced so that hundreds
// of houses, parked cars, lamps and trees cost only a few draw calls.
import { useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { SCENERY, GREENS } from '../data/scenery';
import { C, mat } from './materials';

type Item = { p: [number, number, number]; r?: number; s: [number, number, number]; c?: string };

const _m = new THREE.Matrix4();
const _q = new THREE.Quaternion();
const _e = new THREE.Euler();
const _v = new THREE.Vector3();
const _s = new THREE.Vector3();
const _c = new THREE.Color();

/** One instanced mesh: unit geometry, each item placed, rotated about Y, scaled and optionally coloured. */
function Inst({ geo, items, color = '#ffffff', shadow = false, rough = 0.85, emissive }: { geo: THREE.BufferGeometry; items: Item[]; color?: string; shadow?: boolean; rough?: number; emissive?: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const material = useMemo(() => mat(color, { rough, emissive }), [color, rough, emissive]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const m = ref.current;
    if (!m) return;
    items.forEach((it, i) => {
      _e.set(0, it.r ?? 0, 0);
      _q.setFromEuler(_e);
      _m.compose(_v.set(...it.p), _q, _s.set(...it.s));
      m.setMatrixAt(i, _m);
      if (it.c) m.setColorAt(i, _c.set(it.c));
    });
    m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    if (m.instanceColor) m.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
    m.computeBoundingSphere();
  }, [items]);
  if (!items.length) return null;
  return <instancedMesh ref={ref} args={[geo, material, items.length]} castShadow={shadow} receiveShadow />;
}

const BOX = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
const CYL = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 1, 8);
const SPHERE = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.5, 10, 8);
// a gable roof: triangular prism, ridge along local X, base at y=0, unit size
const ROOF = (() => {
  const sh = new THREE.Shape();
  sh.moveTo(-0.5, 0); sh.lineTo(0.5, 0); sh.lineTo(0, 1); sh.lineTo(-0.5, 0);
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: 1, bevelEnabled: false });
  g.translate(0, 0, -0.5);
  g.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);
  return g;
})();

/** rotate a local offset (along the house's front = local +z) into world space */
function local(x: number, z: number, rot: number, lx: number, lz: number): [number, number] {
  const c = Math.cos(rot), s = Math.sin(rot);
  return [x + lx * c + lz * s, z - lx * s + lz * c];
}

function Houses() {
  const parts = useMemo(() => {
    const walls: Item[] = [], roofs: Item[] = [], doors: Item[] = [], wins: Item[] = [], chim: Item[] = [], drives: Item[] = [], yards: Item[] = [], hedges: Item[] = [];
    for (const h of SCENERY.houses) {
      walls.push({ p: [h.x, h.h / 2, h.z], r: h.rot, s: [h.w, h.h, h.d], c: h.wall });
      roofs.push({ p: [h.x, h.h, h.z], r: h.rot, s: [h.w + 0.8, h.roof, h.d + 1.2], c: h.roofColor });
      const fz = h.d / 2 + 0.06;
      const [dx, dz] = local(h.x, h.z, h.rot, -h.w * 0.18, fz);
      doors.push({ p: [dx, 1.1, dz], r: h.rot, s: [1.1, 2.2, 0.12] });
      for (const lx of [-h.w * 0.38, h.w * 0.12, h.w * 0.34]) {
        const [wx, wz] = local(h.x, h.z, h.rot, lx, fz);
        wins.push({ p: [wx, 1.9, wz], r: h.rot, s: [1.5, 1.2, 0.1] });
        if (h.h > 5) {
          const [ux, uz] = local(h.x, h.z, h.rot, lx - h.w * 0.05, fz);
          wins.push({ p: [ux, 4.7, uz], r: h.rot, s: [1.4, 1.1, 0.1] });
        }
      }
      // back windows so the houses look lived-in from every side
      for (const lx of [-h.w * 0.25, h.w * 0.25]) {
        const [bx, bz] = local(h.x, h.z, h.rot, lx, -fz);
        wins.push({ p: [bx, 1.9, bz], r: h.rot, s: [1.4, 1.1, 0.1] });
      }
      if (h.chimney) {
        const [cx, cz] = local(h.x, h.z, h.rot, h.w * 0.3, -h.d * 0.12);
        chim.push({ p: [cx, h.h + h.roof * 0.6, cz], r: h.rot, s: [0.9, h.roof * 1.1, 0.9] });
      }
      // front path, lawn and a low hedge along the pavement
      const [px, pz] = local(h.x, h.z, h.rot, -h.w * 0.18, h.d / 2 + 4);
      drives.push({ p: [px, 0.04, pz], r: h.rot, s: [1.4, 0.02, 8] });
      const [yx, yz] = local(h.x, h.z, h.rot, 0, 0.5);
      yards.push({ p: [yx, 0.015, yz], r: h.rot, s: [h.w + 8, 0.01, h.d + 16] });
      const [hx, hz] = local(h.x, h.z, h.rot, h.w * 0.22, h.d / 2 + 7.5);
      hedges.push({ p: [hx, 0.45, hz], r: h.rot, s: [h.w * 0.5, 0.9, 0.8] });
    }
    return { walls, roofs, doors, wins, chim, drives, yards, hedges };
  }, []);
  return (
    <group>
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.yards} color="#d4e8d0" rough={1} />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.drives} color="#d9dde6" rough={1} />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.walls} shadow />
      <Inst geo={ROOF} items={parts.roofs} shadow />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.doors} color="#6b4a35" />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.wins} color={C.glass} rough={0.3} />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.chim} color="#9a6b55" shadow />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.hedges} color={C.leafDark} rough={1} />
    </group>
  );
}

function ParkedCars() {
  const parts = useMemo(() => {
    const body: Item[] = [], cab: Item[] = [], glass: Item[] = [], wheel: Item[] = [];
    for (const c of [...SCENERY.driveways, ...SCENERY.kerb]) {
      body.push({ p: [c.x, 0.75, c.z], r: c.rot, s: [4.4, 0.9, 2.0], c: c.color });
      const [cx, cz] = local(c.x, c.z, c.rot, -0.3, 0);
      cab.push({ p: [cx, 1.5, cz], r: c.rot, s: [2.3, 0.75, 1.8], c: c.color });
      const [gx, gz] = local(c.x, c.z, c.rot, 0.86, 0);
      glass.push({ p: [gx, 1.5, gz], r: c.rot, s: [0.06, 0.62, 1.66] });
      for (const [lx, lz] of [[1.35, 0.95], [1.35, -0.95], [-1.35, 0.95], [-1.35, -0.95]]) {
        const [wx, wz] = local(c.x, c.z, c.rot, lx, lz);
        wheel.push({ p: [wx, 0.36, wz], r: c.rot, s: [0.72, 0.72, 0.28] });
      }
    }
    return { body, cab, glass, wheel };
  }, []);
  return (
    <group>
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.body} />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.cab} />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.glass} color={C.glass} rough={0.3} />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.wheel} color={C.tire} />
    </group>
  );
}

    }

    <group>
      <Inst geo={CYL} items={parts.poles} color="#7d879a" />

  );
}

function Benches() {

function Greens() {
  const parts = useMemo(() => {
    const lawns: Item[] = [], paths: Item[] = [], pond: Item[] = [], play: Item[] = [];
    for (const g of GREENS) {
      const cx = (g.x0 + g.x1) / 2, cz = (g.z0 + g.z1) / 2, w = g.x1 - g.x0, d = g.z1 - g.z0;
      lawns.push({ p: [cx, 0.016, cz], s: [w, 0.01, d] });
      paths.push({ p: [cx, 0.03, cz], s: [w - 4, 0.01, 2.4] }, { p: [cx, 0.03, cz], s: [2.4, 0.01, d - 4] });
      if (w > 120) {
        pond.push({ p: [cx + w * 0.25, 0.04, cz], s: [w * 0.18, 0.01, d * 0.4] });
        // a small playground: frame, slide and a sandpit
        play.push({ p: [cx - w * 0.28, 1.3, cz - d * 0.18], s: [4, 0.2, 0.2] }, { p: [cx - w * 0.28 - 2, 0.65, cz - d * 0.18], s: [0.2, 1.3, 0.2] }, { p: [cx - w * 0.28 + 2, 0.65, cz - d * 0.18], s: [0.2, 1.3, 0.2] });
      }
    }
    return { lawns, paths, pond, play };
  }, []);
  return (
    <group>
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.lawns} color="#cfe6cc" rough={1} />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.paths} color="#e8e1d2" rough={1} />
      <Inst geo={SPHERE} items={parts.pond} color="#9cc6ee" rough={0.2} />
      <Inst geo={BOX} items={parts.play} color="#e8590c" />
    </group>
  );
}

function MoreTrees() {

// Static site geometry for a facility: ground, roads, yard markings, building, props.
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { FacilityLayout } from '../data/layouts';
import { FENCE_Z, LANE_Z, ROAD_Z, ROAD_HALF, CORRIDOR_Z } from '../data/layouts';
import { C, mat, roofLogo, wallSign, glassTexture } from './materials';
import { Box, PalletModel, Tree, Rack, CrateStack, ShippingContainer } from './models';

function Flat({ x, z, w, d, color, y = 0.02 }: { x: number; z: number; w: number; d: number; color: string; y?: number }) {
  return (
    <mesh position={[x, y, z]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} receiveShadow material={mat(color, { rough: 1 })}>
      <planeGeometry args={[w, d]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function Ground({ L }: { L: FacilityLayout }) {
  // the street, avenues and the rest of the park are drawn by the park scene
  const yardW = L.yard.x1 - L.yard.x0;
  const yardD = FENCE_Z - L.yard.z0;
  return (
    <group>
      <Flat x={(L.yard.x0 + L.yard.x1) / 2} z={(L.yard.z0 + FENCE_Z) / 2} w={yardW} d={yardD} color={C.yard} y={0.01} />
      {/* gate aprons from the fence to the street */}
      <Flat x={L.gateX} z={(FENCE_Z + ROAD_Z - ROAD_HALF) / 2} w={12} d={ROAD_Z - ROAD_HALF - FENCE_Z + 0.6} color={C.road} y={0.038} />
      <Flat x={L.exitX} z={(FENCE_Z + ROAD_Z - ROAD_HALF) / 2} w={12} d={ROAD_Z - ROAD_HALF - FENCE_Z + 0.6} color={C.road} y={0.038} />
    </group>
  );
}

function YardMarkings({ L }: { L: FacilityLayout }) {
  const els: JSX.Element[] = [];
  const Y = C.marking;
  Object.entries(L.doors).forEach(([id, x]) => {
    els.push(<Flat key={`${id}a`} x={x - 2.3} z={7.5} w={0.18} d={13} color={Y} y={0.04} />);
    els.push(<Flat key={`${id}b`} x={x + 2.3} z={7.5} w={0.18} d={13} color={Y} y={0.04} />);
    els.push(<Flat key={`${id}c`} x={x} z={14} w={4.78} d={0.18} color={Y} y={0.04} />);
    els.push(<Flat key={`${id}d`} x={x} z={0.9} w={3.6} d={1.6} color="#b9c2d6" y={0.045} />);
  });
  L.slots.forEach((s, i) => {
    const h = 1.0;
    els.push(<Flat key={`s${i}a`} x={s.x} z={s.z - h} w={2.1} d={0.12} color={Y} y={0.04} />);
    els.push(<Flat key={`s${i}b`} x={s.x} z={s.z + h} w={2.1} d={0.12} color={Y} y={0.04} />);
    els.push(<Flat key={`s${i}c`} x={s.x - h} z={s.z} w={0.12} d={2.1} color={Y} y={0.04} />);
    els.push(<Flat key={`s${i}d`} x={s.x + h} z={s.z} w={0.12} d={2.1} color={Y} y={0.04} />);
  });
  // lane centre dashes and forklift corridor line
  for (let x = L.gateX + 6; x < L.exitX - 4; x += 6) {
    els.push(<Flat key={`l${x}`} x={x} z={LANE_Z + 5} w={2.6} d={0.16} color="#ffffff" y={0.04} />);
  }
  els.push(<Flat key="corr" x={(L.gateX + L.exitX) / 2} z={CORRIDOR_Z + 2.2} w={L.exitX - L.gateX - 10} d={0.14} color={Y} y={0.04} />);
  return <group>{els}</group>;
}

function Fence({ L }: { L: FacilityLayout }) {
  const posts: JSX.Element[] = [];
  const panels: JSX.Element[] = [];
  const panelMat = mat('#c7d1e6', { opacity: 0.45 });
  const gaps = [L.gateX, L.exitX];
  const blocked = (x: number) => gaps.some((g) => Math.abs(x - g) < 7);
  for (let x = L.yard.x0; x <= L.yard.x1; x += 4) {
    if (blocked(x) || blocked(x + 4)) continue;
    posts.push(<Box key={`p${x}`} p={[x, 1.1, FENCE_Z]} s={[0.12, 2.2, 0.12]} c={C.fence} />);
    if (x + 4 <= L.yard.x1) {
      panels.push(
        <mesh key={`f${x}`} position={[x + 2, 1.1, FENCE_Z]} material={panelMat}>
          <planeGeometry args={[4, 2.0]} />
        </mesh>,
      );
      posts.push(<Box key={`r${x}`} p={[x + 2, 2.15, FENCE_Z]} s={[4, 0.07, 0.07]} c={C.fence} shadow={false} />);
    }
  }
  return <group>{posts}{panels}</group>;
}

function Door({ x, faceZ, kind }: { x: number; faceZ: number; kind: 'dock' | 'small' }) {
  if (kind === 'small') {
    return (
      <group position={[x, 0, faceZ]}>
        <Box p={[0, 1.7, 0.06]} s={[2.9, 3.4, 0.12]} c={C.wallGrey} shadow={false} />
        <Box p={[0, 2.1, 0.13]} s={[2.5, 2.6, 0.04]} c={C.rollDoor} shadow={false} />
        <Box p={[0, 0.4, 0.13]} s={[2.5, 0.8, 0.04]} c={C.doorDark} shadow={false} />
      </group>
    );
  }
  return (
    <group position={[x, 0, faceZ]}>
      <Box p={[0, 2.3, 0.04]} s={[3.9, 4.6, 0.06]} c={C.doorDark} shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[0, 4.15, 0.09]} s={[3.9, 0.7, 0.05]} c={C.rollDoor} shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[-2.1, 2.4, 0.2]} s={[0.36, 4.8, 0.4]} c={C.blue} />
      <Box p={[2.1, 2.4, 0.2]} s={[0.36, 4.8, 0.4]} c={C.blue} />
      <Box p={[0, 4.75, 0.2]} s={[4.56, 0.36, 0.4]} c={C.blue} />
      <Box p={[-1.55, 0.7, 0.35]} s={[0.35, 0.5, 0.3]} c={C.steel} />
      <Box p={[1.55, 0.7, 0.35]} s={[0.35, 0.5, 0.3]} c={C.steel} />
      <group position={[0, 1.0, 0.2]} scale={[1.5, 1.4, 0.3]}>
        <PalletModel look="cardboard" layers={2} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
}

function gable(depth: number, rise: number): THREE.ExtrudeGeometry {
  const s = new THREE.Shape();
  s.moveTo(-0.7, 0);
  s.lineTo(depth + 0.7, 0);
  s.lineTo(depth / 2, rise);
  s.closePath();
  return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 1, bevelEnabled: false });
}

function GableRoof({ x0, x1, zFront, depth, h, rise }: { x0: number; x1: number; zFront: number; depth: number; h: number; rise: number }) {
  const geo = useMemo(() => gable(depth, rise), [depth, rise]);
  return (
    <mesh geometry={geo} position={[x0 - 0.7, h, zFront]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} scale={[1, 1, x1 - x0 + 1.4]} castShadow receiveShadow
      material={[mat('#f2f5fb'), mat(C.blueRoof, { rough: 0.7 })]} />
  );
}

function RoofDecal({ cx, zFront, depth, h, rise, text }: { cx: number; zFront: number; depth: number; h: number; rise: number; text: string }) {
  const tex = useMemo(() => roofLogo(text), [text]);
  const theta = Math.atan2(rise, depth / 2 + 0.7);
  const m = useMemo(() => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }), [tex]);
  const zMid = zFront - (depth / 2 + 0.7) / 2;
  const yMid = h + rise / 2;
  return (
    <mesh position={[cx, yMid + 0.08 * Math.cos(theta), zMid + 0.08 * Math.sin(theta)]} rotation={[-(Math.PI / 2 - theta), 0, 0]} material={m}>
      <planeGeometry args={[6, 6]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function Sign({ p, rot = 0, text, sub, w = 9 }: { p: [number, number, number]; rot?: number; text: string; sub: string; w?: number }) {
  const tex = useMemo(() => wallSign(text, sub), [text, sub]);
  const m = useMemo(() => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }), [tex]);
  return (
    <mesh position={p} rotation={[0, rot, 0]} material={m}>
      <planeGeometry args={[w, w * 0.3125]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function Building({ L, label }: { L: FacilityLayout; label: string }) {
  const { x0, x1, depth, height: h } = L.building;
  const w = x1 - x0;
  const cx = (x0 + x1) / 2;
  const parts: JSX.Element[] = [];
  let faceZ = 0.02;

  if (L.style === 'riverside') {
    parts.push(<Box key="walls" p={[cx, h / 2, -depth / 2]} s={[w, h, depth]} c={C.blue} />);
    parts.push(<Box key="band" p={[cx, 2.9, 0.1]} s={[w - 0.6, 5.8, 0.2]} c={C.white} />);
    parts.push(<Box key="bandside" p={[x1 + 0.1, 2.9, -depth / 2]} s={[0.2, 5.8, depth - 0.6]} c={C.white} />);
    parts.push(<GableRoof key="roof" x0={x0} x1={x1} zFront={0} depth={depth} h={h} rise={3.6} />);
    parts.push(<RoofDecal key="logo" cx={cx + 6} zFront={0} depth={depth} h={h} rise={3.6} text={label} />);
    faceZ = 0.22;
    if (L.annex) {
      const a = L.annex;
      parts.push(<Box key="aw" p={[(a.x0 + a.x1) / 2, a.height / 2, a.z1 - a.depth / 2]} s={[a.x1 - a.x0, a.height, a.depth]} c={C.blue} />);
      parts.push(<GableRoof key="ar" x0={a.x0} x1={a.x1} zFront={a.z1} depth={a.depth} h={a.height} rise={3.2} />);
      parts.push(<Door key="ad" x={(a.x0 + a.x1) / 2} faceZ={a.z1 + 0.02} kind="dock" />);
    }
  } else if (L.style === 'southfield') {
    parts.push(<Box key="walls" p={[cx, h / 2, -depth / 2]} s={[w, h, depth]} c={C.white} />);
    parts.push(<Box key="fascia" p={[cx, h - 0.35, 0.12]} s={[w + 0.3, 0.7, 0.3]} c={C.blue} />);
    parts.push(<Box key="fasciaE" p={[x1 + 0.12, h - 0.35, -depth / 2]} s={[0.3, 0.7, depth]} c={C.blue} />);
    const doors = Object.values(L.doors);
    const pil = new Set<number>([x0 + 0.3, x1 - 0.3]);
    doors.forEach((d) => { pil.add(d - 7); pil.add(d + 7); });
    [...pil].filter((x) => x >= x0 && x <= x1).forEach((x) => parts.push(<Box key={`pl${x}`} p={[x, h / 2, 0.15]} s={[0.6, h, 0.3]} c={C.blue} />));
    const N = Math.max(4, Math.round(w / 12));
    const T = w / N;
    const toothH = 4.6;
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) parts.push(<SawTooth key={`t${i}`} x={x0 + i * T} T={T} H={toothH} depth={depth} h={h} />);
    parts.push(<Sign key="sign" p={[x1 - 9, h - 3.2, 0.32]} text="CargoVerse" sub="Southfield Cross-Dock" />);
    parts.push(<Sign key="signE" p={[x1 + 0.32, h - 3.2, -depth / 2]} rot={Math.PI / 2} text="CargoVerse" sub="WH-04" w={10} />);
  } else {
    parts.push(<Box key="walls" p={[cx, h / 2, -depth / 2]} s={[w, h, depth]} c={C.white} />);
    parts.push(<Box key="band" p={[cx, h - 1.2, 0.08]} s={[w, 0.9, 0.16]} c={C.blue} />);
    parts.push(<Box key="bandE" p={[x1 + 0.08, h - 1.2, -depth / 2]} s={[0.16, 0.9, depth]} c={C.blue} />);
    parts.push(<Box key="roof" p={[cx, h + 0.05, -depth / 2]} s={[w, 0.1, depth]} c="#e4e9f3" />);
    parts.push(<Box key="parF" p={[cx, h + 0.45, 0]} s={[w, 0.8, 0.35]} c={C.blue} />);
    parts.push(<Box key="parB" p={[cx, h + 0.45, -depth]} s={[w, 0.8, 0.35]} c={C.blue} />);
    parts.push(<Box key="parE" p={[x1, h + 0.45, -depth / 2]} s={[0.35, 0.8, depth]} c={C.blue} />);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) parts.push(<Box key={`sky${i}`} p={[x0 + 10 + i * 20, h + 0.2, -depth / 2]} s={[10, 0.2, 2.2]} c="#7f9ff0" shadow={false} />);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) parts.push(<Box key={`hv${i}`} p={[x0 + 18 + i * 24, h + 1.0, -depth * 0.72]} s={[3.4, 1.8, 2.6]} c="#d5dbe7" />);
    parts.push(<Sign key="sign" p={[x0 + 14, h - 3.4, 0.2]} text="Northgate DC" sub="WH-02 · CargoVerse" w={11} />);
    if (L.annex) {
      const a = L.annex;
      parts.push(<GlassBlock key="glass" x0={a.x0} x1={a.x1} depth={a.depth} h={a.height} />);
    }
  }

  const doors = Object.values(L.doors).map((x) => <Door key={`d${x}`} x={x} faceZ={faceZ} kind="dock" />);
  const extra = L.extraDoors.map((x) => <Door key={`e${x}`} x={x} faceZ={faceZ} kind="dock" />);
  const small = Object.values(L.doors).map((x) => <Door key={`s${x}`} x={x + L.storeOffset} faceZ={faceZ} kind="small" />);
  return <group>{parts}{doors}{extra}{small}</group>;
}

function SawTooth({ x, T, H, depth, h }: { x: number; T: number; H: number; depth: number; h: number }) {
  const geo = useMemo(() => {
    const s = new THREE.Shape();
    s.moveTo(0, 0); s.lineTo(T, 0); s.lineTo(T, H); s.closePath();
    return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth, bevelEnabled: false });
  }, [T, H, depth]);
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={geo} position={[x, h, -depth]} castShadow receiveShadow material={[mat('#eef1f7'), mat(C.blueRoof, { rough: 0.7 })]} />
      <mesh position={[x + T + 0.03, h + H / 2, -depth / 2]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} material={mat('#d9e1f1', { rough: 0.5 })}>
        <planeGeometry args={[depth, H]} />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

function GlassBlock({ x0, x1, depth, h }: { x0: number; x1: number; depth: number; h: number }) {
  const m = useMemo(() => {
    const t = glassTexture().clone();
    t.repeat.set((x1 - x0) / 4, h / 4);
    t.needsUpdate = true;
    const t2 = glassTexture().clone();
    t2.repeat.set(depth / 4, h / 4);
    t2.needsUpdate = true;
    const front = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: t, roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.1 });
    const side = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: t2, roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.1 });
    const top = mat(C.blue);
    return [side, side, top, top, front, front];
  }, [x0, x1, depth, h]);
  return (
    <mesh position={[(x0 + x1) / 2, h / 2, -depth / 2]} castShadow receiveShadow material={m}>
      <boxGeometry args={[x1 - x0, h, depth]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

export function Site({ L, label }: { L: FacilityLayout; label: string }) {
  return (
    <group>
      <Ground L={L} />
      <YardMarkings L={L} />
      <Fence L={L} />
      <Building L={L} label={label} />
      {L.trees.map((t, i) => (
        <group key={`tr${i}`} position={[t.x, 0, t.z]}><Tree s={1 + ((i * 37) % 5) / 10} /></group>
      ))}
      {L.decoPallets.map((p, i) => (
        <group key={`dp${i}`} position={[p.x, 0, p.z]} rotation={[0, (i % 3) * 0.2, 0]} scale={1.45}><PalletModel look={p.look} layers={p.layers} /></group>
      ))}
      {L.racks.map((r, i) => <group key={`rk${i}`} position={[r.x, 0, r.z]}><Rack /></group>)}
      {L.crateStacks.map((c, i) => <group key={`cs${i}`} position={[c.x, 0, c.z]} rotation={[0, c.rot, 0]}><CrateStack /></group>)}
      {L.shippingContainers.map((c, i) => (
        <group key={`sc${i}`} position={[c.x, 0, c.z]} rotation={[0, c.rot, 0]}><ShippingContainer color={c.color} /></group>
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}

FILE: waretrack/src/scene/labels.ts

// Floating 2D tags attached to 3D positions. The scene projects anchors each
// frame; the DOM overlay reads the projected positions.
import type { WorldState, EntityRef, FacilityId, Truck } from '../data/types';
import { LAYOUTS } from '../data/layouts';
import { SKUS } from '../data/seed';
import { toPark, PARK_GATES, type GateCode } from '../data/park';
import { getPark, findBuilding, findVehicle, findCompany } from '../data/parkClient';
import { entityWorldPos, truckBadge, forkliftActivity, dockStatus, chargerView, findAsset, vesselActivity, vanActivity } from '../ui/derive';
import { storeByBuilding, storeBuilding } from '../data/city';

export interface LabelSpec {
  key: string;
  text: string;
  chip: string;
  tone: 'blue' | 'plain' | 'park' | 'import' | 'export' | 'unladen' | 'ship' | 'retail';
  world: { x: number; y: number; z: number } | null;
  /** far = only when zoomed out (park overview), near = only when zoomed in */
  range?: 'far' | 'near';
}

export const anchors = new Map<string, { x: number; y: number; on: boolean }>();

const HEIGHT: Record<EntityRef['kind'], number> = {
  truck: 5.6, forklift: 4.6, pallet: 3.0, dock: 5.4, charger: 2.4, facility: 0, asset: 5, building: 10, vehicle: 3.2, gate: 6,
  vessel: 18, crane: 32, berth: 4, store: 12, van: 4.4,
};
const VEH_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { CAR: 'Car', VAN: 'Van', BUS: 'Bus', TRUCK: 'Truck', TANKER: 'Tanker', TAXI: 'Taxi', TRACTOR: 'Terminal tractor' };

function entityTag(w: WorldState, ref: EntityRef, key: string, tone: LabelSpec['tone']): LabelSpec {
  const p = entityWorldPos(w, ref);
  let chip = '';
  let text = ref.id;
  let h = HEIGHT[ref.kind];
  switch (ref.kind) {
    case 'truck': { const t = w.trucks[ref.id]; if (t) chip = truckBadge(t).label; break; }
    case 'forklift': { const fl = w.forklifts[ref.id]; if (fl) chip = forkliftActivity(w, fl).badge.label; break; }
    case 'pallet': { const pl = w.pallets[ref.id]; if (pl) chip = SKUS[pl.skuId].name; if (pl?.featured) text = pl.id; break; }
    case 'dock': { const d = w.docks[ref.id]; if (d) { text = d.name; chip = dockStatus(w, d).badge.label; } break; }
    case 'asset': { const a = findAsset(ref.id); if (a) { text = a.name; chip = a.facilityId; } break; }
    case 'charger': { if (w.chargers[ref.id]) { const v = chargerView(w, ref.id); text = v.title; chip = v.badge.label; } break; }
    case 'building': {
      const b = findBuilding(ref.id);
      if (b) { text = b.name; chip = findCompany(b.companyId)?.name ?? ''; h = Math.max(6, b.h + (b.kind === 'PLANT' ? 6 : 3)); if (chip === text) chip = b.kind.toLowerCase().replace('_', ' '); }
      break;
    }
    case 'vehicle': {
      const v = findVehicle(ref.id);
      if (v) { text = v.plate; chip = `${VEH_LABEL[v.kind]} · ${findCompany(v.companyId)?.name ?? 'public traffic'}`; h = v.kind === 'CAR' ? 3 : 5; }
      break;
    }
    case 'gate': { const g = PARK_GATES[ref.id as GateCode]; if (g) { text = g.name; chip = 'Park gate'; } break; }
    case 'vessel': { const v = w.port?.vessels[ref.id]; if (v) { text = v.name; chip = vesselActivity(w, v).badge.label; } break; }
    case 'crane': { const c = w.port?.cranes[ref.id]; if (c) { text = `Quay crane ${c.id}`; chip = c.phase === 'idle' ? 'Idle' : c.phase === 'discharge' ? 'Discharging' : 'Loading'; } break; }
    case 'berth': { const b = w.port?.berths[ref.id]; if (b) { text = b.name; chip = b.open ? (b.vesselId ? w.port.vessels[b.vesselId]?.name ?? 'Occupied' : 'Free') : 'Closed'; } break; }
    case 'store': { const st = w.retail?.stores[ref.id]; const b = storeBuilding(ref.id); if (st) { text = st.name; chip = st.kind.toLowerCase(); h = (b?.h ?? 8) + 4; } break; }
    case 'van': { const v = w.retail?.vans[ref.id]; if (v) { text = v.id; chip = vanActivity(w, v).badge.label; } break; }
    case 'facility': break;
  }
  const pallet = ref.kind === 'pallet' ? w.pallets[ref.id] : null;
  const extra = pallet?.featured && pallet.slot !== null ? 4.2 : 0;
  const asset = ref.kind === 'asset' ? findAsset(ref.id) : null;
  if (asset) h = asset.size[1] + 1.2;
  let z = p?.z ?? 0;
  if (ref.kind === 'dock') { const d = w.docks[ref.id]; if (d) z = toPark(d.facilityId, { x: 0, z: 7 }).z; }
  return { key, text, chip, tone, world: p ? { x: p.x, y: h + extra, z } : null };
}

/** Trucks on the public roads carry a tag saying what they bring in or take out. */
function flowTag(t: Truck): LabelSpec | null {
  const onRoad = (t.phase === 'en_route' && t.legDist > 0) || (t.phase === 'leaving');
  if (!onRoad) return null;
  const p = toPark(t.facilityId, t.pos);
  const inbound = t.phase === 'en_route';
  const loaded = t.cargo > 0;
  const tone: LabelSpec['tone'] = !loaded ? 'unladen' : inbound ? 'import' : 'export';
  const sea = t.lane === 'SEA' && loaded;
  const what = sea ? `${inbound ? 'Import container · from the port' : 'Export container · to the port'}`
    : loaded ? `${inbound ? 'Import' : 'Export'} · ${t.cargo} pal ${SKUS[t.skuId]?.name ?? ''}`.trim() : inbound ? 'Empty · to load' : 'Empty · returning';
  return { key: `flow-${t.id}`, text: t.id, chip: `${what} · ${t.facilityId}`, tone, world: { x: p.x, y: 5.8, z: p.z } };
}

export function labelSpecs(w: WorldState, facilityId: FacilityId, selection: EntityRef | null, hovered: EntityRef | null = null): LabelSpec[] {
  const out: LabelSpec[] = [];
  for (const fac of Object.keys(LAYOUTS) as FacilityId[]) {
    const L = LAYOUTS[fac];
    const f = w.facilities[fac];
    const c = toPark(fac, { x: (L.building.x0 + L.building.x1) / 2, z: -L.building.depth / 2 });
    out.push({
      key: fac === facilityId ? 'building' : `building-${fac}`,
      text: fac,
      chip: f?.name ?? findBuilding(`PB-${fac.replace('-', '')}`)?.name ?? '',
      tone: 'plain',
      world: { x: c.x, y: L.building.height + 6.5, z: c.z },
    });
  }
  // neighbours and gates are named when looking at the whole park
  for (const b of getPark().buildings) {
    if (b.facilityId || b.kind === 'GATEHOUSE' || b.kind === 'PARKING' || b.kind === 'RESIDENTIAL') continue;
    const co = findCompany(b.companyId);
    const store = storeByBuilding(b.id);
    // in town, keep the overview readable: vendor stores, public services and landmarks only
    if (b.z > 250 && b.x > -600 && !store && b.kind !== 'SERVICES' && b.kind !== 'TERMINAL' && b.h < 40) continue;
    const chip = store ? (store.kind === 'SUPERMARKET' ? 'Supermarket' : `${store.kind.charAt(0)}${store.kind.slice(1).toLowerCase()} store`)
      : b.kind === 'PLANT' ? 'Plant' : b.kind === 'TERMINAL' ? 'Ships · containers' : b.kind.toLowerCase().replace('_', ' ');
    const shared = getPark().buildings.filter((x) => x.companyId === b.companyId).length > 1;
    const text = store ? store.name : shared || !co ? b.name : co.name;
    out.push({ key: `park-${b.id}`, text, chip, tone: store ? 'retail' : 'park', world: { x: b.x, y: Math.max(4, b.h) + 4, z: b.z }, range: 'far' });
  }
  // ships in the bay and alongside
  for (const v of Object.values(w.port?.vessels ?? {})) {
    if (v.status === 'AT_SEA' || (selection?.kind === 'vessel' && selection.id === v.id)) continue;
    out.push({ key: `ship-${v.id}`, text: v.name, chip: vesselActivity(w, v).badge.label, tone: 'ship', world: { x: v.pos.x, y: 18, z: v.pos.z } });
  }
  // delivery vans on their way to and from the stores
  for (const v of Object.values(w.retail?.vans ?? {})) {
    if (v.status === 'IDLE' || v.status === 'LOADING' || (selection?.kind === 'van' && selection.id === v.id)) continue;
    const st = v.storeId ? w.retail.stores[v.storeId] : undefined;
    const chip = v.status === 'RETURNING' ? `Returning to ${v.facilityId}` : v.status === 'UNLOADING' ? `Unloading · ${st?.name ?? ''}` : `Delivery → ${st?.name ?? ''}`;
    out.push({ key: `van-${v.id}`, text: v.id, chip, tone: 'retail', world: { x: v.pos.x, y: 4.6, z: v.pos.z } });
  }
  for (const g of Object.values(PARK_GATES)) {
    out.push({ key: `gate-${g.code}`, text: g.name, chip: g.code === 'WEST' ? 'goods in' : 'goods out', tone: g.code === 'WEST' ? 'import' : 'export', world: { x: g.pos.x, y: 6, z: g.pos.z }, range: 'far' });
  }
  for (const t of Object.values(w.trucks)) {
    if (selection?.kind === 'truck' && selection.id === t.id) continue;
    const tag = flowTag(t);
    if (tag) out.push(tag);
  }
  if (selection && selection.kind !== 'facility') out.push(entityTag(w, selection, 'selection', 'blue'));
  const same = hovered && selection && hovered.kind === selection.kind && hovered.id === selection.id;
  if (hovered && hovered.kind !== 'facility' && !same) out.push(entityTag(w, hovered, 'hover', 'plain'));
  return out;
}

// Shared materials and procedurally drawn canvas textures (no external assets).
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { Carrier, PalletLook } from '../data/types';

export const C = {
  ground: '#e4e9f4',
  yard: '#f0f3f9',
  road: '#d6ddec',
  roadLine: '#ffffff',
  curb: '#c8d1e4',
  marking: '#f1c24f',
  blue: '#2c5be4',
  blueRoof: '#3b6cf1',
  blueDark: '#2149c8',
  white: '#f6f8fc',
  wallGrey: '#e2e7f1',
  doorDark: '#262d3d',
  rollDoor: '#cfd6e4',
  trunk: '#a08b72',
  leaf: '#69c08a',
  leafDark: '#58ae79',
  cardboard: '#d9a86b',
  cardboardDark: '#c3904f',
  wood: '#c9a27a',
  crate: '#2f5fe8',
  crateDark: '#244cc4',
  wrap: '#f3f6fb',
  yellow: '#f6b818',
  yellowDark: '#d99c0c',
  steel: '#2c3242',
  steelLight: '#5d6577',
  tire: '#2a2f3a',
  glass: '#2a3a58',
  fence: '#9fabc3',
};

const cache = new Map<string, THREE.Material>();
export function mat(color: string, opts: { rough?: number; metal?: number; opacity?: number; emissive?: string } = {}): THREE.MeshStandardMaterial {
  const key = `${color}|${opts.rough ?? 0.85}|${opts.metal ?? 0}|${opts.opacity ?? 1}|${opts.emissive ?? ''}`;
  let m = cache.get(key) as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | undefined;
  if (!m) {
    m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color,
      ...(opts.emissive ? { emissive: new THREE.Color(opts.emissive), emissiveIntensity: 0.6 } : {}),
      roughness: opts.rough ?? 0.85,
      metalness: opts.metal ?? 0,
      transparent: (opts.opacity ?? 1) < 1,
      opacity: opts.opacity ?? 1,
      depthWrite: (opts.opacity ?? 1) >= 1,
    });
    cache.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
}

const texCache = new Map<string, THREE.Texture>();
function canvasTexture(key: string, w: number, h: number, draw: (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D) => void): THREE.Texture {
  const hit = texCache.get(key);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = w;
  c.height = h;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  if (g) draw(g);
  const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  t.anisotropy = 4;
  texCache.set(key, t);
  return t;
}

function cubeIcon(g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, x: number, y: number, s: number, color: string) {
  g.save();
  g.translate(x, y);
  g.fillStyle = color;
  g.beginPath();
  g.moveTo(0, -s); g.lineTo(s * 0.9, -s * 0.5); g.lineTo(s * 0.9, s * 0.5); g.lineTo(0, s); g.lineTo(-s * 0.9, s * 0.5); g.lineTo(-s * 0.9, -s * 0.5);
  g.closePath();
  g.fill();
  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)';
  g.beginPath();
  g.moveTo(0, -s); g.lineTo(s * 0.9, -s * 0.5); g.lineTo(0, 0); g.lineTo(-s * 0.9, -s * 0.5);
  g.closePath();
  g.fill();
  g.restore();
}

export const CARRIER_STYLE: Record<Carrier, { cab: string; stripe: string; text: string }> = {
  WareTrack: { cab: '#2c5be4', stripe: '#2c5be4', text: '#2c5be4' },
  Bluepeak: { cab: '#f4f6fa', stripe: '#1f3b8f', text: '#1f3b8f' },
  Nordline: { cab: '#f4f6fa', stripe: '#1e8f80', text: '#1e7f73' },
  Cargoviva: { cab: '#f4f6fa', stripe: '#f07b2c', text: '#e0661a' },
};

export function trailerLogo(carrier: Carrier): THREE.Texture {
  return canvasTexture(`logo-${carrier}`, 512, 160, (g) => {
    const st = CARRIER_STYLE[carrier];
    g.clearRect(0, 0, 512, 160);
    g.fillStyle = st.text;
    if (carrier === 'WareTrack') cubeIcon(g, 70, 80, 42, st.text);
    else if (carrier === 'Bluepeak') {
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(30, 118); g.lineTo(78, 40); g.lineTo(104, 82); g.lineTo(118, 64); g.lineTo(150, 118); g.closePath(); g.fill();
    } else if (carrier === 'Nordline') {
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(30, 118); g.lineTo(62, 44); g.lineTo(84, 92); g.lineTo(110, 44); g.lineTo(140, 118); g.closePath(); g.fill();
    } else {
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { g.fillRect(36, 52 + i * 24, 90 - i * 18, 13); }
    }
    const label = carrier === 'WareTrack' ? 'CargoVerse' : carrier;
    let size = 74;
    g.font = `bold ${size}px Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`;
    while (size > 40 && g.measureText(label).width > 340) { size -= 2; g.font = `bold ${size}px Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`; }
    g.textBaseline = 'middle';
    g.fillText(label, 160, 84);
  });
}

export function glassTexture(): THREE.Texture {
  const t = canvasTexture('glass', 128, 128, (g) => {
    g.fillStyle = '#3f6fe9';

    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)';
    g.lineWidth = 4;
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(i * 32, 0); g.lineTo(i * 32, 128); g.stroke(); }
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, i * 32); g.lineTo(128, i * 32); g.stroke(); }
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';

export function containerTexture(color: string): THREE.Texture {

export function glowTexture(): THREE.Texture {
  return canvasTexture('glow', 128, 128, (g) => {

    grd.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(47,98,224,0.55)');
    grd.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(47,98,224,0)');
    g.fillStyle = grd;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
  });
}

export function lookColors(look: PalletLook): { main: string; dark: string } {
  if (look === 'blue') return { main: C.crate, dark: C.crateDark };
  if (look === 'white') return { main: C.wrap, dark: '#d9e0ec' };
  return { main: C.cardboard, dark: C.cardboardDark };
}

export function roadSign(title: string, sub: string, arrow: 'left' | 'right' | 'up'): THREE.Texture {
  return canvasTexture(`rsign-${title}-${sub}-${arrow}`, 640, 220, (g) => {
    g.fillStyle = '#1f7a4d';
    g.beginPath(); g.roundRect(0, 0, 640, 220, 20); g.fill();
    g.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; g.lineWidth = 6;
    g.beginPath(); g.roundRect(10, 10, 620, 200, 14); g.stroke();
    g.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    g.font = 'bold 64px Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif';
    g.textBaseline = 'middle';
    const ax = arrow === 'left' ? 70 : 570;
    g.textAlign = arrow === 'left' ? 'left' : 'right';
    g.fillText(title, arrow === 'left' ? 140 : 500, 82);
    g.font = '38px Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif';
    g.fillText(sub, arrow === 'left' ? 140 : 500, 152);
    g.beginPath();
    if (arrow === 'left') { g.moveTo(ax - 40, 110); g.lineTo(ax + 20, 60); g.lineTo(ax + 20, 160); }
    else if (arrow === 'right') { g.moveTo(ax + 40, 110); g.lineTo(ax - 20, 60); g.lineTo(ax - 20, 160); }
    else { g.moveTo(ax, 50); g.lineTo(ax - 45, 120); g.lineTo(ax + 45, 120); }
    g.closePath(); g.fill();
  });
}

// Procedural 3D models for vehicles, cargo and props.
import { forwardRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { Carrier, PalletLook } from '../data/types';
import { C, mat, trailerLogo, CARRIER_STYLE, lookColors, containerTexture } from './materials';

type V3 = [number, number, number];

export function Box({ p, s, c, shadow = true, m }: { p: V3; s: V3; c?: string; shadow?: boolean; m?: THREE.Material }) {
  return (
    <mesh position={p} castShadow={shadow} receiveShadow material={m ?? mat(c ?? '#ffffff')}>
      <boxGeometry args={s} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function Wheel({ p, r = 0.52, w = 0.36 }: { p: V3; r?: number; w?: number }) {
  return (
    <mesh position={p} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} castShadow material={mat(C.tire, { rough: 0.9 })}>
      <cylinderGeometry args={[r, r, w, 14]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

/** Truck facing +x, origin at the centre of its footprint on the ground. Length ~12. */
export function TruckModel({ carrier }: { carrier: Carrier }) {
  const st = CARRIER_STYLE[carrier];
  const logo = useMemo(() => trailerLogo(carrier), [carrier]);
  const logoMat = useMemo(() => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: logo, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }), [logo]);
  return (
    <group>
      {/* chassis */}
      <Box p={[-0.2, 0.8, 0]} s={[11.6, 0.34, 2.2]} c={C.steel} />
      {/* trailer */}
      <Box p={[-1.55, 2.75, 0]} s={[8.9, 3.3, 2.6]} c={C.white} />
      <Box p={[-1.55, 1.45, 0]} s={[8.92, 0.75, 2.64]} c={st.stripe} shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[-1.55, 4.43, 0]} s={[8.95, 0.08, 2.64]} c={C.wallGrey} shadow={false} />
      {/* rear doors frame */}
      <Box p={[-6.02, 2.75, 0]} s={[0.06, 3.3, 2.5]} c={C.wallGrey} shadow={false} />
      {/* logos */}
      <mesh position={[-1.4, 3.05, 1.311]} material={logoMat}>
        <planeGeometry args={[5.6, 1.75]} />
      </mesh>
      <mesh position={[-1.4, 3.05, -1.311]} rotation={[0, Math.PI, 0]} material={logoMat}>
        <planeGeometry args={[5.6, 1.75]} />
      </mesh>
      {/* cab */}
      <Box p={[4.5, 2.25, 0]} s={[2.7, 2.6, 2.5]} c={st.cab} />
      <Box p={[4.25, 3.75, 0]} s={[2.1, 0.45, 2.3]} c={st.cab} />
      <Box p={[5.87, 2.95, 0]} s={[0.05, 1.05, 2.2]} c={C.glass} shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[4.7, 2.95, 1.26]} s={[1.0, 0.85, 0.03]} c={C.glass} shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[4.7, 2.95, -1.26]} s={[1.0, 0.85, 0.03]} c={C.glass} shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[5.9, 1.25, 0]} s={[0.22, 0.45, 2.5]} c={C.steel} />
      <Box p={[5.98, 1.75, 0.85]} s={[0.04, 0.22, 0.45]} c="#fff6d6" shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[5.98, 1.75, -0.85]} s={[0.04, 0.22, 0.45]} c="#fff6d6" shadow={false} />
      {carrier !== 'WareTrack' && <Box p={[5.0, 2.05, 0]} s={[1.75, 0.18, 2.52]} c={st.stripe} shadow={false} />}
      {/* wheels */}
      {[4.6, -3.2, -4.4].map((x) => (
        <group key={x}>
          <Wheel p={[x, 0.52, 1.12]} />
          <Wheel p={[x, 0.52, -1.12]} />
        </group>
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}

/** Pallet with load, origin at the base centre. ~1.2 x 1.2. */
export function PalletModel({ look, layers = 2 }: { look: PalletLook; layers?: number }) {
  const { main, dark } = lookColors(look);
  const items: JSX.Element[] = [];
  if (look === 'white') {
    items.push(<Box key="w" p={[0, 0.16 + layers * 0.3, 0]} s={[1.12, layers * 0.6, 1.12]} c={main} />);
    items.push(<Box key="b" p={[0, 0.16 + layers * 0.6 + 0.02, 0]} s={[1.0, 0.04, 1.0]} c={dark} shadow={false} />);
  } else {
    for (let l = 0; l < layers; l++) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
          items.push(
            <Box key={`${l}-${i}-${j}`} p={[(i - 0.5) * 0.56, 0.16 + 0.27 + l * 0.54, (j - 0.5) * 0.56]} s={[0.53, 0.52, 0.53]} c={(i + j + l) % 2 ? main : dark} />,
          );
        }
      }
      if (look === 'cardboard') {
        items.push(<Box key={`t${l}`} p={[0, 0.16 + 0.535 + l * 0.54, 0]} s={[1.1, 0.012, 0.12]} c={C.cardboardDark} shadow={false} />);
      }
    }
  }
  return (
    <group>
      <Box p={[0, 0.07, 0]} s={[1.2, 0.14, 1.2]} c={C.wood} />
      {items}
    </group>
  );
}

          <group position={[1.75, 0.06, 0]}>

      {/* wheels */}
      <Wheel p={[0.55, 0.3, 0.58]} r={0.3} w={0.22} />
      <Wheel p={[0.55, 0.3, -0.58]} r={0.3} w={0.22} />

export function Rack() {

}

export function CrateStack() {
  const cells: V3[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) if (!(k === 1 && i === 2)) cells.push([i * 1.0, 0.45 + k * 0.85, j * 1.0]);
  return (
    <group>
      <Box p={[1.0, 0.07, 0.5]} s={[3.2, 0.14, 2.2]} c={C.wood} />
      {cells.map((p, n) => <Box key={n} p={[p[0], p[1] + 0.1, p[2]]} s={[0.92, 0.8, 0.92]} c={n % 3 ? C.crate : C.crateDark} />)}
    </group>
  );
}

export function ShippingContainer({ color }: { color: string }) {

      <boxGeometry args={[12, 2.8, 2.6]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}
