// Deterministic operations simulation. Mutates a WorldState in place.
// Every visible movement in the 3D scene is a consequence of these state changes.
import type {
  WorldState, Truck, Forklift, Spot, FacilityId, Vec2, Shipment, EntityRef,
} from '../data/types';
import { LAYOUTS } from '../data/layouts';
import { SKUS } from '../data/seed';
import {
  sampleAt, pathLength, legRoadIn, legYardIn, legReverseIn, legYardOut, legRoadOut, dockedPose,
  spotGeometry, forkliftRoute, homeRoute, FORK_SPEED, ROAD_SPEED, gateInDistance, gateOutDistance,
} from './paths';
import type { GateCode } from '../data/park';
import { stepPort, collectImport, deliverExport, newExportBox, type BoxMove } from './port';
import { stepRetail } from './retail';
import { vesselByPrefix } from '../data/city';

export const TIME_SCALE = 10; // simulated seconds per real second
export const LIFT_TIME = 1.4; // real seconds to pick / set down a pallet
export const TRUCK_KMH = 1.9; // display factor: scene units/s -> km/h
export const FORK_KMH = 2.6;
const INBOUND_TURNAROUND = 24;
const MAX_AWAY = 70; // real seconds a truck spends off the map (delivering / collecting)
const QUEUE_GAP = 16; // spacing of trucks waiting outside a site gate // real seconds a truck is away between inbound trips
const BOOK_WITHIN_SIM = 180; // book a dock when ETA is under 3 minutes

const lenCache = new WeakMap<Vec2[], number>();
export function cachedLength(pts: Vec2[]): number {
  let l = lenCache.get(pts);
  if (l === undefined) { l = pathLength(pts); lenCache.set(pts, l); }
  return l;
}

/** Business operations emitted by the simulation so a backend can persist them. */
export type StockReason = 'RECEIPT' | 'PUTAWAY' | 'PICK' | 'RETURN' | 'STORE_SHIP';
export type SimOp =
  | { k: 'stock'; facilityId: FacilityId; skuId: string; pallets: number; units: number; reason: StockReason; palletId?: string; shipmentId?: string; forkliftId?: string; t: number }
  | { k: 'event'; facilityId: FacilityId; t: number; text: string; ref?: EntityRef }
  | { k: 'docked'; truckId: string }
  | { k: 'workDone'; truckId: string }
  | { k: 'assigned'; forkliftId: string; truckId: string }
  | { k: 'released'; forkliftId: string; truckId: string | null }
  | { k: 'delivered'; shipmentId: string }
  | { k: 'gate'; gate: GateCode; direction: 'IN' | 'OUT'; trade: TradeType; truckId: string; facilityId: FacilityId; shipmentId: string; skuId: string; pallets: number; t: number }
  // container terminal: every box movement (ledger) and every ship's port call
  | { k: 'box'; move: BoxMove; containerNo: string; vesselId: string | null; berthId: string | null; craneId: string | null; truckId: string | null; facilityId: FacilityId | null; t: number }
  | { k: 'call'; phase: 'ARRIVE' | 'DEPART'; vesselId: string; berthId: string; voyage: string; discharged: number; loaded: number; t: number };

/** IMPORT = goods arriving into the park, EXPORT = goods leaving it, EMPTY = truck without cargo. */
export type TradeType = 'IMPORT' | 'EXPORT' | 'EMPTY';

let sink: ((op: SimOp) => void) | null = null;
export function setSimSink(fn: ((op: SimOp) => void) | null): void { sink = fn; }
const emit = (op: SimOp) => { if (sink) sink(op); };

export function pushEvent(w: WorldState, facilityId: FacilityId, text: string, ref?: EntityRef): void {
  emit({ k: 'event', facilityId, t: w.simTime, text, ref });
  w.events.unshift({ t: w.simTime, facilityId, text, ref });
  if (w.events.length > 40) w.events.length = 40;
  w.eventSeq += 1;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- trucks

function poseFromLeg(t: Truck): void {
  const leg = t.legs[t.legIdx];
  if (!leg) return;
  const s = sampleAt(leg.pts, t.legDist);
  t.pos = { x: s.x, z: s.z };
  t.heading = Math.atan2(s.dz, s.dx) + (leg.reverse ? Math.PI : 0);
}

function advanceTruck(t: Truck, dt: number): boolean {
  const leg = t.legs[t.legIdx];
  if (!leg) return true;
  const len = cachedLength(leg.pts);
  const remaining = len - t.legDist;
  const target = Math.min(leg.speed, 0.7 + remaining * 0.8);
  const dv = target - t.speed;
  t.speed += Math.max(-8 * dt, Math.min(3 * dt, dv));
  t.speed = Math.max(0.4, t.speed);
  t.legDist = Math.min(len, t.legDist + t.speed * dt);
  poseFromLeg(t);
  return t.legDist >= len - 1e-3;
}

export function truckRemaining(t: Truck): number {
  let rem = 0;
  for (let i = t.legIdx; i < t.legs.length; i++) {
    const len = cachedLength(t.legs[i].pts);
    rem += i === t.legIdx ? len - t.legDist : len;
  }
  return Math.max(0, rem);
}

/** Estimated simulated seconds until the truck reaches the gate (en route) or its dock. */
export function truckEtaSim(t: Truck): number {
  if (t.phase === 'en_route') return (truckRemaining(t) / ROAD_SPEED) * TIME_SCALE;
  if (t.phase === 'docking') return (truckRemaining(t) / 3.2) * TIME_SCALE;
  return 0;
}

function tryBook(w: WorldState, t: Truck): void {
  if (t.dockId) return;
  const want = t.direction === 'inbound' ? 'in' : 'out';
  const docks = Object.values(w.docks).filter((d) => d.facilityId === t.facilityId && !d.truckId && (d.kind === 'any' || d.kind === want));
  const d = docks[0];
  if (!d) return;
  d.truckId = t.id;
  t.dockId = d.id;
  pushEvent(w, t.facilityId, `${t.id} booked at ${d.name}`, { kind: 'truck', id: t.id });
}

function recordDelivery(w: WorldState, s: Shipment): void {
  s.deliveredAt = w.simTime;
  s.onTime = s.deliveredAt <= s.promisedAt;
  emit({ k: 'delivered', shipmentId: s.id });
  const f = w.facilities[s.facilityId];
  f.deliveries30d += 1;
  if (s.onTime) f.onTime30d += 1;
}

const OUT_CUSTOMERS: [string, string][] = [
  ['Liberty Supply Co.', 'Philadelphia, PA'], ['Harbor & Co.', 'Providence, RI'], ['Metro Office Supply', 'Hoboken, NJ'],
  ['Hudson Clinics', 'Jersey City, NJ'], ['Crestline Hardware', 'Stamford, CT'], ['Bayview Foods', 'Wilmington, DE'],
];
const IN_SUPPLIERS = ['Keystone Paper', 'Oakridge Market', 'Sunvale Grocers', 'Halcyon Retail', 'Atlas Furnishings', 'Brightline Medical'];
const SEA_BUYERS: [string, string][] = [
  ['Rotterdam Trading BV', 'Rotterdam, NL (by sea)'], ['Hanse Import GmbH', 'Hamburg, DE (by sea)'], ['Santos Comercial Ltda', 'Santos, BR (by sea)'],
  ['Lion City Supplies', 'Singapore, SG (by sea)'],
];
const SEA_SHIPPERS: Record<string, string> = {
  OSL: 'Maas Packaging BV', NDH: 'Nordic Workwear A/S', PCC: 'Straits Lighting Pte', BWL: 'Paulista Plásticos', OGW: 'Pearl River Office Co.',
};

function newCycle(w: WorldState, t: Truck): void {
  const n = w.nextShipment++;
  const fac = w.facilities[t.facilityId];
  const sku = fac.inventory[n % fac.inventory.length].skuId;
  const id = `SHP-${n}`;
  const now = w.simTime;
  const workSim = t.capacity * 100;
  const expectedArrival = now + 260 + 320;
  // sea freight: every other import comes in a container from the terminal, every third export leaves by ship
  let lane: Shipment['lane'] = 'ROAD';
  let containerNo: string | null = null;
  let [customer, destination] = t.direction === 'outbound'
    ? OUT_CUSTOMERS[n % OUT_CUSTOMERS.length]
    : [IN_SUPPLIERS[n % IN_SUPPLIERS.length], `${fac.id} ${fac.name}`];
  if (t.direction === 'inbound' && n % 2 === 0) {
    containerNo = collectImport(w, emit, t.id, t.facilityId);
    if (containerNo) {
      lane = 'SEA';
      const v = vesselByPrefix(containerNo);
      customer = `${SEA_SHIPPERS[containerNo.slice(0, 3)] ?? 'Overseas supplier'}${v ? ` · ex ${v.name}` : ''}`;
    }
  } else if (t.direction === 'outbound' && n % 3 === 0) {
    lane = 'SEA';
    containerNo = newExportBox(w);
    [customer, destination] = SEA_BUYERS[n % SEA_BUYERS.length];
  }
  const transitMinutes = t.direction === 'outbound' ? 24 + (n % 4) * 4 : 0;
  const s: Shipment = {
    id, truckId: t.id, facilityId: t.facilityId, direction: t.direction, customer, destination, skuId: sku, pallets: t.capacity,
    confirmedAt: now - 9000 + (n % 7) * 300,
    pickedAt: now - 3600 + (n % 5) * 240,
    loadedAt: t.direction === 'inbound' ? now - 1500 : null,
    transitAt: t.direction === 'inbound' ? now - 600 : null,
    deliveredAt: null,
    promisedAt: expectedArrival + workSim + transitMinutes * 60 + 900,
    transitMinutes,
    onTime: null,
    lane,
    containerNo,
  };
  w.shipments[id] = s;
  // keep the shipment table bounded
  const ids = Object.keys(w.shipments);
  if (ids.length > 60) {
    for (const old of ids.slice(0, ids.length - 60)) {
      if (!Object.values(w.trucks).some((tr) => tr.shipmentId === old)) delete w.shipments[old];
    }
  }
  t.shipmentId = id;
  t.skuId = sku;
  t.cargo = t.direction === 'inbound' ? t.capacity : 0;
  t.phase = 'en_route';
  t.lane = t.direction === 'inbound' ? lane : 'ROAD';
  t.legs = [legRoadIn(t.facilityId, t.lane)];
  t.legIdx = 0;
  t.legDist = 0;
  t.speed = ROAD_SPEED;
  t.dockId = null;
  t.forkliftId = null;
  poseFromLeg(t);
  pushEvent(w, t.facilityId, t.lane === 'SEA'
    ? `${t.id} left Port Newark with import container ${containerNo} for ${fac.id} (${id})`
    : `${t.id} en route to ${fac.id} with ${id}`, { kind: 'truck', id: t.id });
  // outbound trucks keep the trip's lane for the way out (sea exports go to the terminal)
  if (t.direction === 'outbound') t.lane = lane;
}

function passGate(w: WorldState, t: Truck, gate: GateCode): void {
  const inbound = gate === 'WEST';
  const trade: TradeType = t.cargo > 0 ? (inbound ? 'IMPORT' : 'EXPORT') : 'EMPTY';
  const f = w.facilities[t.facilityId];
  if (trade === 'IMPORT') { f.importsToday += 1; f.importPalletsToday += t.cargo; }
  if (trade === 'EXPORT') { f.exportsToday += 1; f.exportPalletsToday += t.cargo; }
  emit({ k: 'gate', gate, direction: inbound ? 'IN' : 'OUT', trade, truckId: t.id, facilityId: t.facilityId, shipmentId: t.shipmentId, skuId: t.skuId, pallets: t.cargo, t: w.simTime });
  const what = trade === 'EMPTY' ? 'empty' : `${trade.toLowerCase()} · ${t.cargo} pallets ${SKUS[t.skuId]?.name ?? ''}`.trim();
  pushEvent(w, t.facilityId, `${t.id} ${inbound ? 'checked in at the West Gate' : 'checked out at the East Gate'} (${what})`, { kind: 'truck', id: t.id });
}

/** Trucks for the same site queue outside its gate instead of stacking on one spot. */
function mustQueue(w: WorldState, t: Truck): boolean {
  const rem = truckRemaining(t);
  if (rem > QUEUE_GAP * 4) return false;
  let ahead = 0;
  for (const o of Object.values(w.trucks)) {
    if (o === t || o.facilityId !== t.facilityId) continue;
    if (o.phase === 'at_gate') ahead++;
    else if (o.phase === 'en_route' && (truckRemaining(o) < rem || (truckRemaining(o) === rem && o.id < t.id))) ahead++;
  }
  return ahead > 0 && rem <= QUEUE_GAP * ahead + 0.01;
}

function stepTruck(w: WorldState, t: Truck, dt: number): void {
  const lane = t.facilityId;
  switch (t.phase) {
    case 'en_route': {
      if (!t.dockId && truckEtaSim(t) < BOOK_WITHIN_SIM) tryBook(w, t);
      if (mustQueue(w, t)) { t.speed = 0; break; }
      const before = t.legDist;
      const arrived = advanceTruck(t, dt);
      const g = gateInDistance(t.facilityId, t.direction === 'inbound' ? t.lane : 'ROAD');
      if (before < g && t.legDist >= g) passGate(w, t, 'WEST');
      if (arrived) {
        t.phase = 'at_gate';
        t.speed = 0;
        pushEvent(w, t.facilityId, `${t.id} arrived at the gate`, { kind: 'truck', id: t.id });
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'at_gate': {
      t.speed = 0;
      if (!t.dockId) tryBook(w, t);
      if (t.dockId && !w.laneLock[lane]) {
        w.laneLock[lane] = t.id;
        t.legs = [legYardIn(t.facilityId, t.dockId), legReverseIn(t.facilityId, t.dockId)];
        t.legIdx = 0;
        t.legDist = 0;
        t.phase = 'docking';
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'docking': {
      if (advanceTruck(t, dt)) {
        if (t.legIdx < t.legs.length - 1) {
          t.legIdx += 1;
          t.legDist = 0;
          t.speed = 0;
        } else {
          t.phase = 'working';
          t.speed = 0;
          t.legs = [];
          if (w.laneLock[lane] === t.id) w.laneLock[lane] = null;
          const d = t.dockId ? w.docks[t.dockId] : null;
          if (d) d.trucksToday += 1;
          emit({ k: 'docked', truckId: t.id });
          pushEvent(w, t.facilityId, `${t.id} docked at ${d?.name ?? 'dock'}`, { kind: 'truck', id: t.id });
        }
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'working': {
      t.speed = 0;
      const done = t.direction === 'inbound' ? t.cargo <= 0 : t.cargo >= t.capacity;
      if (done) {
        const s = w.shipments[t.shipmentId];
        if (s) {
          if (t.direction === 'inbound') recordDelivery(w, s);
          else s.loadedAt = w.simTime;
        }
        t.phase = 'ready';
        emit({ k: 'workDone', truckId: t.id });
        pushEvent(w, t.facilityId, `${t.id} ${t.direction === 'inbound' ? 'unloaded' : 'loaded'} · ${t.capacity} pallets`, { kind: 'truck', id: t.id });
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'ready': {
      t.speed = 0;
      if (!w.laneLock[lane] && t.dockId) {
        w.laneLock[lane] = t.id;
        t.legs = [legYardOut(t.facilityId, t.dockId), legRoadOut(t.facilityId, t.direction === 'outbound' ? t.lane : 'ROAD')];
        t.legIdx = 0;
        t.legDist = 0;
        t.phase = 'departing';
        const d = w.docks[t.dockId];
        if (d && d.truckId === t.id) d.truckId = null;
        const s = w.shipments[t.shipmentId];
        if (t.direction === 'outbound') {
          if (s) s.transitAt = w.simTime;
          w.facilities[t.facilityId].outboundToday += 1;
        }
        pushEvent(w, t.facilityId, `${t.id} departed ${d?.name ?? ''}`.trim(), { kind: 'truck', id: t.id });
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'departing': {
      if (advanceTruck(t, dt)) {
        if (w.laneLock[lane] === t.id) w.laneLock[lane] = null;
        t.legIdx = 1;
        t.legDist = 0;
        t.phase = 'leaving';
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'leaving': {
      const before = t.legDist;
      const done = advanceTruck(t, dt);
      const g = gateOutDistance(t.facilityId);
      if (t.legIdx === 1 && before < g && t.legDist >= g) passGate(w, t, 'EAST');
      if (done) {
        t.phase = 'away';
        t.speed = 0;
        t.dockId = null;
        const s = w.shipments[t.shipmentId];
        if (t.direction === 'outbound' && t.lane === 'SEA' && s?.containerNo) {
          deliverExport(w, emit, s.containerNo, t.id, t.facilityId);
          pushEvent(w, t.facilityId, `${t.id} handed export container ${s.containerNo} to Port Newark for ${s.destination.replace(' (by sea)', '')}`, { kind: 'truck', id: t.id });
        }
        t.awayUntil = w.realTime + Math.min(MAX_AWAY, t.direction === 'outbound' && s ? (s.transitMinutes * 60) / TIME_SCALE : INBOUND_TURNAROUND);
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'away': {
      if (w.realTime >= t.awayUntil) {
        const s = w.shipments[t.shipmentId];
        if (t.direction === 'outbound' && s && s.deliveredAt === null) {
          recordDelivery(w, s);
          pushEvent(w, t.facilityId, `${s.id} delivered to ${s.destination}${s.onTime ? '' : ' (late)'}`, { kind: 'truck', id: t.id });
        }
        newCycle(w, t);
      }
      break;
    }
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- forklifts

function slotTaken(w: WorldState, fac: FacilityId, slot: number): boolean {
  for (const p of Object.values(w.pallets)) if (p.facilityId === fac && p.slot === slot) return true;
  for (const f of Object.values(w.forklifts)) {
    if (f.facilityId === fac && f.drop?.type === 'slot' && f.drop.slot === slot) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function stagedCount(w: WorldState, fac: FacilityId): number {
  return Object.values(w.pallets).filter((p) => p.facilityId === fac && p.slot !== null).length;
}

function adjustStock(
  w: WorldState, fac: FacilityId, skuId: string, pallets: number, units: number, reason: StockReason,
  refs: { palletId?: string; shipmentId?: string; forkliftId?: string } = {},
): void {
  const f = w.facilities[fac];
  const before = f.stock;
  f.stock = Math.max(0, f.stock + pallets);
  const line = f.inventory.find((l) => l.skuId === skuId);
  let du = 0;
  if (line) { const u0 = line.units; line.units = Math.max(0, line.units + units); du = line.units - u0; }
  const dp = f.stock - before;
  if (dp !== 0 || du !== 0) emit({ k: 'stock', facilityId: fac, skuId, pallets: dp, units: du, reason, t: w.simTime, ...refs });
}

function clock(simTime: number): string {
  const h = Math.floor(simTime / 3600) % 24, m = Math.floor(simTime / 60) % 60;
  return `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function spotPoints(w: WorldState, f: Forklift, spot: Spot) {
  return spotGeometry(f.facilityId, spot, w.trucks);
}

function planPath(w: WorldState, f: Forklift): void {
  f.pathDist = 0;
  if (f.task === 'to_home') {
    f.path = homeRoute(f.pos, LAYOUTS[f.facilityId].chargers[f.chargerId]);
    return;
  }
  const spot = f.task === 'to_pick' ? f.pick : f.drop;
  if (!spot) { f.path = [f.pos]; return; }
  const g = spotPoints(w, f, spot);
  f.path = forkliftRoute(f.pos, g.approach, g.target);
}

function moveForklift(f: Forklift, dt: number): boolean {
  const len = cachedLength(f.path);
  const remaining = len - f.pathDist;
  const vmax = f.palletId ? FORK_SPEED * 0.85 : FORK_SPEED;
  f.speed = Math.min(vmax, 0.5 + remaining * 1.2);
  f.pathDist = Math.min(len, f.pathDist + f.speed * dt);
  const s = sampleAt(f.path, f.pathDist);
  f.pos = { x: s.x, z: s.z };
  if (len > 0.01) {
    const target = Math.atan2(s.dz, s.dx);
    let d = target - f.heading;
    while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
    while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
    f.heading += d * Math.min(1, dt * 10);
  }
  f.battery = Math.max(0, f.battery - dt * 0.08);
  return f.pathDist >= len - 1e-3;
}

function findWork(w: WorldState, f: Forklift): boolean {
  const candidates = Object.values(w.trucks).filter((t) =>
    t.facilityId === f.facilityId && t.phase === 'working' && !t.forkliftId &&
    (t.direction === 'inbound' ? t.cargo > 0 : t.cargo < t.capacity));
  if (!candidates.length) return false;
  candidates.sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.pos.x - f.pos.x, a.pos.z - f.pos.z) - Math.hypot(b.pos.x - f.pos.x, b.pos.z - f.pos.z));
  const t = candidates[0];
  t.forkliftId = f.id;
  f.truckId = t.id;
  emit({ k: 'assigned', forkliftId: f.id, truckId: t.id });
  startCycle(w, f);
  return true;
}

function startCycle(w: WorldState, f: Forklift): void {
  const t = f.truckId ? w.trucks[f.truckId] : null;
  if (!t || !t.dockId) { release(w, f); return; }
  if (t.direction === 'inbound') {
    f.pick = { type: 'truck', truckId: t.id };
  } else {
    const staged = Object.values(w.pallets)
      .filter((p) => p.facilityId === f.facilityId && p.slot !== null && !p.featured && !p.reserved)
      .sort((a, b) => (a.skuId === t.skuId ? 0 : 1) - (b.skuId === t.skuId ? 0 : 1));
    const p = staged[0];
    if (p && p.slot !== null) {
      p.reserved = true;
      f.pick = { type: 'slot', slot: p.slot };
    } else {
      f.pick = { type: 'store', dockId: t.dockId };
    }
  }
  f.drop = null;
  f.task = 'to_pick';
  f.path = [];
}

function release(w: WorldState, f: Forklift): void {
  emit({ k: 'released', forkliftId: f.id, truckId: f.truckId });
  if (f.truckId) {
    const t = w.trucks[f.truckId];
    if (t && t.forkliftId === f.id) t.forkliftId = null;
  }
  f.truckId = null;
  f.pick = null;
  f.drop = null;
  f.task = 'to_home';
  f.path = [];
}

function doPick(w: WorldState, f: Forklift): void {
  const t = f.truckId ? w.trucks[f.truckId] : null;
  const spot = f.pick;
  if (!t || !spot) { release(w, f); return; }
  if (spot.type === 'truck') {
    if (t.cargo <= 0 || t.phase !== 'working') { release(w, f); return; }
    t.cargo -= 1;
    const sku = SKUS[t.skuId];
    const id = `PAL-${w.nextPallet++}`;
    w.pallets[id] = {
      id, facilityId: f.facilityId, skuId: sku.id, qty: sku.unitsPerPallet, weightKg: sku.kgPerPallet,
      lot: `L${2500 + (w.nextPallet % 9)}-${String(w.nextPallet % 1000).padStart(3, '0')}`,
      received: `Today, ${clock(w.simTime)}`, slot: null, forkliftId: f.id, featured: false, reserved: false,
    };
    f.palletId = id;
    let drop: Spot = { type: 'store', dockId: t.dockId ?? '' };
    const L = LAYOUTS[f.facilityId];
    if (stagedCount(w, f.facilityId) < Math.floor(L.slots.length * 0.55)) {
      const free = L.slots.findIndex((_, i) => !slotTaken(w, f.facilityId, i));
      if (free >= 0) drop = { type: 'slot', slot: free };
    }
    f.drop = drop;
  } else if (spot.type === 'slot') {
    const p = Object.values(w.pallets).find((pp) => pp.facilityId === f.facilityId && pp.slot === spot.slot);
    if (!p) { startCycle(w, f); return; }
    p.slot = null;
    p.reserved = false;
    p.forkliftId = f.id;
    f.palletId = p.id;
    adjustStock(w, f.facilityId, p.skuId, -1, -p.qty, 'PICK', { palletId: p.id, shipmentId: t.shipmentId, forkliftId: f.id });
    f.drop = { type: 'truck', truckId: t.id };
  } else {
    const sku = SKUS[t.skuId];
    const id = `PAL-${w.nextPallet++}`;
    w.pallets[id] = {
      id, facilityId: f.facilityId, skuId: sku.id, qty: sku.unitsPerPallet, weightKg: sku.kgPerPallet,
      lot: `L${2500 + (w.nextPallet % 9)}-${String(w.nextPallet % 1000).padStart(3, '0')}`,
      received: 'In stock', slot: null, forkliftId: f.id, featured: false, reserved: false,
    };
    f.palletId = id;
    adjustStock(w, f.facilityId, sku.id, -1, -sku.unitsPerPallet, 'PICK', { palletId: id, shipmentId: t.shipmentId, forkliftId: f.id });
    f.drop = { type: 'truck', truckId: t.id };
  }
  f.pick = null;
  f.task = 'to_drop';
  f.path = [];
}

function doDrop(w: WorldState, f: Forklift): void {
  const spot = f.drop;
  const p = f.palletId ? w.pallets[f.palletId] : null;
  const t = f.truckId ? w.trucks[f.truckId] : null;
  if (spot && p) {
    if (spot.type === 'truck') {
      const target = w.trucks[spot.truckId];
      if (target && target.phase === 'working' && target.cargo < target.capacity) {
        target.cargo += 1;
        delete w.pallets[p.id];
      } else {
        // truck left: put the pallet back into storage
        adjustStock(w, f.facilityId, p.skuId, 1, p.qty, 'RETURN', { palletId: p.id, forkliftId: f.id });
        delete w.pallets[p.id];
      }
    } else if (spot.type === 'slot') {
      p.slot = spot.slot;
      p.forkliftId = null;
      adjustStock(w, f.facilityId, p.skuId, 1, p.qty, 'RECEIPT', { palletId: p.id, shipmentId: t?.shipmentId, forkliftId: f.id });
    } else {
      adjustStock(w, f.facilityId, p.skuId, 1, p.qty, 'PUTAWAY', { palletId: p.id, shipmentId: t?.shipmentId, forkliftId: f.id });
      w.facilities[f.facilityId].putawaysToday += 1;
      delete w.pallets[p.id];
    }
    f.movesToday += 1;
  }
  f.palletId = null;
  f.drop = null;
  const needsMore = t && t.phase === 'working' && (t.direction === 'inbound' ? t.cargo > 0 : t.cargo < t.capacity);
  if (needsMore && f.battery >= 25) startCycle(w, f);
  else release(w, f);
}

function stepForklift(w: WorldState, f: Forklift, dt: number): void {
  const charger = w.chargers[f.chargerId];
  switch (f.task) {
    case 'idle': {
      f.speed = 0;
      if (f.battery >= 30 && findWork(w, f)) break;
      if (f.battery < 90) {
        f.task = 'charging';
        if (charger) charger.sessionsToday += 1;
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'charging': {
      f.speed = 0;
      if (f.battery >= 80 && findWork(w, f)) break;
      const gain = ((charger?.ratePctPerMin ?? 8) / 60) * TIME_SCALE * dt;
      f.battery = Math.min(100, f.battery + gain);
      if (charger) charger.energyKwh += gain * 0.012;
      if (f.battery >= 100) f.task = 'idle';
      break;
    }
    case 'to_pick':
    case 'to_drop':
    case 'to_home': {
      if (!f.path.length) planPath(w, f);
      if (moveForklift(f, dt)) {
        f.speed = 0;
        if (f.task === 'to_home') {
          f.task = f.battery < 90 ? 'charging' : 'idle';
          if (f.task === 'charging' && charger) charger.sessionsToday += 1;
        } else {
          f.task = f.task === 'to_pick' ? 'lifting' : 'dropping';
          f.timer = LIFT_TIME;
        }
        f.path = [];
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'lifting':
    case 'dropping': {
      f.speed = 0;
      f.timer -= dt;
      if (f.timer <= 0) {
        if (f.task === 'lifting') doPick(w, f);
        else doDrop(w, f);
      }
      break;
    }
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- public

export function syncPoses(w: WorldState): void {
  for (const t of Object.values(w.trucks)) {
    if ((t.phase === 'working' || t.phase === 'ready') && t.dockId) {
      const p = dockedPose(t.facilityId, t.dockId);
      t.pos = p.pos;
      t.heading = p.heading;
    } else if (t.legs.length) {
      poseFromLeg(t);
    }
  }
}

export function stepWorld(w: WorldState, dtReal: number): void {
  const dt = Math.min(Math.max(dtReal, 0), 0.25);
  w.realTime += dt;
  w.simTime += dt * TIME_SCALE;
  if (w.simTime >= 86400) w.simTime -= 86400;
  for (const t of Object.values(w.trucks)) stepTruck(w, t, dt);
  for (const f of Object.values(w.forklifts)) stepForklift(w, f, dt);
  if (w.port) stepPort(w, dt, emit);
  if (w.retail) {
    stepRetail(w, dt, {
      emit,
      event: (fac, text, ref) => pushEvent(w, fac, text, ref),
      takeStock: (fac, skuId, units, orderId) => {
        const line = w.facilities[fac]?.inventory.find((l) => l.skuId === skuId);
        if (!line) return 0;
        const got = Math.min(units, line.units);
        if (got <= 0) return 0;
        line.units -= got;
        emit({ k: 'stock', facilityId: fac, skuId, pallets: 0, units: -got, reason: 'STORE_SHIP', shipmentId: orderId, t: w.simTime });
        return got;
      },
    });
  }
}

export { clock as formatClock };

// Polyline helpers shared by the simulation, the park model and the scene.
import type { Vec2 } from '../data/types';

/** Replace interior corners with smooth quadratic arcs of radius r. */
export function roundCorners(pts: Vec2[], r: number, steps = 7): Vec2[] {
  if (pts.length < 3) return pts.slice();
  const out: Vec2[] = [pts[0]];
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const p0 = pts[i - 1], p1 = pts[i], p2 = pts[i + 1];
    const l1 = Math.hypot(p1.x - p0.x, p1.z - p0.z);
    const l2 = Math.hypot(p2.x - p1.x, p2.z - p1.z);
    const rr = Math.min(r, l1 / 2, l2 / 2);
    if (rr < 0.01) { out.push(p1); continue; }
    const a = { x: p1.x - ((p1.x - p0.x) / l1) * rr, z: p1.z - ((p1.z - p0.z) / l1) * rr };
    const b = { x: p1.x + ((p2.x - p1.x) / l2) * rr, z: p1.z + ((p2.z - p1.z) / l2) * rr };
    for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
      const t = s / steps;
      const u = 1 - t;
      out.push({
        x: u * u * a.x + 2 * u * t * p1.x + t * t * b.x,
        z: u * u * a.z + 2 * u * t * p1.z + t * t * b.z,
      });
    }
  }
  out.push(pts[pts.length - 1]);
  // drop duplicate consecutive points
  return out.filter((p, i) => i === 0 || Math.hypot(p.x - out[i - 1].x, p.z - out[i - 1].z) > 1e-4);
}

export function pathLength(pts: Vec2[]): number {
  let L = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) L += Math.hypot(pts[i].x - pts[i - 1].x, pts[i].z - pts[i - 1].z);
  return L;
}

export interface Sample {
  x: number;
  z: number;
  dx: number;
  dz: number;
}

export function sampleAt(pts: Vec2[], d: number): Sample {
  let acc = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i - 1], b = pts[i];
    const seg = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
    if (seg <= 0) continue;
    if (acc + seg >= d || i === pts.length - 1) {
      const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (d - acc) / seg));
      return { x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, z: a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t, dx: (b.x - a.x) / seg, dz: (b.z - a.z) / seg };
    }
    acc += seg;
  }
  const p = pts[pts.length - 1] ?? { x: 0, z: 0 };
  return { x: p.x, z: p.z, dx: 1, dz: 0 };
}

/** Remaining polyline from distance d to the end (for route ribbons). */
export function remainingPts(pts: Vec2[], d: number): Vec2[] {
  const out: Vec2[] = [];
  let acc = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i - 1], b = pts[i];
    const seg = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
    if (acc + seg > d) {
      if (out.length === 0) {
        const t = Math.max(0, (d - acc) / (seg || 1));
        out.push({ x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, z: a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t });
      }
      out.push(b);
    }
    acc += seg;
  }
  return out;
}

// Route geometry for trucks and forklifts. Pure functions over layout data.
import type { Leg, Vec2, Spot, FacilityId, TradeLane } from '../data/types';
import {
  LAYOUTS, LANE_Z, FENCE_Z, ROAD_LANE_Z, TRUCK_STOP_Z, CORRIDOR_Z,
} from '../data/layouts';
import { parkRouteIn, parkRouteOut, toLocal, distanceAlong, PARK_GATES } from '../data/park';

export const ROAD_SPEED = 13; // public roads (highway, avenues, streets)
export const YARD_SPEED = 4;
export const REVERSE_SPEED = 3.0;
export const FORK_SPEED = 3.2;
export const FORK_REACH = 2.55; // distance from forklift centre to the pallet on its forks

export { roundCorners, pathLength, sampleAt, remainingPts, type Sample } from './geometry';
import { roundCorners } from './geometry';

const doorX = (fac: FacilityId, dockId: string) => LAYOUTS[fac].doors[dockId] ?? 0;

/** Highway → West Gate → street → site gate. Points are in the site's local coordinates. */
export function legRoadIn(fac: FacilityId, lane: TradeLane = 'ROAD'): Leg {
  const L = LAYOUTS[fac];
  const park = parkRouteIn(fac, L.gateX, ROAD_LANE_Z, FENCE_Z - 3, lane);
  return { pts: roundCorners(park.map((p) => toLocal(fac, p)), 8), reverse: false, speed: ROAD_SPEED };
}

/** Site exit → street → East Gate → highway (local coordinates). */
export function legRoadOutPts(fac: FacilityId, lane: TradeLane = 'ROAD'): Vec2[] {
  const L = LAYOUTS[fac];
  const park = parkRouteOut(fac, L.exitX, ROAD_LANE_Z, FENCE_Z - 3, lane);
  return roundCorners(park.map((p) => toLocal(fac, p)), 8);
}

const gateCache = new Map<string, number>();
/** Distance along the inbound road leg at which a truck passes the West Gate (imports in). */
export function gateInDistance(fac: FacilityId, lane: TradeLane = 'ROAD'): number {
  const k = `in:${fac}:${lane}`;
  let d = gateCache.get(k);
  if (d === undefined) { d = distanceAlong(legRoadIn(fac, lane).pts, toLocal(fac, PARK_GATES.WEST.lane)); gateCache.set(k, d); }
  return d;
}
/** Distance along the outbound road leg at which a truck passes the East Gate (exports out). */
export function gateOutDistance(fac: FacilityId): number {
  const k = `out:${fac}`;
  let d = gateCache.get(k);
  if (d === undefined) { d = distanceAlong(legRoadOutPts(fac), toLocal(fac, PARK_GATES.EAST.lane)); gateCache.set(k, d); }
  return d;
}

export function legYardIn(fac: FacilityId, dockId: string): Leg {
  const L = LAYOUTS[fac];
  const dx = doorX(fac, dockId);
  return {
    pts: roundCorners([{ x: L.gateX, z: FENCE_Z - 3 }, { x: L.gateX, z: LANE_Z }, { x: dx + 18, z: LANE_Z }], 7),
    reverse: false,
    speed: YARD_SPEED,
  };
}

export function legReverseIn(fac: FacilityId, dockId: string): Leg {
  const dx = doorX(fac, dockId);
  return {
    pts: roundCorners([{ x: dx + 18, z: LANE_Z }, { x: dx, z: LANE_Z }, { x: dx, z: TRUCK_STOP_Z }], 8, 10),
    reverse: true,
    speed: REVERSE_SPEED,
  };
}

export function legYardOut(fac: FacilityId, dockId: string): Leg {
  const L = LAYOUTS[fac];
  const dx = doorX(fac, dockId);
  return {
    pts: roundCorners(
      [{ x: dx, z: TRUCK_STOP_Z }, { x: dx, z: LANE_Z }, { x: L.exitX, z: LANE_Z }, { x: L.exitX, z: FENCE_Z - 3 }],
      7,
    ),
    reverse: false,
    speed: YARD_SPEED,
  };
}

const outCache = new Map<string, Vec2[]>();
export function legRoadOut(fac: FacilityId, lane: TradeLane = 'ROAD'): Leg {
  const k = `${fac}:${lane}`;
  let pts = outCache.get(k);
  if (!pts) { pts = legRoadOutPts(fac, lane); outCache.set(k, pts); }
  return { pts, reverse: false, speed: ROAD_SPEED };
}

export function dockedPose(fac: FacilityId, dockId: string): { pos: Vec2; heading: number } {
  return { pos: { x: doorX(fac, dockId), z: TRUCK_STOP_Z }, heading: Math.PI / 2 };
}

/** Target point (where the pallet sits) and approach point for a forklift spot. */
export function spotGeometry(fac: FacilityId, spot: Spot, trucks: Record<string, { dockId: string | null }>): {
  target: Vec2;
  approach: Vec2;
} {
  const L = LAYOUTS[fac];
  if (spot.type === 'slot') {
    const s = L.slots[spot.slot];
    return { target: s, approach: { x: s.x, z: s.z - 6 } };
  }
  if (spot.type === 'store') {
    const x = doorX(fac, spot.dockId) + L.storeOffset;
    return { target: { x, z: 0.2 }, approach: { x, z: 6.5 } };
  }
  const dockId = trucks[spot.truckId]?.dockId ?? Object.keys(L.doors)[0];
  const x = doorX(fac, dockId);
  return { target: { x: x + 1.5, z: 4.6 }, approach: { x: x + 7.5, z: 4.6 } };
}

export function forkliftRoute(from: Vec2, approach: Vec2, target: Vec2): Vec2[] {
  const dirx = target.x - approach.x, dirz = target.z - approach.z;
  const len = Math.hypot(dirx, dirz) || 1;
  const stop = { x: target.x - (dirx / len) * FORK_REACH, z: target.z - (dirz / len) * FORK_REACH };
  const pts: Vec2[] = [from];
  if (Math.abs(from.z - CORRIDOR_Z) > 0.5) pts.push({ x: from.x, z: CORRIDOR_Z });
  if (Math.abs(approach.x - from.x) > 0.5) pts.push({ x: approach.x, z: CORRIDOR_Z });
  pts.push(approach, stop);
  const clean = pts.filter((p, i) => i === 0 || Math.hypot(p.x - pts[i - 1].x, p.z - pts[i - 1].z) > 0.05);
  return roundCorners(clean, 2.2, 5);
}

export function homeRoute(from: Vec2, pad: Vec2): Vec2[] {
  const approach = { x: pad.x + 5, z: pad.z };
  const pts: Vec2[] = [from, { x: from.x, z: CORRIDOR_Z }, { x: approach.x, z: CORRIDOR_Z }, approach, pad];
  const clean = pts.filter((p, i) => i === 0 || Math.hypot(p.x - pts[i - 1].x, p.z - pts[i - 1].z) > 0.05);
  return roundCorners(clean, 2.2, 5);
}

FILE: waretrack/src/sim/port.ts

// Container terminal simulation: ships approach, wait at anchor for a free berth,
// berth, have their import boxes discharged and export boxes loaded by the quay
// cranes, then sail. Every container move is emitted for the database ledger.
import type { WorldState, Vessel, FacilityId, EntityRef } from '../data/types';
import {
  approachPath, berthingPath, departurePath, legLength, vesselPose, containerNo, voyageCode, vesselByPrefix,
  CRANE_CYCLE_S, SHIP_SPEED, LOCAL_PREFIX,
} from '../data/city';
import type { SimOp } from './engine';

type Emit = (op: SimOp) => void;
export type BoxMove = 'DISCHARGE' | 'LOAD' | 'GATE_OUT' | 'GATE_IN';

const EXT_EVERY = 6; // real seconds between hauliers / shippers not modelled as CargoVerse trucks

export function portLog(w: WorldState, text: string, ref?: EntityRef): void {
  w.port.log.unshift({ t: w.simTime, text, ref });
  if (w.port.log.length > 30) w.port.log.length = 30;
}

function box(w: WorldState, emit: Emit, move: BoxMove, no: string, o: { vessel?: Vessel; craneId?: string; truckId?: string; facilityId?: FacilityId } = {}): void {
  w.port.movesToday += move === 'DISCHARGE' || move === 'LOAD' ? 1 : 0;
  if (move === 'GATE_OUT') w.port.gateOutToday += 1;
  if (move === 'GATE_IN') w.port.gateInToday += 1;
  emit({
    k: 'box', move, containerNo: no, vesselId: o.vessel?.id ?? null, berthId: o.vessel?.berthId ?? null, craneId: o.craneId ?? null,
    truckId: o.truckId ?? null, facilityId: o.facilityId ?? null, t: w.simTime,
  });
}

/** A CargoVerse truck collects the oldest import box (returns its number, or null if the stack is empty). */
export function collectImport(w: WorldState, emit: Emit, truckId: string, facilityId: FacilityId): string | null {
  const no = w.port.importStack.shift();
  if (!no) return null;
  box(w, emit, 'GATE_OUT', no, { truckId, facilityId });
  const v = vesselByPrefix(no);
  portLog(w, `${truckId} collected ${no}${v ? ` (ex ${v.name})` : ''} for ${facilityId}`, { kind: 'truck', id: truckId });
  return no;
}

/** A CargoVerse truck drops an export box at the terminal. */
export function deliverExport(w: WorldState, emit: Emit, no: string, truckId: string, facilityId: FacilityId): void {
  w.port.exportStack.push(no);
  box(w, emit, 'GATE_IN', no, { truckId, facilityId });
  portLog(w, `${truckId} delivered export box ${no} from ${facilityId}`, { kind: 'truck', id: truckId });
}

export const newExportBox = (w: WorldState): string => containerNo(LOCAL_PREFIX, w.port.nextBox++);

function startVoyage(w: WorldState, v: Vessel): void {
  v.calls += 1;
  v.status = 'ARRIVING';
  v.dist = 0;
  v.berthId = null;
  v.importBoxes = 10 + ((v.calls * 7) % 7);
  v.exportTarget = 8 + ((v.calls * 5) % 6);
  v.exportBoxes = 0;
  v.discharged = 0;
  v.loaded = 0;
  v.waited = 0;
  v.arrivedAt = null;
  v.voyage = voyageCode(v.calls, v.calls % 2 === 0);
  portLog(w, `${v.name} (${v.voyage}) is approaching from ${v.origin} with ${v.importBoxes} boxes for this port`, { kind: 'vessel', id: v.id });
}

function canWork(w: WorldState, v: Vessel): 'discharge' | 'load' | null {
  const P = w.port;
  if (v.importBoxes > 0) return P.importStack.length < P.yardCapacity ? 'discharge' : null;
  const room = v.capacity - v.through - v.exportBoxes;
  if (v.exportBoxes < v.exportTarget && room > 0 && P.exportStack.length > 0) return 'load';
  return null;
}

export function stepPort(w: WorldState, dt: number, emit: Emit): void {
  const P = w.port;
  const vessels = Object.values(P.vessels);

  // berths go to the ship that has waited longest at anchor
  const waiting = vessels.filter((v) => v.status === 'ANCHORED' && !v.hold).sort((a, b) => b.waited - a.waited);
  for (const v of waiting) {
    const berth = Object.values(P.berths).find((b) => b.open && !b.vesselId);
    if (!berth) break;
    berth.vesselId = v.id;
    v.berthId = berth.id;
    v.status = 'BERTHING';
    v.dist = 0;
    portLog(w, `${v.name} cleared to ${berth.name} — pilots on board`, { kind: 'vessel', id: v.id });
  }

  for (const v of vessels) {
    switch (v.status) {
      case 'AT_SEA':
        if (!v.hold) v.timer -= dt;
        if (v.timer <= 0) startVoyage(w, v);
        break;
      case 'ARRIVING': {
        v.dist += SHIP_SPEED.approach * dt;
        if (v.dist >= legLength(approachPath(v.slot))) {
          v.status = 'ANCHORED';
          v.dist = 0;
          v.waited = 0;
          portLog(w, `${v.name} anchored in the bay, waiting for a berth`, { kind: 'vessel', id: v.id });
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'ANCHORED':
        v.waited += dt;
        break;
      case 'BERTHING': {
        v.dist += SHIP_SPEED.berthing * dt;
        if (v.dist >= legLength(berthingPath(v.slot, v.berthId ?? 'B1'))) {
          v.status = 'BERTHED';
          v.timer = 3; // lines made fast, lashing gangs aboard
          v.arrivedAt = w.simTime;
          P.callsToday += 1;
          emit({ k: 'call', phase: 'ARRIVE', vesselId: v.id, berthId: v.berthId ?? 'B1', voyage: v.voyage, discharged: 0, loaded: 0, t: w.simTime });
          portLog(w, `${v.name} alongside ${P.berths[v.berthId ?? 'B1']?.name ?? 'the quay'} — discharging ${v.importBoxes} boxes`, { kind: 'vessel', id: v.id });
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'BERTHED': {
        if (v.timer > 0) v.timer -= dt;
        const work = canWork(w, v);
        const busy = Object.values(P.cranes).some((c) => c.berthId === v.berthId && c.phase !== 'idle');
        // sail when there is nothing left to do (and the manager has not held the ship)
        if (!work && !busy && v.timer <= 0 && !v.hold && (v.importBoxes === 0)) {
          const berth = v.berthId ? P.berths[v.berthId] : null;
          emit({ k: 'call', phase: 'DEPART', vesselId: v.id, berthId: v.berthId ?? 'B1', voyage: v.voyage, discharged: v.discharged, loaded: v.loaded, t: w.simTime });
          portLog(w, `${v.name} sailed for ${v.nextPort} · ${v.discharged} off, ${v.loaded} on`, { kind: 'vessel', id: v.id });
          if (berth && berth.vesselId === v.id) berth.vesselId = null;
          v.status = 'DEPARTING';
          v.dist = 0;
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'DEPARTING': {
        v.dist += SHIP_SPEED.departure * dt;
        if (v.dist >= legLength(departurePath(v.berthId ?? 'B1'))) {
          v.status = 'AT_SEA';
          v.dist = 0;
          v.berthId = null;
          v.timer = 40 + ((v.calls * 13) % 40);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
    const p = vesselPose(v);
    v.pos = p.pos;
    v.heading = p.heading;
  }

  // quay cranes: one container per cycle, alternating between ship and quay
  for (const c of Object.values(P.cranes)) {
    const berth = P.berths[c.berthId];
    const v = berth?.vesselId ? P.vessels[berth.vesselId] : undefined;
    const ready = v && v.status === 'BERTHED' && v.timer <= 2.5;
    if (c.phase === 'idle') {
      const work = ready ? canWork(w, v!) : null;
      if (work) { c.phase = work; c.cycle = 0; }
      continue;
    }
    c.cycle += dt / CRANE_CYCLE_S;
    if (c.cycle < 1) continue;
    c.cycle = 0;
    if (!v || v.status !== 'BERTHED') { c.phase = 'idle'; continue; }
    if (c.phase === 'discharge' && v.importBoxes > 0 && P.importStack.length < P.yardCapacity) {
      v.importBoxes -= 1;
      v.discharged += 1;
      const no = containerNo(v.prefix, P.nextBox++);
      P.importStack.push(no);
      c.movesToday += 1;
      box(w, emit, 'DISCHARGE', no, { vessel: v, craneId: c.id });
      if (v.importBoxes === 0) portLog(w, `${v.name}: discharge complete (${v.discharged} boxes) — loading exports`, { kind: 'vessel', id: v.id });
    } else if (c.phase === 'load' && P.exportStack.length > 0 && v.exportBoxes < v.exportTarget) {
      const no = P.exportStack.shift()!;
      v.exportBoxes += 1;
      v.loaded += 1;
      c.movesToday += 1;
      box(w, emit, 'LOAD', no, { vessel: v, craneId: c.id });
    }
    v.timer = Math.max(v.timer, 2); // linger briefly after the last move
    const next = canWork(w, v);
    c.phase = next ?? 'idle';
  }

  // other hauliers and shippers keep the stacks moving
  P.extTimer += dt;
  if (P.extTimer >= EXT_EVERY) {
    P.extTimer = 0;
    if (P.importStack.length > 26) {
      const no = P.importStack.shift()!;
      box(w, emit, 'GATE_OUT', no);
    }
    if (P.exportStack.length < 18) {
      const prefixes = ['OSL', 'NDH', 'PCC', 'BWL', 'OGW'];
      const no = containerNo(prefixes[P.nextBox % prefixes.length], P.nextBox++);
      P.exportStack.push(no);
      box(w, emit, 'GATE_IN', no);
    }
  }
}

FILE: waretrack/src/sim/retail.ts

// Vendor stores in town sell stock off their shelves; when a line drops to its
// reorder point the store orders from a CargoVerse warehouse, a delivery van is
// loaded there (warehouse stock goes down), drives to the store, unloads (store
// stock goes up) and returns to its depot.
import type { WorldState, FacilityId, StoreOrder, DeliveryVan, EntityRef } from '../data/types';
import { SKUS } from '../data/seed';
import { vanPathOut, vanPathBack, vanDepot, legLength, VAN_SPEED, VAN_LOAD_S, VAN_UNLOAD_S } from '../data/city';
import { sampleAt } from './geometry';
import type { SimOp } from './engine';

export interface RetailHooks {
  emit: (op: SimOp) => void;
  event: (facilityId: FacilityId, text: string, ref?: EntityRef) => void;
  /** Take units off a warehouse inventory line (returns how many were available). */
  takeStock: (facilityId: FacilityId, skuId: string, units: number, orderId: string) => number;
}

const OPEN_STATUSES = new Set(['PLACED', 'LOADING', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY']);
const FACS: FacilityId[] = ['WH-01', 'WH-02', 'WH-04'];
const SIM_SPEED = 10; // simulated seconds per real second (TIME_SCALE)

export function retailLog(w: WorldState, text: string, ref?: EntityRef): void {
  w.retail.log.unshift({ t: w.simTime, text, ref });
  if (w.retail.log.length > 30) w.retail.log.length = 30;
}

const skuName = (id: string) => SKUS[id]?.name ?? id;

/** Warehouse that should supply an order: the store's usual one if it has the stock, else another that carries the item. */
export function chooseSupplier(w: WorldState, preferred: FacilityId, skuId: string, units: number): FacilityId | null {
  const has = (f: FacilityId) => (w.facilities[f]?.inventory.find((l) => l.skuId === skuId)?.units ?? 0) >= units;
  if (has(preferred)) return preferred;
  return FACS.find((f) => f !== preferred && has(f)) ?? null;
}

export function hasOpenOrder(w: WorldState, storeId: string, skuId: string): boolean {
  return Object.values(w.retail.orders).some((o) => o.storeId === storeId && o.skuId === skuId && OPEN_STATUSES.has(o.status));
}

/** Creates an order in the world (used by the automatic reorder and by managers in the UI). */
export function placeOrder(w: WorldState, o: { storeId: string; skuId: string; units: number; facilityId: FacilityId; source: 'AUTO' | 'MANUAL'; placedBy: number | null; id?: string }): StoreOrder {
  const id = o.id ?? `SO-${w.retail.nextOrder++}`;
  const order: StoreOrder = {
    id, storeId: o.storeId, facilityId: o.facilityId, skuId: o.skuId, units: o.units, status: 'PLACED', source: o.source,
    placedBy: o.placedBy, placedAt: w.simTime, dispatchedAt: null, deliveredAt: null, vanId: null,
  };
  w.retail.orders[id] = order;
  const store = w.retail.stores[o.storeId];
  retailLog(w, `${store?.name ?? o.storeId} ordered ${o.units} × ${skuName(o.skuId)} from ${o.facilityId} (${id}${o.source === 'MANUAL' ? ', manual' : ''})`, { kind: 'store', id: o.storeId });
  return order;
}

function setPose(v: DeliveryVan, pts: { x: number; z: number }[], d: number): void {
  const s = sampleAt(pts, d);
  v.pos = { x: s.x, z: s.z };
  v.heading = Math.atan2(s.dz, s.dx);
}

export function stepRetail(w: WorldState, dt: number, h: RetailHooks): void {
  const R = w.retail;
  const hour = Math.floor(w.simTime / 3600) % 24;
  const traffic = hour >= 7 && hour < 22 ? 1 : 0.15; // quiet overnight

  // shoppers buy from the shelves; low lines trigger a reorder
  for (const st of Object.values(R.stores)) {
    for (const line of st.lines) {
      line.acc += (line.salesPerHour * dt * SIM_SPEED * traffic) / 3600;
      const whole = Math.floor(line.acc);
      if (whole > 0) {
        line.acc -= whole;
        const sold = Math.min(whole, line.units);
        line.units -= sold;
        line.soldToday += sold;
      }
      if (line.units <= line.reorderAt && !hasOpenOrder(w, st.id, line.skuId)) {
        const units = Math.ceil((line.maxUnits - line.units) / 5) * 5;
        const fac = chooseSupplier(w, st.facilityId, line.skuId, units);
        if (fac) placeOrder(w, { storeId: st.id, skuId: line.skuId, units, facilityId: fac, source: 'AUTO', placedBy: null });
      }
    }
  }

  // dispatch waiting orders to free vans at the supplying warehouse (oldest first)
  const waiting = Object.values(R.orders).filter((o) => o.status === 'PLACED').sort((a, b) => a.placedAt - b.placedAt || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  for (const o of waiting) {
    const van = Object.values(R.vans).find((v) => v.facilityId === o.facilityId && v.status === 'IDLE');
    if (!van) continue;
    van.status = 'LOADING';
    van.timer = VAN_LOAD_S;
    van.orderId = o.id;
    van.storeId = o.storeId;
    van.dist = 0;
    setPose(van, vanPathOut(van.facilityId, o.storeId), 0);
    o.status = 'LOADING';
    o.vanId = van.id;
  }

  for (const v of Object.values(R.vans)) {
    const o = v.orderId ? R.orders[v.orderId] : undefined;
    switch (v.status) {
      case 'IDLE':
        break;
      case 'LOADING': {
        v.timer -= dt;
        if (v.timer > 0) break;
        if (!o || o.status === 'CANCELLED') { v.status = 'IDLE'; v.orderId = null; v.storeId = null; v.pos = vanDepot(v.facilityId); break; }
        const got = h.takeStock(v.facilityId, o.skuId, o.units, o.id);
        if (got <= 0) {
          o.status = 'CANCELLED';
          retailLog(w, `${o.id} cancelled — ${v.facilityId} is out of ${skuName(o.skuId)}`, { kind: 'store', id: o.storeId });
          v.status = 'IDLE'; v.orderId = null; v.storeId = null; v.pos = vanDepot(v.facilityId);
          break;
        }
        o.units = got;
        o.status = 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY';
        o.dispatchedAt = w.simTime;
        v.status = 'TO_STORE';
        v.dist = 0;
        const st = R.stores[o.storeId];
        h.event(v.facilityId, `${v.id} out for delivery: ${got} × ${skuName(o.skuId)} to ${st?.name ?? o.storeId} (${o.id})`, { kind: 'van', id: v.id });
        break;
      }
      case 'TO_STORE': {
        const pts = vanPathOut(v.facilityId, v.storeId ?? '');
        v.dist += VAN_SPEED * dt;
        setPose(v, pts, v.dist);
        if (v.dist >= legLength(pts)) { v.status = 'UNLOADING'; v.timer = VAN_UNLOAD_S; }
        break;
      }
      case 'UNLOADING': {
        v.timer -= dt;
        if (v.timer > 0) break;
        if (o && o.status === 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY') {
          const st = R.stores[o.storeId];
          const line = st?.lines.find((l) => l.skuId === o.skuId);
          if (line) line.units = Math.min(line.maxUnits + 20, line.units + o.units);
          if (st) st.deliveriesToday += 1;
          o.status = 'DELIVERED';
          o.deliveredAt = w.simTime;
          retailLog(w, `${v.id} delivered ${o.units} × ${skuName(o.skuId)} to ${st?.name ?? o.storeId}`, { kind: 'store', id: o.storeId });
        }
        v.tripsToday += 1;
        v.status = 'RETURNING';
        v.dist = 0;
        break;
      }
      case 'RETURNING': {
        const pts = vanPathBack(v.facilityId, v.storeId ?? '');
        v.dist += VAN_SPEED * dt;
        setPose(v, pts, v.dist);
        if (v.dist >= legLength(pts)) {
          v.status = 'IDLE';
          v.orderId = null;
          v.storeId = null;
          v.dist = 0;
          v.pos = vanDepot(v.facilityId);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // keep the in-memory order list bounded (history stays in the database)
  const ids = Object.keys(R.orders);
  if (ids.length > 70) {
    const done = Object.values(R.orders).filter((o) => !OPEN_STATUSES.has(o.status)).sort((a, b) => a.placedAt - b.placedAt);
    for (const o of done.slice(0, ids.length - 70)) delete R.orders[o.id];
  }
}

FILE: waretrack/src/store.ts

// Application state. The operations world lives in a mutable object (read every
// frame by the 3D scene); React UI re-renders on a throttled `tick`.
//
// Two modes:
//  - live:    signed in to the CargoVerse API. The server runs operations and stores
//             everything in Oracle; this client renders the live snapshots it streams.
//  - offline: no server reachable. A local demo runs in the browser (localStorage).
import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { WorldState, FacilityId, EntityRef } from './data/types';
import type { SessionUser, SimControl, DbLiveStatus } from './api/types';
import { dataSource } from './data/adapter';
import { createSeedWorld } from './data/seed';
import { stepWorld, syncPoses } from './sim/engine';
import { api, tokenStore, streamUrl, setUnauthorizedHandler } from './api/client';
import { findBuilding, findVehicle, setPark, syncParkClock } from './data/parkClient';
import { PARK_GATES, type GateCode } from './data/park';

export type FleetTab = 'docks' | 'forklifts' | 'trucks';
export type WorkTab = 'tasks' | 'alerts' | 'assistant' | 'activity' | 'team' | 'users' | 'reports' | 'trade' | 'port' | 'park' | 'database';
export type CameraCommand =
  | { kind: 'zoomIn' | 'zoomOut' | 'rotateLeft' | 'rotateRight' | 'home' | 'overview' }
  | { kind: 'focus'; ref: EntityRef };

let world: WorldState = createSeedWorld();
syncPoses(world);
export const getWorld = (): WorldState => world;

interface AppState {
  mode: 'live' | 'offline' | null;
  user: SessionUser | null;
  db: 'oracle' | 'memory' | null;
  connection: 'connecting' | 'live' | 'reconnecting';
  control: SimControl;
  versions: { tasks: number; audit: number; gate: number };
  /** Database write-through status from the live stream (null offline). */
  dbLive: DbLiveStatus | null;
  parkVersion: number;
  startView: 'park' | 'site';
  showPanels: boolean;
  togglePanels: () => void;
  ready: boolean;
  tick: number;
  facilityId: FacilityId;
  selection: EntityRef | null;
  hovered: EntityRef | null;
  fleetTab: FleetTab;
  follow: boolean;
  readEvents: number;
  cameraCmd: { seq: number; cmd: CameraCommand | null };
  timelineTruck: Record<string, string | null>;
  workOpen: boolean;
  workTab: WorkTab;
  toast: { id: number; text: string; tone: 'ok' | 'error' } | null;
  highlightSku: string | null;
  panelFocus: { section: 'inventory' | 'top'; seq: number };
  setHighlightSku: (sku: string | null) => void;
  focusPanel: (section: 'inventory' | 'top') => void;
  setFacility: (id: FacilityId) => void;
  select: (ref: EntityRef | null) => void;
  setHovered: (ref: EntityRef | null) => void;
  setFleetTab: (tab: FleetTab) => void;
  toggleFollow: () => void;
  camera: (cmd: CameraCommand) => void;
  markEventsRead: () => void;
  resetDemo: () => Promise<void>;
  openWork: (tab?: WorkTab) => void;
  closeWork: () => void;
  setControl: (c: Partial<SimControl>) => Promise<void>;
  notify: (text: string, tone?: 'ok' | 'error') => void;
  can: (perm: SessionUser['permissions'][number]) => boolean;
}

export const useApp = create<AppState>((set, get) => ({
  mode: null,
  user: null,
  db: null,
  connection: 'connecting',
  control: { paused: false, speed: 1 },
  versions: { tasks: 0, audit: 0, gate: 0 },
  dbLive: null,
  parkVersion: 0,
  startView: typeof location !== 'undefined' && new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('view') === 'site' ? 'site' : 'park',
  showPanels: true,
  togglePanels: () => set({ showPanels: !get().showPanels }),
  ready: false,
  tick: 0,
  facilityId: 'WH-01',
  selection: null,
  hovered: null,
  fleetTab: 'docks',
  follow: false,
  readEvents: 0,
  cameraCmd: { seq: 0, cmd: null },
  timelineTruck: {},
  workOpen: false,
  workTab: 'tasks',
  toast: null,
  highlightSku: null,
  panelFocus: { section: 'top', seq: 0 },
  setHighlightSku: (sku) => set({ highlightSku: sku }),
  focusPanel: (section) => set({ panelFocus: { section, seq: get().panelFocus.seq + 1 } }),
  setFacility: (id) => {
    if (id === get().facilityId) return;
    const u = get().user;
    if (u && !u.facilities.includes(id)) return;
    set({ facilityId: id, selection: null, follow: false, hovered: null, highlightSku: null });
    get().camera({ kind: 'home' });
  },
  select: (ref) => {
    const patch: Partial<AppState> = { selection: ref };
    if (!ref || (ref.kind !== 'truck' && ref.kind !== 'forklift')) patch.follow = false;
    if (ref?.kind === 'truck') {
      const t = world.trucks[ref.id];
      if (t) {
        patch.timelineTruck = { ...get().timelineTruck, [t.facilityId]: t.id };
        if (t.facilityId !== get().facilityId) patch.facilityId = t.facilityId;
      }
    } else if (ref && ref.kind !== 'facility') {
      const fac = facilityOf(ref);
      if (fac && fac !== get().facilityId) patch.facilityId = fac;
    } else if (ref?.kind === 'facility') {
      const u = get().user;
      if (!u || u.facilities.includes(ref.id as FacilityId)) patch.facilityId = ref.id as FacilityId;
    }
    if (patch.facilityId && get().user && !get().user!.facilities.includes(patch.facilityId)) delete patch.facilityId;
    set(patch);
  },
  setHovered: (ref) => set({ hovered: ref }),
  setFleetTab: (tab) => set({ fleetTab: tab }),
  toggleFollow: () => set({ follow: !get().follow }),
  camera: (cmd) => set({ cameraCmd: { seq: get().cameraCmd.seq + 1, cmd } }),
  markEventsRead: () => set({ readEvents: world.eventSeq }),
  resetDemo: async () => {
    if (get().mode !== 'offline') return;
    world = await dataSource.resetWorld();
    syncPoses(world);
    set({ selection: null, follow: false, facilityId: 'WH-01', fleetTab: 'docks', readEvents: 0, timelineTruck: {}, tick: get().tick + 1 });
    get().camera({ kind: 'home' });
  },
  openWork: (tab) => set({ workOpen: true, workTab: tab ?? get().workTab }),
  closeWork: () => set({ workOpen: false }),
  setControl: async (c) => {
    if (get().mode === 'live') {
      try {
        const next = await api.simControl(c);
        set({ control: next });
      } catch (e) {
        get().notify((e as Error).message, 'error');
      }
    } else {
      set({ control: { ...get().control, ...c } });
    }
  },
  notify: (text, tone = 'ok') => set({ toast: { id: Date.now(), text, tone } }),
  can: (perm) => {
    const u = get().user;
    // offline demo: no accounts, so only the dashboard and local operations controls are available
    if (get().mode === 'offline') return perm === 'VIEW_DASHBOARD' || perm === 'CONTROL_SIMULATION';
    return !!u && u.permissions.includes(perm);
  },
}));

export function facilityOf(ref: EntityRef): FacilityId | null {
  switch (ref.kind) {
    case 'facility': return ref.id as FacilityId;
    case 'truck': return world.trucks[ref.id]?.facilityId ?? null;
    case 'forklift': return world.forklifts[ref.id]?.facilityId ?? null;
    case 'pallet': return world.pallets[ref.id]?.facilityId ?? null;
    case 'dock': return world.docks[ref.id]?.facilityId ?? null;
    case 'charger': return world.chargers[ref.id]?.facilityId ?? null;
    case 'asset': { const f = ref.id.split('|')[0] as FacilityId; return world.facilities[f] ? f : null; }
    case 'building': return findBuilding(ref.id)?.facilityId ?? null;
    case 'van': return (world.retail?.vans[ref.id]?.facilityId as FacilityId | undefined) ?? null;
    case 'vehicle':
    case 'gate':
    case 'vessel':
    case 'crane':
    case 'berth':
    case 'store': return null;
  }
}

export function entityExists(ref: EntityRef | null): boolean {
  if (!ref) return false;
  switch (ref.kind) {
    case 'facility': return !!world.facilities[ref.id];
    case 'truck': return !!world.trucks[ref.id];
    case 'forklift': return !!world.forklifts[ref.id];
    case 'pallet': return !!world.pallets[ref.id];
    case 'dock': return !!world.docks[ref.id];
    case 'charger': return !!world.chargers[ref.id];
    case 'asset': return !!world.facilities[ref.id.split('|')[0]];
    case 'building': return !!findBuilding(ref.id);
    case 'vehicle': return !!findVehicle(ref.id);
    case 'gate': return !!PARK_GATES[ref.id as GateCode];
    case 'vessel': return !!world.port?.vessels[ref.id];
    case 'crane': return !!world.port?.cranes[ref.id];
    case 'berth': return !!world.port?.berths[ref.id];
    case 'store': return !!world.retail?.stores[ref.id];
    case 'van': return !!world.retail?.vans[ref.id];
  }
}

function restoreUi(ui: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof dataSource.loadUi>>, allowed: FacilityId[]) {
  const home = useApp.getState().user?.homeFacility;
  const facilityId = ui.facilityId && allowed.includes(ui.facilityId) ? ui.facilityId : home && allowed.includes(home) ? home : allowed[0];
  const sel = ui.selection && entityExists(ui.selection) && facilityOf(ui.selection) === facilityId ? ui.selection : null;
  return { facilityId, selection: sel, fleetTab: ui.fleetTab ?? 'docks', readEvents: ui.readEvents ?? 0 };
}

function saveUi() {
  const s = useApp.getState();
  void dataSource.saveUi({ facilityId: s.facilityId, selection: s.selection, fleetTab: s.fleetTab, readEvents: s.readEvents });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- live mode (API + Oracle)

/** Connects to the live operations stream. Resolves once the first snapshot arrives. */
export function startLive(user: SessionUser, db: 'oracle' | 'memory'): Promise<() => void> {
  useApp.setState({ mode: 'live', user, db, connection: 'connecting', ready: false });
  setUnauthorizedHandler(() => { void signOut(true); });
  // tenants, buildings and vehicles of the logistics park come from the database
  void api.park().then((p) => { setPark(p); useApp.setState({ parkVersion: useApp.getState().parkVersion + 1 }); }).catch(() => undefined);
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let es: EventSource | null = null;
    let closed = false;
    let first = true;
    let retry: number | undefined;
    const uiTimer = window.setInterval(saveUi, 3000);
    const connect = () => {
      es = new EventSource(streamUrl());
      es.addEventListener('snapshot', (ev) => {
        const d = JSON.parse((ev as MessageEvent<string>).data) as { world: WorldState; control: SimControl; versions: { tasks: number; audit: number; gate: number }; db?: DbLiveStatus };
        world = d.world;
        syncParkClock(world.realTime, d.control.paused, d.control.speed);
        const s = useApp.getState();
        const patch: Partial<AppState> = { control: d.control, versions: d.versions, connection: 'live', tick: s.tick + 1, dbLive: d.db ?? null };
        if (first) {
          first = false;
          Object.assign(patch, restoreUi(loadUiSync(), user.facilities), { ready: true });
          useApp.setState(patch);
          resolve(stop);
          return;
        }
        if (s.selection && !entityExists(s.selection)) patch.selection = null;
        useApp.setState(patch);
      });
      es.onerror = () => {
        if (closed) return;
        useApp.setState({ connection: 'reconnecting' });
        es?.close();
        // check whether the session is still valid before reconnecting
        retry = window.setTimeout(() => {
          api.me().then(() => { if (!closed) connect(); }).catch(() => { if (!closed) retry = window.setTimeout(connect, 3000); });
        }, 1500);
      };
    };
    const stop = () => {
      closed = true;
      es?.close();
      window.clearTimeout(retry);
      window.clearInterval(uiTimer);
      saveUi();
    };
    connect();
  });
}

let uiCache: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof dataSource.loadUi>> = {};
export async function preloadUi(): Promise<void> { uiCache = await dataSource.loadUi(); }
function loadUiSync() { return uiCache; }

let stopCurrent: (() => void) | null = null;
export function setStopper(fn: (() => void) | null) { stopCurrent = fn; }

export async function signOut(expired = false): Promise<void> {
  if (!expired) { try { await api.logout(); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
  tokenStore.clear();
  stopCurrent?.();
  stopCurrent = null;
  useApp.setState({ mode: null, user: null, ready: false, selection: null, workOpen: false, follow: false });
  if (expired) useApp.getState().notify('Your session has ended. Please sign in again.', 'error');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- offline demo mode

/** Runs the demo locally in the browser (used when no API server is reachable). */
export async function startOffline(): Promise<() => void> {
  world = await dataSource.loadWorld();
  syncPoses(world);
  const ui = await dataSource.loadUi();
  useApp.setState({ mode: 'offline', user: null, db: null, connection: 'live', ...restoreUi(ui, ['WH-01', 'WH-02', 'WH-04']), ready: true });

  let last = performance.now();
  let lastTick = 0;
  let lastSave = last;
  let raf = 0;
  const step = (dt: number) => {
    const c = useApp.getState().control;
    if (c.paused) return;
    let remaining = dt * c.speed;
    while (remaining > 1e-6) { const s = Math.min(0.2, remaining); stepWorld(world, s); remaining -= s; }
  };
  const loop = (now: number) => {
    step(Math.min(1, (now - last) / 1000));
    const ctl = useApp.getState().control;
    syncParkClock(world.realTime, ctl.paused, ctl.speed);
    last = now;
    const s = useApp.getState();
    if (s.selection && !entityExists(s.selection)) s.select(null);
    if (now - lastTick > 250) { lastTick = now; useApp.setState({ tick: s.tick + 1 }); }
    if (now - lastSave > 3000) { lastSave = now; persist(); }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  };
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  const bg = window.setInterval(() => {
    if (document.hidden) { const now = performance.now(); step(Math.min(1.5, (now - last) / 1000)); last = now; }
  }, 1000);
  const persist = () => { void dataSource.saveWorld(world); saveUi(); };
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', persist);
  return () => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    window.clearInterval(bg);
    window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', persist);
    persist();
  };
}

// AI agents in the Work panel: the exception watcher (Alerts) and the operations assistant (chat).
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Send, Crosshair, ClipboardPlus, AlertTriangle, BatteryLow, Clock3, PackageX, Ban, Wrench } from 'lucide-react';
import type { FacilityId, EntityRef } from '../data/types';
import { api, type Alert } from '../api/client';
import { useApp } from '../store';

const FAC: Record<FacilityId, string> = { 'WH-01': 'Riverside Hub', 'WH-02': 'Northgate DC', 'WH-04': 'Southfield Cross-Dock' };

function goTo(ref: EntityRef) {
  const s = useApp.getState();
  s.select(ref);
  setTimeout(() => s.camera(ref.kind === 'facility' ? { kind: 'home' } : { kind: 'focus', ref }), 30);
}

const KIND_ICON: Record<Alert['kind'], JSX.Element> = {
  late_shipment: <Clock3 size={14} />, low_battery: <BatteryLow size={14} />, gate_wait: <AlertTriangle size={14} />,
  low_stock: <PackageX size={14} />, blocked_task: <Ban size={14} />,
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- exception watcher

export function AlertsTab() {
  const user = useApp((s) => s.user)!;
  const notify = useApp((s) => s.notify);
  const version = useApp((s) => s.versions.tasks);
  const [facility, setFacility] = useState<FacilityId | 'ALL'>('ALL');
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState<Alert[] | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const canAssign = user.permissions.includes('MANAGE_TASKS');
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const load = () => api.alerts(facility === 'ALL' ? undefined : facility)
      .then((a) => { if (alive) { setAlerts(a); setError(null); } })
      .catch((e) => { if (alive) setError((e as Error).message); });
    load();
    const t = window.setInterval(load, 5000); // operations change continuously; re-scan every few seconds
    return () => { alive = false; window.clearInterval(t); };
  }, [facility, version]);
  const raise = async (a: Alert) => {
    setBusy(a.id);
    try {
      const t = await api.alertTask(a.id);
      notify(`Task created${t.assigneeName ? ` and assigned to ${t.assigneeName}` : ''}`);
    } catch (e) { notify((e as Error).message, 'error'); } finally { setBusy(null); }
  };
  const counts = { high: 0, medium: 0, low: 0 };
  for (const a of alerts ?? []) counts[a.severity]++;
  return (
    <div className="tab">
      <div className="toolbar">
        <select className="sel" value={facility} onChange={(e) => setFacility(e.target.value as FacilityId | 'ALL')} aria-label="Site">
          <option value="ALL">All my sites</option>
          {user.facilities.map((f) => <option key={f} value={f}>{f} · {FAC[f]}</option>)}
        </select>
        <span className="summary"><span className="sev sev-high">{counts.high} high</span><span className="sev sev-medium">{counts.medium} medium</span><span className="sev sev-low">{counts.low} low</span></span>
      </div>
      <p className="muted small hint">The exception watcher checks live operations every few seconds for late shipments, forklifts low on battery mid-job, trucks stuck at the gate, low stock and blocked tasks.</p>
      {error && <div className="err">{error}</div>}
      {alerts && !alerts.length && <div className="empty">All clear — nothing needs attention right now.</div>}
      <div className="alert-list">
        {(alerts ?? []).map((a) => (
          <div key={a.id} className={`card alert sev-${a.severity}`}>
            <span className={`alert-ico sev-${a.severity}`}>{KIND_ICON[a.kind]}</span>
            <div className="alert-main">
              <b>{a.title}</b>
              <span className="muted small">{a.detail}</span>
              <span className="alert-meta"><span className="fac-chip">{a.facilityId}</span>{a.suggestion && <span className="muted small"><Wrench size={11} /> Suggested: {a.suggestion.title}</span>}</span>
              <div className="alert-actions">
                {a.ref && <button className="btn-ghost sm" onClick={() => goTo(a.ref!)}><Crosshair size={13} /> Show</button>}
                {a.suggestion && canAssign && (
                  <button className="btn-primary sm" disabled={busy === a.id} onClick={() => raise(a)}><ClipboardPlus size={13} /> {busy === a.id ? 'Creating…' : 'Create task'}</button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- operations assistant

interface Msg { role: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string; tools?: string[]; error?: boolean }

const TOOL_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  get_site_overview: 'site KPIs', list_trucks: 'trucks', get_truck: 'truck details', list_forklifts: 'forklifts', list_alerts: 'alerts',
  list_tasks: 'tasks', list_team: 'team', get_imports_exports: 'imports/exports', list_park_tenants: 'park tenants', search: 'search', create_task: 'created a task', show_in_3d: 'showed it in 3D',
};

/** Tiny formatter for assistant replies: paragraphs, "- " bullets and **bold**. */
function Rich({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const bold = (s: string, key: string) => s.split(/(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)/g).map((part, i) =>
    part.startsWith('**') && part.endsWith('**') ? <b key={`${key}-${i}`}>{part.slice(2, -2)}</b> : <span key={`${key}-${i}`}>{part}</span>);
  const blocks: JSX.Element[] = [];
  let list: string[] = [];
  const flush = () => { if (list.length) { const items = list; blocks.push(<ul key={`ul${blocks.length}`}>{items.map((l, i) => <li key={i}>{bold(l, `li${i}`)}</li>)}</ul>); list = []; } };
  text.split('\n').forEach((line, i) => {
    const m = /^\s*(?:[-*•]|\d+\.)\s+(.*)$/.exec(line);
    if (m) { list.push(m[1]); return; }
    flush();
    if (line.trim()) blocks.push(<p key={`p${i}`}>{bold(line.replace(/^#+\s*/, ''), `p${i}`)}</p>);
  });
  flush();
  return <>{blocks}</>;
}

export function AssistantTab() {
  const user = useApp((s) => s.user)!;
  const facility = useApp((s) => s.facilityId);
  const storeKey = `waretrack.chat.${user.userId}`;
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ configured: boolean; model: string } | null>(null);
  const [msgs, setMsgs] = useState<Msg[]>(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(storeKey) ?? '[]') as Msg[]; } catch { return []; }
  });
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const endRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => { api.assistantStatus().then(setStatus).catch(() => setStatus({ configured: false, model: '' })); }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    try { sessionStorage.setItem(storeKey, JSON.stringify(msgs.slice(-30))); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    endRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
  }, [msgs, storeKey]);

  const manager = user.permissions.includes('MANAGE_TASKS');
  const suggestions = manager
    ? ['How is this site doing right now?', 'Which shipments are at risk of being late?', 'How many imports and exports today?', 'Who on the team has the most open work?']
    : ['What should I work on next?', 'Where is my forklift and how is its battery?', 'Which trucks are arriving soon?'];

  const ask = async (text: string, e?: FormEvent) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    const q = text.trim();
    if (!q || busy) return;
    const next: Msg[] = [...msgs, { role: 'user', content: q }];
    setMsgs(next);
    setInput('');
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const history = next.filter((m) => !m.error).map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }));
      const r = await api.assistant(history, facility);
      setMsgs([...next, { role: 'assistant', content: r.reply, tools: r.tools }]);
      for (const a of r.actions) if (a.type === 'focus') goTo(a.ref);
    } catch (err) {
      setMsgs([...next, { role: 'assistant', content: (err as Error).message, error: true }]);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="tab chat">
      {status && !status.configured && (
        <div className="setup-note">
          <b>Connect the assistant</b>
          <span>The assistant uses Claude through the Anthropic API. Add your key to the <code>.env</code> file in the project folder and restart the server:</span>
          <code className="block">ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-…</code>
          <span className="muted small">The key stays on the server — it is never sent to the browser. The exception watcher in the Alerts tab works without a key.</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="chat-log">
        {!msgs.length && (
          <div className="chat-empty">
            <Sparkles size={22} className="blue" />
            <b>Ask about live operations at {FAC[facility]}</b>
            <span className="muted small">Answers come from the same live data as the dashboard, limited to what your role can see.{manager ? ' It can also create tasks when you ask it to.' : ''}</span>
            <div className="chips">{suggestions.map((s) => <button key={s} className="chip-btn" onClick={() => ask(s)}>{s}</button>)}</div>
          </div>
        )}
        {msgs.map((m, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={`msg ${m.role} ${m.error ? 'error' : ''}`}>
            {m.role === 'assistant' ? <Rich text={m.content} /> : m.content}
            {m.tools && m.tools.length > 0 && (
              <span className="msg-tools">checked: {Array.from(new Set(m.tools)).map((t) => TOOL_LABEL[t] ?? t).join(' · ')}</span>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        {busy && <div className="msg assistant thinking"><span className="dots"><i /><i /><i /></span> Checking live operations…</div>}
        <div ref={endRef} />
      </div>
      <form className="chat-input" onSubmit={(e) => ask(input, e)}>
        <input value={input} onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)} placeholder="Ask about trucks, docks, stock, tasks…" maxLength={1000} aria-label="Ask the assistant" />
        <button className="btn-primary sm" type="submit" disabled={busy || !input.trim()} aria-label="Send"><Send size={14} /></button>
      </form>
      {msgs.length > 0 && <button className="link small clear-chat" onClick={() => setMsgs([])}>Clear conversation</button>}
    </div>
  );
}

// Work-panel tabs backed directly by Oracle: imports/exports through the park gates,
// the park tenant directory, and the Database workspace (schema browser, SQL console,
// saved report queries and the log of SQL the server runs).
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Database, Play, RefreshCw, Table2, Code2, Activity, ChevronRight, Search, Crosshair } from 'lucide-react';
import type { FacilityId } from '../data/types';
import type { GateEntry, TradeRow, DbOverview, DbTableDetail, SqlResult, SqlActivity, SavedQuery } from '../api/types';
import { api } from '../api/client';
import { useApp } from '../store';
import { getPark, findCompany } from '../data/parkClient';
import { GateRow } from './ParkPanels';

export function useData<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, deps: unknown[]) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [n, setN] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    fn().then((d) => { if (alive) { setData(d); setError(null); } }).catch((e) => { if (alive) setError((e as Error).message); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [...deps, n]);
  return { data, error, reload: () => setN((x) => x + 1) };
}

const fmtCell = (v: unknown): string => {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return '∅';
  if (typeof v === 'number') return Number.isInteger(v) ? String(v) : String(Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000);
  if (typeof v === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/.test(v)) return v.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19);
  return String(v);
};

function ResultTable({ columns, rows }: { columns: string[]; rows: unknown[][] }) {
  return (
    <div className="sql-grid">
      <table className="tbl sql-tbl">
        <thead><tr>{columns.map((c) => <th key={c}>{c}</th>)}</tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((r, i) => <tr key={i}>{r.map((v, j) => <td key={j} className={v === null ? 'null' : ''}>{fmtCell(v)}</td>)}</tr>)}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

    </div>
  );
}

export function ParkTab() {
