function SchemaBrowser({ o }: { o: DbOverview }) {
  const [table, setTable] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, DbOverview['tables']>();
    for (const t of o.tables) { if (!m.has(t.group)) m.set(t.group, []); m.get(t.group)!.push(t); }
    return [...m.entries()];
  }, [o]);
  if (table) return <TableDetail name={table} onBack={() => setTable(null)} onOpen={setTable} />;
  const invalid = o.objects.filter((x) => x.status === 'INVALID');
  return (
    <div className="schema">
      {groups.map(([g, tabs]) => (
        <div key={g} className="schema-group">
          <div className="rep-title">{g}</div>
          <div className="table-list">
            {tabs.map((t) => (
              <button key={t.name} className="table-row" onClick={() => setTable(t.name)} title={t.comment || t.name}>
                <Table2 size={13} className="muted" /><b>{t.name.toLowerCase()}</b><span className="muted small">{t.rows.toLocaleString()} rows</span><ChevronRight size={13} className="muted" />
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
      <div className="rep-title">Views, triggers and packages {invalid.length > 0 && <span className="badge sm tone-orange">{invalid.length} invalid</span>}</div>
      <div className="obj-list">
        {o.objects.map((x) => (
          <span key={x.type + x.name} className={`obj ${x.status === 'VALID' ? 'ok' : x.status === 'INVALID' ? 'bad' : ''}`} title={`${x.type} · ${x.status}`}>
            <span className="obj-type">{x.type === 'PACKAGE BODY' ? 'BODY' : x.type}</span>{x.name.toLowerCase()}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TableDetail({ name, onBack, onOpen }: { name: string; onBack: () => void; onOpen: (t: string) => void }) {
  const d = useData<DbTableDetail>(() => api.dbTable(name), [name]);
  return (
    <div className="schema">
      <button className="link small" onClick={onBack}>← All tables</button>
      <div className="rep-title"><code>{name.toLowerCase()}</code></div>
      {d.error && <div className="err">{d.error}</div>}
      {d.data && (
        <>
          <table className="tbl col-tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Column</th><th>Type</th><th>Null?</th><th>Default</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {d.data.columns.map((c) => (
                <tr key={c.name}>
                  <td><b>{c.name.toLowerCase()}</b>{d.data!.constraints.some((k) => k.type === 'PRIMARY KEY' && k.columns.split(',').includes(c.name)) && <span className="badge sm tone-blue">PK</span>}
                    {d.data!.constraints.some((k) => k.type === 'FOREIGN KEY' && k.columns.split(',').includes(c.name)) && <span className="badge sm tone-indigo">FK</span>}</td>
                  <td><code>{c.type}</code></td><td>{c.nullable ? 'yes' : <b>not null</b>}</td><td className="muted small">{c.defaultValue ?? ''}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
          <div className="rep-title">Constraints</div>
          <div className="cons-list">
            {d.data.constraints.map((k) => {
              const ref = k.type === 'FOREIGN KEY' ? /→\s*(\w+)/.exec(k.detail)?.[1] : null;
              return (
                <div key={k.name} className="cons">
                  <span className={`badge sm tone-${k.type === 'PRIMARY KEY' ? 'blue' : k.type === 'FOREIGN KEY' ? 'indigo' : k.type === 'UNIQUE' ? 'green' : 'grey'}`}>{k.type}</span>
                  <code>{k.name.toLowerCase()}</code>
                  <span className="muted small">{k.columns.toLowerCase()} {ref ? '' : k.detail}</span>
                  {ref && <button className="link small" onClick={() => onOpen(ref)}>{k.detail}</button>}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          {d.data.indexes.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <div className="rep-title">Indexes</div>
              <div className="cons-list">{d.data.indexes.map((i) => <div key={i.name} className="cons"><code>{i.name.toLowerCase()}</code><span className="muted small">{i.unique ? 'unique · ' : ''}{i.columns.toLowerCase()}</span></div>)}</div>
            </>
          )}
          <div className="rep-title">First rows</div>
          {d.data.sample.rows.length ? <ResultTable columns={d.data.sample.columns} rows={d.data.sample.rows} /> : <div className="empty small">No rows.</div>}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SqlConsole() {
  const db = useApp((s) => s.db);
  const saved = useData<SavedQuery[]>(() => api.dbQueries(), []);
  const [sql, setSql] = useState('SELECT facility_id, name, imports_today, exports_today, pallet_balance\n  FROM v_trade_today\n ORDER BY facility_id');
  const [res, setRes] = useState<SqlResult | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const run = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try { setRes(await api.runSql(sql)); } catch (e) { setRes(null); setErr((e as Error).message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return (
    <div className="sql">
      <div className="sql-saved">
        <select className="sel" value="" onChange={(e) => { const q = saved.data?.find((x) => x.id === e.target.value); if (q) { setSql(q.sql); setRes(null); setErr(null); } }} aria-label="Saved queries">
          <option value="">Example queries from 05_reports.sql…</option>
          {(saved.data ?? []).map((q) => <option key={q.id} value={q.id}>{q.id}. {q.title}{q.description ? ` (${q.description})` : ''}</option>)}
        </select>
      </div>
      <textarea className="sql-input" spellCheck={false} value={sql} onChange={(e) => setSql(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => { if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); void run(); } }} aria-label="SQL statement" />
      <div className="sql-bar">
        <button className="btn-primary sm" disabled={busy || !sql.trim()} onClick={() => { void run(); }}><Play size={13} /> {busy ? 'Running…' : 'Run query'}</button>
        <span className="muted small">Read-only: one SELECT / WITH statement, run inside <code>SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY</code>, max 500 rows · Ctrl/⌘ + Enter</span>
      </div>
      {err && <div className="err sql-err">{err}{db !== 'oracle' ? '' : ''}</div>}
      {res && (
        <>
          <div className="muted small sql-meta">{res.rowCount} row{res.rowCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}{res.truncated ? ' (first 500)' : ''} · {res.ms} ms · recorded in the audit log</div>
          <ResultTable columns={res.columns} rows={res.rows} />
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SqlActivityLog() {
  const [all, setAll] = useState(false);
  const [n, setN] = useState(0);
  const log = useData<(SqlActivity & { source: string })[]>(() => api.dbActivity(all), [all, n]);
  useEffect(() => { const t = window.setInterval(() => setN((x) => x + 1), 3000); return () => window.clearInterval(t); }, []);
  return (
    <div className="sql-act">
      <div className="toolbar">
        <label className="chk"><input type="checkbox" checked={all} onChange={(e) => setAll(e.target.checked)} /> Include live-operations writes (every 2 s)</label>
        <span className="muted small">Statements this server sent to Oracle, newest first</span>
      </div>
      {log.data && !log.data.length && <div className="empty small">No SQL has run yet{useApp.getState().db !== 'oracle' ? ' — the server is not connected to Oracle' : ''}.</div>}
      <div className="act-list">
        {(log.data ?? []).map((a, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={`act ${a.ok ? '' : 'bad'}`}>
            <span className="muted small">{new Date(a.at).toLocaleTimeString()}</span>
            <code>{a.sql}</code>
            <span className="muted small">{a.ms} ms · {a.rows} row{a.rows === 1 ? '' : 's'}{a.source === 'sim' ? ' · ops' : ''}</span>
            {a.error && <span className="err small">{a.error}</span>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Search, ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Bell, RotateCcw, LogOut, ClipboardList, Pause, Play, Database, LogIn, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import type { FacilityId } from '../data/types';
import { getWorld, useApp, signOut } from '../store';
import { api } from '../api/client';
import { search, fmtClock, facilityHeadline, type SearchResult } from './derive';
import { LogoCube } from './icons';

function useDismiss<T extends HTMLElement>(open: boolean, close: () => void) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDown = (e: MouseEvent) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) close(); };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); };
    window.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDown); window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); };
  }, [open, close]);
  return ref;
}

function SearchBox() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const select = useApp((s) => s.select);
  const camera = useApp((s) => s.camera);
  const tick = useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const results = useMemo(() => search(getWorld(), q), [q, tick]);
  const ref = useDismiss<HTMLDivElement>(open, () => setOpen(false));

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
      if (e.key === '/' && tag !== 'INPUT' && tag !== 'TEXTAREA') { e.preventDefault(); input.current?.focus(); setOpen(true); }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, []);

  const choose = (r: SearchResult) => {
    select(r.ref);
    if (r.ref.kind === 'facility') camera({ kind: 'home' });
    else setTimeout(() => camera({ kind: 'focus', ref: r.ref }), 30);
    setOpen(false);
    setQ('');
    input.current?.blur();
  };

  return (
    <div className="search" ref={ref}>
      <Search size={16} className="search-ico" />
      <input
        ref={input}
        value={q}
        placeholder="Search sites, trucks, forklifts, pallets, shipments..."
        onChange={(e) => { setQ(e.target.value); setOpen(true); setActive(0); }}
        onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); setActive((a) => Math.min(results.length - 1, a + 1)); }
          if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); setActive((a) => Math.max(0, a - 1)); }
          if (e.key === 'Enter' && results[active]) choose(results[active]);
          if (e.key === 'Escape') { setOpen(false); input.current?.blur(); }
        }}
        aria-label="Search"
      />
      <kbd>/</kbd>
      {open && q.trim() && (
        <div className="dropdown search-results" role="listbox">
          {results.length === 0 && <div className="dd-empty">No matches for “{q}”</div>}
          {results.map((r, i) => (
            <button key={`${r.ref.kind}-${r.ref.id}`} className={`dd-item ${i === active ? 'active' : ''}`} onMouseEnter={() => setActive(i)} onClick={() => choose(r)}>
              <span className="dd-kind">{r.kind}</span>
              <span className="dd-main">
                <span className="dd-title">{r.title}</span>
                <span className="dd-sub">{r.sub}</span>
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

      <button className="profile" onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)} aria-expanded={open} aria-label="Account menu">
        <span className={`avatar-init ${user ? user.role.toLowerCase() : 'guest'}`}>{user ? user.fullName.split(' ').map((p) => p[0]).join('').slice(0, 2) : 'WT'}</span>
        <span className="profile-text">
          <span className="profile-name">{name}</span>
          <span className="profile-role">{role}</span>

              </div>

                <ClipboardList size={15} />

function LiveClock() {
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const control = useApp((s) => s.control);
  const connection = useApp((s) => s.connection);
  const can = useApp((s) => s.can);
  const setControl = useApp((s) => s.setControl);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const ref = useDismiss<HTMLDivElement>(open, () => setOpen(false));
  const t = getWorld().simTime;
  const allowed = can('CONTROL_SIMULATION');
  const state = connection === 'reconnecting' ? 'reconnecting' : control.paused ? 'paused' : 'live';
  const label = state === 'reconnecting' ? 'Reconnecting' : state === 'paused' ? 'Paused' : 'Live';
  return (
    <div className="live-wrap" ref={ref}>
      <button className={`live ${state}`} onClick={() => allowed && setOpen((o) => !o)} disabled={!allowed}
        title={allowed ? 'Operations clock — pause, resume or change speed' : 'Operations clock'} aria-expanded={open}>
        <span className="live-dot" />{label} <b>{fmtClock(t)}</b>{control.speed > 1 && <i className="speed">{control.speed}×</i>}
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="dropdown live-menu">
          <div className="dd-head">Operations clock</div>
          <button className="dd-item" onClick={() => { void setControl({ paused: !control.paused }); setOpen(false); }}>
            {control.paused ? <Play size={15} /> : <Pause size={15} />}
            <span className="dd-main"><span className="dd-title">{control.paused ? 'Resume operations' : 'Pause operations'}</span><span className="dd-sub">{control.paused ? 'Vehicles start moving again' : 'Freezes all trucks and forklifts for everyone'}</span></span>
          </button>
          <div className="speed-row">
            <span className="muted small">Speed</span>
            {[1, 2, 4].map((sp) => (
              <button key={sp} className={control.speed === sp ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => { void setControl({ speed: sp }); }}>{sp}×</button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function WorkButton() {
  const user = useApp((s) => s.user);
  const version = useApp((s) => s.versions.tasks);
  const openWork = useApp((s) => s.openWork);
  const workOpen = useApp((s) => s.workOpen);
  const closeWork = useApp((s) => s.closeWork);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    let alive = true;
    api.tasks({ scope: 'mine' }).then((t) => { if (alive) setCount(t.filter((x) => x.status === 'ASSIGNED' || x.status === 'IN_PROGRESS' || x.status === 'BLOCKED').length); }).catch(() => undefined);
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [user, version]);
  if (!user) return null;

    </button>
  );
}

interface Props {
  serverDown: boolean;
  db: 'oracle' | 'memory' | null;
  onLogin: (username: string, password: string, remember: boolean) => Promise<void>;
  onOffline: () => void;
  notice?: string | null;

export function LoginPage({ serverDown, db, onLogin, onOffline, notice }: Props) {
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [remember, setRemember] = useState(true);
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => { document.title = 'Sign in · CargoVerse'; return () => { document.title = 'CargoVerse'; }; }, []);

  const submit = async (e?: FormEvent) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    if (!username || !password) { setError('Enter your username and password'); return; }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await onLogin(username.trim(), password, remember);
    } catch (err) {
      setError((err as Error).message);
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="login">
      <section className="login-art" aria-hidden>
        <div className="login-brand"><LogoCube size={30} /> <span>CargoVerse</span></div>

        <ul className="login-points">
          <li><Database size={15} /> Stored in Oracle Database — tables, PL/SQL, triggers and views</li>
          <li><ShieldCheck size={15} /> Role-based access for administrators, managers and operators</li>
          <li><ClipboardList size={15} /> Tasks, status history and a full audit trail</li>
        </ul>
      </section>

      <section className="login-panel">
        <form className="login-card" onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
          <h2>Sign in</h2>
          <p className="muted">Use your CargoVerse account.</p>
          {notice && <div className="login-note">{notice}</div>}
          {serverDown && (
            <div className="login-warn">
              <WifiOff size={16} />
              <span>The CargoVerse server isn't reachable. Start it with <code>npm run dev</code>, or open the offline demo (no accounts, data stays in this browser).</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <label className="fld">
            <span>Username</span>
            <input autoFocus autoComplete="username" value={username} onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. alex.chen" />
          </label>
          <label className="fld">
            <span>Password</span>
            <span className="pw">
              <input type={show ? 'text' : 'password'} autoComplete="current-password" value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
              <button type="button" className="pw-eye" onClick={() => setShow((s) => !s)} aria-label={show ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}>
                {show ? <EyeOff size={16} /> : <Eye size={16} />}
              </button>
            </span>
          </label>

            <span>Keep me signed in on this device</span>
          </label>
          {error && <div className="login-err" role="alert">{error}</div>}
          <button className="btn-primary" type="submit" disabled={busy || serverDown}>

            {DEMO_ACCOUNTS.map((a) => {
              const Icon = ICON[a.icon];
              return (
                <button type="button" key={a.username} className={`demo-acc ${username === a.username ? 'on' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => { setUsername(a.username); setPassword(a.password); setError(null); }}>
                  <span className={`demo-ico ${a.icon}`}><Icon size={17} /></span>

          </div>
        </form>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function Bar({ value, tone = 'blue' }: { value: number; tone?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className={`bar tone-${tone}`}>
      <span style={{ width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value)) * 100}%` }} />

  );

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- shared helpers

function useOutside<T extends HTMLElement>(open: boolean, close: () => void) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const down = (e: MouseEvent) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) close(); };
    const key = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); };
    window.addEventListener('mousedown', down);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', key);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('mousedown', down); window.removeEventListener('keydown', key); };
  }, [open, close]);
  return ref;
}

/** Select an entity and bring it into view (facilities return to the site overview). */
export function goTo(ref: EntityRef): void {
  const s = useApp.getState();
  s.select(ref);
  setTimeout(() => s.camera(ref.kind === 'facility' ? { kind: 'home' } : { kind: 'focus', ref }), 30);
}

function useFlash(eventName: string): boolean {
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    let t: number | undefined;
    const on = () => { setFlash(true); window.clearTimeout(t); t = window.setTimeout(() => setFlash(false), 900); };
    window.addEventListener(eventName, on);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener(eventName, on); window.clearTimeout(t); };
  }, [eventName]);
  return flash;
}

export function KpiCards() {

interface Row { k: string; v: string; link?: boolean; ref?: EntityRef }

function PanelHead({ glyph, header, title, subtitle, focusRef, followable, closable }: {
  glyph: JSX.Element; header: string; title: string; subtitle: string; focusRef: EntityRef; followable?: boolean; closable?: boolean;
}) {
  const camera = useApp((s) => s.camera);
  const follow = useApp((s) => s.follow);
  const toggleFollow = useApp((s) => s.toggleFollow);
  const select = useApp((s) => s.select);
  return (
    <div className="ph">
      <div className="ph-glyph">{glyph}</div>
      <div className="ph-text">
        <div className="ph-kicker">{header}</div>
        <div className="ph-title">{title}</div>
        <div className="ph-sub">{subtitle}</div>
      </div>
      <div className="ph-actions">
        <button className="sq" title={focusRef.kind === 'facility' ? 'Reset view' : 'Locate in scene'} aria-label="Locate in scene"
          onClick={() => camera(focusRef.kind === 'facility' ? { kind: 'home' } : { kind: 'focus', ref: focusRef })}>
          <Crosshair size={15} />
        </button>
        {followable && (
          <button className={`sq ${follow ? 'on' : ''}`} title={follow ? 'Stop following' : 'Follow in scene'} aria-label="Follow" aria-pressed={follow} onClick={toggleFollow}>
            <ArrowUpRight size={15} />
          </button>
        )}
        {closable && (
          <button className="sq plain" title="Close" aria-label="Close" onClick={() => select(null)}><X size={15} /></button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Rows({ rows, onLink }: { rows: Row[]; onLink?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="kv">
      {rows.map((r) => (
        <div key={r.k} className="kv-row">
          <span className="kv-k">{r.k}</span>
          {r.ref ? (
            <button className="kv-v link" title={r.ref.kind === 'facility' ? 'Back to the site overview' : `Show ${r.v} in the yard`} onClick={() => goTo(r.ref!)}>{r.v}</button>
          ) : r.link && onLink ? (
            <button className="kv-v link" title="Show this shipment's tracking" onClick={onLink}>{r.v}</button>
          ) : <span className="kv-v">{r.v}</span>}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function SitePanel() {
  const facilityId = useApp((s) => s.facilityId);
  const panelFocus = useApp((s) => s.panelFocus);
  const highlight = useApp((s) => s.highlightSku);
  const setHighlight = useApp((s) => s.setHighlightSku);
  const setFleetTab = useApp((s) => s.setFleetTab);
  const focusPanel = useApp((s) => s.focusPanel);
  const [expand, setExpand] = useState<'outbound' | null>(null);
  const [invFlash, setInvFlash] = useState(false);
  const invRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const w = getWorld();
  const v = siteView(w, facilityId);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!panelFocus.seq || panelFocus.section !== 'inventory') return;
    invRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    setInvFlash(true);
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setInvFlash(false), 900);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [panelFocus]);
  const departures = expand === 'outbound'
    ? w.events.filter((e) => e.facilityId === facilityId && /departed|delivered|loaded/.test(e.text)).slice(0, 6) : [];
  const firstDock = docksOf(w, facilityId)[0];
  return (
    <>
      <PanelHead glyph={<WarehouseGlyph />} header={v.header} title={v.title} subtitle={v.subtitle} focusRef={{ kind: 'facility', id: facilityId }} />
      <div className="status-line"><Badge b={{ label: 'Operational', tone: 'green' }} /><span>{v.summary}</span></div>
      <div className="tiles">
        <button className="tile" title="Show inventory" onClick={() => focusPanel('inventory')}>
          <div className="tile-k">Stock on hand</div>
          <div className="tile-v">{fmtNum(v.stock)} <span>/ {fmtNum(v.capacity)}</span></div>
          <Bar value={v.stock / v.capacity} />
        </button>
        <button className="tile" title="Show the dock list" onClick={() => { setFleetTab('docks'); window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wt:fleet-flash')); }}>
          <div className="tile-k">Truck bays</div>
          <div className="tile-v">{v.baysBusy} <span>/ {v.baysTotal} busy</span></div>
          <Bar value={v.baysBusy / v.baysTotal} tone="green" />
        </button>
        <button className={`tile ${expand === 'outbound' ? 'on' : ''}`} title="Recent departures" aria-expanded={expand === 'outbound'} onClick={() => setExpand((x) => (x === 'outbound' ? null : 'outbound'))}>
          <div className="tile-k">Outbound today</div>
          <div className="tile-v">{v.outbound} <span>trucks</span></div>
        </button>
        <button className="tile" title="Show where pallets are put away" onClick={() => firstDock && goTo({ kind: 'asset', id: `${facilityId}|putaway|${firstDock.id}` })}>
          <div className="tile-k">Put-aways today</div>
          <div className="tile-v">{v.putaways} <span>pallets</span></div>
        </button>
      </div>
      {expand === 'outbound' && (
        <div className="mini-list">
          {departures.length === 0 && <div className="muted small">No departures yet in this session.</div>}
          {departures.map((e, i) => (
            <button key={i} className="mini-row" onClick={() => e.ref && goTo(e.ref)}>
              <span className="muted small">{fmtClock(e.t)}</span><span>{e.text}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="sec-head"><span>Inventory</span><span className="muted">units</span></div>
      <div className={`inv ${invFlash ? 'flash' : ''}`} ref={invRef}>
        {v.inventory.map((l) => {
          const on = highlight === l.sku.id;
          const pallets = on ? palletsOfSku(w, facilityId, l.sku.id) : [];
          return (
            <div key={l.sku.id}>
              <button className={`inv-row ${on ? 'on' : ''}`} aria-pressed={on} title={on ? 'Stop highlighting' : `Highlight ${l.sku.name} pallets in the yard`}
                onClick={() => setHighlight(on ? null : l.sku.id)}>
                <span className="inv-ico"><SkuGlyph icon={l.sku.icon} /></span>
                <span className="inv-name">{l.sku.name}</span>
                <span className="inv-units">{fmtNum(l.units)}</span>
                <Badge b={l.badge} small />
              </button>
              {on && (
                <div className="inv-pallets">
                  <span className="muted small">{pallets.length ? `${pallets.length} pallet${pallets.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} in the yard (ringed in orange); the rest is in storage` : 'No pallets of this product in the yard right now — all stock is in storage'}</span>
                  {pallets.map((p) => (
                    <button key={p.id} className="chip-btn" onClick={() => goTo({ kind: 'pallet', id: p.id })}>{p.id} · {palletLocation(w, p.id).replace(`${facilityId} · `, '')}</button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="sec-head"><span>Forklift fleet</span>
        <button className="link small" onClick={() => { setFleetTab('forklifts'); window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wt:fleet-flash')); }}>{v.fleet.working}/{v.fleet.total} working</button>
      </div>
      {v.fleet.lead && (
        <button className="fleet-lead" onClick={() => goTo({ kind: 'forklift', id: v.fleet.lead.id })}>
          <b>{v.fleet.lead.id}</b>
          <span className="fl-text">{v.fleet.leadText}</span>
          <Bar value={v.fleet.lead.battery / 100} tone="green" />
          <span className="muted">{Math.round(v.fleet.lead.battery)}%</span>
        </button>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export function InfoPanel() {
  const sel = useApp((s) => s.selection);
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const w = getWorld();
  const [pulse, setPulse] = useState(0);
  let body: JSX.Element;
  if (!sel || sel.kind === 'facility') {
    body = <SitePanel />;
  } else if (sel.kind === 'truck' && w.trucks[sel.id]) {
    const t = w.trucks[sel.id];
    const v = truckView(w, t);
    body = (
      <>
        <PanelHead glyph={<CarrierGlyph carrier={t.carrier} />} header={v.header} title={v.title} subtitle={v.subtitle} focusRef={sel} followable closable />
        <div className="status-line"><Badge b={v.badge} /><span>{v.activity}</span></div>
        <div className="prog"><Bar value={v.progress} tone={v.badge.tone === 'green' ? 'green' : 'blue'} /><span className="muted">{v.right}</span></div>
        <Rows rows={v.rows} onLink={() => { setPulse((p) => p + 1); window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wt:timeline-flash')); }} />
      </>
    );
  } else if (sel.kind === 'forklift' && w.forklifts[sel.id]) {
    const v = forkliftView(w, w.forklifts[sel.id]);
    body = (
      <>
        <PanelHead glyph={<ForkliftGlyph />} header={v.header} title={v.title} subtitle={v.subtitle} focusRef={sel} followable closable />
        <div className="status-line"><Badge b={v.badge} /><span>{v.activity}</span></div>
        <div className="prog"><Bar value={v.progress} tone={v.progress < 0.25 ? 'orange' : 'green'} /><span className="muted">{v.right}</span></div>
        <Rows rows={v.rows} />
      </>
    );
  } else if (sel.kind === 'pallet' && w.pallets[sel.id]) {
    const p = w.pallets[sel.id];
    const v = palletView(w, sel.id);
    body = (
      <>
        <PanelHead glyph={<SkuGlyph icon={SKUS[p.skuId].icon} size={30} />} header={v.header} title={v.title} subtitle={v.subtitle} focusRef={sel} closable />
        <div className="status-line"><Badge b={v.badge} /><span>{v.activity}</span></div>
        <Rows rows={v.rows} />
      </>
    );
  } else if (sel.kind === 'dock' && w.docks[sel.id]) {
    const v = dockView(w, w.docks[sel.id]);
    body = (
      <>
        <PanelHead glyph={<DockGlyph />} header={v.header} title={v.title} subtitle={v.subtitle} focusRef={sel} closable />
        <div className="status-line"><Badge b={v.badge} /><span>{v.activity}</span></div>
        <Rows rows={v.rows} />
      </>
    );
  } else if (sel.kind === 'charger' && w.chargers[sel.id]) {
    const v = chargerView(w, sel.id);
    body = (
      <>
        <PanelHead glyph={<ChargerGlyph />} header={v.header} title={v.title} subtitle={v.subtitle} focusRef={sel} closable />
        <div className="status-line"><Badge b={v.badge} /><span>{v.activity}</span></div>
        <Rows rows={v.rows} />
      </>
    );
  } else if (sel.kind === 'asset' && assetView(w, sel.id)) {
    const v = assetView(w, sel.id)!;
    body = (
      <>
        <PanelHead glyph={v.asset.type === 'putaway' ? <DockGlyph /> : <WarehouseGlyph />} header={v.header} title={v.title} subtitle={v.subtitle} focusRef={sel} closable />
        <div className="status-line"><Badge b={{ label: 'Yard asset', tone: 'indigo' }} /><span>{v.activity}</span></div>
        <Rows rows={v.rows} />
      </>
    );
  } else if (sel.kind === 'building' && sel.id === 'PB-PORT') {
    body = <TerminalPanel />;
  } else if (sel.kind === 'building' && isStoreBuilding(sel.id)) {
    body = <StorePanel id={isStoreBuilding(sel.id)!.id} />;
  } else if (sel.kind === 'building' && findBuilding(sel.id)) {
    body = <BuildingPanel id={sel.id} />;
  } else if (sel.kind === 'vessel' && w.port?.vessels[sel.id]) {
    body = <VesselPanel id={sel.id} />;
  } else if (sel.kind === 'berth' && w.port?.berths[sel.id]) {
    body = <BerthPanel id={sel.id} />;
  } else if (sel.kind === 'crane' && w.port?.cranes[sel.id]) {
    body = <CranePanel id={sel.id} />;
  } else if (sel.kind === 'store' && w.retail?.stores[sel.id]) {
    body = <StorePanel id={sel.id} />;
  } else if (sel.kind === 'van' && w.retail?.vans[sel.id]) {
    body = <VanPanel id={sel.id} />;
  } else if (sel.kind === 'vehicle' && findVehicle(sel.id)) {
    body = <VehiclePanel id={sel.id} />;
  } else if (sel.kind === 'gate') {
    body = <GatePanel code={sel.id as GateCode} />;
  } else {
    body = <SitePanel />;
  }
  return <aside className="panel info" data-pulse={pulse} aria-label="Details">{body}</aside>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- shipment tracking

const STEP_ICON: Record<TimelineStep['icon'], JSX.Element> = {
  order: <FileText size={14} />,
  picked: <ClipboardCheck size={14} />,
  box: <Package size={14} />,
  truck: <TruckIcon size={14} />,
  check: <Check size={14} />,
};

const STATE_TEXT: Record<TimelineStep['state'], string> = { done: 'Completed', current: 'In progress now', todo: 'Not started yet' };

export function ShipmentTracking() {
  const facilityId = useApp((s) => s.facilityId);
  const preferred = useApp((s) => s.timelineTruck[s.facilityId]);
  const sel = useApp((s) => s.selection);
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const flash = useFlash('wt:timeline-flash');
  const [step, setStep] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const popRef = useOutside<HTMLOListElement>(step !== null, () => setStep(null));
  const w = getWorld();
  const selTruck = sel?.kind === 'truck' ? sel.id : null;
  const t = defaultTimelineTruck(w, facilityId, selTruck ?? preferred);
  useEffect(() => setStep(null), [t?.id]);
  if (!t) return <section className="panel tracking"><div className="tr-head"><TruckIcon size={16} /> Shipment Tracking</div></section>;
  const tl = timeline(w, t);
  const card = timelineCard(w, t);
  const s = tl.shipment;
  const dock = t.dockId ? w.docks[t.dockId] : null;
  const detail = (st: TimelineStep): { text: string; ref: EntityRef | null; refLabel: string } => {
    switch (st.icon) {
      case 'order': return { text: s ? `Order ${s.id} for ${s.customer} · ${s.pallets} pallets of ${SKUS[s.skuId]?.name ?? s.skuId}` : '', ref: null, refLabel: '' };
      case 'picked': return { text: t.direction === 'outbound' ? 'Picked from storage at this site' : `Picked at the supplier (${s?.customer ?? ''})`, ref: null, refLabel: '' };
      case 'box': return { text: dock ? `At ${dock.name} with ${t.forkliftId ?? 'no forklift yet'}` : 'Loading happens at the origin', ref: t.forkliftId ? { kind: 'forklift', id: t.forkliftId } : dock ? { kind: 'dock', id: dock.id } : null, refLabel: t.forkliftId ?? dock?.name ?? '' };
      case 'truck': return { text: `${t.id} · ${t.driver} (${t.plate})`, ref: { kind: 'truck', id: t.id }, refLabel: t.id };
      case 'check': return { text: s ? `To ${s.destination} · promised by ${fmtClock(s.promisedAt)}` : '', ref: dock && t.direction === 'inbound' ? { kind: 'dock', id: dock.id } : { kind: 'truck', id: t.id }, refLabel: dock && t.direction === 'inbound' ? dock.name : t.id };
    }
  };
  return (
    <section className={`panel tracking ${flash ? 'flash' : ''}`} aria-label="Shipment tracking">
      <div className="tr-left">
        <div className="tr-head">
          <span className="tr-title"><TruckIcon size={16} className="blue" /> Shipment Tracking</span>
          <button className="link muted-link" title={`Show ${t.id} in the yard`} onClick={() => goTo({ kind: 'truck', id: t.id })}>{t.id} · {carrierName(t.carrier)}</button>
        </div>
        <ol className="steps" ref={popRef}>
          {tl.steps.map((st, i) => {
            const d = step === st.key ? detail(st) : null;
            return (
              <li key={st.key} className={`step ${st.state} ${step === st.key ? 'picked' : ''}`}>
                {i > 0 && <span className={`line ${tl.steps[i - 1].state === 'done' && st.state !== 'todo' ? 'done' : ''}`} />}
                <button className="node" title={`${st.label} — ${STATE_TEXT[st.state]}`} aria-expanded={step === st.key}
                  onClick={() => setStep((x) => (x === st.key ? null : st.key))}>{STEP_ICON[st.icon]}</button>
                <span className="step-label">{st.label}</span>
                <span className="step-time">{st.time}</span>
                {d && (
                  <div className="pop step-pop" role="dialog">
                    <b>{st.label}</b> <Badge b={{ label: STATE_TEXT[st.state], tone: st.state === 'done' ? 'green' : st.state === 'current' ? 'blue' : 'grey' }} small />
                    <span className="pop-sub">{st.time}</span>
                    <span className="pop-sub">{d.text}</span>
                    {d.ref && <button className="link small" onClick={() => { goTo(d.ref!); setStep(null); }}><Crosshair size={12} /> Show {d.refLabel}</button>}
                  </div>
                )}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      </div>
      <button className="tr-card" title={`Show ${t.id} in the yard`} onClick={() => goTo({ kind: 'truck', id: t.id })}>
        <TruckGlyph color={carrierColor(t.carrier)} w={44} />
        <span className="tr-card-text">
          <b>{card.id}</b>
          <span className="muted ellipsis">{card.to}</span>
          <Badge b={card.badge} small />
          <span className="muted small ellipsis" style={{ maxWidth: '100%' }}>{card.line}</span>
        </span>
        <ChevronRight size={16} className="muted" />
      </button>
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- fleet list

type SortKey = 'default' | 'status' | 'id';
const SORT_LABEL: Record<SortKey, string> = { default: 'Default order', status: 'By status', id: 'By name' };

export function FleetList() {
  const facilityId = useApp((s) => s.facilityId);
  const tab = useApp((s) => s.fleetTab);
  const setTab = useApp((s) => s.setFleetTab);
  const sel = useApp((s) => s.selection);
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const flash = useFlash('wt:fleet-flash');
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<SortKey>('default');
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const w = getWorld();
  const f = w.facilities[facilityId];
  const docks = docksOf(w, facilityId);
  const forks = forkliftsOf(w, facilityId);
  const busyDocks = docks.filter((d) => d.truckId).length;
  const working = forks.filter((x) => x.truckId).length;
  let rows: FleetRow[] = tab === 'docks' ? dockRows(w, facilityId) : tab === 'forklifts' ? forkliftRows(w, facilityId) : truckRows(w, facilityId);
  if (sort === 'status') rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => a.badge.label.localeCompare(b.badge.label) || a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
  if (sort === 'id') rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title, undefined, { numeric: true }));
  const nextSort = () => setSort((s) => (s === 'default' ? 'status' : s === 'status' ? 'id' : 'default'));
  const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key !== 'ArrowDown' && e.key !== 'ArrowUp') return;
    const buttons = Array.from(listRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('.fl-row') ?? []);
    if (!buttons.length) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const i = buttons.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement);
    const next = e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? Math.min(buttons.length - 1, i + 1) : Math.max(0, i < 0 ? 0 : i - 1);
    buttons[next].focus();
    buttons[next].click();
  };
  return (
    <section className={`panel fleet ${flash ? 'flash' : ''}`} aria-label="Fleet and equipment">
      <div className="fl-head">
        <button className="fl-ico" title={`${SORT_LABEL[sort]} — click to change`} aria-label={`Sort: ${SORT_LABEL[sort]}`} onClick={nextSort}>
          {sort === 'default' ? <Warehouse size={15} /> : <ArrowDownUp size={15} />}
        </button>
        <div className="tabs" role="tablist">
          <button role="tab" aria-selected={tab === 'docks'} className={tab === 'docks' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setTab('docks')}>Docks <span>{busyDocks}/{docks.length}</span></button>
          <button role="tab" aria-selected={tab === 'forklifts'} className={tab === 'forklifts' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setTab('forklifts')}>Forklifts <span>{working}/{forks.length}</span></button>
          <button role="tab" aria-selected={tab === 'trucks'} className={tab === 'trucks' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setTab('trucks')}>Trucks <span>{trucksOf(w, facilityId).length}</span></button>
        </div>
        <button className="fl-site" title="Site overview" onClick={() => goTo({ kind: 'facility', id: facilityId })}>{f.name}</button>
      </div>
      <div className="fl-rows" ref={listRef} onKeyDown={onKey} aria-label="Use the arrow keys to move through the list">
        {rows.map((r) => {
          const active = sel && sel.kind === r.ref.kind && sel.id === r.ref.id;
          return (
            <button key={r.key} className={`fl-row ${active ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => goTo(r.ref)}>
              <span className="fl-id"><b>{r.title}</b><span>{r.sub}</span></span>
              <span className={`fl-text ${r.muted ? 'muted' : ''}`}>{r.dot && <i className="dotm" />}{r.text}</span>
              <Badge b={r.badge} small />
              <span className="fl-right">
                {r.bar !== undefined && <Bar value={r.bar} tone={r.barTone ?? 'green'} />}
                <span className="muted">{r.right}</span>
              </span>
              <ChevronRight size={15} className="muted" />
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3D labels overlay

export function LabelsOverlay() {
  const facilityId = useApp((s) => s.facilityId);
  const sel = useApp((s) => s.selection);
  const hovered = useApp((s) => s.hovered);
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const specs = labelSpecs(getWorld(), facilityId, sel, hovered);
  const refs = useRef<Record<string, HTMLDivElement | null>>({});
  useEffect(() => {
    let raf = 0;
    const loop = () => {
      for (const [k, el] of Object.entries(refs.current)) {
        if (!el) continue;
        const a = anchors.get(k);
        if (!a || !a.on) { el.style.opacity = '0'; continue; }
        el.style.opacity = '1';
        el.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(a.x)}px, ${Math.round(a.y)}px) translate(-50%, -100%)`;
      }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, []);
  return (
    <div className="labels" aria-hidden>
      {specs.map((s) => (
        <div key={s.key} ref={(el) => { refs.current[s.key] = el; }} className={`tag ${s.tone}`}>
          <b>{s.text}</b>{s.chip && <span>{s.chip}</span>}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// Detail panels for the logistics park (tenant buildings, public vehicles, park gates)
// and the imports / exports KPI card. Records come from Oracle via /api/park.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { PARK_GATES, PARK_ROUTES, roadAt, type GateCode, type BuildingStatus, type ParkBuilding } from '../data/park';

const KIND_LABEL: Record<ParkBuilding['kind'], string> = {
  WAREHOUSE: 'Warehouse', PLANT: 'Manufacturing plant', OFFICE: 'Office building', COLD_STORE: 'Cold store', FUEL_STATION: 'Fuel & EV station',
  PARKING: 'Car park', GATEHOUSE: 'Gatehouse', SERVICES: 'Public services', TERMINAL: 'Container terminal',
  SUPERMARKET: 'Supermarket', STORE: 'Store', RESIDENTIAL: 'Apartments',
};
const STATUS_TONE: Record<BuildingStatus, string> = { OPERATING: 'green', MAINTENANCE: 'orange', VACANT: 'grey', CONSTRUCTION: 'yellow' };
const STATUS_TEXT: Record<BuildingStatus, string> = { OPERATING: 'Operating', MAINTENANCE: 'Maintenance', VACANT: 'Vacant', CONSTRUCTION: 'Under construction' };

export function Head({ icon, kicker, title, sub, focus, color }: { icon: JSX.Element; kicker: string; title: string; sub: string; focus: EntityRef; color?: string }) {
  const camera = useApp((s) => s.camera);
  const select = useApp((s) => s.select);
  return (
    <div className="ph">
      <div className="ph-glyph park-glyph" style={color ? { background: color } : undefined}>{icon}</div>
      <div className="ph-text">
        <div className="ph-kicker">{kicker}</div>
        <div className="ph-title">{title}</div>
        <div className="ph-sub">{sub}</div>
      </div>
      <div className="ph-actions">
        <button className="sq" title="Locate in scene" aria-label="Locate in scene" onClick={() => camera({ kind: 'focus', ref: focus })}><Crosshair size={15} /></button>
        <button className="sq plain" title="Close" aria-label="Close" onClick={() => select(null)}><X size={15} /></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function KV({ rows }: { rows: [string, React.ReactNode][] }) {
  return (
    <div className="kv">
      {rows.map(([k, v]) => <div key={k} className="kv-row"><span className="kv-k">{k}</span><span className="kv-v">{v}</span></div>)}
    </div>
  );
}

export function BuildingPanel({ id }: { id: string }) {
  useApp((s) => s.parkVersion);
  const can = useApp((s) => s.can);
  const notify = useApp((s) => s.notify);
  const mode = useApp((s) => s.mode);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const b = findBuilding(id);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ status: b?.status ?? 'OPERATING', staff: String(b?.staff ?? 0), leaseEnd: b?.leaseEnd ?? '' });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => { if (b) setForm({ status: b.status, staff: String(b.staff), leaseEnd: b.leaseEnd }); setEditing(false); }, [id]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  if (!b) return null;
  const c = findCompany(b.companyId);
  const area = Math.round(b.w * b.d * b.floors);
  const leaseYears = Math.max(0, (new Date(b.leaseEnd).getTime() - Date.now()) / (365.25 * 86400000));
  const save = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const updated = await api.updateBuilding(b.id, { status: form.status as BuildingStatus, staff: Number(form.staff), leaseEnd: form.leaseEnd });
      const p = getPark();
      setPark({ ...p, buildings: p.buildings.map((x) => (x.id === updated.id ? updated : x)) });
      useApp.setState({ parkVersion: useApp.getState().parkVersion + 1 });
      notify(`${b.name} updated — saved in the database and recorded in the audit trail`);
      setEditing(false);
    } catch (e) { notify((e as Error).message, 'error'); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Head icon={<Building2 size={20} />} kicker={`${KIND_LABEL[b.kind].toUpperCase()} · ${b.id}`} title={b.name} sub={`${c?.name ?? ''} · ${b.street}`} focus={{ kind: 'building', id: b.id }} color={c?.color} />
      <div className="status-line"><span className={`badge tone-${STATUS_TONE[b.status]}`}>{STATUS_TEXT[b.status]}</span><span>{c?.industry}</span></div>
      <p className="park-desc">{b.description}</p>
      <KV rows={[
        ['Tenant', c?.name ?? b.companyId],
        ['Contact', c ? `${c.contactName} · ${c.phone}` : '—'],
        ['Floor area', `${fmtNum(area)} m² · ${b.floors} floor${b.floors > 1 ? 's' : ''}`],
        ['Staff on site', b.kind === 'PARKING' ? '—' : fmtNum(b.staff)],
        ['Lease', `${b.leaseStart} → ${b.leaseEnd} (${leaseYears.toFixed(1)} years left)`],
      ]} />
      {mode === 'live' && can('MANAGE_PARK') && !editing && (
        <button className="btn-ghost sm park-edit" onClick={() => setEditing(true)}><Pencil size={13} /> Edit tenant record</button>
      )}
      {editing && (
        <div className="park-form">
          <label>Status
            <select className="sel" value={form.status} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, status: e.target.value as BuildingStatus })}>
              {(Object.keys(STATUS_TEXT) as BuildingStatus[]).map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{STATUS_TEXT[s]}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>Staff<input className="inp" type="number" min={0} value={form.staff} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, staff: e.target.value })} /></label>
          <label>Lease ends<input className="inp" type="date" value={form.leaseEnd} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, leaseEnd: e.target.value })} /></label>
          <div className="row-actions">
            <button className="btn-ghost sm" onClick={() => setEditing(false)}>Cancel</button>
            <button className="btn-primary sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { void save(); }}>{busy ? 'Saving…' : 'Save'}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export function VehiclePanel({ id }: { id: string }) {
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const v = findVehicle(id);
  if (!v) return null;
  const c = findCompany(v.companyId);
  const pose = vehicleNow(v);

  return (

      <div className="status-line"><span className={`badge tone-${paused ? 'grey' : 'green'}`}>{paused ? 'Stopped' : 'Driving'}</span><span>{roadAt(pose)}</span></div>
      <div className="prog"><span className="bar tone-blue"><span style={{ width: `${Math.round(pose.t * 100)}%` }} /></span><span className="muted">{Math.round(pose.t * 100)}% of route</span></div>
      <KV rows={[
        ['Owner', c?.name ?? 'Public (not a park tenant)'],
        ['Route', route.name],
        ['Speed', paused ? '0 km/h' : `${v.speedKmh} km/h`],
        ['Colour', <span key="c" className="swatch" style={{ background: v.color }} />],
      ]} />
    </>
  );
}

export function GatePanel({ code }: { code: GateCode }) {
  const g = PARK_GATES[code];
  const user = useApp((s) => s.user);
  const version = useApp((s) => s.versions.gate);
  const mode = useApp((s) => s.mode);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<GateEntry[] | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== 'live') return;
    let alive = true;
    api.gateLog({ limit: 40 }).then((r) => { if (alive) setRows(r.filter((x) => x.gate === code).slice(0, 8)); }).catch(() => setRows([]));
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [code, version, mode]);
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const w = getWorld();
  const facs = Object.keys(w.facilities) as FacilityId[];
  const trucks = facs.reduce((n, f) => n + (code === 'WEST' ? w.facilities[f].importsToday : w.facilities[f].exportsToday), 0);
  const pallets = facs.reduce((n, f) => n + (code === 'WEST' ? w.facilities[f].importPalletsToday : w.facilities[f].exportPalletsToday), 0);
  return (
    <>
      <Head icon={<ShieldCheck size={20} />} kicker={`PARK GATE · ${code}`} title={g.name} sub={code === 'WEST' ? 'Harbor Avenue · inbound lane' : 'Industrial Avenue · outbound lane'} focus={{ kind: 'gate', id: code }} color={code === 'WEST' ? '#2f9e44' : '#e8590c'} />
      <p className="park-desc">{g.purpose}</p>
      <div className="tiles">
        <div className="tile"><div className="tile-k">{code === 'WEST' ? 'Imports today' : 'Exports today'}</div><div className="tile-v">{trucks} <span>trucks</span></div></div>
        <div className="tile"><div className="tile-k">Pallets</div><div className="tile-v">{fmtNum(pallets)} <span>{code === 'WEST' ? 'in' : 'out'}</span></div></div>
      </div>
      <div className="sec-head"><span>Latest movements</span><span className="muted">{user ? (user.role === 'ADMIN' ? 'all sites' : user.facilities.join(', ')) : ''}</span></div>
      {mode !== 'live' && <div className="muted small">The gate log is stored in Oracle; sign in to the server to see it.</div>}
      <div className="gate-rows">
        {(rows ?? []).map((r) => <GateRow key={r.id} r={r} />)}
        {rows && !rows.length && <div className="muted small">No movements yet.</div>}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export function GateRow({ r }: { r: GateEntry }) {
  const tone = r.trade === 'IMPORT' ? 'import' : r.trade === 'EXPORT' ? 'export' : 'unladen';
  return (
    <button className="gate-row" onClick={() => { const s = useApp.getState(); s.select({ kind: 'truck', id: r.truckId }); setTimeout(() => s.camera({ kind: 'focus', ref: { kind: 'truck', id: r.truckId } }), 30); }}>
      <span className={`trade-dot ${tone}`}>{r.direction === 'IN' ? <ArrowDownToLine size={12} /> : <ArrowUpFromLine size={12} />}</span>
      <span className="gate-main"><b>{r.truckId}</b> <span className="muted">{carrierName(r.carrier)} · {r.facilityId}</span>
        <span className="gate-sub">{r.trade === 'EMPTY' ? 'empty truck' : `${r.trade === 'IMPORT' ? 'Import' : 'Export'} · ${r.pallets} pallets ${r.skuName ?? ''}`}</span></span>
      <span className="muted small">{fmtClock(r.simTime)}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

/** KPI card: goods that came into the park for this site today and goods that left. */
export function TradeKpi() {

      </div>

}

// Detail panels for the container terminal (terminal, ships, berths, quay cranes)
// and the town (vendor stores, delivery vans). Live state comes from the operations
// stream; actions and history go through the API to the database.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Anchor, Ship as ShipIcon, Container, Store as StoreIcon, Truck, Pause, Play, Lock, Unlock, PackagePlus, X as XIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import type { EntityRef, Store, StoreOrder, Vessel } from '../data/types';
import type { ContainerMoveRow, StoreOrderRow } from '../api/types';
import { SKUS } from '../data/seed';
import { YARD_CAPACITY, storeBuilding } from '../data/city';
import { findCompany } from '../data/parkClient';
import { api } from '../api/client';
import { getWorld, useApp } from '../store';
import { fmtClock, fmtNum, vesselActivity, vanActivity, storeHealth } from './derive';
import { Head, KV } from './ParkPanels';

const goTo = (ref: EntityRef) => {
  const s = useApp.getState();
  s.select(ref);
  setTimeout(() => s.camera({ kind: 'focus', ref }), 30);
};

function useAction() {
  const notify = useApp((s) => s.notify);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const run = async (fn: () => Promise<unknown>, ok: string) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try { await fn(); notify(ok); } catch (e) { notify((e as Error).message, 'error'); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return { busy, run };
}

function Bar({ value, tone }: { value: number; tone: string }) {
  return <span className={`bar tone-${tone}`}><span style={{ width: `${Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value)) * 100)}%` }} /></span>;
}

function MoveRow({ m }: { m: ContainerMoveRow }) {
  const label = m.move === 'DISCHARGE' ? 'Off ship' : m.move === 'LOAD' ? 'On ship' : m.move === 'GATE_OUT' ? 'Out by truck' : 'In by truck';
  const ref: EntityRef | null = m.truckId ? { kind: 'truck', id: m.truckId } : m.vesselId ? { kind: 'vessel', id: m.vesselId } : null;
  return (
    <button className="gate-row" onClick={() => ref && goTo(ref)} disabled={!ref}>
      <span className={`trade-dot ${m.move === 'DISCHARGE' || m.move === 'GATE_OUT' ? 'import' : 'export'}`}><Container size={12} /></span>
      <span className="gate-main"><b className="mono">{m.containerNo}</b> <span className="muted">{label}</span>
        <span className="gate-sub">{m.vesselName ?? m.truckId ?? 'other haulier'}{m.craneId ? ` · ${m.craneId}` : ''}{m.facilityId ? ` · ${m.facilityId}` : ''}</span></span>
      <span className="muted small">{fmtClock(m.simTime)}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the terminal (PB-PORT)
export function TerminalPanel() {
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const can = useApp((s) => s.can);
  const mode = useApp((s) => s.mode);
  const openWork = useApp((s) => s.openWork);
  const { busy, run } = useAction();
  const P = getWorld().port;
  if (!P) return null;
  const c = findCompany('PORTNWK');
  const manage = mode === 'live' && can('MANAGE_PORT');
  const order = ['BERTHED', 'BERTHING', 'ANCHORED', 'ARRIVING', 'DEPARTING', 'AT_SEA'];
  const ships = Object.values(P.vessels).sort((a, b) => order.indexOf(a.status) - order.indexOf(b.status));
  return (
    <>
      <Head icon={<Anchor size={20} />} kicker="CONTAINER TERMINAL · PB-PORT" title="Port Newark Container Terminal" sub={`${c?.name ?? 'Port Newark'} · 2 berths · 4 quay cranes`} focus={{ kind: 'building', id: 'PB-PORT' }} color={c?.color} />
      <div className="tiles">
        <div className="tile"><div className="tile-k">Import stack</div><div className="tile-v">{P.importStack.length} <span>/ {YARD_CAPACITY} boxes</span></div><Bar value={P.importStack.length / YARD_CAPACITY} tone="blue" /></div>
        <div className="tile"><div className="tile-k">Export stack</div><div className="tile-v">{P.exportStack.length} <span>/ {YARD_CAPACITY} boxes</span></div><Bar value={P.exportStack.length / YARD_CAPACITY} tone="orange" /></div>
        <div className="tile"><div className="tile-k">Crane moves today</div><div className="tile-v">{fmtNum(P.movesToday)}</div></div>
        <div className="tile"><div className="tile-k">Gate in / out</div><div className="tile-v">{P.gateInToday} <span>/ {P.gateOutToday}</span></div></div>
      </div>
      <div className="sec-head"><span>Berths</span><span className="muted">{P.callsToday} ship calls today</span></div>
      <div className="port-list">
        {Object.values(P.berths).map((b) => {
          const v = b.vesselId ? P.vessels[b.vesselId] : undefined;
          return (
            <div key={b.id} className="port-row">
              <button className="port-main" onClick={() => goTo({ kind: 'berth', id: b.id })}>
                <b>{b.name}</b>
                <span className="muted small">{!b.open ? 'Closed to new arrivals' : v ? `${v.name} · ${vesselActivity(getWorld(), v).badge.label}` : 'Free'}</span>
              </button>
              {manage && (
                <button className="btn-ghost sm" disabled={busy} title={b.open ? 'Close this berth to new ships' : 'Reopen this berth'}
                  onClick={() => { void run(() => api.openBerth(b.id, !b.open), `${b.name} ${b.open ? 'closed' : 'reopened'}`); }}>
                  {b.open ? <Lock size={13} /> : <Unlock size={13} />}{b.open ? 'Close' : 'Open'}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="sec-head"><span>Ships</span><span className="muted">click to follow</span></div>
      <div className="port-list">
        {ships.map((v) => <ShipRow key={v.id} v={v} />)}
      </div>
      <div className="sec-head"><span>Latest at the terminal</span>{mode === 'live' && <button className="link small" onClick={() => openWork('port')}>Container log</button>}</div>
      <div className="port-log">
        {P.log.slice(0, 7).map((e, i) => (
          <button key={`${e.t}-${i}`} className="log-row" onClick={() => e.ref && goTo(e.ref)}><span className="muted small">{fmtClock(e.t)}</span><span>{e.text}</span></button>
        ))}
        {!P.log.length && <div className="muted small">Cranes and gates are working; new events appear here.</div>}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function ShipRow({ v }: { v: Vessel }) {
  const a = vesselActivity(getWorld(), v);
  return (
    <button className="port-row ship" onClick={() => (v.status === 'AT_SEA' ? useApp.getState().select({ kind: 'vessel', id: v.id }) : goTo({ kind: 'vessel', id: v.id }))}>
      <span className="ship-swatch" style={{ background: v.color }} />
      <span className="port-main"><b>{v.name}</b><span className="muted small">{a.text}</span></span>
      <span className={`badge sm tone-${a.badge.tone}`}>{a.badge.label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- one ship
export function VesselPanel({ id }: { id: string }) {
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const can = useApp((s) => s.can);
  const mode = useApp((s) => s.mode);
  const { busy, run } = useAction();
  const [moves, setMoves] = useState<ContainerMoveRow[] | null>(null);
  const w = getWorld();
  const v = w.port?.vessels[id];
  const movesKey = v ? v.discharged + v.loaded : 0;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== 'live') return;
    let alive = true;
    api.portMoves({ vessel: id, limit: 6 }).then((r) => { if (alive) setMoves(r); }).catch(() => setMoves([]));
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [id, mode, movesKey]);
  if (!v) return null;
  const a = vesselActivity(w, v);
  const aboard = v.through + v.importBoxes + v.exportBoxes;
  const berth = v.berthId ? w.port.berths[v.berthId] : undefined;
  return (
    <>
      <Head icon={<ShipIcon size={20} />} kicker={`CONTAINER SHIP · ${v.imo}`} title={v.name} sub={`${v.line} · ${v.flag} flag`} focus={{ kind: 'vessel', id }} color={v.color} />
      <div className="status-line"><span className={`badge tone-${a.badge.tone}`}>{a.badge.label}</span><span>{a.text}</span></div>
      <div className="prog"><Bar value={a.progress} tone="blue" /><span className="muted">voyage {v.voyage}</span></div>
      <KV rows={[
        ['From', v.origin],
        ['Next port', v.nextPort],
        ['Berth', berth ? <button key="b" className="link" onClick={() => goTo({ kind: 'berth', id: berth.id })}>{berth.name}</button> : v.status === 'ANCHORED' ? 'At anchor in the bay' : '—'],
        ['Boxes aboard', `${aboard} of ${v.capacity} (${v.through} for other ports)`],
        ['Discharged here', `${v.discharged}${v.importBoxes ? ` · ${v.importBoxes} to go` : ''}`],
        ['Loaded here', `${v.loaded} of ${v.exportTarget} booked`],
        ['Alongside since', v.arrivedAt !== null && (v.status === 'BERTHED' || v.status === 'DEPARTING') ? fmtClock(v.arrivedAt) : '—'],
        ['Port calls', fmtNum(v.calls)],
      ]} />
      {mode === 'live' && can('MANAGE_PORT') && v.status !== 'DEPARTING' && (
        <button className={`btn-ghost sm park-edit ${v.hold ? 'on' : ''}`} disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => { void run(() => api.holdVessel(v.id, !v.hold), `${v.name} ${v.hold ? 'released' : 'is on hold'}`); }}>
          {v.hold ? <Play size={13} /> : <Pause size={13} />}{v.hold ? 'Release ship' : v.status === 'BERTHED' ? 'Hold alongside' : 'Hold at sea / anchor'}
        </button>
      )}
      {mode === 'live' && (
        <>
          <div className="sec-head"><span>Latest container moves</span></div>
          <div className="gate-rows">
            {(moves ?? []).map((m) => <MoveRow key={m.id} m={m} />)}
            {moves && !moves.length && <div className="muted small">No boxes moved on this call yet.</div>}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export function CranePanel({ id }: { id: string }) {
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const P = getWorld().port;
  const c = P?.cranes[id];
  if (!c) return null;
  const b = P.berths[c.berthId];
  const v = b?.vesselId ? P.vessels[b.vesselId] : undefined;
  const label = c.phase === 'idle' ? 'Idle' : c.phase === 'discharge' ? 'Discharging' : 'Loading';
  return (
    <>
      <Head icon={<Container size={20} />} kicker="SHIP-TO-SHORE CRANE" title={`Quay crane ${c.id}`} sub={`${b?.name ?? c.berthId} · 65 t spreader`} focus={{ kind: 'crane', id }} color="#e03131" />
      <div className="status-line"><span className={`badge tone-${c.phase === 'idle' ? 'grey' : c.phase === 'discharge' ? 'indigo' : 'green'}`}>{label}</span>
        <span>{c.phase === 'idle' ? (v ? `Waiting · ${v.name}` : 'No ship at this berth') : c.phase === 'discharge' ? `Lifting boxes off ${v?.name ?? 'the ship'} into the import stack` : `Loading export boxes onto ${v?.name ?? 'the ship'}`}</span></div>
      {c.phase !== 'idle' && <div className="prog"><Bar value={c.cycle} tone="blue" /><span className="muted">this move</span></div>}
      <KV rows={[
        ['Berth', <button key="b" className="link" onClick={() => goTo({ kind: 'berth', id: c.berthId })}>{b?.name ?? c.berthId}</button>],
        ['Ship', v ? <button key="v" className="link" onClick={() => goTo({ kind: 'vessel', id: v.id })}>{v.name}</button> : '—'],
        ['Moves today', fmtNum(c.movesToday)],
        ['Cycle time', 'about 1 container per minute'],
      ]} />
    </>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- vendor stores
export function StorePanel({ id }: { id: string }) {
  useApp((s) => s.tick);
  const can = useApp((s) => s.can);
  const mode = useApp((s) => s.mode);
  const w = getWorld();
  const st = w.retail?.stores[id];
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<StoreOrderRow[] | null>(null);
  const [ordering, setOrdering] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [units, setUnits] = useState('');
  const { busy, run } = useAction();
  const delivered = st?.deliveriesToday ?? 0;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== 'live') return;
    let alive = true;
    api.storeOrders({ store: id, limit: 6 }).then((r) => { if (alive) setHistory(r); }).catch(() => setHistory([]));
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [id, mode, delivered]);
  useEffect(() => { setOrdering(null); }, [id]);
  if (!st) return null;
  const b = storeBuilding(id);
  const c = b ? findCompany(b.companyId) : undefined;
  const health = storeHealth(st);
  const open = Object.values(w.retail.orders).filter((o) => o.storeId === id && (o.status === 'PLACED' || o.status === 'LOADING' || o.status === 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY'));
  const manage = mode === 'live' && can('MANAGE_RETAIL');
  return (
    <>
      <Head icon={<StoreIcon size={20} />} kicker={`${st.kind} · ${st.id}`} title={st.name} sub={`${b?.street ?? 'Market Street'} · Port Harbor`} focus={b ? { kind: 'building', id: b.id } : { kind: 'store', id }} color={c?.color} />
      <div className="status-line"><span className={`badge tone-${health.badge.tone}`}>{health.badge.label}</span><span>Supplied by {w.facilities[st.facilityId]?.name ?? st.facilityId} · {st.deliveriesToday} deliveries today</span></div>
      <div className="sec-head"><span>Shelf stock</span><span className="muted">reorders automatically at the line</span></div>
      <div className="shelf">
        {st.lines.map((l) => {
          const sku = SKUS[l.skuId];
          const o = open.find((x) => x.skuId === l.skuId);
          const tone = l.units === 0 ? 'orange' : l.units <= l.reorderAt ? 'yellow' : 'green';
          return (
            <div key={l.skuId} className="shelf-row">
              <div className="shelf-top">
                <b>{sku?.name ?? l.skuId}</b>
                <span className="muted small">{l.units} / {l.maxUnits}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="shelf-bar">
                <Bar value={l.units / l.maxUnits} tone={tone} />
                <i className="reorder-mark" style={{ left: `${(l.reorderAt / l.maxUnits) * 100}%` }} title={`Reorder at ${l.reorderAt}`} />
              </div>
              <div className="shelf-sub muted small">
                <span>{l.soldToday} sold today · {Math.round(l.salesPerHour)}/h</span>
                {o ? <OrderChip o={o} /> : manage && ordering !== l.skuId && (
                  <button className="link small" onClick={() => { setOrdering(l.skuId); setUnits(String(Math.max(5, Math.ceil((l.maxUnits - l.units) / 5) * 5))); }}><PackagePlus size={12} /> Restock</button>
                )}
              </div>
              {ordering === l.skuId && !o && (
                <div className="restock">
                  <input className="inp" type="number" min={1} max={l.maxUnits * 2} value={units} onChange={(e) => setUnits(e.target.value)} aria-label="Units to order" />
                  <span className="muted small">units</span>
                  <button className="btn-ghost sm" onClick={() => setOrdering(null)}>Cancel</button>
                  <button className="btn-primary sm" disabled={busy || !(Number(units) > 0)}
                    onClick={() => { void run(async () => { await api.placeStoreOrder({ storeId: id, skuId: l.skuId, units: Number(units) }); setOrdering(null); }, `Order placed for ${st.name}`); }}>
                    Order
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {open.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div className="sec-head"><span>On the way</span></div>
          <div className="port-list">
            {open.map((o) => <OpenOrder key={o.id} o={o} manage={manage} busy={busy} run={run} />)}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {mode === 'live' && (
        <>
          <div className="sec-head"><span>Recent orders</span></div>
          <div className="gate-rows">
            {(history ?? []).map((r) => (
              <div key={r.id} className="order-row">
                <span className="mono small">{r.id}</span>
                <span>{r.units} × {SKUS[r.skuId]?.name ?? r.skuId}<span className="muted small"> · {r.facilityId}{r.source === 'MANUAL' ? ` · by ${r.placedBy ?? 'manager'}` : ''}</span></span>
                <span className={`badge sm tone-${r.status === 'DELIVERED' ? 'green' : r.status === 'CANCELLED' ? 'grey' : 'blue'}`}>{r.status.replace(/_/g, ' ').toLowerCase()}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
            {history && !history.length && <div className="muted small">No orders yet.</div>}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function OrderChip({ o }: { o: StoreOrder }) {
  const label = o.status === 'PLACED' ? 'ordered' : o.status === 'LOADING' ? 'loading' : 'on the way';
  return <span className="order-chip">{o.units} {label}</span>;
}

function OpenOrder({ o, manage, busy, run }: { o: StoreOrder; manage: boolean; busy: boolean; run: (fn: () => Promise<unknown>, ok: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  const w = getWorld();
  const van = o.vanId ? w.retail.vans[o.vanId] : undefined;
  return (
    <div className="port-row">
      <button className="port-main" onClick={() => van && van.status !== 'IDLE' && goTo({ kind: 'van', id: van.id })}>
        <b>{o.units} × {SKUS[o.skuId]?.name ?? o.skuId}</b>
        <span className="muted small">{o.id} · from {o.facilityId}{van ? ` · ${van.id} (${vanActivity(w, van).badge.label.toLowerCase()})` : ' · waiting for a van'}</span>
      </button>
      {manage && o.status === 'PLACED' && (
        <button className="sq plain" title="Cancel order" aria-label="Cancel order" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { void run(() => api.cancelStoreOrder(o.id), `${o.id} cancelled`); }}><XIcon size={14} /></button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
